```python
# ai_caddie/rounds/reducer_v2.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
from heapq import heappop, heappush
import re
from typing import Any, Iterable, Mapping

from ai_caddie.contracts.generated import PROJECTION_AUTHORITIES, ProjectionAuthority
from ai_caddie.contracts.typed_ids import typed_id
from .ledger_models import RoundEventEnvelopeV2, validate_event_payload


REDUCER_VERSION = "round-reducer-v2"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ProjectionInput:
    event: RoundEventEnvelopeV2
    authority: ProjectionAuthority
    ledger_partition_id: str | None
    ledger_position: str | None
    source_ordinal: int = 0

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.authority not in PROJECTION_AUTHORITIES:
            raise ValueError("projection authority invalid")
        if self.authority == "canonicalReplay":
            if (
                self.ledger_partition_id is None
                or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", self.ledger_partition_id) is None
                or self.ledger_position is None
                or not self.ledger_position.isascii()
                or not self.ledger_position.isdecimal()
                or self.ledger_position.startswith("0")
            ):
                raise ValueError("canonical projection input requires decimal-string position")
        elif self.ledger_partition_id is not None or self.ledger_position is not None:
            raise ValueError("provisional projection input cannot claim canonical coordinate")

    @property
    def is_canonical(self) -> bool:
        return self.authority == "canonicalReplay"

    @classmethod
    def from_fixture(cls, row: Mapping[str, Any]) -> "ProjectionInput":
        order = row["projectionOrder"]
        if set(order) != {"authority", "ledgerPartitionId", "ledgerPosition", "sourceOrdinal"}:
            raise ValueError("projectionOrder exact-key mismatch")
        return cls(
            event=RoundEventEnvelopeV2.model_validate(row["event"]),
            authority=order["authority"],
            ledger_partition_id=order.get("ledgerPartitionId"),
            ledger_position=order.get("ledgerPosition"),
            source_ordinal=int(order.get("sourceOrdinal", 0)),
        )

    @property
    def stable_key(self) -> tuple[int, int, str, str]:
        return (
            0 if self.is_canonical else 1,
            self.source_ordinal,
            self.event.event_identity(),
            self.event.event_hash(),
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class EntityRevisionToken:
    scope_id: str
    reducer_version: str
    canonical_ordinal: int
    entity_projection_hash: str
    contributing_event_set_hash: str
    provisional_flag: bool

    @classmethod
    def from_wire(cls, value: Any) -> "EntityRevisionToken | None":
        if value is None:
            return None
        raw = value.model_dump(mode="json") if hasattr(value, "model_dump") else value
        return cls(
            scope_id=raw["scopeId"], reducer_version=raw["reducerVersion"],
            canonical_ordinal=int(raw["canonicalOrdinal"]), entity_projection_hash=raw["entityProjectionHash"],
            contributing_event_set_hash=raw["contributingEventSetHash"], provisional_flag=bool(raw["provisionalFlag"]),
        )

    def equivalent_base(self, other: "EntityRevisionToken") -> bool:
        return (
            self.scope_id,
            self.reducer_version,
            self.entity_projection_hash,
            self.contributing_event_set_hash,
        ) == (
            other.scope_id,
            other.reducer_version,
            other.entity_projection_hash,
            other.contributing_event_set_hash,
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class EntityState:
    value: Any
    revision: EntityRevisionToken
    contributing_event_ids: tuple[str, ...]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class HoleProjection:
    score: int | None = None
    putts: int | None = None
    penalties: int | None = None
    fairway: str | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ShotProjection:
    shot_id: str
    hole: int
    latitude: float
    longitude: float
    horizontal_accuracy_m: float | None
    lie: str
    provenance: str
    actual_club_id: str | None = None
    retracted: bool = False


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ShotTargetProjection:
    shot_id: str
    target_ref: str
    latitude: float
    longitude: float
    provenance: str
    orphaned: bool
    retracted: bool = False


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FlagPositionProjection:
    hole: int
    latitude: float
    longitude: float
    provenance: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RoundProjectionV2:
    lifecycle: str = "draft"
    replication: str = "clean"
    holes: dict[int, HoleProjection] = field(default_factory=dict)
    shots: dict[str, ShotProjection] = field(default_factory=dict)
    shot_targets: dict[str, ShotTargetProjection] = field(default_factory=dict)
    flag_positions: dict[int, FlagPositionProjection] = field(default_factory=dict)
    resolutions: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    resolution_scopes: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict, repr=False)
    merge_control: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    conflicts: tuple[dict[str, Any], ...] = ()
    entity_states: dict[str, EntityState] = field(default_factory=dict, repr=False)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "lifecycle": self.lifecycle,
            "replication": self.replication,
            "holes": {str(key): {"score": value.score, "putts": value.putts, "penalties": value.penalties, "fairway": value.fairway} for key, value in sorted(self.holes.items())},
            "shots": {
                key: {
                    "shotId": value.shot_id, "hole": value.hole,
                    "latitude": value.latitude, "longitude": value.longitude,
                    "horizontalAccuracyM": value.horizontal_accuracy_m,
                    "lie": value.lie, "provenance": value.provenance,
                    "actualClubId": value.actual_club_id, "retracted": value.retracted,
                }
                for key, value in sorted(self.shots.items())
            },
            "shotTargets": {
                key: {
                    "shotId": value.shot_id, "targetRef": value.target_ref,
                    "latitude": value.latitude, "longitude": value.longitude,
                    "provenance": value.provenance, "orphaned": value.orphaned,
                    "retracted": value.retracted,
                }
                for key, value in sorted(self.shot_targets.items())
            },
            "flagPositions": {
                str(key): {
                    "hole": value.hole, "latitude": value.latitude,
                    "longitude": value.longitude, "provenance": value.provenance,
                }
                for key, value in sorted(self.flag_positions.items())
            },
            "resolutions": dict(sorted(self.resolutions.items())),
            "mergeControl": self.merge_control,
            "conflicts": list(self.conflicts),
            "entityRevisions": {
                key: {
                    "scopeId": value.revision.scope_id,
                    "reducerVersion": value.revision.reducer_version,
                    "canonicalOrdinal": value.revision.canonical_ordinal,
                    "entityProjectionHash": value.revision.entity_projection_hash,
                    "contributingEventSetHash": value.revision.contributing_event_set_hash,
                    "provisionalFlag": value.revision.provisional_flag,
                }
                for key, value in sorted(self.entity_states.items())
            },
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ReplicationContext:
    pending_count: int = 0
    awaiting_canonical_replay_count: int = 0
    syncing: bool = False
    dead_letter_count: int = 0
    canonical_prefix_event_ids: frozenset[str] = frozenset()


def _projection_hash(value: Any) -> str:
    return typed_id("EntityProjection/v1", {"value": value})


def _event_set_hash(event_ids: Iterable[str]) -> str:
    return typed_id("ContributingEventSet/v1", {"eventIds": sorted(set(event_ids))})


def _absent(scope_id: str) -> EntityState:
    return EntityState(
        value=None,
        revision=EntityRevisionToken(scope_id, REDUCER_VERSION, 0, _projection_hash(None), _event_set_hash([]), True),
        contributing_event_ids=(),
    )


def _decimal_order(value: str) -> tuple[int, str]:
    return (len(value), value)


def projection_order(
    events: Iterable[ProjectionInput], *, known_cause_ids: frozenset[str]
) -> list[ProjectionInput]:
    precedence = {
        "peerProvisional": 0,
        "localPreparedResolutionCommit": 1,
        "localProvisional": 2,
        "acceptedAwaitingReplay": 3,
        "localTerminalFallback": 4,
        "canonicalReplay": 5,
    }
    selected: dict[str, ProjectionInput] = {}
    canonical_coordinates: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {}
    canonical_identities: set[str] = set()
    for item in events:
        identity = item.event.event_identity()
        event_hash = item.event.event_hash()
        validation_error = validate_event_payload(item.event)
        if validation_error is not None:
            raise ValueError(validation_error)
        if item.is_canonical:
            assert item.ledger_partition_id is not None and item.ledger_position is not None
            coordinate = (item.ledger_partition_id, item.ledger_position)
            if coordinate in canonical_coordinates:
                raise ValueError("replay_duplicate_coordinate")
            canonical_coordinates[coordinate] = identity
            if identity in canonical_identities:
                raise ValueError("replay_duplicate_identity")
            canonical_identities.add(identity)
        prior = selected.get(identity)
        if prior is not None and prior.event.event_hash() != event_hash:
            raise ValueError("identity_envelope_mismatch")
        if prior is not None and prior.is_canonical and item.is_canonical:
            raise ValueError("replay_duplicate_identity")
        if (
            prior is not None
            and not prior.is_canonical
            and not item.is_canonical
            and prior.authority == item.authority
        ):
            raise ValueError("projection_duplicate_identity")
        if prior is None or precedence[item.authority] > precedence[prior.authority]:
            selected[identity] = item

    by_node = dict(selected)
    incoming = {node: 0 for node in by_node}
    outgoing: dict[str, set[str]] = {node: set() for node in by_node}

    def edge(before: str, after: str) -> None:
        if before != after and after not in outgoing[before]:
            outgoing[before].add(after)
            incoming[after] += 1

    by_partition: dict[str, list[tuple[str, ProjectionInput]]] = {}
    for node, item in by_node.items():
        if item.is_canonical:
            assert item.ledger_partition_id is not None and item.ledger_position is not None
            by_partition.setdefault(item.ledger_partition_id, []).append((node, item))
        cause = item.event.causationId
        base = EntityRevisionToken.from_wire(item.event.baseEntityRevision)
        if (
            base is not None
            and (
                base.canonical_ordinal > 0
                or base.contributing_event_set_hash != _event_set_hash([])
            )
            and cause is None
        ):
            raise ValueError("replay_base_dependency_unresolved")
        if cause is not None:
            if cause in by_node:
                cause_input = by_node[cause]
                if item.is_canonical and not cause_input.is_canonical:
                    raise ValueError("replay_canonical_depends_on_provisional")
                edge(cause, node)
            elif cause not in known_cause_ids:
                raise ValueError("replay_cause_missing")
    for rows in by_partition.values():
        rows.sort(key=lambda pair: _decimal_order(pair[1].ledger_position or "0"))
        for (left, _), (right, _) in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
            edge(left, right)

    ready: list[tuple[tuple[int, int, str, str], str]] = []
    for node, count in incoming.items():
        if count == 0:
            heappush(ready, (by_node[node].stable_key, node))
    ordered: list[ProjectionInput] = []
    while ready:
        _, node = heappop(ready)
        ordered.append(by_node[node])
        for target in sorted(outgoing[node]):
            incoming[target] -= 1
            if incoming[target] == 0:
                heappush(ready, (by_node[target].stable_key, target))
    if len(ordered) != len(by_node):
        raise ValueError("projection_dependency_cycle")
    return ordered


def _conflict(projection: RoundProjectionV2, event: RoundEventEnvelopeV2, current: EntityState, reason: str) -> RoundProjectionV2:
    conflict = {
        "entityRef": event.entityRef,
        "eventId": event.eventId,
        "eventIdentity": event.event_identity(),
        "currentRevision": {
            "scopeId": current.revision.scope_id,
            "reducerVersion": current.revision.reducer_version,
            "canonicalOrdinal": current.revision.canonical_ordinal,
            "entityProjectionHash": current.revision.entity_projection_hash,
            "contributingEventSetHash": current.revision.contributing_event_set_hash,
            "provisionalFlag": current.revision.provisional_flag,
        },
        "providedBase": None if event.baseEntityRevision is None else event.baseEntityRevision.model_dump(mode="json"),
        "reasonCode": reason,
    }
    return replace(projection, conflicts=projection.conflicts + (conflict,))


def _set_entity(
    projection: RoundProjectionV2,
    item: ProjectionInput,
    *,
    scope_id: str,
    value: Any,
) -> RoundProjectionV2:
    event = item.event
    if isinstance(value, dict) and value == {"state": "unset"}:
        return projection
    current = projection.entity_states.get(scope_id, _absent(scope_id))
    provided = EntityRevisionToken.from_wire(event.baseEntityRevision)
    if provided is None or not provided.equivalent_base(current.revision):
        return _conflict(projection, event, current, "entity_base_revision_conflict")
    contributors = tuple(sorted(set(current.contributing_event_ids + (event.event_identity(),))))
    revision = EntityRevisionToken(
        scope_id=scope_id, reducer_version=REDUCER_VERSION,
        canonical_ordinal=current.revision.canonical_ordinal + (1 if item.is_canonical else 0),
        entity_projection_hash=_projection_hash(value),
        contributing_event_set_hash=_event_set_hash(contributors),
        provisional_flag=not item.is_canonical,
    )
    entities = dict(projection.entity_states)
    entities[scope_id] = EntityState(value=value, revision=revision, contributing_event_ids=contributors)
    return replace(projection, entity_states=entities)


def _create_entity(
    projection: RoundProjectionV2,
    item: ProjectionInput,
    *,
    value: Any,
) -> RoundProjectionV2:
    event = item.event
    current = projection.entity_states.get(event.entityRef)
    if current is not None:
        return _conflict(projection, event, current, "shot_identity_conflict")
    contributors = (event.event_identity(),)
    revision = EntityRevisionToken(
        scope_id=event.entityRef, reducer_version=REDUCER_VERSION,
        canonical_ordinal=1 if item.is_canonical else 0,
        entity_projection_hash=_projection_hash(value),
        contributing_event_set_hash=_event_set_hash(contributors),
        provisional_flag=not item.is_canonical,
    )
    entities = dict(projection.entity_states)
    entities[event.entityRef] = EntityState(value=value, revision=revision, contributing_event_ids=contributors)
    return replace(projection, entity_states=entities)


def _apply_hole_fact(
    projection: RoundProjectionV2,
    item: ProjectionInput,
    field_name: str,
    payload_name: str,
) -> RoundProjectionV2:
    event = item.event
    hole = int(event.payload["hole"])
    updated = _set_entity(projection, item, scope_id=event.entityRef, value=event.payload[payload_name])
    if updated is projection or len(updated.conflicts) > len(projection.conflicts):
        return updated
    value = updated.entity_states[event.entityRef].value
    holes = dict(updated.holes)
    holes[hole] = replace(holes.get(hole, HoleProjection()), **{field_name: value})
    return replace(updated, holes=holes)


def apply_event(projection: RoundProjectionV2, item: ProjectionInput) -> RoundProjectionV2:
    event = item.event
    if event.kind == "round_merge_resolution":
        revision = int(event.payload["revision"])
        if projection.merge_control is not None and revision <= int(projection.merge_control["revision"]):
            return _conflict(
                projection, event,
                projection.entity_states.get(event.entityRef, _absent(event.entityRef)),
                "entity_base_revision_conflict",
            )
        updated = _set_entity(projection, item, scope_id=event.entityRef, value=event.payload)
        if len(updated.conflicts) > len(projection.conflicts): return updated
        return replace(updated, merge_control=dict(event.payload))
    lifecycle_targets = {
        "round_started": "active", "round_suspended": "suspended", "round_resumed": "active",
        "round_finished": "finished", "round_discarded": "discarded",
    }
    legal_lifecycle_events = {
        "draft": {"round_started"},
        "active": {"round_suspended", "round_finished", "round_discarded"},
        "suspended": {"round_resumed", "round_finished", "round_discarded"},
        "finished": set(),
        "discarded": set(),
    }
    if event.kind in lifecycle_targets:
        if event.kind not in legal_lifecycle_events[projection.lifecycle]:
            return _conflict(
                projection,
                event,
                projection.entity_states.get(event.entityRef, _absent(event.entityRef)),
                "illegal_lifecycle_transition",
            )
        target = lifecycle_targets[event.kind]
        if event.kind == "round_started":
            return replace(projection, lifecycle=target)
        updated = _set_entity(projection, item, scope_id=event.entityRef, value=target)
        return updated if len(updated.conflicts) > len(projection.conflicts) else replace(updated, lifecycle=target)
    if event.kind == "hole_score_set": return _apply_hole_fact(projection, item, "score", "strokes")
    if event.kind == "putts_set": return _apply_hole_fact(projection, item, "putts", "putts")
    if event.kind == "penalties_set": return _apply_hole_fact(projection, item, "penalties", "penalties")
    if event.kind == "fairway_set": return _apply_hole_fact(projection, item, "fairway", "fairway")
    if event.kind == "flag_position_set":
        hole = int(event.payload["hole"])
        latitude = float(event.payload["latitude"])
        longitude = float(event.payload["longitude"])
        if not 1 <= hole <= 18 or event.payload.get("provenance") != "player_set":
            raise ValueError("flag_position_not_player_set")
        if not -90 <= latitude <= 90 or not -180 <= longitude <= 180:
            raise ValueError("payload_schema_invalid")
        value = {
            "hole": hole, "latitude": latitude,
            "longitude": longitude, "provenance": event.payload["provenance"],
        }
        updated = _set_entity(projection, item, scope_id=event.entityRef, value=value)
        if len(updated.conflicts) > len(projection.conflicts): return updated
        flags = dict(updated.flag_positions)
        flags[hole] = FlagPositionProjection(**value)
        return replace(updated, flag_positions=flags)
    if event.kind == "shot_target_set":
        shot_id = event.payload["shotId"]
        provenance = event.payload.get("provenance")
        latitude = float(event.payload["latitude"])
        longitude = float(event.payload["longitude"])
        if provenance not in {"player_confirmed", "explicit_touch_target"}:
            raise ValueError("shot_target_not_player_confirmed")
        if not -90 <= latitude <= 90 or not -180 <= longitude <= 180:
            raise ValueError("payload_schema_invalid")
        value = {
            "shotId": shot_id, "targetRef": event.payload["targetRef"],
            "latitude": latitude, "longitude": longitude,
            "provenance": provenance, "retracted": False,
        }
        updated = _set_entity(projection, item, scope_id=event.entityRef, value=value)
        if len(updated.conflicts) > len(projection.conflicts): return updated
        targets = dict(updated.shot_targets)
        targets[shot_id] = ShotTargetProjection(
            shot_id=shot_id, target_ref=value["targetRef"], latitude=value["latitude"],
            longitude=value["longitude"], provenance=value["provenance"],
            orphaned=shot_id not in updated.shots,
        )
        return replace(updated, shot_targets=targets)
    if event.kind == "shot_target_retracted":
        shot_id = event.payload["shotId"]
        current = projection.entity_states.get(event.entityRef)
        target = projection.shot_targets.get(shot_id)
        if current is None or target is None:
            return _conflict(projection, event, current or _absent(event.entityRef), "shot_target_orphaned")
        value = dict(current.value); value["retracted"] = True
        updated = _set_entity(projection, item, scope_id=event.entityRef, value=value)
        if len(updated.conflicts) > len(projection.conflicts): return updated
        targets = dict(updated.shot_targets); targets[shot_id] = replace(target, retracted=True)
        return replace(updated, shot_targets=targets)
    if event.kind == "shot_recorded":
        shot_id = event.payload["shotId"]
        if shot_id in projection.shots: return _conflict(projection, event, projection.entity_states.get(event.entityRef, _absent(event.entityRef)), "shot_identity_conflict")
        value = {
            "shotId": shot_id, "hole": int(event.payload["hole"]),
            "latitude": float(event.payload["latitude"]), "longitude": float(event.payload["longitude"]),
            "horizontalAccuracyM": event.payload.get("horizontalAccuracyM"),
            "lie": event.payload["lie"], "provenance": event.payload["provenance"], "retracted": False,
        }
        updated = _create_entity(projection, item, value=value)
        if len(updated.conflicts) > len(projection.conflicts): return updated
        shots = dict(updated.shots)
        shots[shot_id] = ShotProjection(
            shot_id=shot_id, hole=value["hole"], latitude=value["latitude"], longitude=value["longitude"],
            horizontal_accuracy_m=value["horizontalAccuracyM"], lie=value["lie"], provenance=value["provenance"],
        )
        targets = dict(updated.shot_targets)
        if shot_id in targets:
            targets[shot_id] = replace(targets[shot_id], orphaned=False)
        return replace(updated, shots=shots, shot_targets=targets)
    if event.kind == "actual_club_set":
        shot_id = event.payload["shotId"]
        if shot_id not in projection.shots: return _conflict(projection, event, _absent(event.entityRef), "shot_identity_conflict")
        updated = _set_entity(projection, item, scope_id=event.entityRef, value=event.payload["clubId"])
        if len(updated.conflicts) > len(projection.conflicts): return updated
        shots = dict(updated.shots); shots[shot_id] = replace(shots[shot_id], actual_club_id=updated.entity_states[event.entityRef].value)
        return replace(updated, shots=shots)
    if event.kind == "shot_fact_corrected":
        shot_id = event.payload["shotId"]
        current = projection.entity_states.get(event.entityRef)
        if current is None or shot_id not in projection.shots: return _conflict(projection, event, current or _absent(event.entityRef), "shot_identity_conflict")
        patch = event.payload["patch"]
        value = dict(current.value); value.update(patch)
        updated = _set_entity(projection, item, scope_id=event.entityRef, value=value)
        if len(updated.conflicts) > len(projection.conflicts): return updated
        swift_to_python = {
            "latitude": "latitude", "longitude": "longitude", "horizontalAccuracyM": "horizontal_accuracy_m",
            "lie": "lie", "provenance": "provenance",
        }
        changes = {swift_to_python[key]: value for key, value in patch.items()}
        shots = dict(updated.shots); shots[shot_id] = replace(shots[shot_id], **changes)
        return replace(updated, shots=shots)
    if event.kind == "shot_retracted":
        shot_id = event.payload["shotId"]
        current = projection.entity_states.get(event.entityRef)
        if current is None or shot_id not in projection.shots: return _conflict(projection, event, current or _absent(event.entityRef), "shot_identity_conflict")
        value = dict(current.value); value["retracted"] = True
        updated = _set_entity(projection, item, scope_id=event.entityRef, value=value)
        if len(updated.conflicts) > len(projection.conflicts): return updated
        shots = dict(updated.shots); shots[shot_id] = replace(shots[shot_id], retracted=True)
        return replace(updated, shots=shots)
    if event.kind == "resolution_opened":
        resolution_id = event.payload["resolutionId"]
        scope_id = event.payload["scopeId"]
        if resolution_id in projection.resolutions:
            return _conflict(
                projection, event,
                projection.entity_states.get(event.entityRef, _absent(event.entityRef)),
                "resolution_episode_conflict",
            )
        same_scope_nonterminal = sorted(
            candidate_id
            for candidate_id, state in projection.resolutions.items()
            if projection.resolution_scopes[candidate_id] == scope_id
            and state in {"active", "conflicted"}
        )
        updated = _set_entity(
            projection, item, scope_id=event.entityRef,
            value={"state": "active", "scopeId": scope_id},
        )
        if len(updated.conflicts) > len(projection.conflicts): return updated
        resolutions = dict(updated.resolutions)
        resolutions[resolution_id] = "conflicted" if same_scope_nonterminal else "active"
        for candidate_id in same_scope_nonterminal:
            resolutions[candidate_id] = "conflicted"
        scopes = dict(updated.resolution_scopes); scopes[resolution_id] = scope_id
        updated = replace(updated, resolutions=resolutions, resolution_scopes=scopes)
        if same_scope_nonterminal:
            updated = _conflict(
                updated, event, updated.entity_states[event.entityRef],
                "resolution_episode_conflict",
            )
        return updated
    if event.kind == "resolution_closed":
        resolution_id = event.payload["resolutionId"]
        if projection.resolutions.get(resolution_id) != "active":
            return _conflict(
                projection, event,
                projection.entity_states.get(event.entityRef, _absent(event.entityRef)),
                "resolution_episode_conflict",
            )
        updated = _set_entity(
            projection, item, scope_id=event.entityRef,
            value={"state": event.payload["disposition"], "scopeId": projection.resolution_scopes[resolution_id]},
        )
        if len(updated.conflicts) > len(projection.conflicts): return updated
        resolutions = dict(updated.resolutions); resolutions[resolution_id] = event.payload["disposition"]
        return replace(updated, resolutions=resolutions)
    return projection


def reduce_round(events: Iterable[ProjectionInput], *, replication: ReplicationContext) -> RoundProjectionV2:
    projection = RoundProjectionV2()
    for ordered in projection_order(
        events,
        known_cause_ids=replication.canonical_prefix_event_ids,
    ):
        projection = apply_event(projection, ordered)
    replication_state = (
        "conflict" if projection.conflicts else "deadLetter" if replication.dead_letter_count
        else "syncing" if replication.syncing
        else "dirty" if (
            replication.pending_count or replication.awaiting_canonical_replay_count
        ) else "clean"
    )
    projection = replace(projection, replication=replication_state)
    return projection
```

Golden fixture 的每项只有两个字段：`event` 必须通过 `RoundEventEnvelopeV2.model_validate()`，`projectionOrder` 必须通过 `ProjectionInput.from_fixture()`；checked-in 五份 fixtures 与本 task/Task 10 的参数化测试共同锁定其完整 bytes。`shotCorrection.patch` 的 JSON schema 把 key allowlist 固定为 `latitude/longitude/horizontalAccuracyM/lie/provenance` 且 `additionalProperties=false`；所有 operation 都通过 registry 名称表进入上述显式 handler，unknown/opaque event 保留在 ledger 但 reducer no-op。

`round_sync_v2.schema.json` owns strict `$defs` for `DeviceSyncStreamV2`, `CanonicalOriginEvidenceV1`, `DeviceReplayEventV2`, `DeviceSyncBootstrapV2`, `DeviceReplayPageV2`, `DeviceAckRequestV2`, `DeviceAckResponseV2` and exact `{code}` error envelopes. Every object uses `additionalProperties:false`; all ledger positions are bounded canonical decimal strings (`0...9223372036854775807` where zero is allowed, positive-only for replayed event coordinates), partition/hash fields are lowercase hex64, source ordinals and vector generations are bounded integers。`DeviceReplayPageV2.events[*]`引用`DeviceReplayEventV2`，后者同时携带current materialization的generated `ProjectionInput/v1`与immutable `canonicalOrigin`；origin字段冻结event identity/hash、owner、stream subject、首次partition/epoch/stream/position和recomputable `CanonicalOriginProof/v1`。Register `DeviceSyncBootstrap/v2`, `DeviceReplayPage/v2` and `DeviceAck/v2`; generator emits Python declarations plus Swift/TypeScript strict decoders named `validateDeviceSyncBootstrap`, `validateDeviceReplayPage`, and `validateDeviceAckResponse`. The golden fixture contains one standalone bootstrap, one merged bootstrap, one replay page with non-equal origin/current partition after compaction, one ACK request/response and exact 409/422 code envelopes；Python/Swift/Web mutation tests拒绝integer/leading-zero/overflow position、duplicate/unknown keys、bad stream subject、gapped coordinates、string vector generation、非`canonicalReplay` authority、origin identity/hash/owner/subject漂移、origin partition重算不一致、origin position与materialization position不同、以及tampered origin proof hash。

- [ ] **Step 1: 写 vector、late event、source compaction 与 unmerge 测试**

```python
# tests/test_round_sync_v2.py
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import tempfile
import unittest

from ai_caddie.rounds.ledger_repo import LedgerRepository
from ai_caddie.rounds.reducer_v2 import ReplicationContext, reduce_round
from ai_caddie.rounds.sync_v2 import RoundSyncService
from server_v2.db import reset_engine_for_tests


ROUND_A = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
ROUND_B = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
ROUND_MERGED = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"


class RoundSyncV2Tests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        os.environ["AI_CADDIE_DATABASE_URL"] = f"sqlite:///{self.tmp.name}/sync.db"
        self.addCleanup(os.environ.pop, "AI_CADDIE_DATABASE_URL", None)
        reset_engine_for_tests()
        self.repo = LedgerRepository.create_schema_for_tests()
        self.repo.seed_round_binding_for_tests(
            owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_A, round_incarnation_id="inc-a",
            round_intent_id="intent-a", snapshot_id="snapshot-1", semantic_binding_hash="binding-1",
        )
        self.repo.seed_round_binding_for_tests(
            owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_B, round_incarnation_id="inc-b",
            round_intent_id="intent-b", snapshot_id="snapshot-1", semantic_binding_hash="binding-1",
        )
        self.service = RoundSyncService(self.repo)

    def merge(self) -> None:
        self.service.merge(
            owner_account_id="acct", canonical_round_id=ROUND_MERGED,
            source_incarnation_ids=["inc-a", "inc-b"],
        )

    def replay_all(self, round_id: str, partition_id: str) -> list:
        cursor = "0"
        result = []
        while True:
            page = self.service.replay(
                owner_account_id="acct", round_id=round_id,
                partition_id=partition_id, after_position=cursor, limit=1,
            )
            result.extend(page.events)
            self.assertEqual(
                [row.input.ledger_position for row in page.events],
                [
                    str(position)
                    for position in range(int(cursor) + 1, int(page.through_inclusive) + 1)
                ],
            )
            if not page.has_more:
                return result
            self.assertIsNotNone(page.next_cursor)
            cursor = page.next_cursor

    def test_merge_bootstrap_contains_control_and_all_source_streams(self) -> None:
        self.merge()
        bootstrap = self.service.bootstrap(owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_MERGED, consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="1")
        self.assertEqual([row.stream_subject.kind for row in bootstrap.streams], ["merge_control", "round_incarnation", "round_incarnation"])

    def test_sync_transport_identifiers_have_hard_bounds(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "payload_schema_invalid"):
            self.service.bootstrap(
                owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_A,
                consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="x" * 129,
            )
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "payload_schema_invalid"):
            self.service.merge(
                owner_account_id="acct", canonical_round_id=ROUND_MERGED,
                source_incarnation_ids=[f"inc-{index}" for index in range(9)],
            )
        bootstrap = self.service.bootstrap(
            owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_A,
            consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="1",
        )
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "payload_schema_invalid"):
            self.service.replay(
                owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_A,
                partition_id=bootstrap.streams[0].ledger_partition_id,
                after_position="0", limit=501,
            )

    def test_late_source_event_advances_only_its_vector_member(self) -> None:
        self.merge()
        before = self.service.bootstrap(owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_MERGED, consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="1")
        self.repo.append_fixture_score("inc-b", event_id="late")
        after = self.service.bootstrap(owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_MERGED, consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="1")
        self.assertNotEqual(before.merged_checkpoint_hash, after.merged_checkpoint_hash)
        self.assertEqual(before.streams[1].checkpoint_hash, after.streams[1].checkpoint_hash)
        self.assertNotEqual(before.streams[2].checkpoint_hash, after.streams[2].checkpoint_hash)

    def test_different_semantic_binding_cannot_merge(self) -> None:
        self.repo.set_binding_hash_for_tests("inc-b", "different")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "merge_semantic_binding_mismatch"):
            self.merge()

    def test_source_compaction_invalidates_old_partition_cursor(self) -> None:
        self.merge()
        before = self.service.bootstrap(owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_MERGED, consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="1")
        old_partition = before.streams[1].ledger_partition_id
        self.service.compact_source(owner_account_id="acct", source_incarnation_id="inc-a", new_stream_id="stream-a-2")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "bootstrap_required"):
            self.service.replay(owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_MERGED, partition_id=old_partition, after_position="0")

    def test_compaction_materializes_replay_base_and_preserves_projection_twice(self) -> None:
        self.repo.append_fixture_score("inc-a", event_id="score-a-1")
        self.repo.append_fixture_score("inc-a", event_id="score-a-2")
        before_bootstrap = self.service.bootstrap(
            owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_A,
            consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="1",
        )
        before_events = self.replay_all(ROUND_A, before_bootstrap.streams[0].ledger_partition_id)
        before_projection = reduce_round(
            [row.input for row in before_events], replication=ReplicationContext()
        ).to_dict()

        first_partition = self.service.compact_source(
            owner_account_id="acct", source_incarnation_id="inc-a", new_stream_id="stream-a-2"
        )
        first_events = self.replay_all(ROUND_A, first_partition)
        self.assertEqual(
            [row.input.event.event_identity() for row in first_events],
            [row.input.event.event_identity() for row in before_events],
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            [row.canonical_origin for row in first_events],
            [row.canonical_origin for row in before_events],
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            reduce_round(
                [row.input for row in first_events],
                replication=ReplicationContext(),
            ).to_dict(),
            before_projection,
        )

        self.repo.append_fixture_score("inc-a", event_id="score-a-late")
        before_second = self.replay_all(ROUND_A, first_partition)
        before_second_projection = reduce_round(
            [row.input for row in before_second],
            replication=ReplicationContext(),
        ).to_dict()
        second_partition = self.service.compact_source(
            owner_account_id="acct", source_incarnation_id="inc-a", new_stream_id="stream-a-3"
        )
        second_events = self.replay_all(ROUND_A, second_partition)
        self.assertEqual(len(second_events), len(before_events) + 1)
        self.assertEqual(
            [row.input.ledger_position for row in second_events],
            [str(position) for position in range(1, len(second_events) + 1)],
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            [row.input.event.event_identity() for row in second_events],
            [row.input.event.event_identity() for row in before_second],
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            [row.canonical_origin for row in second_events],
            [row.canonical_origin for row in before_second],
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            reduce_round(
                [row.input for row in second_events],
                replication=ReplicationContext(),
            ).to_dict(),
            before_second_projection,
        )

    def test_bootstrap_and_replay_are_account_and_current_vector_scoped(self) -> None:
        bootstrap = self.service.bootstrap(
            owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_A,
            consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="1",
        )
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "bootstrap_required"):
            self.service.bootstrap(
                owner_account_id="other", round_id=ROUND_A,
                consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="1",
            )
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "bootstrap_required"):
            self.service.replay(
                owner_account_id="other", round_id=ROUND_A,
                partition_id=bootstrap.streams[0].ledger_partition_id, after_position="0",
            )

    def test_compaction_fault_rolls_back_checkpoint_membership_and_deactivation(self) -> None:
        self.merge()
        before = self.service.bootstrap(
            owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_MERGED,
            consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="1",
        )

        for fault_point in ("after_checkpoint", "after_membership_switch"):
            with self.subTest(fault_point=fault_point):
                def fail(point: str) -> None:
                    if point == fault_point:
                        raise RuntimeError("injected compaction crash")

                failing = RoundSyncService(LedgerRepository(compaction_fault_hook=fail))
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "injected compaction crash"):
                    failing.compact_source(
                        owner_account_id="acct", source_incarnation_id="inc-a",
                        new_stream_id=f"stream-a-failed-{fault_point}",
                    )
                after = self.service.bootstrap(
                    owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_MERGED,
                    consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="1",
                )
                self.assertEqual(after.streams[1].ledger_partition_id, before.streams[1].ledger_partition_id)
                self.assertEqual(after.merged_checkpoint_hash, before.merged_checkpoint_hash)

    def test_ack_is_bound_to_current_vector_and_immutable_prefix_checkpoint(self) -> None:
        self.repo.append_fixture_score("inc-a", event_id="score-for-ack")
        bootstrap = self.service.bootstrap(
            owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_A,
            consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="1",
        )
        stream = bootstrap.streams[0]
        page = self.service.replay(
            owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_A,
            partition_id=stream.ledger_partition_id, after_position="0", limit=1,
        )
        # The token covers exactly prefix [1], so a concurrently appended tail
        # cannot starve the ACK for data already persisted by the consumer.
        self.repo.append_fixture_score("inc-a", event_id="score-after-page")
        self.assertEqual(self.repo.ack_current_partition(
            owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_A,
            partition_id=stream.ledger_partition_id,
            consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="1", position="1",
            expected_ack_checkpoint_hash=page.ack_checkpoint_hash,
            expected_vector_generation=0,
        ), "1")
        # Lower retries are monotonic no-ops after current vector membership is
        # checked; their obsolete/tampered lower-position token is irrelevant.
        self.assertEqual(self.repo.ack_current_partition(
            owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_A,
            partition_id=stream.ledger_partition_id,
            consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="1", position="0",
            expected_ack_checkpoint_hash="0" * 64,
            expected_vector_generation=0,
        ), "1")
        advancing = self.service.replay(
            owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_A,
            partition_id=stream.ledger_partition_id, after_position="1", limit=1,
        )
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "bootstrap_required"):
            self.repo.ack_current_partition(
                owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_A,
                partition_id=stream.ledger_partition_id,
                consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="1", position="2",
                expected_ack_checkpoint_hash="f" * 64,
                expected_vector_generation=0,
            )
        self.assertEqual(self.repo.ack_current_partition(
            owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_A,
            partition_id=stream.ledger_partition_id,
            consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="1", position="2",
            expected_ack_checkpoint_hash=advancing.ack_checkpoint_hash,
            expected_vector_generation=0,
        ), "2")
        self.service.compact_source(
            owner_account_id="acct", source_incarnation_id="inc-a", new_stream_id="stream-after-ack"
        )
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "bootstrap_required"):
            self.repo.ack_current_partition(
                owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_A,
                partition_id=stream.ledger_partition_id,
                consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="1", position="1",
                expected_ack_checkpoint_hash=page.ack_checkpoint_hash,
                expected_vector_generation=0,
            )

    def test_source_reorder_invalidates_pre_reorder_prefix_token(self) -> None:
        self.repo.append_fixture_score("inc-a", event_id="score-a")
        self.merge()
        before = self.service.bootstrap(
            owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_MERGED,
            consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="1",
        )
        source_a = before.streams[1]
        page = self.service.replay(
            owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_MERGED,
            partition_id=source_a.ledger_partition_id, after_position="0", limit=1,
            expected_vector_generation=before.merge_control_generation,
        )
        self.service.merge(
            owner_account_id="acct", canonical_round_id=ROUND_MERGED,
            source_incarnation_ids=["inc-b", "inc-a"],
        )
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "bootstrap_required"):
            self.repo.ack_current_partition(
                owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_MERGED,
                partition_id=source_a.ledger_partition_id,
                consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="1",
                position=page.through_inclusive,
                expected_ack_checkpoint_hash=page.ack_checkpoint_hash,
                expected_vector_generation=before.merge_control_generation,
            )

    def test_unmerge_supersedes_membership_without_rewriting_sources(self) -> None:
        self.merge()
        before = self.service.bootstrap(owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_MERGED, consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="1")
        self.service.merge(owner_account_id="acct", canonical_round_id=ROUND_MERGED, source_incarnation_ids=["inc-a"])
        after = self.service.bootstrap(owner_account_id="acct", round_id=ROUND_MERGED, consumer_device_id="ios", consumer_epoch="1")
        self.assertEqual(after.merge_control_generation, before.merge_control_generation + 1)
        self.assertEqual([row.stream_subject.subject_id for row in after.streams[1:]], ["inc-a"])
```

- [ ] **Step 3: 实现 vector bootstrap types**

SQL `BigInteger` 只作为 server-internal bounded representation；所有 wire、fixture、checkpoint 与客户端 storage 始终保存 canonical decimal string。把上限冻结为 signed 64-bit positive maximum，partition 分配到上限时 fail closed，绝不 rollover：

```python
# ai_caddie/rounds/ledger_limits.py
MAX_LEDGER_POSITION = 9_223_372_036_854_775_807


def is_canonical_ledger_position(value: object, *, allow_zero: bool) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.isascii() or not value.isdecimal():
        return False
    if value == "0":
        return allow_zero
    if value.startswith("0") or len(value) > 19:
        return False
    return (len(value), value) <= (
        len(str(MAX_LEDGER_POSITION)), str(MAX_LEDGER_POSITION)
    )


def ledger_position_to_int(value: object, *, allow_zero: bool) -> int:
    if not is_canonical_ledger_position(value, allow_zero=allow_zero):
        raise ValueError("payload_schema_invalid")
    return int(value)
```

Task 8 `_append_event_in_session()` 与 Task 7 `append_event()` 在读取 `partition.next_position` 后先要求 `1 <= next_position <= MAX_LEDGER_POSITION`；达到上限后的下一次 append 抛 service-unavailable/operator alert，不写 event、receipt 或 wraparound position（它不是 per-event permanent reject，因此不伪造一个未注册 reason）。schema 中所有 position string 同时加 `maxLength: 19`，negative tests 覆盖 integer、leading zero、超过上限和 20 digits。

```python
# ai_caddie/rounds/sync_v2.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Protocol

from ai_caddie.contracts.typed_ids import typed_id
from ai_caddie.rounds.ledger_limits import is_canonical_ledger_position
from ai_caddie.rounds.reducer_v2 import ProjectionInput


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StreamSubjectRef:
    kind: str
    subject_id: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StreamCursor:
    ledger_partition_id: str
    stream_subject: StreamSubjectRef
    ledger_epoch: int
    stream_id: str
    last_acked_position: str
    replay_cursor: str
    checkpoint_hash: str
    source_ordinal: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DeviceSyncBootstrap:
    round_id: str
    consumer_device_id: str
    consumer_epoch: str
    merge_control_generation: int
    merge_resolution_id: str | None
    streams: tuple[StreamCursor, ...]
    merged_checkpoint_hash: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CanonicalOriginEvidence:
    event_identity: str
    event_hash: str
    owner_account_id: str
    stream_subject: StreamSubjectRef
    ledger_partition_id: str
    ledger_epoch: int
    stream_id: str
    ledger_position: str
    replay_proof_hash: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DeviceReplayEventV2:
    input: ProjectionInput
    canonical_origin: CanonicalOriginEvidence


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ReplayPage:
    ledger_partition_id: str
    ledger_epoch: int
    stream_id: str
    from_exclusive: str
    through_inclusive: str
    events: tuple[DeviceReplayEventV2, ...]
    next_cursor: str | None
    has_more: bool
    checkpoint_hash: str
    ack_checkpoint_hash: str
    merge_control_generation: int
    merge_resolution_id: str | None


def merged_checkpoint(resolution_id: str | None, streams: list[StreamCursor], reducer_version: str) -> str:
    vector = [
        {
            "subjectKind": row.stream_subject.kind,
            "subjectId": row.stream_subject.subject_id,
            "partition": row.ledger_partition_id,
            "ledgerEpoch": str(row.ledger_epoch),
            "streamId": row.stream_id,
            "checkpoint": row.checkpoint_hash,
            "sourceOrdinal": row.source_ordinal,
        }
        for row in streams
    ]
    return typed_id("MergedCheckpoint/v1", {"resolutionId": resolution_id, "streams": vector, "reducerVersion": reducer_version})


from ai_caddie.rounds.ledger_limits import (
    MAX_CONSUMER_EPOCH_CHARACTERS,
    MAX_MERGE_SOURCE_INCARNATIONS,
    MAX_REPLAY_PAGE_SIZE,
    MAX_SYNC_PATH_ID_CHARACTERS,
)


class RoundSyncRepository(Protocol):
    def merge_round(self, *, owner_account_id: str, canonical_round_id: str, source_incarnation_ids: list[str]) -> str: ...
    def bootstrap_round(self, *, owner_account_id: str, round_id: str, consumer_device_id: str, consumer_epoch: str) -> DeviceSyncBootstrap: ...
    def replay_partition(self, *, owner_account_id: str, round_id: str, partition_id: str, after_position: str, limit: int, expected_vector_generation: int | None = None) -> ReplayPage: ...
    def compact_source_transactionally(self, *, owner_account_id: str, source_incarnation_id: str, new_stream_id: str) -> str: ...


class RoundSyncService:
    def __init__(self, repo: RoundSyncRepository) -> None:
        self.repo = repo

    def merge(self, *, owner_account_id: str, canonical_round_id: str, source_incarnation_ids: list[str]) -> str:
        if (
            not 1 <= len(source_incarnation_ids) <= MAX_MERGE_SOURCE_INCARNATIONS
            or len(set(source_incarnation_ids)) != len(source_incarnation_ids)
            or not all(
                1 <= len(value) <= MAX_SYNC_PATH_ID_CHARACTERS
                for value in source_incarnation_ids
            )
        ):
            raise ValueError("payload_schema_invalid")
        return self.repo.merge_round(
            owner_account_id=owner_account_id,
            canonical_round_id=canonical_round_id,
            source_incarnation_ids=source_incarnation_ids,
        )

    def compact_source(self, *, owner_account_id: str, source_incarnation_id: str, new_stream_id: str) -> str:
        return self.repo.compact_source_transactionally(
            owner_account_id=owner_account_id,
            source_incarnation_id=source_incarnation_id,
            new_stream_id=new_stream_id,
        )

    def replay(self, *, owner_account_id: str, round_id: str, partition_id: str, after_position: str, limit: int = 200, expected_vector_generation: int | None = None) -> ReplayPage:
        if not is_canonical_ledger_position(after_position, allow_zero=True) or not 1 <= limit <= MAX_REPLAY_PAGE_SIZE:
            raise ValueError("payload_schema_invalid")
        return self.repo.replay_partition(
            owner_account_id=owner_account_id,
            round_id=round_id,
            partition_id=partition_id,
            after_position=after_position,
            limit=limit,
            expected_vector_generation=expected_vector_generation,
        )

    def bootstrap(self, *, owner_account_id: str, round_id: str, consumer_device_id: str, consumer_epoch: str) -> DeviceSyncBootstrap:
        if not 1 <= len(consumer_epoch) <= MAX_CONSUMER_EPOCH_CHARACTERS:
            raise ValueError("payload_schema_invalid")
        return self.repo.bootstrap_round(
            owner_account_id=owner_account_id,
            round_id=round_id,
            consumer_device_id=consumer_device_id,
            consumer_epoch=consumer_epoch,
        )
```
