```swift
    func testStorageV1CaptureReplaceFaultIsOldOrCompletePendingV2() throws {
        let fixture = try XCTUnwrap(Bundle.module.url(
            forResource: "domain_ledger_v1_restart",
            withExtension: "json",
            subdirectory: "Fixtures"
        ))
        let fixtureData = try Data(contentsOf: fixture)
        let expected = try expectedCapture(for: fixtureData)

        for point in [
            DomainLedgerFaultPoint.beforeMigrationPrimaryReplace,
            .afterMigrationPrimaryReplace,
        ] {
            let directory = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory
                .appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
            defer {
                DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: directory)
                try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: directory)
            }
            try FileManager.default.createDirectory(
                at: directory,
                withIntermediateDirectories: true
            )
            let stateURL = DomainLedgerStore.stateURL(in: directory)
            try fixtureData.write(to: stateURL)

            XCTAssertThrowsError(try DomainLedgerCompositionRoot.open(
                directoryURL: directory,
                expectedOriginDeviceId: "ios-1",
                faultHook: { observed in
                    if observed == point {
                        throw CocoaError(.fileWriteUnknown)
                    }
                }
            ))
            DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: directory)

            if point == .beforeMigrationPrimaryReplace {
                XCTAssertEqual(try Data(contentsOf: stateURL), fixtureData)
            } else {
                let captured = try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(
                    DomainLedgerStateV2.self,
                    from: Data(contentsOf: stateURL)
                )
                try assertCaptureOnlyState(captured, expected: expected)
                let restarted = try DomainLedgerCompositionRoot.open(
                    directoryURL: directory,
                    expectedOriginDeviceId: "ios-1"
                )
                XCTAssertEqual(try restarted.allEvents(), [])
                XCTAssertEqual(try restarted.pendingEventIds(), [])
            }
        }
    }

    func testStorageV1CaptureIgnoresStaleStagingAndUsesAttemptScopedDirectory() throws {
        let fixture = try XCTUnwrap(Bundle.module.url(
            forResource: "domain_ledger_v1_restart",
            withExtension: "json",
            subdirectory: "Fixtures"
        ))
        let fixtureData = try Data(contentsOf: fixture)
        let expected = try expectedCapture(for: fixtureData)
        let directory = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory
            .appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        addTeardownBlock {
            DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: directory)
            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: directory)
        }
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(
            at: directory,
            withIntermediateDirectories: true
        )
        let stateURL = DomainLedgerStore.stateURL(in: directory)
        try fixtureData.write(to: stateURL)

        let staleName =
            "ledger-migration-(UUID().uuidString.lowercased())"
        let staleDirectory = directory.appendingPathComponent(staleName)
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(
            at: staleDirectory,
            withIntermediateDirectories: true
        )
        try Data("stale-partial-state".utf8).write(
            to: staleDirectory.appendingPathComponent("domain-ledger.json")
        )

        var observedAttemptDirectory: String?
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try DomainLedgerStorageMigration.migrateIfNeeded(
            stateURL: stateURL,
            expectedOriginDeviceId: "ios-1",
            faultHook: { point in
                guard point == .beforeMigrationPrimaryReplace else { return }
                let migrationDirectories = try FileManager.default
                    .contentsOfDirectory(atPath: directory.path)
                    .filter {
                        $0.hasPrefix("ledger-migration-")
                            && $0 != staleName
                    }
                XCTAssertEqual(migrationDirectories.count, 1)
                observedAttemptDirectory = migrationDirectories.first
                throw CocoaError(.fileWriteUnknown)
            }
        ))
        XCTAssertNotNil(observedAttemptDirectory)
        XCTAssertEqual(try Data(contentsOf: stateURL), fixtureData)
        XCTAssertEqual(
            try FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(
                atPath: directory.path
            ).filter { $0.hasPrefix("ledger-migration-") },
            [staleName]
        )

        try DomainLedgerStorageMigration.migrateIfNeeded(
            stateURL: stateURL,
            expectedOriginDeviceId: "ios-1"
        )
        try assertCaptureOnlyState(
            StrictJSONDecoder.decode(
                DomainLedgerStateV2.self,
                from: Data(contentsOf: stateURL)
            ),
            expected: expected
        )
        let restarted = try DomainLedgerCompositionRoot.open(
            directoryURL: directory,
            expectedOriginDeviceId: "ios-1"
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(try restarted.allEvents(), [])
        XCTAssertEqual(
            try FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(
                atPath: directory.path
            ).filter { $0.hasPrefix("ledger-migration-") },
            [staleName]
        )
    }

    func testStorageV1FutureKindsRemainRawPendingSourceRecordsForTask12Classification() throws {
        let directory = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory
            .appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        addTeardownBlock {
            DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: directory)
            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: directory)
        }
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(
            at: directory,
            withIntermediateDirectories: true
        )
        let stateURL = DomainLedgerStore.stateURL(in: directory)
        let roundId = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
        let body = """
        {
          "storageVersion": 1,
          "origin": {
            "originDeviceId": "ios-legacy",
            "originEpoch": "epoch-1",
            "lastReservedClientSequence": 3
          },
          "events": [
            {
              "eventId": "bad-score", "originDeviceId": "ios-legacy",
              "originEpoch": "epoch-1", "clientSequence": 1,
              "roundId": "\(roundId)", "kind": "hole_score_set",
              "payload": {"strokes": 4},
              "occurredAt": "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
            },
            {
              "eventId": "future-1", "originDeviceId": "ios-legacy",
              "originEpoch": "epoch-1", "clientSequence": 2,
              "roundId": "\(roundId)",
              "kind": "legacy_v1_future_kind",
              "payload": {"opaque": "kept"},
              "occurredAt": "2026-07-18T00:00:01.000Z"
            },
            {
              "eventId": "future-2", "originDeviceId": "ios-legacy",
              "originEpoch": "epoch-1", "clientSequence": 3,
              "roundId": "\(roundId)", "kind": "future_kind",
              "payload": {"opaque": "adapted"},
              "occurredAt": "2026-07-18T00:00:02.000Z"
            }
          ],
          "outbox": [],
          "deadLetters": [],
          "receipts": {},
          "legacyWireBindings": [],
          "preparedLegacyV1Batches": [],
          "watchTerminalReceiptRelayObligations": [],
          "watchTerminalReceiptRelayConfirmations": [],
          "migrationMarkers": [],
          "transportAnomalies": []
        }
        """
        let raw = Data(body.utf8)
        try raw.write(to: stateURL)
        let expected = try expectedCapture(for: raw)

        try DomainLedgerStorageMigration.migrateIfNeeded(
            stateURL: stateURL,
            expectedOriginDeviceId: "ios-legacy"
        )
        let state = try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(
            DomainLedgerStateV2.self,
            from: Data(contentsOf: stateURL)
        )
        try assertCaptureOnlyState(state, expected: expected)
        let pending = try XCTUnwrap(
            state.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations[
                expected.authority.authorityId
            ]
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(pending.sourceRecords.map(\.sourceLine), [1, 2, 3])
        XCTAssertEqual(
            pending.sourceRecords.compactMap(\.eventId),
            ["bad-score", "future-1", "future-2"]
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(
            pending.sourceRoundIds,
            CanonicalStringSet(Set([roundId]))
        )
        let capturedRows = try pending.sourceRecords.map { record in
            let rowData = try XCTUnwrap(
                Data(base64Encoded: record.rawBase64)
            )
            XCTAssertEqual(
                SHA256.hash(data: rowData)
                    .map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined(),
                record.rawSha256
            )
            return try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(
                StoredEventV1.self,
                from: rowData
            )
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(
            capturedRows.map { $0.kind.rawValue },
            [
                "hole_score_set",
                "legacy_v1_future_kind",
                "future_kind",
            ]
        )
        for pair in zip(pending.sourceRecords, capturedRows) {
            XCTAssertEqual(
                pair.0.rawBase64,
                try CanonicalJSON.data(pair.1).base64EncodedString()
            )
        }

        let restarted = try DomainLedgerCompositionRoot.open(
            directoryURL: directory,
            expectedOriginDeviceId: "ios-legacy"
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(try restarted.allEvents(), [])
        XCTAssertEqual(try restarted.pendingEventIds(), [])
        // Full known/opaque classification and future-kind conversion are
        // deliberately deferred to Task 12's pending -> completed transaction.
    }
}
```

`testTask5StorageV1FixtureCapturesSealedPendingAuthorityAndRestartsAsV2` 的实际实现必须逐项断言Task 11 capture milestone，而不是提前断言operational conversion：origin exact且`storageVersion == 2`；`SealedLegacyAuthority`与source file bytes/SHA exact；一次decode与一次seal后由`validatedStorageV1Snapshot`构造的`PendingLegacyAuthorityMigration.sourceRecords/sourceRoundIds`与唯一scanner roster exact；`LegacyStorageEvidence.rawStorageBase64/rawStorageSha256/parsedTransportEvidence`全部直接复用snapshot authority/parsed evidence且exact；同一authority在pending/completed roots间exact XOR。fixture中的receipt/outbox/dead-letter/binding/prepared batch/Watch relay/anomaly只存在于sealed raw authority与parsed transport evidence中，本阶段不得被伪造成V2 `events/outbox/receipts/localProjectionInputs/migrationMarkers`或任何completed disposition。restart与exact retry仍保持同一pending V2 bytes和空operational roots。

同一test class还必须包含以下capture-only exact gates：`testStorageV1CaptureHasExactSourceLineRosterAndNoCompletedDisposition`逐项验证one-based sourceLine、canonical row bytes、raw SHA、eventId/roundId与sorted-unique sourceRoundIds；`testStorageV1CaptureSealsDecodesAndScansExactlyOnceAndStoreConsumesValidatedCapability`直接切出production migrator、capture store与validator source边界，分别断言V1 path对whole authority恰好一次seal、一次decode、一次validated snapshot roster scan，raw evidence只复用snapshot sealed字段，store transaction只收到`ValidatedPendingLegacyAuthorityCapture`且不含任何reseal/redecode/rescan/hash/Base64重建，并锁住validator用SHA-keyed expected dictionary与seen set在O(n)内完成storage-v1 snapshot/evidence exact bijection；`testStorageV1CaptureRejectsMismatchedOriginBeforeWriting`证明origin mismatch保持byte-identical V1；`testStorageV1CaptureExactRetryDoesNotDuplicateAuthorityOrEvidence`证明retry只有同一sealed/pending/evidence各一份；`testStorageV1AndV2UnknownNestedKeysFailBeforeDecode`参数化root与每一种typed nested record；`testMigrationPrimaryFaultPointsDoNotFireForStagingTransactions`证明staging普通atomic writes不会提前消费migration-primary hook。source-line分类、referenced-unmappable关系、legacy receipt/awaiting maps、canonical replay清理与完整future-kind conversion全部归Task 12：Task 12必须从同一durable state snapshot为该pending authority构造一次`LegacyAuthorityClassificationBatch`，并在一个transaction中原子完成pending → completed及全部operational merge；Task 11不得做部分classification或保留第二套prefix replay。

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomainTests/LegacyAuthorityProcessingTests.swift
import CryptoKit
import Foundation
import XCTest
@testable import AICaddieDomain

final class LegacyAuthorityProcessingRecorder: @unchecked Sendable {
    struct PassCounts: Equatable {
        var sealed: Int
        var decodedOrRead: Int
        var rosterScanned: Int
        var classificationBuilt: Int

        init(
            sealed: Int = 0,
            decodedOrRead: Int = 0,
            rosterScanned: Int = 0,
            classificationBuilt: Int = 0
        ) {
            self.sealed = sealed
            self.decodedOrRead = decodedOrRead
            self.rosterScanned = rosterScanned
            self.classificationBuilt = classificationBuilt
        }
    }

    struct ApplyAttempt: Hashable {
        let authority: LegacyAuthorityProcessingKey
        let eventIdentity: String
        let sourceOrdinal: Int
    }

    struct Observation {
        let passesByAuthority: [LegacyAuthorityProcessingKey: PassCounts]
        let applyAttempts: [ApplyAttempt: Int]

        func passes(
            for key: LegacyAuthorityProcessingKey
        ) -> PassCounts {
            passesByAuthority[key] ?? PassCounts()
        }

        var sealedTotal: Int {
            passesByAuthority.values.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.sealed }
        }
        var decodedOrReadTotal: Int {
            passesByAuthority.values.reduce(0) {
                $0 + $1.decodedOrRead
            }
        }
        var rosterScannedTotal: Int {
            passesByAuthority.values.reduce(0) {
                $0 + $1.rosterScanned
            }
        }
        var classificationBuiltTotal: Int {
            passesByAuthority.values.reduce(0) {
                $0 + $1.classificationBuilt
            }
        }
        var applyAttemptTotal: Int {
            applyAttempts.values.reduce(0, +)
        }
    }

    private let lock = NSLock()
    private var passesByAuthority:
        [LegacyAuthorityProcessingKey: PassCounts] = [:]
    private var applyAttempts: [ApplyAttempt: Int] = [:]

    var observers: LegacyAuthorityProcessingObservers {
        LegacyAuthorityProcessingObservers(
            onSealedAuthorityMake: { [weak self] key in
                self?.recordSeal(key)
            },
            onAuthorityDecodeOrRead: { [weak self] key in
                self?.recordDecodeOrRead(key)
            },
            onSourceRosterScan: { [weak self] key in
                self?.recordRosterScan(key)
            },
            onClassificationBuilderPass: { [weak self] key in
                self?.recordClassificationBuilder(key)
            },
            onReducerApplyAttempt: {
                [weak self] key, eventIdentity, sourceOrdinal in
                self?.recordApply(
                    key: key,
                    eventIdentity: eventIdentity,
                    sourceOrdinal: sourceOrdinal
                )
            }
        )
    }

    func reset() {
        lock.lock()
        defer { lock.unlock() }
        passesByAuthority = [:]
        applyAttempts = [:]
    }

    func observation() -> Observation {
        lock.lock()
        defer { lock.unlock() }
        return Observation(
            passesByAuthority: passesByAuthority,
            applyAttempts: applyAttempts
        )
    }

    private func update(
        _ key: LegacyAuthorityProcessingKey,
        _ body: (inout PassCounts) -> Void
    ) {
        lock.lock()
        defer { lock.unlock() }
        var counts = passesByAuthority[key] ?? PassCounts()
        body(&counts)
        passesByAuthority[key] = counts
    }

    private func recordSeal(_ key: LegacyAuthorityProcessingKey) {
        update(key) { $0.sealed += 1 }
    }

    private func recordDecodeOrRead(
        _ key: LegacyAuthorityProcessingKey
    ) {
        update(key) { $0.decodedOrRead += 1 }
    }

    private func recordRosterScan(
        _ key: LegacyAuthorityProcessingKey
    ) {
        update(key) { $0.rosterScanned += 1 }
    }

    private func recordClassificationBuilder(
        _ key: LegacyAuthorityProcessingKey
    ) {
        update(key) { $0.classificationBuilt += 1 }
    }

    private func recordApply(
        key: LegacyAuthorityProcessingKey,
        eventIdentity: String,
        sourceOrdinal: Int
    ) {
        lock.lock()
        defer { lock.unlock() }
        let attempt = ApplyAttempt(
            authority: key,
            eventIdentity: eventIdentity,
            sourceOrdinal: sourceOrdinal
        )
        applyAttempts[attempt, default: 0] += 1
    }
}

final class LegacyAuthorityProcessingTests: XCTestCase {
    private struct ExpectedStorageV1Capture {
        let raw: Data
        let legacy: LegacyDomainLedgerStateV1
        let authority: SealedLegacyAuthority
        let pending: PendingLegacyAuthorityMigration
        let evidence: LegacyStorageEvidence
    }

    private struct CompletedAuthorityFixture {
        let authority: SealedLegacyAuthority
        let snapshot: ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot
        let completed: CompletedLegacyAuthorityMigration

        var key: LegacyAuthorityProcessingKey {
            LegacyAuthorityProcessingKey(
                authorityKind: authority.authorityKind,
                authorityId: authority.authorityId
            )
        }
    }

    private struct CompletedAuthoritiesFixture {
        let state: DomainLedgerStateV2
        let authorities: [CompletedAuthorityFixture]
    }

    private func temporaryDirectory() throws -> URL {
        let directory = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory
            .appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(
            at: directory,
            withIntermediateDirectories: true
        )
        addTeardownBlock {
            DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: directory)
            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: directory)
        }
        return directory
    }

    private func writeV2(
        _ state: DomainLedgerStateV2,
        to directory: URL
    ) throws {
        try CanonicalJSON.data(state).write(
            to: DomainLedgerStore.stateURL(in: directory)
        )
    }

    private func lowercaseSHA256(_ data: Data) -> String {
        SHA256.hash(data: data)
            .map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
    }

    private func expectedStorageV1Capture()
        throws -> ExpectedStorageV1Capture {
        let fixtureURL = try XCTUnwrap(Bundle.module.url(
            forResource: "domain_ledger_v1_restart",
            withExtension: "json",
            subdirectory: "Fixtures"
        ))
        let raw = try Data(contentsOf: fixtureURL)
        let legacy = try DomainLedgerStorageWireValidator
            .decodeStorageV1(raw)
        let authority = try SealedLegacyAuthority.make(
            authorityKind:
                LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator.storageV1AuthorityKind,
            authorityFile: raw,
            observers: .init()
        )
        let snapshot = try LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator
            .validatedStorageV1Snapshot(
                validatedAuthority: authority,
                authorityData: raw,
                decodedStorageV1: legacy,
                observers: .init()
            )
        let sourceRecords = snapshot.sourceRecords
        let pending = PendingLegacyAuthorityMigration(
            authorityId: authority.authorityId,
            authorityKind: authority.authorityKind,
            authorityFileSha256: authority.authorityFileSha256,
            sourceRecords: sourceRecords,
            sourceRoundIds: CanonicalStringSet(Set(
                sourceRecords.compactMap { record in
                    record.classification == .event
                        ? record.roundId : nil
                }
            ))
        )
        let evidence = LegacyStorageEvidence(
            storageVersion: 1,
            rawStorageBase64: authority.authorityFileBase64,
            rawStorageSha256: authority.authorityFileSha256,
            parsedTransportEvidence: try XCTUnwrap(
                snapshot.storageV1ParsedTransportEvidence
            )
        )
        return ExpectedStorageV1Capture(
            raw: raw,
            legacy: legacy,
            authority: authority,
            pending: pending,
            evidence: evidence
        )
    }

    private func assertCaptureOnlyState(
        _ state: DomainLedgerStateV2,
        expected: ExpectedStorageV1Capture
    ) throws {
        XCTAssertEqual(state.storageVersion, 2)
        XCTAssertEqual(
            state.originSequenceAuthority,
            expected.legacy.origin
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(
            state.sealedLegacyAuthorities,

        )
        XCTAssertEqual(
            state.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations,

        )
        XCTAssertTrue(state.completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertEqual(state.legacyTransportEvidence, [expected.evidence])
        XCTAssertEqual(
            try XCTUnwrap(Data(
                base64Encoded: expected.evidence.rawStorageBase64
            )),

        )
        XCTAssertTrue(state.events.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.outbox.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.localOrdinaryOutboxEvidence.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.verifiedPeerBundleEvidence.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.legacyV1RetryableOutbox.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.deadLetters.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.receipts.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.legacyV1TerminalReceipts.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(
            state.legacyV1AcceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay.isEmpty

        XCTAssertTrue(state.migrationMarkers.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.migrationDeadLetters.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.transportAnomalies.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.legacyWireBindings.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.preparedLegacyV1Batches.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(
            state.watchTerminalReceiptRelayObligations.isEmpty
        )
        XCTAssertTrue(
            state.watchTerminalReceiptRelayConfirmations.isEmpty
        )
        XCTAssertTrue(state.shotCaptureStates.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.localProjectionInputs.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.inboundProjectionRecords.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.stagedInboundProjectionRecords.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.canonicalOriginEvidence.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.canonicalMaterializationActivations.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.canonicalMaterializationEvidence.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(

        XCTAssertTrue(state.inboundCursors.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.stagedInboundCursors.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.activeInboundPartitionsByRound.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.stagedInboundPartitionsByRound.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.inboundVectorsByRound.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(state.stagedInboundVectorsByRound.isEmpty)

    private func completedSyncMarkerAuthority(

    ) throws -> CompletedAuthorityFixture {
        let line = #"{"eventId":"\#(eventId)","roundId":"\#(roundId)","timestamp":"2026-07-18T00:00:00Z","hole":0,"kind":"sync_marker","payload":{"status":"synced"}}"#

    private func assertExactlyOneProcessingPass(
        _ observation: LegacyAuthorityProcessingRecorder.Observation,
        for key: LegacyAuthorityProcessingKey,
        file: StaticString = #filePath,
        line: UInt = #line
    ) {
        XCTAssertEqual(
            observation.passes(for: key),
            .init(
                sealed: 1,

            "\(key)",

            line: line

    func testStorageV1CaptureProcessesAuthorityExactlyOnceAtRuntime()
        throws {
        let expected = try expectedStorageV1Capture()
        let directory = try temporaryDirectory()
        let stateURL = DomainLedgerStore.stateURL(in: directory)
        try expected.raw.write(to: stateURL)
        let recorder = LegacyAuthorityProcessingRecorder()
        let observers = recorder.observers

        try LegacyAuthorityProcessingObserverScope.$current.withValue(
            observers
        ) {
            try DomainLedgerStorageMigration.migrateIfNeeded(
                stateURL: stateURL,
                expectedOriginDeviceId:
                    expected.legacy.origin.originDeviceId,
                faultHook: { _ in }
            )
        }

        try assertCaptureOnlyState(
            StrictJSONDecoder.decode(
                DomainLedgerStateV2.self,
                from: Data(contentsOf: stateURL)
            ),
            expected: expected
        )
        let observation = recorder.observation()
        let decodeKey = LegacyAuthorityProcessingKey(
            authorityKind:
                LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator.storageV1AuthorityKind,
            authorityId: nil
        )
        let authorityKey = LegacyAuthorityProcessingKey(
            authorityKind: expected.authority.authorityKind,
            authorityId: expected.authority.authorityId
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(
            observation.passes(for: decodeKey),
            .init(decodedOrRead: 1)
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(
            observation.passes(for: authorityKey),
            .init(sealed: 1, rosterScanned: 1)
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(
            Set(observation.passesByAuthority.keys),
            Set([decodeKey, authorityKey])
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(observation.sealedTotal, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(observation.decodedOrReadTotal, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(observation.rosterScannedTotal, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(observation.classificationBuiltTotal, 0)
        XCTAssertEqual(observation.applyAttemptTotal, 0)
    }

    func testLegacyTransportEvidenceMustBeExactBijectionWithStorageV1Authorities()
        throws {
        let expected = try expectedStorageV1Capture()
        let captureDirectory = try temporaryDirectory()
        let captureStateURL = DomainLedgerStore.stateURL(
            in: captureDirectory
        )
        try expected.raw.write(to: captureStateURL)
        try DomainLedgerStorageMigration.migrateIfNeeded(
            stateURL: captureStateURL,
            expectedOriginDeviceId:
                expected.legacy.origin.originDeviceId,
            faultHook: { _ in }
        )
        let captured = try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(
            DomainLedgerStateV2.self,
            from: Data(contentsOf: captureStateURL)
        )
        try assertCaptureOnlyState(captured, expected: expected)
        let evidence = try XCTUnwrap(
            captured.legacyTransportEvidence.only
        )

        func assertStartupRejects(
            _ state: DomainLedgerStateV2,
            mutation: String
        ) throws {
            let directory = try temporaryDirectory()
            try writeV2(state, to: directory)
            XCTAssertThrowsError(
                try DomainLedgerCompositionRoot.open(
                    directoryURL: directory,
                    expectedOriginDeviceId:
                        expected.legacy.origin.originDeviceId,
                    faultHook: { _ in }
                ),
                mutation
            ) { error in
                XCTAssertEqual(
                    error as? DomainLedgerError,
                    .storageInvariantViolation,
                    mutation
                )
            }
        }

        var missingEvidence = captured
        missingEvidence.legacyTransportEvidence = []
        try assertStartupRejects(
            missingEvidence,
            mutation: "missing_evidence"
        )

        var duplicateEvidence = captured
        duplicateEvidence.legacyTransportEvidence.append(evidence)
        try assertStartupRejects(
            duplicateEvidence,
            mutation: "duplicate_evidence"
        )

        let orphanFirstHex = evidence.rawStorageSha256.hasPrefix("0")
            ? "1" : "0"
        let orphanRawSHA = orphanFirstHex
            + String(evidence.rawStorageSha256.dropFirst())
        var orphanEvidence = captured
        orphanEvidence.legacyTransportEvidence = [
            LegacyStorageEvidence(
                storageVersion: evidence.storageVersion,
                rawStorageBase64: evidence.rawStorageBase64,
                rawStorageSha256: orphanRawSHA,
                parsedTransportEvidence:
                    evidence.parsedTransportEvidence
            ),
        ]
        try assertStartupRejects(
            orphanEvidence,
            mutation: "orphan_unknown_raw_sha_evidence"
        )

        let mismatchedRawStorageBase64 = Data(
            #"{"storageVersion":1}"#.utf8
        ).base64EncodedString()
        var rawBase64Mismatch = captured
        rawBase64Mismatch.legacyTransportEvidence = [
            LegacyStorageEvidence(
                storageVersion: evidence.storageVersion,
                rawStorageBase64: mismatchedRawStorageBase64,
                rawStorageSha256: evidence.rawStorageSha256,
                parsedTransportEvidence:
                    evidence.parsedTransportEvidence
            ),
        ]
        try assertStartupRejects(
            rawBase64Mismatch,
            mutation: "same_sha_mismatched_raw_storage_base64"
        )

        var parsedEvidenceMismatch = captured
        parsedEvidenceMismatch.legacyTransportEvidence = [
            LegacyStorageEvidence(
                storageVersion: evidence.storageVersion,
                rawStorageBase64: evidence.rawStorageBase64,
                rawStorageSha256: evidence.rawStorageSha256,
                parsedTransportEvidence: .object([
                    "mutation": .string(
                        "parsed_transport_evidence_mismatch"
                    ),
                ])
            ),
        ]
        try assertStartupRejects(
            parsedEvidenceMismatch,
            mutation:
                "same_sha_and_base64_mismatched_parsed_transport_evidence"
        )
    }

    func testEachLegacySourceRecordAttemptsReducerApplyAtMostOnce()
        throws {
        let roundId = "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
        let roundStart = try legalIOSV1RoundStart(roundId: roundId)
        guard case .object(let install)? = roundStart.payload[
                "deviceRoundInstallBinding"
              ] else {
            XCTFail("missing deviceRoundInstallBinding")
            return
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(install.count, 11)
        XCTAssertEqual(
            install["deviceId"],
            .string(roundStart.originDeviceId)
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(
            install["snapshotId"],
            .string(try XCTUnwrap(roundStart.snapshotId))
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(install["profileId"], .string("ios-v1"))
        XCTAssertEqual(
            roundStart.roundSemanticBindingHash,
            try TypedID.make(
                domain: "RoundSemanticBinding/v1",
                value: .object([
                    "snapshotId": install["snapshotId"]!,
                    "courseLayoutIdentityId":
                        install["courseLayoutIdentityId"]!,
                    "layoutRevisionId": install["layoutRevisionId"]!,
                    "teeSelectionId": install["teeSelectionId"]!,
                    "liveRoundPackageId":
                        install["liveRoundPackageId"]!,
                ])
            )
        )
        let rawLines = [
            #"{"eventId":"runtime-score-1","roundId":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444","timestamp":"2026-07-18T00:00:01Z","hole":1,"kind":"score","payload":{"strokes":4}}"#,
            #"{"eventId":"runtime-putt-1","roundId":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444","timestamp":"2026-07-18T00:00:02Z","hole":1,"kind":"putt","payload":{"putts":2}}"#,
        ]
        let authorityData = Data(
            rawLines.joined(separator: "\n").utf8
        )
        let authority = try SealedLegacyAuthority.make(
            authorityKind:
                LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator.iosEventsAuthorityKind,
            authorityFile: authorityData,
            observers: .init()
        )
        let authorityKey = LegacyAuthorityProcessingKey(
            authorityKind: authority.authorityKind,
            authorityId: authority.authorityId
        )
        let recorder = LegacyAuthorityProcessingRecorder()
        let observers = recorder.observers

        let invalidStarts = [
            (
                "nonhex_install_ack",
                try legalIOSV1RoundStart(
                    roundId: roundId,
                    installAckId: "not-hex"
                )
            ),
            (
                "invalid_install_uuid_version",
                try legalIOSV1RoundStart(
                    roundId: roundId,
                    installInstanceId:
                        "9a3d4f6b-2c71-0e85-9b06-1f2a3c4d5e6f"
                )
            ),
            (
                "invalid_calendar_date",
                try legalIOSV1RoundStart(
                    roundId: roundId,
                    verifiedAt: "2026-02-30T00:00:00.000Z"
                )
            ),
        ]
        for (mutation, invalidStart) in invalidStarts {
            XCTAssertThrowsError(
                try LegacyAuthorityProcessingObserverScope.$current
                    .withValue(observers) {
                        try LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator
                            .classificationBatch(
                                authority: authority,
                                authorityData: authorityData,
                                durableEvents: [invalidStart],
                                legacyWireBindings: [:]
                            )
                    },
                mutation
            ) { error in
                XCTAssertEqual(
                    error as? DomainLedgerError,
                    .roundContextMismatch,
                    mutation
                )
            }
            let rejected = recorder.observation()
            XCTAssertTrue(rejected.applyAttempts.isEmpty, mutation)
            XCTAssertEqual(rejected.applyAttemptTotal, 0, mutation)
            recorder.reset()
        }

        let batch = try LegacyAuthorityProcessingObserverScope.$current
            .withValue(observers) {
                try LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator.classificationBatch(
                    authority: authority,
                    authorityData: authorityData,
                    durableEvents: [roundStart],
                    legacyWireBindings: [:]
                )
            }

        XCTAssertEqual(batch.authority, authority)
        XCTAssertEqual(batch.sourceRecords.map(\.sourceLine), [1, 2])
        XCTAssertEqual(batch.results.count, 2)
        let observation = recorder.observation()
        XCTAssertEqual(
            observation.passesByAuthority,
            [
                authorityKey: .init(
                    sealed: 1,
                    decodedOrRead: 1,
                    rosterScanned: 1,
                    classificationBuilt: 1
                ),
            ]
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(
            Set(observation.applyAttempts.keys.map(\.authority)),
            Set([authorityKey])
        )
        let seedAttempt = LegacyAuthorityProcessingRecorder.ApplyAttempt(
            authority: authorityKey,
            eventIdentity: try roundStart.eventIdentity(),
            sourceOrdinal: 0
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(observation.applyAttempts[seedAttempt], 1)

        var importedCount = 0
        for (sourceRecord, result) in zip(
            batch.sourceRecords,
            batch.results
        ) {
            guard case .importedEvent(let imported) = result else {
                XCTFail("expected imported source line \(sourceRecord.sourceLine)")
                continue
            }
            importedCount += 1
            let rowAttempt =
                LegacyAuthorityProcessingRecorder.ApplyAttempt(
                    authority: authorityKey,
                    eventIdentity:
                        try imported.candidate.event.eventIdentity(),
                    sourceOrdinal: sourceRecord.sourceLine
                )
            XCTAssertEqual(
                observation.applyAttempts[rowAttempt],
                1,
                "source line \(sourceRecord.sourceLine)"
            )
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(importedCount, 2)
        let expectedApplyAttemptCount = 1 + batch.sourceRecords.count
        XCTAssertEqual(expectedApplyAttemptCount, 3)
        XCTAssertEqual(
            observation.applyAttempts.count,
            expectedApplyAttemptCount
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(
            observation.applyAttemptTotal,
            expectedApplyAttemptCount
        )
        XCTAssertTrue(
            observation.applyAttempts.values.allSatisfy { $0 == 1 }
        )
    }
}

private extension Array {
    var only: Element? { count == 1 ? self[0] : nil }
}
```

前五个RED tests是Phase 2B2c-A的runtime proof，后两个是Phase 2B2c-B的startup/reducer runtime proof，总计七个，均不是source-string proxy。recorder的五个callback只在`NSLock`内累加typed key/counter，绝不重入XCTest、store或migration API；fixture、sealed authority、validated snapshot与legal V2 bytes全部在`LegacyAuthorityProcessingObserverScope.$current.withValue(...)`外构造。两个cold-start authority故意使用同一`ios-events-jsonl-v1` kind但不同whole-file bytes/authority IDs，防止kind-only聚合蒙混过关。storage-v1 capture必须调用原三参数`migrateIfNeeded(stateURL:expectedOriginDeviceId:faultHook:)`，startup/cache与五个bijection mutation必须调用原三参数`open(directoryURL:expectedOriginDeviceId:faultHook:)`，ordinary mutation必须调用public `reserveClientSequence()`；raw iOS authority test必须调用production `classificationBatch(authority:authorityData:durableEvents:legacyWireBindings:)`并以exact authority ID记录seed/source-row attempts。该同一B test先把nonhex install authority、UUID version nibble非法与真实calendar date非法的三份durable start逐一送入raw-authority入口，全部必须映射为`roundContextMismatch`且在任何seed/source reducer attempt前失败；每个case后reset recorder，再以合法start执行原exact-once断言。observer seam不得成为caller-visible production参数。

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomainTests/LegacyDomainEventAdapterTests.swift
import XCTest
@testable import AICaddieDomain

final class LegacyDomainEventAdapterTests: XCTestCase {
    func testKnownKindKeepsKindAndDerivesEntity() throws {
        let kind = RoundEventKind(rawValue: "hole_score_set")
        XCTAssertEqual(try LegacyDomainEventAdapter.adaptedKind(kind), kind)
        XCTAssertEqual(
            try LegacyDomainEventAdapter.entityRef(
                eventId: "score-1", roundId: "round-1", kind: kind,
                payload: ["hole": .integer(7), "strokes": .integer(4)]
            ),
            "round:round-1:hole:7:score"
        )
    }

    func testUnknownKindPrefixingIsIdempotentAndEntityUsesEventId() throws {
        let first = try LegacyDomainEventAdapter.adaptedKind(
            RoundEventKind(rawValue: "future_kind")
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(first.rawValue, "legacy_v1_future_kind")
        XCTAssertEqual(try LegacyDomainEventAdapter.adaptedKind(first), first)
        XCTAssertEqual(
            try LegacyDomainEventAdapter.entityRef(
                eventId: "future-1", roundId: "round-1", kind: first, payload: [:]
            ),
            "legacy:round-1:future-1"
        )
    }

    func testMergeControlAndMissingKnownPayloadFieldFailClosed() throws {
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try LegacyDomainEventAdapter.adaptedKind(
            RoundEventKind(rawValue: "round_merge_resolution")
        )) { error in
            XCTAssertEqual(
                error as? LegacyDomainEventAdapterError,
                .unsupportedLegacyMergeControl
            )
        }
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try LegacyDomainEventAdapter.entityRef(
            eventId: "score-1", roundId: "round-1",
            kind: RoundEventKind(rawValue: "hole_score_set"),
            payload: ["strokes": .integer(4)]
        )) { error in
            XCTAssertEqual(
                error as? LegacyDomainEventAdapterError,
                .missingPayloadField("hole")
            )
        }
    }
}
```

```python
# tests/test_swift_domain_api_surface.py
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest


class SwiftDomainAPISurfaceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_only_composition_root_exposes_public_ledger_construction(self) -> None:
        subprocess.run(["swift", "build", "--target", "AICaddieDomain"], check=True)
        bin_path = Path(subprocess.check_output(
            ["swift", "build", "--show-bin-path"], text=True
        ).strip())
        target_info = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(
            ["swift", "-print-target-info"], text=True
        ))
        triple = target_info["target"]["triple"]
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            subprocess.run([
                "swift", "symbolgraph-extract",
                "-module-name", "AICaddieDomain",
                "-I", str(bin_path / "Modules"),
                "-target", triple,
                "-minimum-access-level", "public",
                "-output-dir", directory,
            ], check=True)
            graph_path = next(Path(directory).glob("AICaddieDomain*.symbols.json"))
            symbols = json.loads(graph_path.read_text())["symbols"]
        paths = [symbol["pathComponents"] for symbol in symbols]
        self.assertNotIn(
            ["DomainLedgerStore", "init(directoryURL:faultHook:)"],
            paths,
        )
        self.assertIn(
            [
                "DomainLedgerCompositionRoot",
                "open(directoryURL:expectedOriginDeviceId:faultHook:)",
            ],
            paths,
        )
        self.assertFalse(any("DomainLedgerStateV2" in path for path in paths))
        self.assertFalse(any("transaction" in path for path in paths))
        for forbidden_type in (
            "RoundEventAppendValidationModeV3",
            "PreparedResolutionCommitAppendCapability",
            "VerifiedPeerPreparedCommitAppendCapability",
            "VerifiedPeerBundleImportCapability",
            "LegacyDomainLedgerStateV2",
            "LegacyOutboxRecordV2",
        ):
            self.assertFalse(
                any(forbidden_type in component for path in paths
                    for component in path),
                forbidden_type,
            )
        self.assertFalse(any(
            "trustedPeerServerKeys" in component
            for path in paths for component in path
        ))
        self.assertFalse(any(
            "source:transportClass" in component
            for path in paths for component in path
        ))

    def test_app_module_can_construct_only_the_public_domain_dtos(self) -> None:
        subprocess.run(["swift", "build", "--target", "AICaddieDomain"], check=True)
        bin_path = Path(subprocess.check_output(
            ["swift", "build", "--show-bin-path"], text=True
        ).strip())
        source = r'''
import AICaddieDomain

func compilePublicDTOs(
    event: DomainRoundEvent,
    order: DomainProjectionOrder,
    receipt: EventReceipt
) {
    _ = EntityRevisionToken(
        scopeId: "scope-1", reducerVersion: "round-reducer-v2",
        canonicalOrdinal: 0, entityProjectionHash: String(repeating: "a", count: 64),
        contributingEventSetHash: String(repeating: "b", count: 64),
        provisionalFlag: true
    )
    _ = RoundEventContext(
        ownerAccountId: "acct-1", subjectPlayerId: "player-1",
        actorId: "player-1", roundId: "round-1", roundIntentId: "intent-1",
        roundIncarnationId: "inc-1", snapshotId: "snapshot-1",
        semanticBindingHash: "binding-1", deviceRoundInstallBinding: .object([:])
    )
    _ = DomainProjectionInput(event: event, projectionOrder: order)
    _ = EventWriteResponseV2(
        schema: "ai-caddie-event-write-response-v2",
        requestHash: String(repeating: "c", count: 64),
        requestBodySha256: String(repeating: "d", count: 64),

}
'''
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            source_path = Path(directory) / "ExternalDomainDTOConsumer.swift"
            source_path.write_text(source)
            subprocess.run([
                "swiftc", "-typecheck", "-I", str(bin_path / "Modules"),
                str(source_path),
            ], check=True)

    def test_event_validation_modes_and_legacy_candidate_have_exact_owners(self) -> None:
        root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
        production_roots = [
            root / "mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain",
            root / "mobile/ios/AICaddie",
            root / "mobile/ios/AICaddieWatch",
        ]
        sources = {
            path.relative_to(root).as_posix(): path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            for source_root in production_roots
            for path in source_root.rglob("*.swift")
        }

        def owners(pattern: re.Pattern[str]) -> set[str]:
            return {
                path for path, body in sources.items() if pattern.search(body)
            }

        constructor = re.compile(
            r"\bLegacyDomainEventMigrationCandidate\s*\(\s*event\s*:"
        )
        constructor_owners = owners(constructor)
        self.assertEqual(
            constructor_owners,
            {"mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/LegacyDomainEventAdapter.swift"},
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            len(list(constructor.finditer(
                sources["mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/LegacyDomainEventAdapter.swift"]
            ))),
            1,
        )

        factory = re.compile(
            r"\bLegacyDomainEventAdapter\s*\.\s*makeMigrationCandidate\s*\("
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            owners(factory),
            {
                "mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator.swift",
            },
        )
        validated_storage_snapshot = re.compile(
            r"\bLegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator\s*\.\s*"
            r"validatedStorageV1Snapshot\s*\("
            r"\s*validatedAuthority\s*:"
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            owners(validated_storage_snapshot),
            {"mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/DomainLedgerStorageMigration.swift"},
        )
        coordinator = sources[
            "mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator.swift"
        ]
        self.assertRegex(
            coordinator,
            r"(?m)^\s{4}static func validatedStorageV1Snapshot\(\s*"
            r"validatedAuthority\s+authority\s*:",
        )
        self.assertNotRegex(
            coordinator,
            r"fileprivate\s+static\s+func\s+"
            r"validatedStorageV1Snapshot\(\s*"
            r"validatedAuthority\s+authority\s*:",
        )
        source_records_declaration = re.compile(
            r"(?m)^[ \t]*(?:(?:public|package|internal|fileprivate|private)\s+)?"
            r"static\s+func\s+sourceRecords\s*\("
        )
        self.assertIsNone(
            source_records_declaration.search(coordinator),
        )
        self.assertNotRegex(
            coordinator,
            r"static\s+func\s+make\s*\(\s*authorityFile\s*:\s*Data",
        )
        composition_root = sources[
            "mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/DomainLedgerCompositionRoot.swift"
        ]
        open_start = composition_root.index("public static func open(")
        open_end = composition_root.index(
            "static func releaseForTesting", open_start
        )
        self.assertNotIn(
            "validateStorageV2()",
            composition_root[open_start:open_end],
        )
        store_path = "mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/DomainLedgerStore.swift"
        for pattern in (
            re.compile(r"\bvalidationMode\s*:\s*\.locallyAuthored\b"),
            re.compile(
                r"\bvalidationMode\s*:\s*\.sealedLegacyMigration\s*\("
            ),
        ):
```

`NumberVector` 是 `{bitPatternHex, expected}`；`tools/contracts/generate_rfc8785_vectors.py` 用固定 LCG seed 生成 bit pattern，跳过 NaN/Infinity/negative-zero，以 Python `rfc8785.dumps(value).decode()` 写 expected。测试读取 checked-in expected，禁止运行时调用 Python。Web 加同一 fixture 测试：

```typescript
import canonicalize from 'canonicalize'

function validateCanonicalValue(value: unknown): void {
  if (value === null || typeof value === 'boolean') return
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    if (value.normalize('NFC') !== value) throw new TypeError('strings must be NFC')
    return
  }
  if (typeof value === 'number') {
    if (!Number.isFinite(value) || Object.is(value, -0)) throw new TypeError('invalid canonical number')
    if (Number.isInteger(value) && !Number.isSafeInteger(value)) throw new TypeError('unsafe canonical integer')
    return
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) { value.forEach(validateCanonicalValue); return }
  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>)) {
      validateCanonicalValue(key); validateCanonicalValue(child)
    }
    return
  }
  throw new TypeError('unsupported canonical JSON value')
}

export function canonicalJsonBytes(value: unknown): Uint8Array {
  validateCanonicalValue(value)
  const text = canonicalize(value)
  if (text === undefined) throw new TypeError('unsupported canonical JSON value')
  return new TextEncoder().encode(text)
}

export async function typedId(domainTag: string, value: unknown): Promise<string> {
  const prefix = new TextEncoder().encode(`${domainTag}\0`)
  const body = canonicalJsonBytes(value)
  const input = new Uint8Array(prefix.length + body.length)
  input.set(prefix); input.set(body, prefix.length)
  const digest = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', input))
  return [...digest].map(byte => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/DomainRoundEvent.swift
import Foundation

public enum StreamSubject: Codable, Equatable, Sendable {
    case roundIncarnation(String)
    case mergeControl(String)

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey { case kind, roundIncarnationId, mergeControlId }

    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let values = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        switch try values.decode(String.self, forKey: .kind) {
        case "round_incarnation": self = .roundIncarnation(try values.decode(String.self, forKey: .roundIncarnationId))
        case "merge_control": self = .mergeControl(try values.decode(String.self, forKey: .mergeControlId))
        default: throw DecodingError.dataCorruptedError(forKey: .kind, in: values, debugDescription: "unknown stream subject")
        }
    }

    public func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {
        var values = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        switch self {
        case .roundIncarnation(let value):
            try values.encode("round_incarnation", forKey: .kind); try values.encode(value, forKey: .roundIncarnationId)
        case .mergeControl(let value):
            try values.encode("merge_control", forKey: .kind); try values.encode(value, forKey: .mergeControlId)
        }
    }
}

public struct DomainRoundEvent: Codable, Equatable, Identifiable, Sendable {
    public var id: String { eventId }
    public let eventId: String
    public let originDeviceId: String
    public let originEpoch: String
    public let clientSequence: Int

    public let baseEntityRevision: EntityRevisionToken?
    public let transactionRef: ResolutionCommitTransactionRef?
    public let occurredAt: String
    public let schemaVersion: Int

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case eventId, originDeviceId, originEpoch, clientSequence, ownerAccountId, subjectPlayerId, actorId
        case roundId, streamSubject, roundIntentId, snapshotId, roundSemanticBindingHash, kind, entityRef
        case payload, causationId, baseEntityRevision, transactionRef, occurredAt, schemaVersion
    }

    public init(
        eventId: String,
        originDeviceId: String,
        originEpoch: String,
        clientSequence: Int,
        ownerAccountId: String,
        subjectPlayerId: String,
        actorId: String,
        roundId: String,
        streamSubject: StreamSubject,
        roundIntentId: String?,
        snapshotId: String?,
        roundSemanticBindingHash: String?,
        kind: RoundEventKind,
        entityRef: String,
        payload: [String: JSONValue],
        causationId: String?,
        baseEntityRevision: EntityRevisionToken?,
        occurredAt: String,
        transactionRef: ResolutionCommitTransactionRef? = nil,
        schemaVersion: Int = 2
    ) {
        self.eventId = eventId
        self.originDeviceId = originDeviceId
        self.originEpoch = originEpoch
        self.clientSequence = clientSequence
        self.ownerAccountId = ownerAccountId
        self.subjectPlayerId = subjectPlayerId
        self.actorId = actorId
        self.roundId = roundId
        self.streamSubject = streamSubject
        self.roundIntentId = roundIntentId
        self.snapshotId = snapshotId

        self.kind = kind

        self.payload = payload
        self.causationId = causationId
        self.baseEntityRevision = baseEntityRevision
        self.transactionRef = transactionRef
        self.occurredAt = occurredAt
        self.schemaVersion = schemaVersion
    }

    public func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {
        var values = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        try values.encode(eventId, forKey: .eventId)
        try values.encode(originDeviceId, forKey: .originDeviceId)
        try values.encode(originEpoch, forKey: .originEpoch)
        try values.encode(clientSequence, forKey: .clientSequence)
        try values.encode(ownerAccountId, forKey: .ownerAccountId)
        try values.encode(subjectPlayerId, forKey: .subjectPlayerId)
        try values.encode(actorId, forKey: .actorId)
        try values.encode(roundId, forKey: .roundId)
        try values.encode(streamSubject, forKey: .streamSubject)
        if let roundIntentId { try values.encode(roundIntentId, forKey: .roundIntentId) } else { try values.encodeNil(forKey: .roundIntentId) }
        if let snapshotId { try values.encode(snapshotId, forKey: .snapshotId) } else { try values.encodeNil(forKey: .snapshotId) }
        if let roundSemanticBindingHash { try values.encode(roundSemanticBindingHash, forKey: .roundSemanticBindingHash) } else { try values.encodeNil(forKey: .roundSemanticBindingHash) }
        try values.encode(kind, forKey: .kind)
        try values.encode(entityRef, forKey: .entityRef)
        try values.encode(payload, forKey: .payload)
        if let causationId { try values.encode(causationId, forKey: .causationId) } else { try values.encodeNil(forKey: .causationId) }
        if let baseEntityRevision { try values.encode(baseEntityRevision, forKey: .baseEntityRevision) } else { try values.encodeNil(forKey: .baseEntityRevision) }
        if let transactionRef { try values.encode(transactionRef, forKey: .transactionRef) } else { try values.encodeNil(forKey: .transactionRef) }
        try values.encode(occurredAt, forKey: .occurredAt)
        try values.encode(schemaVersion, forKey: .schemaVersion)
    }

    public func eventIdentity() throws -> String {

            originDeviceId: originDeviceId, originEpoch: originEpoch, eventId: eventId
        ))
    }

    public func eventHash() throws -> String {
        try TypedID.make(domain: "RoundEvent/v2", value: self)
    }
}

public struct DomainProjectionOrder: Codable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public let authority: ProjectionAuthority
    public let ledgerPartitionId: String?
    public let ledgerPosition: CanonicalLedgerPosition?
    public let sourceOrdinal: Int

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case authority, ledgerPartitionId, ledgerPosition, sourceOrdinal
    }

    public init(
        authority: ProjectionAuthority,
        ledgerPartitionId: String?,
        ledgerPosition: CanonicalLedgerPosition?,
        sourceOrdinal: Int
    ) throws {
        guard sourceOrdinal >= 0 else { throw DomainReducerError.invalidProjectionOrder }
        switch authority {
        case .canonicalReplay:
            guard let ledgerPartitionId,
                  DomainStringValidation.isLowercaseHex64(ledgerPartitionId),
                  let ledgerPosition, ledgerPosition.rawValue != "0" else {
                throw DomainReducerError.invalidProjectionOrder
            }
        case .localProvisional, .peerProvisional,
             .localPreparedResolutionCommit, .acceptedAwaitingReplay,
             .localTerminalFallback:
            guard ledgerPartitionId == nil, ledgerPosition == nil else {
                throw DomainReducerError.invalidProjectionOrder
            }
        }
        self.authority = authority
        self.ledgerPartitionId = ledgerPartitionId
        self.ledgerPosition = ledgerPosition
        self.sourceOrdinal = sourceOrdinal
    }

    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let values = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        try self.init(
            authority: values.decode(ProjectionAuthority.self, forKey: .authority),
            ledgerPartitionId: values.decodeIfPresent(
                String.self,
                forKey: .ledgerPartitionId
            ),
            ledgerPosition: values.decodeIfPresent(
                CanonicalLedgerPosition.self,
                forKey: .ledgerPosition
            ),
            sourceOrdinal: values.decode(Int.self, forKey: .sourceOrdinal)
        )
    }

    public func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {
        var values = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        try values.encode(authority, forKey: .authority)
        if let ledgerPartitionId {
            try values.encode(ledgerPartitionId, forKey: .ledgerPartitionId)
        } else {
            try values.encodeNil(forKey: .ledgerPartitionId)
        }
        if let ledgerPosition {
            try values.encode(ledgerPosition, forKey: .ledgerPosition)
        } else {
            try values.encodeNil(forKey: .ledgerPosition)
        }
        try values.encode(sourceOrdinal, forKey: .sourceOrdinal)
    }
}

public struct DomainProjectionInput: Codable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public let event: DomainRoundEvent
    public let projectionOrder: DomainProjectionOrder

    public init(
        event: DomainRoundEvent,
        projectionOrder: DomainProjectionOrder
    ) {
        self.event = event
        self.projectionOrder = projectionOrder
    }
}

    }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/CanonicalLedgerPosition.swift
import Foundation

public enum CanonicalLedgerPositionError: Error, Equatable {
    case nonCanonical
    case overflow
}

enum DomainStringValidation {
    static func isLowercaseHex64(_ value: String) -> Bool {
        value.utf8.count == 64 && value.utf8.allSatisfy {
            (48...57).contains($0) || (97...102).contains($0)
        }
    }
}

public struct CanonicalLedgerPosition: Codable, Hashable, Comparable, Sendable {
    public static let maximum = "9223372036854775807"
    public let rawValue: String

    public init(_ rawValue: String) throws {
        guard !rawValue.isEmpty,
              rawValue.utf8.allSatisfy({ (48...57).contains(Int($0)) }),
              rawValue == "0" || rawValue.first != "0",
              (rawValue.count < Self.maximum.count
               || (rawValue.count == Self.maximum.count && rawValue <= Self.maximum)) else {
            throw CanonicalLedgerPositionError.nonCanonical
        }
        self.rawValue = rawValue
    }

    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let container = try decoder.singleValueContainer()
        try self.init(container.decode(String.self))
    }

    public func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {
        var container = encoder.singleValueContainer()
        try container.encode(rawValue)
    }

    public static func < (lhs: Self, rhs: Self) -> Bool {
        lhs.rawValue.count < rhs.rawValue.count
            || (lhs.rawValue.count == rhs.rawValue.count
                && lhs.rawValue < rhs.rawValue)
    }

    public func successor() throws -> Self {
        guard rawValue != Self.maximum else {
            throw CanonicalLedgerPositionError.overflow
        }
        var digits = Array(rawValue.utf8)
        var index = digits.count
        while index > 0 {
            index -= 1
            if digits[index] < 57 {
                digits[index] += 1
                return try Self(String(decoding: digits, as: UTF8.self))
            }
            digits[index] = 48
        }
        digits.insert(49, at: 0)
        return try Self(String(decoding: digits, as: UTF8.self))
    }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/CanonicalRequestTarget.swift
import Foundation

public enum CanonicalRequestTargetError: Error, Equatable {
    case nonASCIIOrInvalidPath
    case tooManyQueryFields
    case invalidPercentEncoding
    case invalidUTF8
}

public enum CanonicalRequestTarget {
    public static func normalize(_ rawTarget: String) throws -> String {
        guard rawTarget.utf8.allSatisfy({ $0 < 128 }), rawTarget.first == "/" else {
            throw CanonicalRequestTargetError.nonASCIIOrInvalidPath
        }
        let pieces = rawTarget.split(
            separator: "?",
            maxSplits: 1,
            omittingEmptySubsequences: false
        )
        let path = String(pieces[0])
        guard path.utf8.count <= 512 else {
            throw CanonicalRequestTargetError.nonASCIIOrInvalidPath
        }
        guard pieces.count == 2, !pieces[1].isEmpty else { return path }
        guard pieces[1].utf8.count <= 4_096 else {
            throw CanonicalRequestTargetError.nonASCIIOrInvalidPath
        }
        let rawFields = pieces[1].split(
            separator: "&",
            omittingEmptySubsequences: false
        )
        guard rawFields.count <= 64 else {
            throw CanonicalRequestTargetError.tooManyQueryFields
        }
        let pairs = try rawFields.filter { !$0.isEmpty }.map { field -> (String, String) in
            let pair = field.split(
                separator: "=",
                maxSplits: 1,
                omittingEmptySubsequences: false
            )
            return (
                try decodeFormComponent(pair[0]),
                try decodeFormComponent(pair.count == 2 ? pair[1] : "")
            )
        }.sorted { ($0.0, $0.1) < ($1.0, $1.1) }
        guard !pairs.isEmpty else { return path }
        return path + "?" + pairs.map {
            "\(encodeQueryComponent($0.0))=\(encodeQueryComponent($0.1))"
        }.joined(separator: "&")
    }

    private static func decodeFormComponent(_ raw: Substring) throws -> String {
        let bytes = Array(raw.utf8)
        var decoded: [UInt8] = []
        var index = 0
        while index < bytes.count {
            if bytes[index] == 43 {
                decoded.append(32); index += 1; continue
            }
            if bytes[index] == 37 {
                guard index + 2 < bytes.count,
                      let high = hex(bytes[index + 1]),
                      let low = hex(bytes[index + 2]) else {
                    throw CanonicalRequestTargetError.invalidPercentEncoding
                }
                decoded.append(high * 16 + low); index += 3; continue
            }
            decoded.append(bytes[index]); index += 1
        }
        guard let result = String(bytes: decoded, encoding: .utf8) else {
            throw CanonicalRequestTargetError.invalidUTF8
        }
        return result
    }

    private static func encodeQueryComponent(_ value: String) -> String {
        value.utf8.map { byte -> String in
            if (48...57).contains(byte) || (65...90).contains(byte)
                || (97...122).contains(byte) || [45, 46, 95, 126].contains(byte) {
                return String(UnicodeScalar(byte))
            }
            return String(format: "%%%02X", byte)
        }.joined()
    }

    private static func hex(_ byte: UInt8) -> UInt8? {
        switch byte {
        case 48...57: return byte - 48
        case 65...70: return byte - 55
        case 97...102: return byte - 87
        default: return nil
        }
    }
}
```

Python/Swift都实现上面冻结的同一byte algorithm，而不是委托平台URL parser：raw path必须ASCII、以`/`开头且最多512 bytes并原样保留；raw query最多4096 bytes，先按`&`切出最多64个字段（空字段也计入上限，随后忽略），每字段只按首个`=`分割；`+`解为space，`%HH`必须完整合法，decoded bytes必须UTF-8；按decoded `(key,value)`排序后以RFC3986 unreserved allowlist重编码、space变`%20`、percent hex大写。无`=`字段canonicalize为`key=`。golden显式覆盖65个空段、`%ZZ`、孤立`%`、invalid UTF-8及512/4096边界。任何Swift callsite使用`URLComponents`/`URLQueryItem`重建待签target都由symbol test失败。

`DomainProjectionOrder` 使用 custom `init(from:)` 调用上面的 validating initializer；生成的 projection-order schema validator 在 Codable 前拒绝 unknown/missing keys，所以 Swift decoder 不能依赖 `JSONDecoder` 静默忽略额外字段。Swift 只允许通过 `CanonicalLedgerPosition.successor()` 做有上界的单步连续性检查；排序、比较和 storage 永远使用长度+字典序，不调用 `Int(rawValue)`，任意通用算术只留在 server Python 的 bounded internal representation。

### Task 11 frozen storage-v1 → storage-v2 capture foundation

Task 11只建立Task 5 storage-v1 bytes → storage-v2 sealed/pending/raw-evidence的原子capture foundation。它不得把旧transport state提前分类成V2 operational records；完成primary replace前，staging storage-v2必须逐项证明：

- Task 5 `originDeviceId/originEpoch/lastReservedClientSequence` exact迁入v2 origin sequence authority，并在任何新reserve/append前生效；sequence不得回退或复用。
- 完整storage-v1 file只形成一个exact `SealedLegacyAuthority`；authority Base64/SHA必须byte-for-byte覆盖source，不能只保存parsed summary。
- `LegacyAuthoritySourceRecord` roster与V1 events one-based、同序、同长；每项冻结canonical `StoredEventV1` row bytes/SHA、eventId与roundId。`PendingLegacyAuthorityMigration.sourceRecords/sourceRoundIds`必须由该唯一scanner roster直接派生。
- 同一authority在`pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations`与`completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations`之间exact XOR；Task 11 capture结果必须pending且completed缺失。
- fixture内outbox/dead-letter/receipt/binding/prepared batch/relay/anomaly/marker仍只存在于sealed raw authority与`LegacyStorageEvidence.parsedTransportEvidence`中；Task 11不得伪造`events/outbox/receipts/localProjectionInputs/migrationDeadLetters/migrationMarkers`或任何legacy operational map。
- fault before primary replace得到byte-identical storage-v1；fault after replace只能得到完成strict validation的完整pending storage-v2。exact retry不得重复sealed authority、pending record或raw evidence。

Task 12才在durable context到齐后从同一locked state snapshot构造一次`LegacyAuthorityClassificationBatch`，并在一个transaction中原子完成pending → completed及旧retryable rows、terminal receipts、dead letters、bindings/aliases、prepared bytes、relay/anomaly/marker的operational merge。Task 11 capture测试只证明source authority没有丢失或被伪造；Task 12 completion测试负责逐字段证明旧transport继续工作。

storage-v1的原始文件bytes只由`LegacyStorageEvidence.rawStorageBase64/rawStorageSha256`与matching `SealedLegacyAuthority`作exact authority，必须byte-for-byte保留。Task 11 source-record raw bytes固定为`CanonicalJSON.data(StoredEventV1)`；`MigrationDeadLetter`只在Task 12 classification后产生，不得在capture阶段冒充已完成分类。

`DomainLedgerCompositionRoot.open` 延续 Task 5 single-root owner cache/guard；它不得每次调用都创建第二个 production store。migration在该root owner建立前执行，staging使用明确的private/unregistered store constructor，避免递归或绕过owner规则。

Task 11 必须把 Task 5 的 `DomainLedgerStateV1` 与 store implementation **整体替换**为下面的 storage-v2 production definition；后续 extension 只扩展这一份 state，不能继续引用 `load()` 或分散声明“state field”：

```swift

public struct OriginSequenceState: Codable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public let originDeviceId: String
    public let originEpoch: String
    public var lastReservedClientSequence: Int

    public static func fresh(originDeviceId: String) throws -> OriginSequenceState {
        guard !originDeviceId.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        return OriginSequenceState(
            originDeviceId: originDeviceId,
            originEpoch: UUID().uuidString.lowercased(),
            lastReservedClientSequence: 0
        )
    }
}

public struct MigrationDeadLetter: Codable, Equatable {
    public let id: String
    public let sourceLine: Int
    public let eventId: String?
    public let roundId: String?
    public let reasonCode: String
    public let rawBase64: String

    public static func make(
        sourceLine: Int,
        eventId: String?,
        roundId: String?,
        reasonCode: String,
        raw: Data
    ) throws -> MigrationDeadLetter {
        let rawBase64 = raw.base64EncodedString()
        let id = try TypedID.make(domain: "MigrationDeadLetter/v1", value: .object([
            "sourceLine": .integer(Int64(sourceLine)),
            "eventId": eventId.map(JSONValue.string) ?? .null,
            "roundId": roundId.map(JSONValue.string) ?? .null,
            "reasonCode": .string(reasonCode),
            "rawBase64": .string(rawBase64),
        ]))
        return MigrationDeadLetter(
            id: id, sourceLine: sourceLine, eventId: eventId, roundId: roundId,
            reasonCode: reasonCode, rawBase64: rawBase64
        )
    }
}

extension MigrationDeadLetter {
    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey, CaseIterable {
        case id, sourceLine, eventId, roundId, reasonCode, rawBase64
    }

    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let values = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        let present = Set(values.allKeys.map(\.rawValue))
        let required = Set(CodingKeys.allCases.map(\.rawValue))
        guard present == required else {
            throw DecodingError.dataCorrupted(.init(
                codingPath: decoder.codingPath,
                debugDescription:
                    "MigrationDeadLetter requires all six known keys"
            ))
        }
        id = try values.decode(String.self, forKey: .id)
        sourceLine = try values.decode(Int.self, forKey: .sourceLine)
        eventId = try values.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .eventId)
        roundId = try values.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .roundId)
        reasonCode = try values.decode(String.self, forKey: .reasonCode)
        rawBase64 = try values.decode(String.self, forKey: .rawBase64)
    }

    public func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {
        var values = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        try values.encode(id, forKey: .id)
        try values.encode(sourceLine, forKey: .sourceLine)
        if let eventId {
            try values.encode(eventId, forKey: .eventId)
        } else {
            try values.encodeNil(forKey: .eventId)
        }
        if let roundId {
            try values.encode(roundId, forKey: .roundId)
        } else {
            try values.encodeNil(forKey: .roundId)
        }
        try values.encode(reasonCode, forKey: .reasonCode)
        try values.encode(rawBase64, forKey: .rawBase64)
    }
}

import Foundation

public struct CanonicalOriginEvidence: Codable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public let eventIdentity: String
    public let eventHash: String
    public let ownerAccountId: String
    public let streamSubject: StreamSubject
    public let ledgerPartitionId: String
    public let ledgerEpoch: Int
    public let streamId: String
    public let ledgerPosition: CanonicalLedgerPosition
    public let replayProofHash: String

    public init(
        eventIdentity: String,
        eventHash: String,
        ownerAccountId: String,
        streamSubject: StreamSubject,
        ledgerPartitionId: String,
        ledgerEpoch: Int,
        streamId: String,
        ledgerPosition: CanonicalLedgerPosition,
        replayProofHash: String
    ) {
        self.eventIdentity = eventIdentity
        self.eventHash = eventHash
        self.ownerAccountId = ownerAccountId
        self.streamSubject = streamSubject
        self.ledgerPartitionId = ledgerPartitionId
        self.ledgerEpoch = ledgerEpoch
        self.streamId = streamId
        self.ledgerPosition = ledgerPosition
        self.replayProofHash = replayProofHash
    }

    static func make(
        event: DomainRoundEvent,
        eventIdentity: String,
        eventHash: String,
        ledgerPartitionId: String,
        ledgerEpoch: Int,
        streamId: String,
        ledgerPosition: CanonicalLedgerPosition
    ) throws -> CanonicalOriginEvidence {
        let replayProofHash = try TypedID.make(
            domain: "CanonicalOriginProof/v1",
            value: .object([
                "eventIdentity": .string(eventIdentity),
                "eventHash": .string(eventHash),
                "ownerAccountId": .string(event.ownerAccountId),
                "streamSubject": try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(
                    JSONValue.self,
                    from: CanonicalJSON.data(event.streamSubject)
                ),
                "ledgerPartitionId": .string(ledgerPartitionId),
                "ledgerEpoch": .integer(Int64(ledgerEpoch)),
                "streamId": .string(streamId),
                "ledgerPosition": .string(ledgerPosition.rawValue),
            ])
        )
        return CanonicalOriginEvidence(
            eventIdentity: eventIdentity,
            eventHash: eventHash,
            ownerAccountId: event.ownerAccountId,
            streamSubject: event.streamSubject,
            ledgerPartitionId: ledgerPartitionId,
            ledgerEpoch: ledgerEpoch,
            streamId: streamId,
            ledgerPosition: ledgerPosition,
            replayProofHash: replayProofHash
        )
    }
}

struct CanonicalStringSet: Codable, Equatable, Sendable, Sequence,
    ExpressibleByArrayLiteral {
    private var values: Set<String>

    init(_ values: Set<String> = []) {
        self.values = values
    }

    init(arrayLiteral elements: String...) {
        self.values = Set(elements)
    }

    init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let container = try decoder.singleValueContainer()
        let ordered = try container.decode([String].self)
        guard ordered == ordered.sorted(),
              Set(ordered).count == ordered.count else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        values = Set(ordered)
    }

    func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {
        var container = encoder.singleValueContainer()
        try container.encode(values.sorted())
    }

    var isEmpty: Bool { values.isEmpty }
    var count: Int { values.count }
    func contains(_ value: String) -> Bool { values.contains(value) }
    func sorted() -> [String] { values.sorted() }
    func allSatisfy(_ predicate: (String) throws -> Bool) rethrows -> Bool {
        try values.allSatisfy(predicate)
    }
    func subtracting(_ other: Set<String>) -> Set<String> {
        values.subtracting(other)
    }
    @discardableResult
    mutating func insert(_ value: String) -> (inserted: Bool, memberAfterInsert: String) {
        values.insert(value)
    }
    mutating func formUnion(_ other: CanonicalStringSet) {
        values.formUnion(other.values)
    }
    func makeIterator() -> IndexingIterator<[String]> {
        values.sorted().makeIterator()
    }
}

        outbox: [OutboxRecord] = [],
        localOrdinaryOutboxEvidence: [String: LocalOrdinaryOutboxEvidence] = [:],
        sealedLegacyAuthorities: [String: SealedLegacyAuthority] = [:],
        pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations:
            [String: PendingLegacyAuthorityMigration] = [:],
        completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations:
            [String: CompletedLegacyAuthorityMigration] = [:],
        sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence: [String: SealedLegacyMigrationEvidence] = [:],
        verifiedPeerBundleAuthorities:
            [String: VerifiedPeerBundleAuthority] = [:],
        verifiedPeerCredentialVerificationRecords:
            [String: VerifiedPeerCredentialVerificationRecord] = [:],
        verifiedPeerBundleVerificationReceipts:
            [String: VerifiedPeerBundleVerificationReceipt] = [:],
        verifiedPeerBundleEvidence: [String: VerifiedPeerBundleEvidence] = [:],
        peerTakeoverWatermarks: [String: PeerTakeoverWatermark] = [:],
        peerBundleReceipts: [String: PeerBundleReceipt] = [:],
        legacyV1RetryableOutbox: [LegacyV1OutboxRecord] = [],
        deadLetters: [OutboxRecord] = [],
        receipts: [String: EventReceipt] = [:],
        acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay: [String: EventReceipt] = [:],
        legacyV1TerminalReceipts: [String: LegacyV1EventReceipt] = [:],
        legacyV1AcceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay: [String: LegacyV1AcceptedReplayEvidence] = [:],
        migrationMarkers: CanonicalStringSet = [],
        migrationDeadLetters: [MigrationDeadLetter] = [],
        transportAnomalies: [TransportAnomaly] = [],
        legacyTransportEvidence: [LegacyStorageEvidence] = [],
        legacyWireBindings: [String: LegacyWireBinding] = [:],
        preparedLegacyV1Batches: [String: PreparedLegacyV1Batch] = [:],
        watchTerminalReceiptRelayObligations: [String: WatchTerminalReceiptRelayObligation] = [:],
        watchTerminalReceiptRelayConfirmations: [String: WatchTerminalReceiptRelayConfirmation] = [:],
        shotCaptureStates: [String: DurableShotCaptureState] = [:],
        localProjectionInputs: [DomainProjectionInput] = [],
        inboundProjectionRecords: [InboundProjectionRecord] = [],
        stagedInboundProjectionRecords: [StagedInboundProjectionRecord] = [],
        canonicalOriginEvidence: [String: CanonicalOriginEvidence] = [:],
        canonicalMaterializationActivations: [String: CanonicalMaterializationActivation] = [:],
        canonicalMaterializationEvidence: [CanonicalMaterializationEvidence] = [],
        materializationActivationHighWaterByRound: [String: Int] = [:],
        inboundCursors: [String: InboundCursorState] = [:],
        stagedInboundCursors: [String: InboundCursorState] = [:],
        activeInboundPartitionsByRound: [String: CanonicalStringSet] = [:],
        stagedInboundPartitionsByRound: [String: CanonicalStringSet] = [:],
        inboundVectorsByRound: [String: InboundVectorState] = [:],
        stagedInboundVectorsByRound: [String: InboundVectorState] = [:]
    ) {
        self.storageVersion = 2
        self.originSequenceAuthority = originSequenceAuthority
        self.events = events
        self.outbox = outbox
        self.localOrdinaryOutboxEvidence = localOrdinaryOutboxEvidence
        self.sealedLegacyAuthorities = sealedLegacyAuthorities
        self.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations =
            pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations
        self.completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations =
            completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations
        self.sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence = sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence
        self.verifiedPeerBundleAuthorities = verifiedPeerBundleAuthorities
        self.verifiedPeerCredentialVerificationRecords =
            verifiedPeerCredentialVerificationRecords
        self.verifiedPeerBundleVerificationReceipts =
            verifiedPeerBundleVerificationReceipts
        self.verifiedPeerBundleEvidence = verifiedPeerBundleEvidence
        self.peerTakeoverWatermarks = peerTakeoverWatermarks
        self.peerBundleReceipts = peerBundleReceipts
        self.legacyV1RetryableOutbox = legacyV1RetryableOutbox
        self.deadLetters = deadLetters
        self.receipts = receipts
        self.acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay = acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay
        self.legacyV1TerminalReceipts = legacyV1TerminalReceipts
```
