        self.legacyV1AcceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay = legacyV1AcceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay
        self.migrationMarkers = migrationMarkers
        self.migrationDeadLetters = migrationDeadLetters
        self.transportAnomalies = transportAnomalies
        self.legacyTransportEvidence = legacyTransportEvidence
        self.legacyWireBindings = legacyWireBindings
        self.preparedLegacyV1Batches = preparedLegacyV1Batches
        self.watchTerminalReceiptRelayObligations = watchTerminalReceiptRelayObligations
        self.watchTerminalReceiptRelayConfirmations = watchTerminalReceiptRelayConfirmations
        self.shotCaptureStates = shotCaptureStates
        self.localProjectionInputs = localProjectionInputs
        self.inboundProjectionRecords = inboundProjectionRecords
        self.stagedInboundProjectionRecords = stagedInboundProjectionRecords
        self.canonicalOriginEvidence = canonicalOriginEvidence
        self.canonicalMaterializationActivations =
            canonicalMaterializationActivations
        self.canonicalMaterializationEvidence = canonicalMaterializationEvidence
        self.materializationActivationHighWaterByRound =
            materializationActivationHighWaterByRound
        self.inboundCursors = inboundCursors
        self.stagedInboundCursors = stagedInboundCursors
        self.activeInboundPartitionsByRound = activeInboundPartitionsByRound
        self.stagedInboundPartitionsByRound = stagedInboundPartitionsByRound
        self.inboundVectorsByRound = inboundVectorsByRound
        self.stagedInboundVectorsByRound = stagedInboundVectorsByRound
    }
}

public final class DomainLedgerStore {
    private static let productionOwnerLock = NSRecursiveLock()
    private static var claimedProductionRoots: Set<URL> = []

    private let stateURL: URL
    private let encoder: JSONEncoder
    private let lock = NSRecursiveLock()
    private let faultHook: (DomainLedgerFaultPoint) throws -> Void
    private let claimedProductionRoot: URL?
    private let trustedPeerServerKeys: [String: Data]

    private init(
        directoryURL: URL,
        seedState: DomainLedgerStateV2?,
        claimedProductionRoot: URL?,
        trustedPeerServerKeys: [String: Data],
        faultHook: @escaping (DomainLedgerFaultPoint) throws -> Void = { _ in }
    ) throws {
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: directoryURL, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        stateURL = Self.stateURL(in: directoryURL)
        self.faultHook = faultHook
        self.claimedProductionRoot = claimedProductionRoot
        self.trustedPeerServerKeys = trustedPeerServerKeys
        encoder = JSONEncoder()
        encoder.outputFormatting = [.sortedKeys, .withoutEscapingSlashes]
        if let seedState {
            guard !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: stateURL.path) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.migrationTargetNotEmpty
            }
            try writeStateDurably(seedState)
        }
    }

    deinit {
        guard let root = claimedProductionRoot else { return }
        Self.productionOwnerLock.lock()
        Self.claimedProductionRoots.remove(root)
        Self.productionOwnerLock.unlock()
    }

    static func productionStore(
        directoryURL: URL,
        expectedOriginDeviceId: String,
        trustedPeerServerKeys: [String: Data] = [:],
        faultHook: @escaping (DomainLedgerFaultPoint) throws -> Void = { _ in }
    ) throws -> DomainLedgerStore {
        guard !expectedOriginDeviceId.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        let root = directoryURL.standardizedFileURL.resolvingSymlinksInPath()
        productionOwnerLock.lock()
        defer { productionOwnerLock.unlock() }
        guard claimedProductionRoots.insert(root).inserted else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.productionOwnerAlreadyOpen
        }
        do {
            let stateURL = Self.stateURL(in: root)
            let seed = FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: stateURL.path)
                ? nil : DomainLedgerStateV2(
                    originSequenceAuthority: try .fresh(
                        originDeviceId: expectedOriginDeviceId
                    )
                )
            let store = try DomainLedgerStore(
                directoryURL: root, seedState: seed,
                claimedProductionRoot: root,
                trustedPeerServerKeys: trustedPeerServerKeys,
                faultHook: faultHook
            )
            try store.validateStorageV2()
            let origin = try store.originSequenceAuthority()
            guard origin.originDeviceId == expectedOriginDeviceId else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            return store
        } catch {
            claimedProductionRoots.remove(root)
            throw error
        }
    }

    static func makeMigrationStagingStore(
        directoryURL: URL,
        originSequenceAuthority: OriginSequenceState,
        observers: LegacyAuthorityProcessingObservers
    ) throws -> DomainLedgerStore {
        let root = directoryURL.standardizedFileURL.resolvingSymlinksInPath()
        guard !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: root.path) else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.migrationTargetNotEmpty
        }
        let store = try DomainLedgerStore(
            directoryURL: root,
            seedState: DomainLedgerStateV2(
                originSequenceAuthority: originSequenceAuthority
            ),
            claimedProductionRoot: nil,
            trustedPeerServerKeys: [:],
            // Staging durability is validated before the primary is touched. It must
            // never consume production transaction or migration-primary fault points.
            faultHook: { _ in }
        )
        try store.validateStorageV2(observers: observers)
        return store
    }

    public static func stateURL(in directoryURL: URL) -> URL {
        directoryURL.appendingPathComponent("domain-ledger.json")
    }

    public func validateStorageV2() throws {
        let observers = LegacyAuthorityProcessingObserverScope.current
        try validateStorageV2(observers: observers)
    }

    private func validateStorageV2(
        observers: LegacyAuthorityProcessingObservers
    ) throws {
        try locked {
            try Self.validateOperationalInvariants(
                try loadV2(),
                observers: observers,
                trustedPeerServerKeys: trustedPeerServerKeys
            )
        }
    }

    private func writeStateDurably(
        _ state: DomainLedgerStateV2,
        invokeFaultHooks: Bool = false
    ) throws {
        let nextURL = stateURL.appendingPathExtension("next")
        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: nextURL) }
        try encoder.encode(state).write(to: nextURL, options: [.atomic])
        let handle = try FileHandle(forWritingTo: nextURL)
        try handle.synchronize()
        try handle.close()
        try fsyncDirectory(stateURL.deletingLastPathComponent())
        if invokeFaultHooks { try faultHook(.beforeAtomicReplace) }
        if FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: stateURL.path) {
            _ = try FileManager.default.replaceItemAt(stateURL, withItemAt: nextURL)
        } else {
            try FileManager.default.moveItem(at: nextURL, to: stateURL)
        }
        try fsyncDirectory(stateURL.deletingLastPathComponent())
        if invokeFaultHooks { try faultHook(.afterAtomicReplace) }
    }

    private func fsyncDirectory(_ directoryURL: URL) throws {
        let descriptor = open(directoryURL.path, O_RDONLY)
        guard descriptor >= 0 else {
            throw NSError(domain: NSPOSIXErrorDomain, code: Int(errno))
        }
        defer { close(descriptor) }
        guard Darwin.fsync(descriptor) == 0 else {
            throw NSError(domain: NSPOSIXErrorDomain, code: Int(errno))
        }
    }

    func transaction(
        _ update: (inout DomainLedgerStateV2) throws -> Void
    ) throws {
        let observers = LegacyAuthorityProcessingObserverScope.current
        try transaction(
            prevalidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshots: [:],
            observers: observers,
            update
        )
    }

    func transaction(
        prevalidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshots:
            [String: ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot],
        observers: LegacyAuthorityProcessingObservers,
        _ update: (inout DomainLedgerStateV2) throws -> Void
    ) throws {
        try locked {
            var state = try loadV2()
            try update(&state)
            try Self.validateOperationalInvariants(
                state,
                prevalidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshots:
                    prevalidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshots,
                observers: observers,
                trustedPeerServerKeys: trustedPeerServerKeys
            )
            try writeStateDurably(state, invokeFaultHooks: true)
        }
    }

    func locked<T>(_ body: () throws -> T) rethrows -> T {
        lock.lock()
        defer { lock.unlock() }
        return try body()
    }

    func hasExactTrustedPeerServerKeys(
        _ expected: [String: Data]
    ) -> Bool {
        locked { trustedPeerServerKeys == expected }
    }

    func loadV2() throws -> DomainLedgerStateV2 {
        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: stateURL.path) else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageMissing
        }
        do {
            let data = try Data(contentsOf: stateURL)
            return try DomainLedgerStorageWireValidator.decodeStorageV2(data)
        } catch let error as DomainLedgerError {
            throw error
        } catch {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
    }

    public func allEvents() throws -> [DomainRoundEvent] {
        try locked { try loadV2().events }
    }

    public func eventsForCurrentRound() throws -> [DomainRoundEvent] {
        let events = try allEvents()
        guard let roundId = events.last?.roundId else { return [] }
        return events.filter { $0.roundId == roundId }
    }

    public func projectionInputs(
        roundId: String
    ) throws -> [DomainProjectionInput] {
        try locked {
            let state = try loadV2()
            let activePartitions = state.activeInboundPartitionsByRound[
                roundId,
                default: []
            ]
            let inbound = state.inboundProjectionRecords.filter {
                $0.syncRoundId == roundId
                    && activePartitions.contains(
                        $0.input.projectionOrder.ledgerPartitionId
                    )
            }.map(\.input)
            let inboundIdentities = try inbound.map {
                try $0.event.eventIdentity()
            }
            guard Set(inboundIdentities).count == inboundIdentities.count else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.identityEnvelopeMismatch
            }
            let canonicalIdentities = Set(inboundIdentities)
            let local = try state.localProjectionInputs.filter {
                $0.event.roundId == roundId
                    && !canonicalIdentities.contains(
                        try $0.event.eventIdentity()
                    )
            }
            return local + inbound
        }
    }

    public func pendingEventIds() throws -> [String] {
        try locked {
            try loadV2().outbox.compactMap {
                $0.deadLetterReason == nil ? $0.event.eventId : nil
            }
        }
    }

    public func pendingEvents(roundId: String) throws -> [DomainRoundEvent] {
        try locked {
            try loadV2().outbox.compactMap { row in
                row.deadLetterReason == nil && row.event.roundId == roundId ? row.event : nil
            }
        }
    }

    public func receipt(eventIdentity: String) throws -> EventReceipt? {
        try locked { try loadV2().receipts[eventIdentity] }
    }

    public func transportAnomalies() throws -> [TransportAnomaly] {
        try locked { try loadV2().transportAnomalies }
    }

    // Read-only operational surfaces used by recovery/diagnostics and the rich
    // migration gate. They return durable records, never reconstructed summaries.
    func originSequenceAuthority() throws -> OriginSequenceState {
        try locked { try loadV2().originSequenceAuthority }
    }

    public func reserveClientSequence() throws -> ReservedOriginSequence {
        var reserved: ReservedOriginSequence?
        try transaction { state in
            guard state.originSequenceAuthority.lastReservedClientSequence
                    < 9_007_199_254_740_991 else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            state.originSequenceAuthority.lastReservedClientSequence += 1
            reserved = ReservedOriginSequence(
                originDeviceId: state.originSequenceAuthority.originDeviceId,
                originEpoch: state.originSequenceAuthority.originEpoch,
                clientSequence: state.originSequenceAuthority.lastReservedClientSequence
            )
        }
        guard let reserved else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        return reserved
    }

    public func rotateOriginEpoch(
        expectedCurrentEpoch: String
    ) throws -> OriginSequenceState {
        var rotated: OriginSequenceState?
        try transaction { state in
            guard !expectedCurrentEpoch.isEmpty,
                  state.originSequenceAuthority.originEpoch
                    == expectedCurrentEpoch else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.originEpochMismatch
            }
            guard state.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations.isEmpty else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.legacyMigrationPending
            }
            var nextEpoch: String
            repeat {
                nextEpoch = UUID().uuidString.lowercased()
            } while nextEpoch == expectedCurrentEpoch
            let next = OriginSequenceState(
                originDeviceId: state.originSequenceAuthority.originDeviceId,
                originEpoch: nextEpoch,
                lastReservedClientSequence: 0
            )
            state.originSequenceAuthority = next
            rotated = next
        }
        guard let rotated else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        return rotated
    }

    func allDeadLetters() throws -> [OutboxRecord] {
        try locked { try loadV2().deadLetters }
    }

    func allLegacyV1RetryableOutbox() throws -> [LegacyV1OutboxRecord] {
        try locked { try loadV2().legacyV1RetryableOutbox }
    }

    func allLegacyV1TerminalReceipts() throws -> [String: LegacyV1EventReceipt] {
        try locked { try loadV2().legacyV1TerminalReceipts }
    }

    func allLegacyV1AcceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay()
        throws -> [String: LegacyV1AcceptedReplayEvidence] {
        try locked { try loadV2().legacyV1AcceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay }
    }

    func allLegacyWireBindings() throws -> [String: LegacyWireBinding] {
        try locked { try loadV2().legacyWireBindings }
    }

    func allPreparedLegacyV1Batches() throws -> [String: PreparedLegacyV1Batch] {
        try locked { try loadV2().preparedLegacyV1Batches }
    }

    func allWatchRelayObligations()
        throws -> [String: WatchTerminalReceiptRelayObligation] {
        try locked { try loadV2().watchTerminalReceiptRelayObligations }
    }

    func allWatchRelayConfirmations()
        throws -> [String: WatchTerminalReceiptRelayConfirmation] {
        try locked { try loadV2().watchTerminalReceiptRelayConfirmations }
    }

    public func recordTransportAnomaly(
        roundId: String,
        code: String,
        evidence: String
    ) throws {
        try transaction { state in
            let id = try TypedID.make(
                domain: "TransportAnomaly/v1",
                value: .object([
                    "roundId": .string(roundId),
                    "code": .string(code),
                    "evidence": .string(evidence),
                ])
            )
            if !state.transportAnomalies.contains(where: { $0.id == id }) {
                state.transportAnomalies.append(TransportAnomaly(
                    id: id,
                    roundId: roundId,
                    code: code,
                    evidence: evidence
                ))
            }
        }
    }

    public func hasMigrationMarker(_ marker: String) throws -> Bool {
        try locked { try loadV2().migrationMarkers.contains(marker) }
    }

    static func validateOperationalInvariants(
        _ state: DomainLedgerStateV2,
        prevalidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshots:
            [String: ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot] = [:],
        observers: LegacyAuthorityProcessingObservers,
        trustedPeerServerKeys: [String: Data]
    ) throws {
        do {
            let safeIntegerMaximum = 9_007_199_254_740_991
            func isLowercaseHex64(_ value: String) -> Bool {
                value.utf8.count == 64 && value.utf8.allSatisfy {
                    (48...57).contains($0) || (97...102).contains($0)
                }
            }
            func lowercaseSHA256(_ data: Data) -> String {
                SHA256.hash(data: data).map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
            }
            func base64url(_ value: String) throws -> String {
                guard !value.isEmpty else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                return Data(value.utf8).base64EncodedString()
                    .replacingOccurrences(of: "+", with: "-")
                    .replacingOccurrences(of: "/", with: "_")
                    .replacingOccurrences(of: "=", with: "")
            }
            func bindingKey(_ binding: LegacyWireBinding) throws -> String {
                "binding.v1.\(try base64url(binding.roundId))."
                    + "\(try base64url(binding.wireClientId))."
                    + "\(try base64url(binding.wireEventId))"
            }
            func ledgerPartitionId(
                ownerAccountId: String,
                streamSubject: StreamSubject,
                ledgerEpoch: Int,
                streamId: String
            ) throws -> String {
                try TypedID.make(
                    domain: "LedgerPartitionId/v1",
                    value: .object([
                        "ownerAccountId": .string(ownerAccountId),
                        "streamSubject": try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(
                            JSONValue.self,
                            from: CanonicalJSON.data(streamSubject)
                        ),
                        "ledgerEpoch": .string(String(ledgerEpoch)),
                        "streamId": .string(streamId),
                    ])
                )
            }

            guard state.storageVersion == 2,
                  !state.originSequenceAuthority.originDeviceId.isEmpty,
                  !state.originSequenceAuthority.originEpoch.isEmpty,
                  (0...safeIntegerMaximum).contains(
                    state.originSequenceAuthority.lastReservedClientSequence
                  ) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }

            var facts: [String: (event: DomainRoundEvent, hash: String)] = [:]
            var seenOriginSequences = Set<String>()
            var seenOriginEventIds = Set<String>()
            var localMaximum = 0
            try RoundEventBranchBindingValidator.validatePersistedOrReduced(
                state.events
            )
            for event in state.events {
                _ = try RoundPayloadValidator.validatePersistedOrInbound(event)
                let identity = try event.eventIdentity()
                let hash = try event.eventHash()
                let sequenceKey = [
                    event.originDeviceId,
                    event.originEpoch,
                    String(event.clientSequence),
                ].joined(separator: "\u{0}")
                let eventIdKey = [
                    event.originDeviceId,
                    event.originEpoch,
                    event.eventId,
                ].joined(separator: "\u{0}")
                guard (1...safeIntegerMaximum).contains(event.clientSequence),
                      facts.updateValue((event, hash), forKey: identity) == nil,
                      seenOriginSequences.insert(sequenceKey).inserted,
                      seenOriginEventIds.insert(eventIdKey).inserted else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                if event.originDeviceId == state.originSequenceAuthority.originDeviceId,
                   event.originEpoch == state.originSequenceAuthority.originEpoch {
                    localMaximum = max(localMaximum, event.clientSequence)
                }
            }
            guard localMaximum
                    <= state.originSequenceAuthority.lastReservedClientSequence else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }

            func validateOutboxFact(_ row: OutboxRecord) throws {
                guard let fact = facts[row.eventIdentity],
                      fact.event == row.event,
                      fact.hash == row.eventHash,
                      try row.event.eventIdentity() == row.eventIdentity,
                      try row.event.eventHash() == row.eventHash else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }

            var ordinaryRetryable = Set<String>()
            for row in state.outbox {
                try validateOutboxFact(row)
                guard row.deadLetterReason == nil,
                      row.receiptStorageKey == nil,
                      ordinaryRetryable.insert(row.eventIdentity).inserted else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                if let receipt = row.receipt {
                    guard receipt.status == .deferred,
                          (0...63).contains(receipt.inputIndex),
                          receipt.eventId == row.event.eventId,
                          receipt.eventIdentity == row.eventIdentity,
                          receipt.eventHash == row.eventHash,
                          receipt.ledgerPartitionId == nil,
                          receipt.ledgerEpoch == nil,
                          receipt.streamId == nil,
                          receipt.ledgerPosition == nil else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                }
            }

            var legacyRetryable = Set<String>()
            for row in state.legacyV1RetryableOutbox {
                guard let fact = facts[row.eventIdentity],
                      fact.hash == row.eventHash,
                      row.receipt == nil,
                      row.deadLetterReason == nil,
                      legacyRetryable.insert(row.eventIdentity).inserted else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }

            var deadByIdentity: [String: OutboxRecord] = [:]
            for row in state.deadLetters {
                try validateOutboxFact(row)
                guard let reason = row.deadLetterReason,
                      !reason.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty,
                      deadByIdentity.updateValue(row, forKey: row.eventIdentity) == nil else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                if let receipt = row.receipt {
                    guard let receiptStorageKey = row.receiptStorageKey,
                          !receiptStorageKey.isEmpty,
                          receipt.status == .rejectedPermanent,
                          (0...63).contains(receipt.inputIndex),
                          receipt.eventId == row.event.eventId,
                          receipt.reasonCode != nil,
                          receipt.ledgerPartitionId == nil,
                          receipt.ledgerEpoch == nil,
                          receipt.streamId == nil,
                          receipt.ledgerPosition == nil else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    if let identity = receipt.eventIdentity {
                        guard identity == row.eventIdentity,
                              receipt.eventHash == row.eventHash else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                    } else if receipt.reasonCode?.rawValue
                                == "identity_envelope_mismatch" {
                        guard receipt.eventHash == row.eventHash else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                    } else if receipt.eventHash != nil {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                } else if row.receiptStorageKey != nil {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
            let deadIds = Set(deadByIdentity.keys)
            guard ordinaryRetryable.isDisjoint(with: legacyRetryable),
                  ordinaryRetryable.isDisjoint(with: deadIds),
                  legacyRetryable.isDisjoint(with: deadIds) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }

            var legacyEvidenceAuthorityIds = Set<String>()
            for (key, evidence) in state.sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence {
                guard key == evidence.evidenceKey else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                legacyEvidenceAuthorityIds.insert(evidence.authorityId)
            }
            let pendingAuthorityIds = Set(
                state.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations.keys
            )
            let completedAuthorityIds = Set(
                state.completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations.keys
            )
            let sealedAuthorityIds = Set(
                state.sealedLegacyAuthorities.keys
            )
            guard pendingAuthorityIds.isDisjoint(
                with: completedAuthorityIds
            ), pendingAuthorityIds.union(completedAuthorityIds)
                == sealedAuthorityIds,
                  legacyEvidenceAuthorityIds.isSubset(
                    of: completedAuthorityIds
                  ) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            guard Set(prevalidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshots.keys)
                    .isSubset(of: sealedAuthorityIds) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            var validatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshotsById:
                [String: ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot] = [:]
            for (authorityId, snapshot) in
                prevalidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshots {
                guard authorityId == snapshot.authority.authorityId,
                      state.sealedLegacyAuthorities[authorityId]
                        == snapshot.authority,
                      validatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshotsById.updateValue(
                        snapshot,
                        forKey: authorityId
                      ) == nil else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
            for (authorityId, authority) in state.sealedLegacyAuthorities
            where validatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshotsById[authorityId] == nil {
                guard authorityId == authority.authorityId,
                      let authorityData = Data(
                        base64Encoded: authority.authorityFileBase64
                      ) else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                let snapshot = try LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator
                    .validatedSnapshot(
                        authority: authority,
                        authorityData: authorityData,
                        observers: observers
                    )
                guard validatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshotsById.updateValue(
                        snapshot,
                        forKey: authorityId
                      ) == nil else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
            guard Set(validatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshotsById.keys)
                    == sealedAuthorityIds else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            var expectedLegacyTransportEvidenceByRawSha256:
                [String: LegacyStorageEvidence] = [:]
            for snapshot in validatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshotsById.values {
                if snapshot.authority.authorityKind ==
                    LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator.storageV1AuthorityKind {
                    guard let parsed =
                            snapshot.storageV1ParsedTransportEvidence else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    let expected = LegacyStorageEvidence(
                        storageVersion: 1,
                        rawStorageBase64:
                            snapshot.authority.authorityFileBase64,
                        rawStorageSha256:
                            snapshot.authority.authorityFileSha256,
                        parsedTransportEvidence: parsed
                    )
                    guard expectedLegacyTransportEvidenceByRawSha256
                            .updateValue(
                                expected,
                                forKey: expected.rawStorageSha256
                            ) == nil else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                } else {
                    guard snapshot.storageV1ParsedTransportEvidence == nil
                    else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                }
            }
            guard state.legacyTransportEvidence.count
                    == expectedLegacyTransportEvidenceByRawSha256.count else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            var seenLegacyTransportEvidenceSha256 = Set<String>()
            for evidence in state.legacyTransportEvidence {
                guard seenLegacyTransportEvidenceSha256.insert(
                        evidence.rawStorageSha256
                      ).inserted,
                      let expected =
                        expectedLegacyTransportEvidenceByRawSha256[
                        evidence.rawStorageSha256
                      ], expected == evidence else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
            guard seenLegacyTransportEvidenceSha256
                    == Set(expectedLegacyTransportEvidenceByRawSha256.keys)
                  else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            var completedLegacyClassificationBatches:
                [String: LegacyAuthorityClassificationBatch] = [:]
            for authorityId in completedAuthorityIds {
                guard let snapshot =
                        validatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshotsById[authorityId]
                      else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                let batch = try LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator
                    .classificationBatch(
                        snapshot: snapshot,
                        durableEvents: state.events,
                        legacyWireBindings: state.legacyWireBindings,
                        observers: observers
                    )
                guard completedLegacyClassificationBatches.updateValue(
                        batch,
                        forKey: authorityId
                      ) == nil else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }

            let peerBundleIds = Set(
                state.verifiedPeerBundleAuthorities.keys
            )
            guard peerBundleIds == Set(state.peerBundleReceipts.keys),
                  Set(
                    state.peerBundleReceipts.values.map(
                        \.verificationReceiptId
                    )
                  ) == Set(
                    state.verifiedPeerBundleVerificationReceipts.keys
                  ),
                  Set(
                    state.peerBundleReceipts.values.map(
                        \.credentialVerificationRecordId
                    )
                  ) == Set(
                    state.verifiedPeerCredentialVerificationRecords.keys
                  ) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            for bundleId in peerBundleIds {
                try VerifiedPeerBundleEvidenceValidator
                    .validateDurableRootGraph(
                        bundleId: bundleId,
                        state: state,
                        trustedServerKeys: trustedPeerServerKeys
                    )
                guard let bundle = state.verifiedPeerBundleAuthorities[
                        bundleId
                      ],
                      zip(
                        bundle.orderedImportedEventIdentities,
                        bundle.orderedImportedEventHashes
                      ).allSatisfy({ identity, hash in
                        facts[identity]?.hash == hash
                      }) else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
            for (key, watermark) in state.peerTakeoverWatermarks {
                guard key == "\(watermark.sourceDeviceId)|\(watermark.roundId)",
                      let bundle = state.verifiedPeerBundleAuthorities[
                        watermark.bundleId
                      ],
                      bundle.bundleHash == watermark.bundleHash,
                      bundle.sourceDeviceId == watermark.sourceDeviceId,
                      bundle.roundId == watermark.roundId,
                      bundle.takeoverGeneration
                        == watermark.takeoverGeneration,
                      state.peerBundleReceipts[watermark.bundleId] != nil
                      else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }

            var referencedSourceKeys = Set<String>()
            var referencedLocalEvidence = Set<String>()
            var referencedLegacyEvidence = Set<String>()
            var referencedPeerEvidence = Set<String>()
            var referencedLegacyAuthorities = Set<String>()
            for row in state.outbox + state.deadLetters {
                guard referencedSourceKeys.insert(
                    row.source.evidenceKey
                ).inserted else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                switch row.source.sourceClass {
                case .localOrdinary:
                    guard let evidence = state.localOrdinaryOutboxEvidence[
                        row.source.evidenceKey
                    ], referencedLocalEvidence.insert(
                        evidence.evidenceKey
                    ).inserted else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    try Self.validateStoredLocalOrdinaryEvidence(
                        row: row,
                        evidence: evidence,
                        state: state
                    )
                case .sealedLegacyMigration:
                    guard let evidence = state.sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence[
                        row.source.evidenceKey
                    ], let batch = completedLegacyClassificationBatches[
                        evidence.authorityId
                    ], referencedLegacyEvidence.insert(
                        evidence.evidenceKey
                    ).inserted else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    referencedLegacyAuthorities.insert(
                        evidence.authorityId
                    )
                    try LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator
                        .validateStoredEvidence(
                            row: row,
                            evidence: evidence,
                            batch: batch,
                            legacyWireBindings: state.legacyWireBindings
                        )
                case .verifiedPeerBundle:
                    guard let evidence = state.verifiedPeerBundleEvidence[
                        row.source.evidenceKey
                    ], referencedPeerEvidence.insert(
                        evidence.evidenceKey
                    ).inserted else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    try VerifiedPeerBundleEvidenceValidator.validateStored(
                        row: row,
                        evidence: evidence,
                        state: state,
                        trustedServerKeys: trustedPeerServerKeys
                    )
                }
            }
            let localEvidenceKeys = Set(
                state.localOrdinaryOutboxEvidence.keys
            )
            let legacyEvidenceKeys = Set(
                state.sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence.keys
            )
            let peerEvidenceKeys = Set(
                state.verifiedPeerBundleEvidence.keys
            )
            var completedDeadLetterIds = Set<String>()
            for (authorityId, pending) in
                state.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations {
                guard let snapshot =
                        validatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshotsById[authorityId]
                      else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                let authority = snapshot.authority
                guard authorityId == pending.authorityId,
                      authority.authorityKind == pending.authorityKind,
                      authority.authorityFileSha256
                        == pending.authorityFileSha256,
                      referencedLegacyAuthorities.contains(authorityId)
                        == false,
                      !legacyEvidenceAuthorityIds.contains(authorityId),
                      snapshot.sourceRecords == pending.sourceRecords,
                      pending.sourceRoundIds == CanonicalStringSet(
                        Set(pending.sourceRecords.compactMap { record in
                            record.classification == .event
                                ? record.roundId : nil
                        })
                      ) else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                for roundId in pending.sourceRoundIds {
                    let durableRoundEvents = state.events.filter {
                        $0.roundId == roundId
                    }
                    let transportRows =
                        (state.outbox + state.deadLetters).filter {
                            $0.event.roundId == roundId
                        }
                    let projectionEvents = state.localProjectionInputs
                        .map(\.event)
                        + state.inboundProjectionRecords.map {
                            $0.input.event
                        }
                        + state.stagedInboundProjectionRecords.map {
                            $0.input.event
                        }
                    let roundProjectionEvents = projectionEvents.filter {
                        $0.roundId == roundId
                    }
                    guard durableRoundEvents.allSatisfy({
                            $0.kind == .roundStarted
                          }),
                          durableRoundEvents.filter({
                            $0.kind == .roundStarted
                          }).count <= 1,
                          transportRows.allSatisfy({
                            $0.event.kind == .roundStarted
                          }),
                          roundProjectionEvents.allSatisfy({
                            $0.kind == .roundStarted
                          }),
                          try LegacyRoundStartContextResolver.context(
                            roundId: roundId,
                            events: state.events
                          ) != nil || durableRoundEvents.isEmpty else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                }
            }
            for (authorityId, completed) in
                state.completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations {
                guard let snapshot =
                        validatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshotsById[authorityId]
                      else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                let authority = snapshot.authority
                guard authorityId == completed.authorityId,
                      authority.authorityKind == completed.authorityKind,
                      authority.authorityFileSha256
                        == completed.authorityFileSha256,
                      let batch =
                        completedLegacyClassificationBatches[authorityId],
                      batch.authority == authority,
                      batch.sourceRecords == completed.sourceRecords,
                      completed.marker == completed.authorityKind,
                      isLowercaseHex64(
                        completed.authorityFileSha256
                      ),
                      completed.sourceRecords.map(\.sourceRecordId)
                        == completed.terminalDispositions.map(
                            \.sourceRecordId
                        ),
                      Set(completed.sourceRecords.map(\.sourceRecordId))
                        .count == completed.sourceRecords.count,
                      lowercaseSHA256(
                        try CanonicalJSON.data(
                            completed.terminalDispositions
                        )
                      ) == completed.terminalDispositionSha256 else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                for (record, disposition) in zip(
                    completed.sourceRecords,
                    completed.terminalDispositions
                ) {
                    switch disposition.disposition {
                    case .importedEvent:
                        guard record.classification == .event,
                              let identity =
                                disposition.eventIdentity,
                              let hash = disposition.eventHash,
                              let evidenceKey =
                                disposition.sourceEvidenceKey,
                              disposition.migrationDeadLetterId == nil,
                              facts[identity]?.hash == hash,
                              let evidence =
                                state.sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence[
                                    evidenceKey
                                ],
                              evidence.authorityId == authorityId,
                              evidence.sourceRecordId
                                == record.sourceRecordId,
                              evidence.eventIdentity == identity,
                              evidence.eventHash == hash else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError
                                .storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                        _ = referencedLegacyEvidence.insert(evidenceKey)
                        referencedLegacyAuthorities.insert(authorityId)
                        guard let fact = facts[identity] else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError
                                .storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                        try LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator
                            .validateCompletedEvidence(
                                event: fact.event,
                                eventIdentity: identity,
                                eventHash: hash,
                                evidence: evidence,
                                batch: batch,
                                legacyWireBindings:
                                    state.legacyWireBindings
                            )
                    case .migrationDeadLetter:
                        guard disposition.eventIdentity == nil,
                              disposition.eventHash == nil,
                              disposition.sourceEvidenceKey == nil,
                              let deadId =
                                disposition.migrationDeadLetterId,
                              completedDeadLetterIds.insert(deadId)
                                .inserted,
                              record.classification != .syncMarker,
                              let raw = Data(
                                base64Encoded: record.rawBase64
                              ),
                              let dead = state.migrationDeadLetters
                                .first(where: { $0.id == deadId }),
                              dead.sourceLine == record.sourceLine,
                              dead.eventId == record.eventId,
                              dead.roundId == record.roundId,
                              dead.rawBase64 == record.rawBase64,
                              try MigrationDeadLetter.make(
                                sourceLine: record.sourceLine,
                                eventId: record.eventId,
                                roundId: record.roundId,
                                reasonCode: dead.reasonCode,
                                raw: raw
                              ) == dead,
                              case .migrationDeadLetter(
                                let classifiedDead
                              ) = try LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator
                                .classificationResult(
                                    sourceRecord: record,
                                    in: batch
                                ),
                              classifiedDead == dead else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError
                                .storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                    case .ignoredSyncMarker:
                        guard record.classification == .syncMarker,
                              disposition.eventIdentity == nil,
                              disposition.eventHash == nil,
                              disposition.sourceEvidenceKey == nil,
                              disposition.migrationDeadLetterId == nil,
                              case .ignoredSyncMarker = try
                                LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator
                                    .classificationResult(
                                        sourceRecord: record,
                                        in: batch
                                    ) else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError
                                .storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            guard referencedLocalEvidence == localEvidenceKeys,
                  referencedLegacyEvidence == legacyEvidenceKeys,
                  referencedPeerEvidence == peerEvidenceKeys,
                  localEvidenceKeys.isDisjoint(with: legacyEvidenceKeys),
                  localEvidenceKeys.isDisjoint(with: peerEvidenceKeys),
                  legacyEvidenceKeys.isDisjoint(with: peerEvidenceKeys),
                  referencedLegacyAuthorities.isSubset(
                    of: completedAuthorityIds
                  ),
                  completedDeadLetterIds
                    == Set(state.migrationDeadLetters.map(\.id)) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            var successfulV2Receipts: [String: EventReceipt] = [:]
            var rejectedV2ReceiptsByStorageKey: [String: EventReceipt] = [:]
            for (storageKey, receipt) in state.receipts {
                let success = receipt.status == .accepted
                    || receipt.status == .duplicateHashMatch
                    || receipt.status == .acceptedOpaque
                let coordinateComplete = receipt.ledgerPartitionId.map(isLowercaseHex64)
                        == true
                    && (receipt.ledgerEpoch ?? 0) > 0
                    && !(receipt.streamId ?? "").isEmpty
                    && receipt.ledgerPosition.map { $0.rawValue != "0" } == true
                let coordinateAbsent = receipt.ledgerPartitionId == nil
                    && receipt.ledgerEpoch == nil
                    && receipt.streamId == nil
                    && receipt.ledgerPosition == nil
                guard (0...63).contains(receipt.inputIndex),
                      (success ? coordinateComplete : coordinateAbsent) else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                if let identity = receipt.eventIdentity {
                    guard storageKey == identity,
                          let fact = facts[identity],
                          receipt.eventId == fact.event.eventId,
                          fact.hash == receipt.eventHash else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    if success {
                        guard receipt.reasonCode == nil else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                        guard successfulV2Receipts.updateValue(
                            receipt,
                            forKey: identity
                        ) == nil else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                    } else if receipt.status == .rejectedPermanent {
                        guard receipt.reasonCode != nil,
                              rejectedV2ReceiptsByStorageKey.updateValue(
                            receipt,
                            forKey: storageKey
                        ) == nil else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                    } else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                } else {
                    guard receipt.status == .rejectedPermanent,
                          receipt.reasonCode != nil else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    let pieces = storageKey.split(
                        separator: "#",
                        maxSplits: 1,
                        omittingEmptySubsequences: false
                    )
                    guard pieces.count == 2,
                          isLowercaseHex64(String(pieces[0])),
                          String(pieces[1]) == String(receipt.inputIndex),
                          rejectedV2ReceiptsByStorageKey.updateValue(
                            receipt,
                            forKey: storageKey
                          ) == nil else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                }
            }

            for (identity, receipt) in state.acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay {
                guard successfulV2Receipts[identity] == receipt,
                      receipt.eventIdentity == identity,
                      !ordinaryRetryable.contains(identity),
                      !legacyRetryable.contains(identity),
                      !deadIds.contains(identity) else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
            guard Set(state.acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay.keys)
                    .isSubset(of: Set(successfulV2Receipts.keys)) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            guard Set(successfulV2Receipts.keys).isDisjoint(
                    with: ordinaryRetryable.union(legacyRetryable).union(deadIds)
                  ) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            var legacyTerminalByIdentity: [String: LegacyV1EventReceipt] = [:]
            for (storageKey, receipt) in state.legacyV1TerminalReceipts {
                guard !storageKey.isEmpty,
                      let fact = facts[receipt.eventIdentity],
                      fact.hash == receipt.eventHash,
                      (0...safeIntegerMaximum).contains(receipt.serverSequence),
                      legacyTerminalByIdentity.updateValue(
                        receipt,
                        forKey: receipt.eventIdentity
                      ) == nil,
                      !legacyRetryable.contains(receipt.eventIdentity),
                      !ordinaryRetryable.contains(receipt.eventIdentity) else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                if receipt.status == .rejectedPermanent {
                    guard deadIds.contains(receipt.eventIdentity) else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                } else {
                    guard !deadIds.contains(receipt.eventIdentity) else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                }
            }
            for (identity, evidence) in
                state.legacyV1AcceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay {
                guard identity == evidence.eventIdentity,
                      let receipt = state.legacyV1TerminalReceipts[
                        evidence.receiptStorageKey
                      ],
                      receipt.eventIdentity == identity,
                      receipt.eventHash == evidence.eventHash,
                      receipt.status == .accepted
                        || receipt.status == .duplicateHashMatch else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
            var referencedV2RejectStorageKeys = Set<String>()
            for (identity, dead) in deadByIdentity {
                let legacyReceipt = legacyTerminalByIdentity[identity]
                let isLegacyPermanent = legacyReceipt?.status == .rejectedPermanent
                if let receipt = dead.receipt {
                    guard !isLegacyPermanent,
                          let storageKey = dead.receiptStorageKey,
                          rejectedV2ReceiptsByStorageKey[storageKey] == receipt,
                          referencedV2RejectStorageKeys.insert(storageKey).inserted else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                } else {
                    guard dead.receiptStorageKey == nil,
                          isLegacyPermanent else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                }
            }
            guard referencedV2RejectStorageKeys
                    == Set(rejectedV2ReceiptsByStorageKey.keys) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }

            for (key, binding) in state.legacyWireBindings {
                guard key == try bindingKey(binding),
                      let fact = facts[binding.canonicalDomainIdentity],
                      fact.hash == binding.canonicalDomainEventHash,
                      isLowercaseHex64(binding.normalizedWireEnvelopeHash),
                      binding.legacyAliases.allSatisfy({
                        $0.eventIdentity == binding.canonicalDomainIdentity
                            && $0.eventHash == binding.canonicalDomainEventHash
                      }) else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
            for (key, batch) in state.preparedLegacyV1Batches {
                guard key == batch.idempotencyKey,
                      !key.isEmpty,
                      lowercaseSHA256(batch.exactRequestBody)
                        == batch.requestBodySha256,
                      case .object(let body) = try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(
                        JSONValue.self,
                        from: batch.exactRequestBody
                      ),
                      Set(body.keys) == ["events"],
                      case .array(let bodyEvents)? = body["events"],
                      bodyEvents == batch.orderedSlots.map(\.exactNormalizedEnvelope) else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                for slot in batch.orderedSlots {
                    guard let binding = state.legacyWireBindings[slot.bindingKey],
                          binding.roundId == batch.roundId,
                          lowercaseSHA256(
                            try CanonicalJSON.data(slot.exactNormalizedEnvelope)
                          ) == slot.exactNormalizedEnvelopeHash,
                          binding.normalizedWireEnvelopeHash
                            == slot.exactNormalizedEnvelopeHash else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                }
            }

            for (key, obligation) in
                state.watchTerminalReceiptRelayObligations {
                guard key == obligation.obligationId,
                      let receipt = legacyTerminalByIdentity[
                        obligation.eventIdentity
                      ],
                      receipt.eventHash == obligation.eventHash,
                      receipt.status == obligation.status else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
            for (key, confirmation) in
                state.watchTerminalReceiptRelayConfirmations {
                guard key == confirmation.confirmationId,
                      let obligation =
                        state.watchTerminalReceiptRelayObligations[
                            confirmation.obligationId
                        ],
                      obligation.eventIdentity == confirmation.eventIdentity,
                      obligation.eventHash == confirmation.eventHash,
                      obligation.status == confirmation.status else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }

            guard state.migrationMarkers.allSatisfy({
                !$0.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty
            }) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            var migrationEvidenceIds = Set<String>()
            for dead in state.migrationDeadLetters {
                guard dead.sourceLine > 0,
                      let raw = Data(base64Encoded: dead.rawBase64),
                      try MigrationDeadLetter.make(
                        sourceLine: dead.sourceLine,
                        eventId: dead.eventId,
                        roundId: dead.roundId,
                        reasonCode: dead.reasonCode,
                        raw: raw
                      ) == dead,
                      migrationEvidenceIds.insert(dead.id).inserted else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
            var anomalyIds = Set<String>()
            for anomaly in state.transportAnomalies {
                guard anomaly.id == try TypedID.make(
                    domain: "TransportAnomaly/v1",
                    value: JSONValue.object([
                        "roundId": .string(anomaly.roundId),
                        "code": .string(anomaly.code),
                        "evidence": .string(anomaly.evidence),
                    ])
                ), anomalyIds.insert(anomaly.id).inserted else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
            func streamSubjectKey(_ value: StreamSubject) throws -> String {
                try CanonicalJSON.data(value).base64EncodedString()
            }
            func densePositions(
                _ positions: [CanonicalLedgerPosition],
                through: CanonicalLedgerPosition
            ) -> Bool {
                guard var expected = try? CanonicalLedgerPosition("0") else {
                    return false
                }
                for position in positions.sorted() {
                    guard let successor = try? expected.successor(),
                          position == successor else {
                        return false
                    }
                    expected = successor
                }
                return expected == through
            }

            var localProjectionAuthorities: [String: ProjectionAuthority] = [:]
            for input in state.localProjectionInputs {
                let identity = try input.event.eventIdentity()
                guard let fact = facts[identity],
                      fact.event == input.event,
                      fact.hash == try input.event.eventHash(),
                      input.projectionOrder.authority != .canonicalReplay,
                      input.projectionOrder.ledgerPartitionId == nil,
                      input.projectionOrder.ledgerPosition == nil,
                      localProjectionAuthorities.updateValue(
                        input.projectionOrder.authority,
                        forKey: identity
                      ) == nil else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }

            // Origin is permanent identity evidence, not a materialization field.
            var canonicalFactByOriginCoordinate = [String: String]()
            for (identity, origin) in state.canonicalOriginEvidence {
                guard identity == origin.eventIdentity,
                      let fact = facts[identity],
                      fact.hash == origin.eventHash,
                      fact.event.ownerAccountId == origin.ownerAccountId,
                      fact.event.streamSubject == origin.streamSubject,
                      isLowercaseHex64(origin.ledgerPartitionId),
                      origin.ledgerEpoch > 0,
                      !origin.streamId.isEmpty,
                      origin.ledgerPosition.rawValue != "0",
                      origin.ledgerPartitionId == try ledgerPartitionId(
                        ownerAccountId: origin.ownerAccountId,
                        streamSubject: origin.streamSubject,
                        ledgerEpoch: origin.ledgerEpoch,
                        streamId: origin.streamId
                      ),
                      try CanonicalOriginEvidence.make(
                        event: fact.event,
                        eventIdentity: identity,
                        eventHash: fact.hash,
                        ledgerPartitionId: origin.ledgerPartitionId,
                        ledgerEpoch: origin.ledgerEpoch,
                        streamId: origin.streamId,
                        ledgerPosition: origin.ledgerPosition
                      ) == origin else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                let coordinate = [
                    origin.ledgerPartitionId,
                    String(origin.ledgerEpoch),
                    origin.streamId,
                    origin.ledgerPosition.rawValue,
                ].joined(separator: "\u{0}")
                let canonicalFact = "\(identity)|\(origin.eventHash)"
                if let existing = canonicalFactByOriginCoordinate[coordinate] {
                    guard existing == canonicalFact else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.canonicalCoordinateConflict
                    }
                } else {
                    canonicalFactByOriginCoordinate[coordinate] = canonicalFact
                }
            }

            for (roundId, highWater) in
                state.materializationActivationHighWaterByRound {
                guard !roundId.isEmpty,
                      (0...safeIntegerMaximum).contains(highWater) else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
            var activationByRoundOrdinal = [String: String]()
            var activeActivationIds = Set<String>()
            var activeActivationSubjects = Set<String>()
            for (key, activation) in
                state.canonicalMaterializationActivations {
                let ordinalKey =
                    "\(activation.syncRoundId)|\(activation.activationOrdinal)"
                guard key == activation.materializationId,
                      !activation.syncRoundId.isEmpty,
                      !activation.ownerAccountId.isEmpty,
                      (1...safeIntegerMaximum).contains(
                        activation.activationOrdinal
                      ),
                      activation.activationOrdinal
                        <= state.materializationActivationHighWaterByRound[
                            activation.syncRoundId,
                            default: 0
                        ],
                      isLowercaseHex64(activation.ledgerPartitionId),
                      activation.ledgerEpoch > 0,
                      !activation.streamId.isEmpty,
                      activation.activatedAtMergeControlGeneration >= 0,
                      activation.ledgerPartitionId == try ledgerPartitionId(
                        ownerAccountId: activation.ownerAccountId,
                        streamSubject: activation.streamSubject,
                        ledgerEpoch: activation.ledgerEpoch,
                        streamId: activation.streamId
                      ),
                      activation.materializationId
                        == try CanonicalMaterializationEvidence
                            .materializationId(
                                syncRoundId: activation.syncRoundId,
                                ledgerPartitionId:
                                    activation.ledgerPartitionId,
                                ledgerEpoch: activation.ledgerEpoch,
                                streamId: activation.streamId,
                                activationOrdinal:
                                    activation.activationOrdinal,
                                activatedAtMergeControlGeneration:
                                    activation
                                        .activatedAtMergeControlGeneration
                            ),
                      activationByRoundOrdinal.updateValue(
                        activation.materializationId,
                        forKey: ordinalKey
                      ) == nil else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }

                if let retirement = activation.retirement {
                    let replacementAbsent =
                        retirement.replacementMaterializationId == nil
                        && retirement.replacementActivationOrdinal == nil
                        && retirement.replacementLedgerPartitionId == nil
                        && retirement.replacementLedgerEpoch == nil
                        && retirement.replacementStreamId == nil
                    let replacementComplete =
                        retirement.replacementMaterializationId != nil
                        && retirement.replacementActivationOrdinal != nil
                        && retirement.replacementLedgerPartitionId != nil
                        && retirement.replacementLedgerEpoch != nil
                        && retirement.replacementStreamId != nil
                    guard retirement.retiredAtMergeControlGeneration
                            >= activation
                                .activatedAtMergeControlGeneration else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    switch retirement.reason {
                    case .viewRemoved:
                        guard replacementAbsent else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                    case .streamReplaced, .partitionCompacted:
                        guard replacementComplete,
                              let replacementId =
                                retirement.replacementMaterializationId,
                              replacementId != activation.materializationId,
                              let replacement = state
                                .canonicalMaterializationActivations[
                                    replacementId
                                ],
                              replacement.syncRoundId
                                == activation.syncRoundId,
                              replacement.ownerAccountId
                                == activation.ownerAccountId,
                              replacement.streamSubject
                                == activation.streamSubject,
                              replacement.activationOrdinal
                                == retirement.replacementActivationOrdinal,
                              replacement.activationOrdinal
                                > activation.activationOrdinal,
                              replacement.ledgerPartitionId
                                == retirement
                                    .replacementLedgerPartitionId,
                              replacement.ledgerEpoch
                                == retirement.replacementLedgerEpoch,
                              replacement.streamId
                                == retirement.replacementStreamId,
                              replacement
                                .activatedAtMergeControlGeneration
                                >= retirement
                                    .retiredAtMergeControlGeneration else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                        if retirement.reason == .partitionCompacted {
                            guard replacement.ledgerPartitionId
                                    != activation.ledgerPartitionId,
                                  replacement.ledgerEpoch
                                    > activation.ledgerEpoch else {
                                throw DomainLedgerError
                                    .storageInvariantViolation
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    guard activeActivationIds.insert(
                        activation.materializationId
                    ).inserted,
                    activeActivationSubjects.insert(
                        activation.syncRoundId + "|"
                        + (try streamSubjectKey(
                            activation.streamSubject
                        ))
                    ).inserted else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                }
            }

            // Serving is the only vector visible to projection.
            guard Set(state.activeInboundPartitionsByRound.keys)
                    == Set(state.inboundVectorsByRound.keys) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            var servingCursorActivationIds = Set<String>()
            var servingPartitionsByRound: [String: Set<String>] = [:]
            var servingOrdinalsByRound: [String: [Int]] = [:]
            for (roundId, vector) in state.inboundVectorsByRound {
                guard !roundId.isEmpty,
                      !vector.ownerAccountId.isEmpty,
                      vector.mergeControlGeneration >= 0,
                      isLowercaseHex64(vector.mergedCheckpointHash),
                      state.activeInboundPartitionsByRound[roundId] != nil else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
            for (key, cursor) in state.inboundCursors {
                guard key == "\(cursor.syncRoundId)|\(cursor.ledgerPartitionId)",
                      let vector = state.inboundVectorsByRound[
                        cursor.syncRoundId
                      ],
                      cursor.ownerAccountId == vector.ownerAccountId,
                      cursor.ledgerPartitionId == try ledgerPartitionId(
                        ownerAccountId: cursor.ownerAccountId,
                        streamSubject: cursor.streamSubject,
                        ledgerEpoch: cursor.ledgerEpoch,
                        streamId: cursor.streamId
                      ),
                      cursor.ledgerEpoch > 0,
                      !cursor.streamId.isEmpty,
                      cursor.sourceOrdinal >= 0,
                      cursor.mergeControlGeneration
                        == vector.mergeControlGeneration,
                      isLowercaseHex64(cursor.checkpointHash),
                      cursor.ackCheckpointHash.map(isLowercaseHex64) ?? true,
                      cursor.ackedThrough <= cursor.persistedThrough,
                      cursor.replayCursor.map({
                        $0 <= cursor.persistedThrough
                      }) ?? true,
                      cursor.replayComplete
                        == (cursor.replayCursor == nil),
                      let activation = state
                        .canonicalMaterializationActivations[
                            cursor.materializationId
                        ],
                      activation.retirement == nil,
                      activation.syncRoundId == cursor.syncRoundId,
                      activation.ownerAccountId == cursor.ownerAccountId,
                      activation.streamSubject == cursor.streamSubject,
                      activation.ledgerPartitionId
                        == cursor.ledgerPartitionId,
                      activation.ledgerEpoch == cursor.ledgerEpoch,
                      activation.streamId == cursor.streamId,
                      activation.activationOrdinal
                        == cursor.materializationActivationOrdinal,
                      activation.activatedAtMergeControlGeneration
                        == cursor
                            .materializationActivatedAtMergeControlGeneration,
                      servingCursorActivationIds.insert(
                        cursor.materializationId
                      ).inserted,
                      state.activeInboundPartitionsByRound[
                        cursor.syncRoundId
                      ]?.contains(cursor.ledgerPartitionId) == true else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                servingPartitionsByRound[
                    cursor.syncRoundId,
                    default: []
                ].insert(cursor.ledgerPartitionId)
                servingOrdinalsByRound[
                    cursor.syncRoundId,
                    default: []
                ].append(cursor.sourceOrdinal)
            }
            guard servingCursorActivationIds == activeActivationIds else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            for (roundId, partitions) in
                state.activeInboundPartitionsByRound {
                let ordinals =
                    servingOrdinalsByRound[roundId, default: []].sorted()
                guard Set(partitions.sorted())
                        == servingPartitionsByRound[roundId, default: []],
                      ordinals == Array(0..<ordinals.count) else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }

            // Staging is durable but invisible.  New descriptors reserve fresh
            // ordinals; retained exact descriptors reuse the active ordinal/ID.
            guard Set(state.stagedInboundPartitionsByRound.keys)
                    == Set(state.stagedInboundVectorsByRound.keys) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            var stagedPartitionsByRound: [String: Set<String>] = [:]
            var stagedOrdinalsByRound: [String: [Int]] = [:]
            var stagedCursorByKey: [String: InboundCursorState] = [:]
            var stagedMaterializationIds = Set<String>()
            for (roundId, vector) in state.stagedInboundVectorsByRound {
                guard !roundId.isEmpty,
                      !vector.ownerAccountId.isEmpty,
                      vector.mergeControlGeneration >= 0,
                      isLowercaseHex64(vector.mergedCheckpointHash),
                      state.stagedInboundPartitionsByRound[roundId] != nil else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
            for (key, cursor) in state.stagedInboundCursors {
                let ordinalKey =
                    "\(cursor.syncRoundId)|\(cursor.materializationActivationOrdinal)"
                let expectedMaterializationId =
                    try CanonicalMaterializationEvidence.materializationId(
                        syncRoundId: cursor.syncRoundId,
                        ledgerPartitionId: cursor.ledgerPartitionId,
                        ledgerEpoch: cursor.ledgerEpoch,
                        streamId: cursor.streamId,
                        activationOrdinal:
                            cursor.materializationActivationOrdinal,
                        activatedAtMergeControlGeneration:
                            cursor
                                .materializationActivatedAtMergeControlGeneration
                    )
                guard key == "\(cursor.syncRoundId)|\(cursor.ledgerPartitionId)",
                      let vector = state.stagedInboundVectorsByRound[
                        cursor.syncRoundId
                      ],
                      cursor.ownerAccountId == vector.ownerAccountId,
                      cursor.ledgerPartitionId == try ledgerPartitionId(
                        ownerAccountId: cursor.ownerAccountId,
                        streamSubject: cursor.streamSubject,
                        ledgerEpoch: cursor.ledgerEpoch,
