```swift
                        streamId: cursor.streamId
                      ),
                      cursor.materializationId == expectedMaterializationId,
                      (1...safeIntegerMaximum).contains(
                        cursor.materializationActivationOrdinal
                      ),
                      cursor.materializationActivationOrdinal
                        <= state.materializationActivationHighWaterByRound[
                            cursor.syncRoundId,
                            default: 0
                        ],
                      cursor.sourceOrdinal >= 0,
                      cursor.mergeControlGeneration
                        == vector.mergeControlGeneration,
                      isLowercaseHex64(cursor.checkpointHash),
                      cursor.ackCheckpointHash.map(isLowercaseHex64) ?? true,
                      cursor.ackedThrough <= cursor.persistedThrough,
                      cursor.replayCursor.map({
                        $0 <= cursor.persistedThrough
                      }) ?? true,
                      cursor.replayComplete
                        == (cursor.replayCursor == nil),
                      state.stagedInboundPartitionsByRound[
                        cursor.syncRoundId
                      ]?.contains(cursor.ledgerPartitionId) == true,
                      stagedMaterializationIds.insert(
                        cursor.materializationId
                      ).inserted,
                      stagedCursorByKey.updateValue(
                        cursor,
                        forKey: key
                      ) == nil else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                if let permanent = state
                    .canonicalMaterializationActivations[
                        cursor.materializationId
                    ] {
                    guard permanent.retirement == nil,
                          permanent.syncRoundId == cursor.syncRoundId,
                          permanent.ownerAccountId == cursor.ownerAccountId,
                          permanent.streamSubject == cursor.streamSubject,
                          permanent.activationOrdinal
                            == cursor.materializationActivationOrdinal,
                          permanent.ledgerPartitionId
                            == cursor.ledgerPartitionId,
                          permanent.ledgerEpoch == cursor.ledgerEpoch,
                          permanent.streamId == cursor.streamId else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                } else {
                    guard state.canonicalMaterializationEvidence.allSatisfy({
                        $0.materializationId != cursor.materializationId
                    }) else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    if let occupied = activationByRoundOrdinal[ordinalKey] {
                        guard occupied == cursor.materializationId else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                    } else {
                        activationByRoundOrdinal[
                            ordinalKey
                        ] = cursor.materializationId
                    }
                }
                stagedPartitionsByRound[
                    cursor.syncRoundId,
                    default: []
                ].insert(cursor.ledgerPartitionId)
                stagedOrdinalsByRound[
                    cursor.syncRoundId,
                    default: []
                ].append(cursor.sourceOrdinal)
            }
            for (roundId, partitions) in
                state.stagedInboundPartitionsByRound {
                let ordinals =
                    stagedOrdinalsByRound[roundId, default: []].sorted()
                let cursors = state.stagedInboundCursors.values.filter {
                    $0.syncRoundId == roundId
                }
                guard !cursors.isEmpty,
                      Set(partitions.sorted())
                        == stagedPartitionsByRound[roundId, default: []],
                      ordinals == Array(0..<ordinals.count),
                      // Final-page persistence promotes in the same transaction.
                      cursors.contains(where: { !$0.replayComplete }) else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
            func replacementDescends(
                _ descendantId: String,
                from ancestorId: String
            ) -> Bool {
                var current = ancestorId
                var seen = Set<String>()
                while seen.insert(current).inserted,
                      let next = state
                        .canonicalMaterializationActivations[current]?
                        .retirement?.replacementMaterializationId {
                    if next == descendantId { return true }
                    current = next
                }
                return false
            }

            for activation in
                state.canonicalMaterializationActivations.values {
                if let replacement =
                    activation.retirement?.replacementMaterializationId {
                    guard replacementDescends(
                        replacement,
                        from: activation.materializationId
                    ), !replacementDescends(
                        activation.materializationId,
                        from: replacement
                    ) else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                }
            }

            var stagedRecordKeys = Set<String>()
            var stagedSyncIdentityKeys = Set<String>()
            var stagedPositionsByCursor:
                [String: [CanonicalLedgerPosition]] = [:]
            var stagedIdentities = Set<String>()
            for record in state.stagedInboundProjectionRecords {
                let order = record.input.projectionOrder
                guard order.authority == .canonicalReplay,
                      let partition = order.ledgerPartitionId,
                      let position = order.ledgerPosition,
                      let cursor = stagedCursorByKey[
                        "\(record.syncRoundId)|\(partition)"
                      ],
                      cursor.sourceOrdinal == order.sourceOrdinal,
                      cursor.streamSubject
                        == record.input.event.streamSubject,
                      position <= cursor.persistedThrough else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                let identity = try record.input.event.eventIdentity()
                let eventHash = try record.input.event.eventHash()
                let recordKey =
                    "\(record.syncRoundId)|\(partition)|\(position.rawValue)"
                guard let fact = facts[identity],
                      fact.event == record.input.event,
                      fact.hash == eventHash,
                      let origin = state.canonicalOriginEvidence[identity],
                      origin.eventHash == eventHash,
                      origin.replayProofHash
                        == record.canonicalOriginProofHash,
                      origin.ledgerPosition == position,
                      stagedRecordKeys.insert(recordKey).inserted,
                      stagedSyncIdentityKeys.insert(
                        "\(record.syncRoundId)|\(identity)"
                      ).inserted else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                stagedPositionsByCursor[
                    "\(record.syncRoundId)|\(partition)",
                    default: []
                ].append(position)
                stagedIdentities.insert(identity)
            }
            for (key, cursor) in stagedCursorByKey {
                guard densePositions(
                    stagedPositionsByCursor[key, default: []],
                    through: cursor.persistedThrough
                ) else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }

            var evidenceIds = Set<String>()
            var evidenceByIdentity:
                [String: [CanonicalMaterializationEvidence]] = [:]
            var evidenceBySyncIdentity:
                [String: [CanonicalMaterializationEvidence]] = [:]
            var activeEvidenceByRecordKey:
                [String: CanonicalMaterializationEvidence] = [:]
            var factByMaterializationPosition = [String: String]()
            for evidence in state.canonicalMaterializationEvidence {
                guard let fact = facts[evidence.eventIdentity],
                      fact.hash == evidence.eventHash,
                      let origin = state.canonicalOriginEvidence[
                        evidence.eventIdentity
                      ],
                      origin.eventHash == evidence.eventHash,
                      origin.replayProofHash
                        == evidence.canonicalOriginProofHash,
                      evidence.ledgerPosition == origin.ledgerPosition,
                      isLowercaseHex64(evidence.ledgerPartitionId),
                      evidence.ledgerEpoch > 0,
                      !evidence.streamId.isEmpty,
                      evidence.ledgerPosition.rawValue != "0",
                      (1...safeIntegerMaximum).contains(
                        evidence.materializationActivationOrdinal
                      ),
                      evidence.activatedAtMergeControlGeneration >= 0,
                      evidenceIds.insert(evidence.evidenceId).inserted,
                      let activation = state
                        .canonicalMaterializationActivations[
                            evidence.materializationId
                        ],
                      activation.ownerAccountId
                        == fact.event.ownerAccountId,
                      activation.streamSubject
                        == fact.event.streamSubject,
                      activation.syncRoundId == evidence.syncRoundId,
                      activation.ledgerPartitionId
                        == evidence.ledgerPartitionId,
                      activation.ledgerEpoch == evidence.ledgerEpoch,
                      activation.streamId == evidence.streamId,
                      activation.activationOrdinal
                        == evidence.materializationActivationOrdinal,
                      activation.activatedAtMergeControlGeneration
                        == evidence
                            .activatedAtMergeControlGeneration,
                      activation.retirement == evidence.retirement,
                      evidence.ledgerPartitionId
                        == try ledgerPartitionId(
                            ownerAccountId: activation.ownerAccountId,
                            streamSubject: activation.streamSubject,
                            ledgerEpoch: evidence.ledgerEpoch,
                            streamId: evidence.streamId
                        ) else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                let rebuilt = try CanonicalMaterializationEvidence.make(
                    syncRoundId: evidence.syncRoundId,
                    eventIdentity: evidence.eventIdentity,
                    eventHash: evidence.eventHash,
                    canonicalOriginProofHash:
                        evidence.canonicalOriginProofHash,
                    ledgerPartitionId: evidence.ledgerPartitionId,
                    ledgerEpoch: evidence.ledgerEpoch,
                    streamId: evidence.streamId,
                    ledgerPosition: evidence.ledgerPosition,
                    materializationActivationOrdinal:
                        evidence.materializationActivationOrdinal,
                    activatedAtMergeControlGeneration:
                        evidence.activatedAtMergeControlGeneration
                )
                guard rebuilt.evidenceId == evidence.evidenceId,
                      rebuilt.materializationId
                        == evidence.materializationId else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                let materializationPositionKey =
                    "\(evidence.syncRoundId)|"
                    + "\(evidence.materializationId)|"
                    + evidence.ledgerPosition.rawValue
                let canonicalFact =
                    "\(evidence.eventIdentity)|\(evidence.eventHash)"
                if let existing = factByMaterializationPosition[
                    materializationPositionKey
                ] {
                    guard existing == canonicalFact else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError
                            .canonicalCoordinateConflict
                    }
                } else {
                    factByMaterializationPosition[
                        materializationPositionKey
                    ] = canonicalFact
                }
                evidenceByIdentity[
                    evidence.eventIdentity,
                    default: []
                ].append(evidence)
                evidenceBySyncIdentity[
                    "\(evidence.syncRoundId)|\(evidence.eventIdentity)",
                    default: []
                ].append(evidence)
                if evidence.retirement == nil {
                    let recordKey =
                        "\(evidence.syncRoundId)|"
                        + "\(evidence.ledgerPartitionId)|"
                        + evidence.ledgerPosition.rawValue
                    guard activation.retirement == nil,
                          activeEvidenceByRecordKey.updateValue(
                            evidence,
                            forKey: recordKey
                          ) == nil else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError
                            .canonicalCoordinateConflict
                    }
                }
            }
            for rows in evidenceBySyncIdentity.values {
                for leftIndex in rows.indices {
                    for rightIndex in rows.indices
                    where leftIndex < rightIndex {
                        let left = rows[leftIndex]
                        let right = rows[rightIndex]
                        guard left.materializationId
                                != right.materializationId,
                              replacementDescends(
                                right.materializationId,
                                from: left.materializationId
                              ) || replacementDescends(
                                left.materializationId,
                                from: right.materializationId
                              ) else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError
                                .canonicalCoordinateConflict
                        }
                    }
                }
                guard rows.filter({ $0.retirement == nil }).count <= 1 else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.canonicalCoordinateConflict
                }
            }
            var servingRecordKeys = Set<String>()
            var servingSyncIdentityKeys = Set<String>()
            var servingPositionsByCursor:
                [String: [CanonicalLedgerPosition]] = [:]
            for record in state.inboundProjectionRecords {
                let order = record.input.projectionOrder
                guard order.authority == .canonicalReplay,
                      let partition = order.ledgerPartitionId,
                      let position = order.ledgerPosition,
                      state.activeInboundPartitionsByRound[
                        record.syncRoundId
                      ]?.contains(partition) == true,
                      let cursor = state.inboundCursors[
                        "\(record.syncRoundId)|\(partition)"
                      ],
                      cursor.sourceOrdinal == order.sourceOrdinal,
                      cursor.streamSubject
                        == record.input.event.streamSubject,
                      position <= cursor.persistedThrough else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                let identity = try record.input.event.eventIdentity()
                let eventHash = try record.input.event.eventHash()
                let recordKey =
                    "\(record.syncRoundId)|\(partition)|\(position.rawValue)"
                guard let fact = facts[identity],
                      fact.event == record.input.event,
                      fact.hash == eventHash,
                      let origin = state.canonicalOriginEvidence[identity],
                      origin.eventHash == eventHash,
                      origin.ledgerPosition == position,
                      let evidence = activeEvidenceByRecordKey[recordKey],
                      evidence.eventIdentity == identity,
                      evidence.eventHash == eventHash,
                      evidence.canonicalOriginProofHash
                        == origin.replayProofHash,
                      evidence.materializationId
                        == cursor.materializationId,
                      servingSyncIdentityKeys.insert(
                        "\(record.syncRoundId)|\(identity)"
                      ).inserted,
                      servingRecordKeys.insert(recordKey).inserted else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                servingPositionsByCursor[
                    "\(record.syncRoundId)|\(partition)",
                    default: []
                ].append(position)
            }
            guard servingRecordKeys
                    == Set(activeEvidenceByRecordKey.keys) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            for (key, cursor) in state.inboundCursors {
                guard densePositions(
                    servingPositionsByCursor[key, default: []],
                    through: cursor.persistedThrough
                ) else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
            let successfulV2Ids = Set(successfulV2Receipts.keys)
            let successfulLegacyIds = Set(legacyTerminalByIdentity.compactMap {
                identity, receipt in
                receipt.status == .accepted
                    || receipt.status == .duplicateHashMatch
                    ? identity : nil
            })
            guard successfulV2Ids.isDisjoint(with: successfulLegacyIds) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            for identity in successfulV2Ids {
                guard let receipt = successfulV2Receipts[identity] else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                let origin = state.canonicalOriginEvidence[identity]
                let originMatches = origin.map {
                    $0.eventHash == receipt.eventHash
                        && $0.ledgerPartitionId
                            == receipt.ledgerPartitionId
                        && $0.ledgerEpoch == receipt.ledgerEpoch
                        && $0.streamId == receipt.streamId
                        && $0.ledgerPosition == receipt.ledgerPosition
                } ?? false
                if origin != nil && !originMatches {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.canonicalCoordinateConflict
                }
                let awaiting = state.acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay[
                    identity
                ] == receipt
                guard awaiting == !originMatches,
                      localProjectionAuthorities[identity]
                        == (awaiting
                            ? .acceptedAwaitingReplay
                            : .localTerminalFallback) else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
            for identity in successfulLegacyIds {
                guard let receipt = legacyTerminalByIdentity[identity] else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                let materialized = state.canonicalOriginEvidence[
                    identity
                ]?.eventHash == receipt.eventHash
                let awaiting = state
                    .legacyV1AcceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay[identity] != nil
                guard awaiting == !materialized,
                      localProjectionAuthorities[identity]
                        == (awaiting
                            ? .acceptedAwaitingReplay
                            : .localTerminalFallback) else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }

            func exactV2PendingSupport(
                identity: String,
                fact: (event: DomainRoundEvent, hash: String),
                allowedSourceClasses: Set<OutboxSourceClass>
            ) throws -> OutboxRecord? {
                let rows = state.outbox.filter { $0.eventIdentity == identity }
                guard rows.count <= 1 else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                guard let row = rows.first else { return nil }
                guard row.event == fact.event,
                      row.eventHash == fact.hash,
                      row.deadLetterReason == nil,
                      row.receiptStorageKey == nil,
                      row.receipt == nil || row.receipt?.status == .deferred,
                      allowedSourceClasses.contains(row.source.sourceClass)
                      else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                switch row.source.sourceClass {
                case .localOrdinary:
                    guard let evidence = state.localOrdinaryOutboxEvidence[
                        row.source.evidenceKey
                    ], evidence.evidenceKey == row.source.evidenceKey else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    try Self.validateStoredLocalOrdinaryEvidence(
                        row: row,
                        evidence: evidence,
                        state: state
                    )
                case .sealedLegacyMigration:
                    guard let evidence = state.sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence[
                        row.source.evidenceKey
                    ], evidence.evidenceKey == row.source.evidenceKey,
                       let batch = completedLegacyClassificationBatches[
                        evidence.authorityId
                       ] else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    try LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator.validateStoredEvidence(
                        row: row,
                        evidence: evidence,
                        batch: batch,
                        legacyWireBindings: state.legacyWireBindings
                    )
                case .verifiedPeerBundle:
                    guard let evidence = state.verifiedPeerBundleEvidence[
                        row.source.evidenceKey
                    ], evidence.evidenceKey == row.source.evidenceKey else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    try VerifiedPeerBundleEvidenceValidator.validateStored(
                        row: row,
                        evidence: evidence,
                        state: state,
                        trustedServerKeys: trustedPeerServerKeys
                    )
                }
                return row
            }

            func hasExactLegacyV1PendingSupport(
                identity: String,
                fact: (event: DomainRoundEvent, hash: String)
            ) throws -> Bool {
                let rows = state.legacyV1RetryableOutbox.filter {
                    $0.eventIdentity == identity
                }
                guard rows.count <= 1 else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                guard let row = rows.first else { return false }
                let bindings = state.legacyWireBindings.filter { _, binding in
                    binding.canonicalDomainIdentity == identity
                        && binding.canonicalDomainEventHash == fact.hash
                        && binding.roundId == fact.event.roundId
                }
                guard row.eventHash == fact.hash,
                      row.receipt == nil,
                      row.deadLetterReason == nil,
                      bindings.count == 1,
                      let binding = bindings.first else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                for batch in state.preparedLegacyV1Batches.values {
                    for slot in batch.orderedSlots
                    where slot.bindingKey == binding.key {
                        guard batch.roundId == fact.event.roundId,
                              slot.exactNormalizedEnvelopeHash
                                == binding.value.normalizedWireEnvelopeHash
                              else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                    }
                }
                return true
            }

            func hasAnyTerminalOrDeadSupport(_ identity: String) -> Bool {
                deadByIdentity[identity] != nil
                    || state.acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay[identity] != nil
                    || state.legacyV1AcceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay[
                        identity
                    ] != nil
                    || state.receipts.values.contains {
                        $0.eventIdentity == identity
                    }
                    || legacyTerminalByIdentity[identity] != nil
            }

            // Replay can precede the upload response. It immediately makes the
            // local input a durable fallback but leaves its complete source graph.
            for (identity, authority) in localProjectionAuthorities {
                guard let fact = facts[identity] else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                let origin = state.canonicalOriginEvidence[identity]
                switch authority {
                case .acceptedAwaitingReplay:
                    let v2Awaiting = state
                        .acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay[identity].map {
                            $0 == successfulV2Receipts[identity]
                                && $0.eventIdentity == identity
                                && $0.eventHash == fact.hash
                        } ?? false
                    let legacyAwaiting = state
                        .legacyV1AcceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay[identity]
                        .map { evidence in
                            evidence.eventIdentity == identity
                                && evidence.eventHash == fact.hash
                                && state.legacyV1TerminalReceipts[
                                    evidence.receiptStorageKey
                                ] == legacyTerminalByIdentity[identity]
                                && successfulLegacyIds.contains(identity)
                        } ?? false
                    let v2Pending = try exactV2PendingSupport(
                        identity: identity,
                        fact: fact,
                        allowedSourceClasses: [
                            .localOrdinary,
                            .sealedLegacyMigration,
                            .verifiedPeerBundle,
                        ]
                    )
                    let legacyPending = try hasExactLegacyV1PendingSupport(
                        identity: identity,
                        fact: fact
                    )
                    guard origin == nil,
                          v2Pending == nil,
                          !legacyPending,
                          deadByIdentity[identity] == nil,
                          [v2Awaiting, legacyAwaiting]
                            .filter({ $0 }).count == 1 else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                case .localTerminalFallback:
                    let v2Pending = try exactV2PendingSupport(
                        identity: identity,
                        fact: fact,
                        allowedSourceClasses: [
                            .localOrdinary,
                            .sealedLegacyMigration,
                            .verifiedPeerBundle,
                        ]
                    ) != nil
                    let legacyPending = try hasExactLegacyV1PendingSupport(
                        identity: identity,
                        fact: fact
                    )
                    let v2Terminal = successfulV2Receipts[identity].map {
                        receipt in
                        receipt.eventIdentity == identity
                            && receipt.eventHash == fact.hash
                            && origin?.eventHash == receipt.eventHash
                            && origin?.ledgerPartitionId
                                == receipt.ledgerPartitionId
                            && origin?.ledgerEpoch == receipt.ledgerEpoch
                            && origin?.streamId == receipt.streamId
                            && origin?.ledgerPosition
                                == receipt.ledgerPosition
                            && state.acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay[
                                identity
                            ] == nil
                    } ?? false
                    let legacyTerminal = successfulLegacyIds
                        .contains(identity)
                        && legacyTerminalByIdentity[identity]?.eventHash
                            == fact.hash
                        && state
                            .legacyV1AcceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay[
                                identity
                            ] == nil
                    let supportCount = [
                        v2Pending,
                        legacyPending,
                        v2Terminal,
                        legacyTerminal,
                    ].filter({ $0 }).count
                    guard origin?.eventIdentity == identity,
                          origin?.eventHash == fact.hash,
                          deadByIdentity[identity] == nil,
                          supportCount == 1 else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                case .localProvisional:
                    let v2Pending = try exactV2PendingSupport(
                        identity: identity,
                        fact: fact,
                        allowedSourceClasses: [
                            .localOrdinary,
                            .sealedLegacyMigration,
                        ]
                    ) != nil
                    let legacyPending = try hasExactLegacyV1PendingSupport(
                        identity: identity,
                        fact: fact
                    )
                    guard origin == nil,
                          !hasAnyTerminalOrDeadSupport(identity),
                          [v2Pending, legacyPending]
                            .filter({ $0 }).count == 1 else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                case .peerProvisional:
                    let peerRow = try exactV2PendingSupport(
                        identity: identity,
                        fact: fact,
                        allowedSourceClasses: [.verifiedPeerBundle]
                    )
                    let legacyPending = try hasExactLegacyV1PendingSupport(
                        identity: identity,
                        fact: fact
                    )
                    guard origin == nil,
                          peerRow != nil,
                          !legacyPending,
                          !hasAnyTerminalOrDeadSupport(identity) else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                case .localPreparedResolutionCommit:
                    // Storage V2 has no resolution-commit provenance root.
                    // Task 13a admits this authority only after V2 -> V3.
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                case .canonicalReplay:
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }

            // Permanent rejection conflicts with serving or staging origin proof.
            for identity in deadIds {
                guard state.canonicalOriginEvidence[identity] == nil,
                      !stagedIdentities.contains(identity),
                      evidenceByIdentity[identity, default: []].isEmpty else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.canonicalCoordinateConflict
                }
            }
            for (key, capture) in state.shotCaptureStates {
                guard key == "\(capture.roundId)|\(capture.roundIncarnationId)",
                      !capture.active.shotId.isEmpty,
                      capture.active.phase == .reserved,
                      capture.active.eventIdentity == nil,
                      capture.active.eventHash == nil else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                if let completed = capture.lastCompleted {
                    guard completed.phase == .completed,
                          let identity = completed.eventIdentity,
                          let hash = completed.eventHash,
                          facts[identity]?.hash == hash else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch let error as DomainLedgerError {
            switch error {
            case .productionOwnerAlreadyOpen, .storageMissing,
                 .unsupportedStorageVersion, .migrationTargetNotEmpty:
                throw error
            default:
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        } catch {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
    }

    public func replicationContext(roundId: String) throws -> DomainReplicationContext {
        try locked {
            let state = try loadV2()
            let canonicalPrefix = try Set(state.inboundProjectionRecords.compactMap { record in
                guard record.input.event.roundId == roundId,
                      record.input.projectionOrder.authority == .canonicalReplay else { return nil }
                return try record.input.event.eventIdentity()
            })
            let eventRoundByIdentity = try Dictionary(
                uniqueKeysWithValues: state.events.map {
                    (try $0.eventIdentity(), $0.roundId)
                }
            )
            let legacyPendingCount = state.legacyV1RetryableOutbox.filter {
                eventRoundByIdentity[$0.eventIdentity] == roundId
            }.count
            return DomainReplicationContext(
                pendingCount: state.outbox.filter {
                    $0.event.roundId == roundId && $0.deadLetterReason == nil
                }.count + legacyPendingCount,
                awaitingCanonicalReplayCount: state.acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay.values.filter {
                    $0.eventIdentity.map { identity in
                        state.events.contains {
                            $0.roundId == roundId && (try? $0.eventIdentity()) == identity
                        }
                    } ?? false
                }.count + state.legacyV1AcceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay.values.filter { evidence in
                    state.events.contains {
                        $0.roundId == roundId
                            && (try? $0.eventIdentity()) == evidence.eventIdentity
                    }
                }.count,
                syncing: false,
                deadLetterCount: state.deadLetters.filter {
                    $0.event.roundId == roundId
                }.count + state.migrationDeadLetters.filter { $0.roundId == roundId }.count,
                canonicalPrefixEventIdentities: canonicalPrefix
            )
        }
    }
}
```

上述production definition中的三个validator entry不是占位符：Task 11必须在同一checkpoint实现`DomainLedgerStorageWireValidator.validateStorageV1ExactKeys(_:)`、`validateStorageV2ExactKeys(_:)`与static `DomainLedgerStore.validateOperationalInvariants(_:)`。`probeStorageVersion(_:)`是唯一允许root unknown keys的probe；完整storage-v1/v2 decode前，wire validator必须先用保留每次object-key occurrence的raw scanner拒绝duplicate key，再做exact-key/type walk，不能先materialize成Swift dictionary，也不能依赖会忽略unknown keys的合成`JSONDecoder`。

root exact keys冻结为：

```swift
private static let storageV1RootKeys: Set<String> = [
    "storageVersion", "origin", "events", "outbox", "deadLetters", "receipts",
    "legacyWireBindings", "preparedLegacyV1Batches",
    "watchTerminalReceiptRelayObligations", "watchTerminalReceiptRelayConfirmations",
    "migrationMarkers", "transportAnomalies",
]

private static let storageV2RootKeys: Set<String> = [
    "storageVersion", "originSequenceAuthority", "events", "outbox",
    "localOrdinaryOutboxEvidence", "sealedLegacyAuthorities",
    "pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations",
    "completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations",
    "sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence",
    "verifiedPeerBundleAuthorities",
    "verifiedPeerCredentialVerificationRecords",
    "verifiedPeerBundleVerificationReceipts",
    "verifiedPeerBundleEvidence",
    "peerTakeoverWatermarks", "peerBundleReceipts",
    "legacyV1RetryableOutbox", "deadLetters",
    "receipts", "acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay", "legacyV1TerminalReceipts",
    "legacyV1AcceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay", "migrationMarkers",
    "migrationDeadLetters", "transportAnomalies", "legacyTransportEvidence",
    "legacyWireBindings", "preparedLegacyV1Batches",
    "watchTerminalReceiptRelayObligations", "watchTerminalReceiptRelayConfirmations",
    "shotCaptureStates", "localProjectionInputs", "inboundProjectionRecords",
    "stagedInboundProjectionRecords",
    "canonicalOriginEvidence",
    "canonicalMaterializationActivations",
    "canonicalMaterializationEvidence",
    "materializationActivationHighWaterByRound",
    "inboundCursors", "stagedInboundCursors",
    "activeInboundPartitionsByRound", "stagedInboundPartitionsByRound",
    "inboundVectorsByRound", "stagedInboundVectorsByRound",
]
```

recursive typed-record roster至少包括``。V2 `OutboxRecord` exact keys包含required `source`与nullable `receiptStorageKey`；retryable row必须为nil，V2 permanent dead letter必须指向`receipts` dictionary中的exact key，V1 migrated permanent dead letter保持nil并由`legacyV1TerminalReceipts`支持。每个authority ID在`pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations`与`completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations`之间exact XOR。pending record的`sourceRoundIds`必须由event-classified source records的non-null round IDs sorted-unique派生；pending可以与后来新增的valid durable start共存，但不得已有该authority的source evidence、import event/outbox/local projection、migration dead letter或completion。completed record必须1:1覆盖scanner source roster，每条仅有一个terminal disposition，marker仅是审计且exact等于authority kind；完成判定只能查typed authority ID，不能查bare marker/kind。`InboundCursorState` exact keys还包含immutable `ownerAccountId/streamSubject/materializationId/materializationActivationOrdinal/materializationActivatedAtMergeControlGeneration`与mutable `replayComplete`；per-sync-round `materializationActivationHighWaterByRound`是独立、monotonic、gap-tolerant的ordinal authority，merge generation只作审计。永久`canonicalOriginEvidence`以event identity为key，冻结identity/hash/original coordinate与`CanonicalOriginProof/v1`；staging supersede不得删除它。永久activation registry只记录promoted serving/retired lineage。serving与staging projection/cursor/vector/partition roots分别exact-shaped；staging record引用origin proof但不进入terminal materialization evidence，不能把未完成target混入当前投影。storage-v1 bytes仍按旧shape decode；Task 11的V1→V2 migrator无论durable `round_started`是否已经存在都只写sealed authority、typed pending authority record与raw storage evidence，不写event/outbox/local projection/import dead-letter/completion；Task 12才从同一locked state snapshot分类并原子完成pending → completed。storage-v2 checked-in fixture对三种source class以及全部六个peer authority/credential/verification/evidence/receipt/watermark roots使用非空、可区分evidence。每个helper都以该type的完整`CodingKeys`作为exact set并递归检查array/object/scalar类型；dictionary只允许任意业务key，value仍按对应typed record检查。`payload`与`parsedTransportEvidence`是显式开放的`JSONValue`边界，可以有业务字段，但仍受duplicate-key、depth、number/string canonical限制。mutation corpus对上述每一种typed record至少插入一个unknown key，并对V1/V2 root分别做missing/extra/wrong-container/duplicate-key；任何一项都必须在完整decode前fail closed。

literal production wire validator如下。它先运行raw duplicate-key scanner，再由generated exact shape递归检查每个object/array/dictionary/scalar；它不用Codable round-trip猜optional keys，也不依赖`Set`的非确定编码顺序。只有shape显式标成`.anyJSON`的`payload/parsedTransportEvidence`可以容纳业务key：

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/DomainLedgerStorageWireValidator.swift
import CoreFoundation
import Foundation

indirect enum StorageJSONShape {
    case object(
        required: [String: StorageJSONShape],
        optional: [String: StorageJSONShape]
    )
    case array(StorageJSONShape)
    case uniqueArray(StorageJSONShape)
    case dictionary(StorageJSONShape)
    case nullable(StorageJSONShape)
    case oneOf([StorageJSONShape])
    case string
    case enumStrings(Set<String>)
    case integer
    case number
    case boolean
    case null
    case literalInteger(Int64)
    case literalString(String)
    case anyJSON
}

private enum StorageJSONShapeWalker {
    static func validate(
        _ value: Any,
        against shape: StorageJSONShape,
        path: String = "$",
        depth: Int = 0
    ) throws {
        guard depth <= 64 else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        switch shape {
        case .object(let required, let optional):
            guard let object = value as? [String: Any],
                  required.keys.allSatisfy(object.keys.contains),
                  Set(object.keys).isSubset(
                    of: Set(required.keys).union(optional.keys)
                  ) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            for (key, child) in required {
                guard let nested = object[key] else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                try validate(
                    nested,
                    against: child,
                    path: "\(path).\(key)",
                    depth: depth + 1
                )
            }
            for (key, child) in optional where object[key] != nil {
                try validate(
                    object[key]!,
                    against: child,
                    path: "\(path).\(key)",
                    depth: depth + 1
                )
            }
        case .array(let child):
            guard let array = value as? [Any] else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            for (index, nested) in array.enumerated() {
                try validate(
                    nested,
                    against: child,
                    path: "\(path)[\(index)]",
                    depth: depth + 1
                )
            }
        case .uniqueArray(let child):
            guard let array = value as? [Any] else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            var seen = Set<Data>()
            var previous: Data?
            for (index, nested) in array.enumerated() {
                try validate(
                    nested,
                    against: child,
                    path: "\(path)[\(index)]",
                    depth: depth + 1
                )
                let bytes = try JSONSerialization.data(
                    withJSONObject: nested,
                    options: [.fragmentsAllowed, .sortedKeys, .withoutEscapingSlashes]
                )
                guard seen.insert(bytes).inserted else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                if let previous, !(previous.lexicographicallyPrecedes(bytes)) {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                previous = bytes
            }
        case .dictionary(let child):
            guard let object = value as? [String: Any] else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            for (key, nested) in object {
                guard !key.isEmpty, key.count <= 4_096 else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                try validate(
                    nested,
                    against: child,
                    path: "\(path).\(key)",
                    depth: depth + 1
                )
            }
        case .nullable(let child):
            if value is NSNull { return }
            try validate(value, against: child, path: path, depth: depth + 1)
        case .oneOf(let choices):
            var matches = 0
            for choice in choices {
                if (try? validate(
                    value,
                    against: choice,
                    path: path,
                    depth: depth + 1
                )) != nil { matches += 1 }
            }
            guard matches == 1 else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        case .string:
            guard value is String else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        case .enumStrings(let allowed):
            guard let string = value as? String, allowed.contains(string) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        case .integer:
            guard isInteger(value) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        case .number:
            guard isJSONNumber(value) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        case .boolean:
            guard CFGetTypeID(value as AnyObject) == CFBooleanGetTypeID() else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        case .null:
            guard value is NSNull else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        case .literalInteger(let expected):
            guard isInteger(value),
                  (value as? NSNumber)?.int64Value == expected else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        case .literalString(let expected):
            guard value as? String == expected else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        case .anyJSON:
            try validateOpenJSON(value, depth: depth)
        }
    }

    private static func isInteger(_ value: Any) -> Bool {
        guard let number = value as? NSNumber,
              CFGetTypeID(number) != CFBooleanGetTypeID() else { return false }
        let type = String(cString: number.objCType)
        return !["f", "d"].contains(type)
            && abs(number.doubleValue) <= 9_007_199_254_740_991
    }

    private static func isJSONNumber(_ value: Any) -> Bool {
        guard let number = value as? NSNumber,
              CFGetTypeID(number) != CFBooleanGetTypeID() else { return false }
        return number.doubleValue.isFinite
            && abs(number.doubleValue) <= 9_007_199_254_740_991
    }

    private static func validateOpenJSON(_ value: Any, depth: Int) throws {
        guard depth <= 16 else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        if value is NSNull { return }
        if let string = value as? String {
            guard string.count <= 4_096,
                  string.precomposedStringWithCanonicalMapping == string else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            return
        }
        if CFGetTypeID(value as AnyObject) == CFBooleanGetTypeID() { return }
        if value is NSNumber {
            guard isJSONNumber(value) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            return
        }
        if let array = value as? [Any] {
            for nested in array {
                try validateOpenJSON(nested, depth: depth + 1)
            }
            return
        }
        if let object = value as? [String: Any] {
            for (key, nested) in object {
                guard !key.isEmpty, key.count <= 128,
                      key.precomposedStringWithCanonicalMapping == key else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                try validateOpenJSON(nested, depth: depth + 1)
            }
            return
        }
        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
    }
}

enum DomainLedgerStorageWireValidator {

    static func probeStorageVersion(_ data: Data) throws -> Int {
        do {
            try StrictJSONDecoder.validateNoDuplicateKeys(in: data)
            guard let root = try JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data)
                    as? [String: Any],
                  let raw = root["storageVersion"],
                  StorageJSONShapeWalker.isIntegerForProbe(raw),
                  let version = (raw as? NSNumber)?.int64Value,
                  version >= 0, version <= Int64(Int.max) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            return Int(version)
        } catch let error as DomainLedgerError {
            throw error
        } catch {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
    }

    static func decodeStorageV1(_ data: Data) throws -> LegacyDomainLedgerStateV1 {
        do {
            try validateStorageV1ExactKeys(data)
            let state = try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(
                LegacyDomainLedgerStateV1.self,
                from: data
            )
            guard state.storageVersion == 1 else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.unsupportedStorageVersion
            }
            return state
        } catch let error as DomainLedgerError {
            throw error
        } catch {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
    }

    static func decodeStorageV2(_ data: Data) throws -> DomainLedgerStateV2 {
        do {
            try validateStorageV2ExactKeys(data)
            let state = try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(DomainLedgerStateV2.self, from: data)
            guard state.storageVersion == 2 else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.unsupportedStorageVersion
            }
            return state
        } catch let error as DomainLedgerError {
            throw error
        } catch {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
    }

    static func validateStorageV1ExactKeys(_ data: Data) throws {
        try validate(data, shape: GeneratedDomainLedgerStorageShapes.storageV1)
    }

    static func validateStorageV2ExactKeys(_ data: Data) throws {
        try validate(data, shape: GeneratedDomainLedgerStorageShapes.storageV2)
    }

    private static func validate(
        _ data: Data,
        shape: StorageJSONShape
    ) throws {
        do {
            try StrictJSONDecoder.validateNoDuplicateKeys(in: data)
            let raw = try JSONSerialization.jsonObject(
                with: data,
                options: [.fragmentsAllowed]
            )
            try StorageJSONShapeWalker.validate(raw, against: shape)
        } catch let error as DomainLedgerError {
            throw error
        } catch {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
    }
}

fileprivate extension StorageJSONShapeWalker {
    static func isIntegerForProbe(_ value: Any) -> Bool {
        guard let number = value as? NSNumber,
              CFGetTypeID(number) != CFBooleanGetTypeID() else { return false }
        return !["f", "d"].contains(String(cString: number.objCType))
            && abs(number.doubleValue) <= 9_007_199_254_740_991
    }
}
```

`validateOperationalInvariants`按固定顺序证明：

1. storage version、origin IDs与sequence合法；本root origin+epoch的最大event sequence不超过lastReserved。
2. 每个event先通过`RoundPayloadValidator.validatePersistedOrInbound(_:)`：generated exhaustive common envelope、canonical bytes、depth/string/byte limits与identity/hash对known/unknown一视同仁；known kind再执行payload/entity/base/transaction strict validation，unknown返回`.opaque`而不是进入known switch。随后`RoundEventBranchBindingValidator.validatePersistedOrReduced(_:)`按stream冻结principal与round binding，最后证明recomputed event identity/hash唯一，所有map/list storage key与record identity exact round-trip。
3. 按关系矩阵验证transport state：ordinary V2 retryable outbox与dead letter/terminal delivery互斥；每个V2 outbox/dead-letter row先重算identity/hash，再按`source.sourceClass`查找exact supporting evidence并运行source-specific validator。local ordinary evidence必须匹配append-time origin/epoch/sequence/high-water、ordinary submission policy与frozen branch binding，但不得要求等于当前epoch；sealed legacy evidence必须从fixed authority SHA/raw line/sourceLine/binding重建candidate；verified peer evidence必须匹配durable verified bundle/credential receipt。local opaque、commit-owned、forged legacy、forged peer、cross-class/orphan evidence均在startup fail closed。`receipts`是历史证据，可与matching `acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay`或matching permanent `deadLetters`共存；V2 awaiting必须引用matching successful V2 receipt。每个successful V2 receipt必须恰好处于“awaiting + matching `.acceptedAwaitingReplay` local projection”或“matching canonical inbound projection”之一，不能两个都没有或两个都有。`legacyV1RetryableOutbox`只由exact V1 sender消费，与legacy terminal/permanent state互斥；V1 accepted/duplicate terminal同样必须恰好处于legacy awaiting或canonical replay之一。每个visible dead letter必须恰好由matching V2 rejected receipt或matching V1 rejected terminal支持。只有canonical V2 success receipt允许完整canonical coordinates且position必须non-nil/positive；legacy records永不携带或派生coordinate。
4. binding serialized key、canonical identity/hash、normalized wire hash和alias均只指向一个fact；prepared request body SHA/idempotency/ordered slot roster exact且每个binding存在。
5. Watch confirmation有matching obligation与matching terminal identity/hash/status，未确认obligation仍pending。
6. migration marker非空；migration dead letter sourceLine/id/raw bytes和anomaly typed ID可重算。
7. 每个local/inbound projection input引用`events`中的exact identity/hash；同identity canonical inbound优先且不得留下第二个local input。同一canonical fact可按`syncRoundId`分别materialize到standalone与merged view。每个inbound record必须有一条exact active`CanonicalMaterializationEvidence`，每个active evidence也必须反向对应一条record；evidence显式包含由`syncRoundId/partition/epoch/stream/activation generation`派生的`materializationId`。同一`syncRoundId + identity`至多一个active coordinate，同一active `materializationId + position`至多一个identity。retired evidence永久保留原coordinate与retirement generation/reason；replacement fields要么全nil（unmerge/removal），要么all-present且指向由`adoptBootstrap`建立的新materialization。`persistInbound`不能删除/覆盖evidence来搬家。
8. cursor的partition/epoch/stream/positive canonical position、active partition sets、inbound records、materialization evidence和vector generation/checkpoint maps内部一致。`adoptBootstrap`对仍active且same epoch/stream的retained partition沿用既有`materializationId`，即使merge generation变化也不重置freeze；remove或epoch/stream replacement先retire旧ID，之后即使同partition+epoch+stream被re-add，也必须以新的activation generation生成新ID。同一active materialization内已有identity只能在原position exact replay；higher-position identity move即使hash相同也fail closed。普通persist不得隐式retire。

Task 11的storage-v2 projection-authority switch必须对六个generated cases exhaustive：`.localProvisional/.acceptedAwaitingReplay/.localTerminalFallback`继续证明各自local/terminal graph；`.peerProvisional`必须要求canonical origin absent且恰有一条same-identity的non-dead retryable outbox row，再从该exact event/hash贯穿`OutboxSourceClass.verifiedPeerBundle`、matching evidence key、`verifiedPeerBundleEvidence` identity/hash、bundle/credential/verification-receipt stored validator到projection fact，任一orphan、cross-key、cross-identity/hash或多row supporting graph都fail closed；`.localPreparedResolutionCommit`在尚无resolution provenance root的V2中显式拒绝；`.canonicalReplay`不得出现在local projection root。不能用只检查outbox source-class的existence test代替verified-peer graph。

validator mutation tests必须逐项从一个合法rich V2 state删除/篡改：successful receipt的`ledgerPosition`、awaiting map、canonical inbound projection、`.acceptedAwaitingReplay` local authority；legacy accepted awaiting evidence；V1/V2 permanent dead-letter的matching terminal evidence；三种outbox source reference/evidence key/class/identity/hash/authority bytes；active/retired materialization evidence及其coordinate/retirement fields；并构造awaiting与canonical replay同时存在、同sync identity双active coordinate和同coordinate双identity状态。projection-authority专用回归名固定为`testV2LocalProvisionalProjectionWithoutExactPendingGraphFailsStartup`、`testV2LocalProvisionalProjectionRejectsPeerCrossClassOrMultipleSupport`、`testV2PeerProvisionalProjectionWithoutExactPeerOutboxFailsStartup`、`testV2PeerProvisionalProjectionCrossKeyEvidenceFailsStartup`、`testV2VerifiedPeerBundleAppendCannotBecomeLocalProvisional`、`testV2AcceptedAwaitingReplayRequiresExactlyOneTerminalGraph`、`testV2LocalTerminalFallbackRequiresCanonicalOriginAndOneExactSupportGraph`与`testV2LocalPreparedResolutionCommitProjectionFailsStartup`。这些case分别覆盖V2 local ordinary、sealed legacy、legacy-v1 retryable与peer source的zero/one/multiple/cross-key support；fallback还分别覆盖canonical+local/legacy/peer retryable以及canonical+V1/V2 successful terminal，并删除origin或换成wrong hash/coordinate。任何orphan projection、cross-source class、same-identity multi-row、pending+terminal double support或仅“某行存在”的弱关系都必须由同一个exhaustive operational switch而非wire missing-key gate拒绝。另加入known malformed payload、unknown malformed common envelope、unknown跨principal/stream/frozen binding、unknown超depth/string/byte limit，以及canonical `future_kind` restart仍作为opaque fact存在的cases。每个case都必须在startup decode完成shape检查后由`validateOperationalInvariants`精确fail closed，不能只靠missing-key schema提前失败；合法unknown不能因storage startup误入strict known-kind validator而失败。

实现用单一`do/catch`把任何低层decode/hash/roster错误映射为`DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation`，但必须保留`productionOwnerAlreadyOpen/storageMissing/unsupportedStorageVersion/migrationTargetNotEmpty`这些启动边界的exact error。startup不能返回空store或部分state；migration candidate与每次transaction都调用这同一个static validator，禁止`skipValidationForMigration`之类逃生口。

symbol/API test固定：全module只有`DomainLedgerCompositionRoot.swift`调用`productionStore`，只有`DomainLedgerStorageMigration.swift`调用`makeMigrationStagingStore`与module-internal `validatedStorageV1Snapshot(validatedAuthority:authorityData:decodedStorageV1:observers:)`；旧`sourceRecords(...)` wrappers不存在。designated initializer保持private，staging root不进入production claim set。`productionStore`完成唯一cold-start storage-v2 validation，composition root取得validated store后不得再次调用`validateStorageV2()`。`productionOwnerAlreadyOpen/storageMissing/storageInvariantViolation/migrationTargetNotEmpty`是exact error cases。

`DomainLedgerStore` 的 production construction只能经过这个 composition root。它按canonical root URL返回single owner，在任何store暴露前完成storage-v1 migration；随后`productionStore`恰好一次strict-load并验证v2，composition root不做第二次validation。staging migration只能调用private `makeMigrationStagingStore`，该store不注册到production owner map：

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/DomainLedgerCompositionRoot.swift
import Foundation

public enum DomainLedgerCompositionRoot {
    private static let lock = NSRecursiveLock()
    private static var storesByCanonicalRoot: [URL: DomainLedgerStore] = [:]

    public static func open(
        directoryURL: URL,
        expectedOriginDeviceId: String,
        faultHook: @escaping (DomainLedgerFaultPoint) throws -> Void = { _ in }
    ) throws -> DomainLedgerStore {
        try open(
            directoryURL: directoryURL,
            expectedOriginDeviceId: expectedOriginDeviceId,
            trustedPeerServerKeys: [:],
            faultHook: faultHook
        )
    }

    // Internal injection seam used by the paired-credential composition owner
    // and tests; arbitrary app callers retain only the three-argument API.
    static func open(
        directoryURL: URL,
        expectedOriginDeviceId: String,
        trustedPeerServerKeys: [String: Data],
        faultHook: @escaping (DomainLedgerFaultPoint) throws -> Void = { _ in }
    ) throws -> DomainLedgerStore {
        let root = directoryURL.standardizedFileURL.resolvingSymlinksInPath()
        lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }
        if let existing = storesByCanonicalRoot[root] {
            let origin = try existing.originSequenceAuthority()
            guard origin.originDeviceId == expectedOriginDeviceId,
                  existing.hasExactTrustedPeerServerKeys(
                    trustedPeerServerKeys
                  ) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            return existing
        }
        try DomainLedgerStorageMigration.migrateIfNeeded(
            stateURL: DomainLedgerStore.stateURL(in: root),
            expectedOriginDeviceId: expectedOriginDeviceId,
            faultHook: faultHook
        )
        let store = try DomainLedgerStore.productionStore(
            directoryURL: root,
            expectedOriginDeviceId: expectedOriginDeviceId,
            trustedPeerServerKeys: trustedPeerServerKeys,
            faultHook: faultHook
        )
        storesByCanonicalRoot[root] = store
        return store
    }

    // Internal test support only. Tests must release every strong store reference
    // before calling this, then reopen through the same public composition path.
    static func releaseForTesting(directoryURL: URL) {
        let root = directoryURL.standardizedFileURL.resolvingSymlinksInPath()
        lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }
        storesByCanonicalRoot.removeValue(forKey: root)
    }
}
```

```swift
enum DomainLedgerTestHarness {

        trustedPeerServerKeys: [String: Data] = [:],

    }
}
```

