
`ShotCaptureSession` 不是第二份 sidecar store。`DomainLedgerStateV2` 新增 `shotCaptureStates: [String: DurableShotCaptureState]`，key 固定为 `roundId + "|" + roundIncarnationId`；target append、shot append/outbox、完成旧 slot 和预留下一 slot 都复用 `DomainLedgerStore.transaction` 的同一个 atomic replace：

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/DomainLedgerStore.swift
private func shotCaptureKey(roundId: String, roundIncarnationId: String) -> String {
    "\(roundId)|\(roundIncarnationId)"
}

enum RoundEventAppendValidationMode {
    case locallyAuthored
    case peerOperationalImport(VerifiedPeerBundleImportCapability)
    case sealedLegacyMigration(LegacyDomainEventMigrationCandidate)
}

extension DomainLedgerStore {
    private static func hasPendingLegacyAuthority(
        for roundId: String,
        in state: DomainLedgerStateV2
    ) -> Bool {
        state.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations.values.contains {
            $0.sourceRoundIds.contains(roundId)
        }
    }

    func validateLocalAuthoringPreflight(
        roundId: String,
        kind: RoundEventKind
    ) throws {
        try locked {
            let state = try loadV2()
            guard Self.hasPendingLegacyAuthority(
                for: roundId,
                in: state
            ) else { return }
            let alreadyStarted = state.events.contains {
                $0.roundId == roundId && $0.kind == .roundStarted
            }
            guard kind == .roundStarted, !alreadyStarted else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.legacyMigrationPending
            }
        }
    }

    private static func validatePendingLegacyLocalAuthoring(
        _ event: DomainRoundEvent,
        against state: DomainLedgerStateV2
    ) throws {
        guard Self.hasPendingLegacyAuthority(
            for: event.roundId,
            in: state
        ) else { return }
        let identity = try event.eventIdentity()
        if let existing = state.events.first(where: {
            (try? $0.eventIdentity()) == identity
        }) {
            guard try existing.eventHash() == event.eventHash() else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.identityEnvelopeMismatch
            }
            return
        }
        let alreadyStarted = state.events.contains {
            $0.roundId == event.roundId && $0.kind == .roundStarted
        }
        guard event.kind == .roundStarted, !alreadyStarted else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.legacyMigrationPending
        }
    }

    private static func validateFrozenRoundBranchBinding(
        _ event: DomainRoundEvent,
        against state: DomainLedgerStateV2
    ) throws {
        let branchEvents = state.events.filter {
            $0.streamSubject == event.streamSubject
        }
        let starts = branchEvents.filter { $0.kind == .roundStarted }
        func sameFrozenBinding(
            _ left: DomainRoundEvent,
            _ right: DomainRoundEvent
        ) -> Bool {
            left.ownerAccountId == right.ownerAccountId
                && left.subjectPlayerId == right.subjectPlayerId
                && left.actorId == right.actorId
                && left.roundId == right.roundId
                && left.streamSubject == right.streamSubject
                && left.roundIntentId == right.roundIntentId
                && left.snapshotId == right.snapshotId
                && left.roundSemanticBindingHash
                    == right.roundSemanticBindingHash
        }
        if event.kind == .roundStarted {
            if let start = starts.first {
                guard starts.count == 1,
                      sameFrozenBinding(start, event),
                      try start.eventIdentity() == event.eventIdentity(),
                      try start.eventHash() == event.eventHash() else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.roundStartConflict
                }
            } else if !branchEvents.isEmpty {
                throw DomainLedgerError.roundStartConflict
            }
        } else {
            guard starts.count == 1,
                  let start = starts.first,
                  sameFrozenBinding(start, event) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.roundStartConflict
            }
        }
    }

    private static func validateLocallyAuthoredStateBinding(
        _ event: DomainRoundEvent,
        against state: DomainLedgerStateV2
    ) throws {
        guard event.originDeviceId
                == state.originSequenceAuthority.originDeviceId,
              event.originEpoch
                == state.originSequenceAuthority.originEpoch,
              event.clientSequence > 0,
              event.clientSequence
                <= state.originSequenceAuthority.lastReservedClientSequence,
              case .roundIncarnation = event.streamSubject else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.originEpochMismatch
        }
        try Self.validatePendingLegacyLocalAuthoring(
            event,
            against: state
        )
        try Self.validateFrozenRoundBranchBinding(event, against: state)
    }

    private static func validateStoredLocalOrdinaryEvidence(
        row: OutboxRecord,
        evidence: LocalOrdinaryOutboxEvidence,
        state: DomainLedgerStateV2
    ) throws {
        try RoundPayloadValidator.validateLocallyAuthored(row.event)
        guard row.source.sourceClass == .localOrdinary,
              row.source.evidenceKey == evidence.evidenceKey,
              evidence.eventIdentity == row.eventIdentity,
              evidence.eventHash == row.eventHash,
              evidence.originDeviceId == row.event.originDeviceId,
              evidence.originEpoch == row.event.originEpoch,
              evidence.clientSequence == row.event.clientSequence,
              evidence.clientSequence > 0,
              evidence.clientSequence <= evidence.reservedThroughAtAppend,
              try LocalOrdinaryOutboxEvidence.make(
                eventIdentity: row.eventIdentity,
                eventHash: row.eventHash,
                event: row.event,
                reservedThroughAtAppend: evidence.reservedThroughAtAppend
              ) == evidence else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        // Deliberately no comparison with the currently active origin epoch:
        // rotation must not strand already-durable pending work.
        try Self.validateFrozenRoundBranchBinding(row.event, against: state)
    }

    func ensureShotCaptureState(roundId: String, roundIncarnationId: String) throws {
        try transaction { state in
            let key = shotCaptureKey(roundId: roundId, roundIncarnationId: roundIncarnationId)
            if let existing = state.shotCaptureStates[key] {
                guard existing.roundId == roundId,
                      existing.roundIncarnationId == roundIncarnationId else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.roundContextMismatch
                }
                return
            }
            state.shotCaptureStates[key] = DurableShotCaptureState(
                roundId: roundId,
                roundIncarnationId: roundIncarnationId,
                active: ShotCaptureSlot(
                    shotId: UUID().uuidString.lowercased(),
                    phase: .reserved,
                    eventIdentity: nil,
                    eventHash: nil
                ),
                lastCompleted: nil
            )
        }
    }

    func shotCaptureState(roundId: String, roundIncarnationId: String) throws -> DurableShotCaptureState {
        try locked {
            let state = try loadV2()
            guard let capture = state.shotCaptureStates[
                shotCaptureKey(roundId: roundId, roundIncarnationId: roundIncarnationId)
            ], capture.roundId == roundId, capture.roundIncarnationId == roundIncarnationId else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.roundContextMismatch
            }
            return capture
        }
    }

    func appendTargetAtomically(
        _ event: DomainRoundEvent,
        roundId: String,
        roundIncarnationId: String
    ) throws {
        try transaction { state in
            let key = shotCaptureKey(roundId: roundId, roundIncarnationId: roundIncarnationId)
            guard let capture = state.shotCaptureStates[key],
                  capture.roundId == event.roundId,
                  capture.roundId == roundId,
                  capture.roundIncarnationId == roundIncarnationId,
                  event.streamSubject == .roundIncarnation(roundIncarnationId),
                  [.shotTargetSet, .shotTargetRetracted].contains(event.kind),
                  event.payload["shotId"] == .string(capture.active.shotId) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.roundContextMismatch
            }
            try appendValidated(
                event,
                to: &state,
                validationMode: .locallyAuthored
            )
        }
    }

    func appendShotAndReserveNextAtomically(
        _ event: DomainRoundEvent,
        roundId: String,
        roundIncarnationId: String
    ) throws {
        let identity = try event.eventIdentity()
        let eventHash = try event.eventHash()
        try transaction { state in
            let key = shotCaptureKey(roundId: roundId, roundIncarnationId: roundIncarnationId)
            guard var capture = state.shotCaptureStates[key],
                  capture.roundId == event.roundId,
                  capture.roundId == roundId,
                  capture.roundIncarnationId == roundIncarnationId,
                  event.streamSubject == .roundIncarnation(roundIncarnationId),
                  event.kind == .shotRecorded else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.roundContextMismatch
            }

            if capture.lastCompleted?.eventIdentity == identity {
                guard capture.lastCompleted?.eventHash == eventHash,
                      state.events.contains(where: { (try? $0.eventIdentity()) == identity }) else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.identityEnvelopeMismatch
                }
                return
            }
            guard event.payload["shotId"] == .string(capture.active.shotId),
                  capture.active.phase == .reserved else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.shotIdentityConflict
            }

            try appendValidated(
                event,
                to: &state,
                validationMode: .locallyAuthored
            )
            capture.lastCompleted = ShotCaptureSlot(
                shotId: capture.active.shotId,
                phase: .completed,
                eventIdentity: identity,
                eventHash: eventHash
            )
            capture.active = ShotCaptureSlot(
                shotId: UUID().uuidString.lowercased(),
                phase: .reserved,
                eventIdentity: nil,
                eventHash: nil
            )
            state.shotCaptureStates[key] = capture
        }
    }

    func appendValidated(
        _ event: DomainRoundEvent,
        to state: inout DomainLedgerStateV2,
        validationMode: RoundEventAppendValidationMode
    ) throws {
        switch validationMode {
        case .locallyAuthored:
            try RoundPayloadValidator.validateLocallyAuthored(event)
            try Self.validateLocallyAuthoredStateBinding(event, against: state)
        case .peerOperationalImport(let capability):
            guard capability.event == event else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.identityEnvelopeMismatch
            }
            _ = try RoundPayloadValidator.validatePersistedOrInbound(event)
        case .sealedLegacyMigration(let candidate):
            guard candidate.event == event else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.identityEnvelopeMismatch
            }
            _ = try RoundPayloadValidator.validateLegacyMigrationCandidate(
                candidate
            )
        }
        let identity = try event.eventIdentity()
        let eventHash = try event.eventHash()
        if let existing = state.events.first(where: { (try? $0.eventIdentity()) == identity }) {
            guard try existing.eventHash() == eventHash else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.identityEnvelopeMismatch
            }
            return
        }
        if case .locallyAuthored = validationMode,
           let occupied = state.events.first(where: {
               $0.originDeviceId == event.originDeviceId
                   && $0.originEpoch == event.originEpoch
                   && $0.clientSequence == event.clientSequence
           }) {
            guard try occupied.eventIdentity() == identity,
                  try occupied.eventHash() == eventHash else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.originSequenceCollision
            }
            return
        }
        let source: OutboxSourceReference
        switch validationMode {
        case .locallyAuthored:
            let evidence = try LocalOrdinaryOutboxEvidence.make(
                eventIdentity: identity,
                eventHash: eventHash,
                event: event,
                reservedThroughAtAppend:
                    state.originSequenceAuthority.lastReservedClientSequence
            )
            guard state.localOrdinaryOutboxEvidence.updateValue(
                evidence,
                forKey: evidence.evidenceKey
            ) == nil else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            source = OutboxSourceReference(
                sourceClass: .localOrdinary,
                evidenceKey: evidence.evidenceKey
            )
        case .sealedLegacyMigration(let candidate):
            let evidence = candidate.sourceEvidence
            guard evidence.eventIdentity == identity,
                  evidence.eventHash == eventHash else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            if let existing = state.sealedLegacyAuthorities[
                candidate.authority.authorityId
            ] {
                guard existing == candidate.authority else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            } else {
                state.sealedLegacyAuthorities[
                    candidate.authority.authorityId
                ] = candidate.authority
            }
            guard
                  state.sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence.updateValue(
                    evidence,
                    forKey: evidence.evidenceKey
                  ) == nil else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            source = OutboxSourceReference(
                sourceClass: .sealedLegacyMigration,
                evidenceKey: evidence.evidenceKey
            )
        case .peerOperationalImport(let capability):
            let evidence = capability.evidence
            guard evidence.eventIdentity == identity,
                  evidence.eventHash == eventHash,
                  state.verifiedPeerBundleEvidence.updateValue(
                    evidence,
                    forKey: evidence.evidenceKey
                  ) == nil else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            source = OutboxSourceReference(
                sourceClass: .verifiedPeerBundle,
                evidenceKey: evidence.evidenceKey
            )
        }
        let projectionAuthority: ProjectionAuthority
        if state.canonicalOriginEvidence[identity] != nil {
            projectionAuthority = .localTerminalFallback
        } else {
            switch source.sourceClass {
            case .localOrdinary, .sealedLegacyMigration:
                projectionAuthority = .localProvisional
            case .verifiedPeerBundle:
                projectionAuthority = .peerProvisional
            }
        }
        state.events.append(event)
        state.localProjectionInputs.append(DomainProjectionInput(
            event: event,
            projectionOrder: try DomainProjectionOrder(
                authority: projectionAuthority,
                ledgerPartitionId: nil,
                ledgerPosition: nil,
                sourceOrdinal: event.clientSequence
            )
        ))
        state.outbox.append(OutboxRecord(
            event: event,
            eventIdentity: identity,
            eventHash: eventHash,
            source: source,
            receipt: nil,
            deadLetterReason: nil
        ))
    }
}
```

普通 `DomainLedgerStore.append()`在打开transaction前先调用`validateLocallyAuthored(_:)`，transaction内再以`.locallyAuthored`调用internal `appendValidated`；unknown、server-owned、commit-owned、transactionRef与confirmed AutoShot必须在event/outbox mutation前失败。state-aware local guard还要求origin device/epoch等于append当时的`originSequenceAuthority`、sequence已durable reserve且未超high-water、stream为round incarnation，并要求该branch首个fact是唯一`round_started`；其后owner/subject/actor/round/intent/incarnation/snapshot/semantic binding必须与start exact一致。计算identity/hash后、写任何temporary state前，还必须检查同一local `(originDeviceId, originEpoch, clientSequence)`是否已被不同identity占用；只有exact identity+hash replay幂等，collision抛`originSequenceCollision`且event/local projection/outbox/evidence全部不变。Phase 0 principal把actor绑定为authenticated player，因此这里冻结actor；将来若支持delegated actor，必须先version protocol/branch binding，不能静默放宽。`.sealedLegacyMigration`只接收Domain coordinator的candidate；Task 11/V2 transport validation mode `.peerOperationalImport(capability)`只接收verified peer-bundle capability，并落`OutboxSourceClass.verifiedPeerBundle`。这两个case属于不同enum layer：validation mode表达可信入口，source class表达durable transport provenance；`validationMode`绝不能使用`.verifiedPeerBundle`，`sourceClass`绝不能使用`.peerOperationalImport`。Task 13a保留同一个`.peerOperationalImport` validation case，只给`appendValidated`增加显式transport class，不进行第二次rename。`appendValidated`没有projection-authority default；它只从已验证的`OutboxSourceReference.sourceClass`与现有canonical origin派生`.localProvisional/.peerProvisional/.localTerminalFallback`，因此peer import不能静默落成local provisional。canonical server inbound从不调用`appendValidated`，只写`events/inboundProjectionRecords`，所以不会反向进入outbox。source/API-surface ownership test以whitespace-tolerant regex固定三个mode只存在于Domain file，禁止ordinary append/builder选择migration或peer mode，并要求mode与`appendValidated`不在public symbol graph。fault injection tests 分别在 transaction replace 前和 replace 后强杀：前者同时看不到 shot event 与rotation，后者同时看到 shot event、outbox、source evidence、completed slot和全新reserved UUID；不存在半完成状态。

本节 RED/回归矩阵还必须包含：`testPendingLegacyRoundAllowsOnlyOneStrictRoundStarted`、`testPendingLegacyRoundRejectsNonStartBeforeBuilderReservesSequence`、`testPendingLegacyAuthorityRejectsOriginRotationWithoutMutation`、`testHandcraftedPendingRoundWithOrdinaryFactFailsStartupValidation`、`testCompletedLegacyEvidenceMayAlsoBackOutboxOrDeadLetter`、`testCompletedMigrationDeadLetterBindsExactSourceRecordAndRawBytes`、`testEarlierInvalidLegacyRowDeadLettersWithoutPoisoningLaterValidRow`、`testLegacySourceRoundStartedIsUnmappableAndNeverCreatesSecondStart`、`testNullableLegacyJournalRecordsEncodeExplicitNullsAndSurviveStrictRestart`、`testMigrationDeadLetterMissingNullableKeyFailsStrictRestart`、`testLegacyAuthoritySourceRecordMissingNullableKeyFailsStrictRestart`、`testLegacyAuthorityTerminalDispositionMissingNullableKeyFailsStrictRestart`、`testCapturePendingLegacyAuthorityWritesOnlyThreeRootsAtomically`、`testCapturePendingLegacyAuthorityExactRetryIsIdempotentAndConflictRollsBack`、`testCapturePendingLegacyAuthorityCrashBeforeReplaceLeavesNoPartialJournal`、`testCapturePendingLegacyAuthorityCrashAfterReplaceRestartsWithExactJournal`、`testSealedLegacyAuthorityIsExactlyPendingXorCompleted`、`testPendingLegacyAuthorityRejectsOwnedEvidenceOrTransport` 与 `testCompletionOnlyLegacyEvidenceDictionaryRekeyFailsStartup`。nullable journal tests必须先用production encoder断言每个nil字段仍以explicit `null`出现，再经storage-v2 strict restart逐字段exact equality；逐一删除nullable key的mutation必须在任何`decodeIfPresent`默认语义可介入前失败。三类type内的present-key gate只负责拒绝缺失的known key；unknown key继续由外层recursive strict JSON shape gate拒绝。每个capture mutation/fault test都比较写入前后的完整state bytes、staging origin high-water、events/outbox/local projection/evidence/dead-letter/completion roots；共享classifier test同时从initial retry、startup validation与prepare evidence validation入口断言同一source record得到同一typed result，且authority SHA/coordinate/binding矛盾整包fail closed而不被catch成dead letter。

authority-batch RED/回归还必须包含：`testClassificationBatchRejectsWholeAuthorityBase64MismatchBeforeScanning`、`testClassificationBatchHasExactOrderedUniqueSourceRoster`、`testOneAuthorityBatchIsReusedAcrossInitialRetryStartupCompletionAndPrepare`、`testPreparePrefixSizingBuildsEachLegacyAuthorityBatchOnlyOnce`、`testIOSLegacyAuthorityRejectsDurableStartWithWrongProfile`、`testReducerInvalidPayloadCandidateDoesNotAdvancePrefixAndFollowingValidRowImports`、`testReducerMissingCauseStillFailsWholeAuthority`、`testIOSJSONLEmptyEventIdIsMalformedAndFollowingValidRowImports`、`testIOSJSONLEmptyRoundIdIsMalformedAndFollowingValidRowImports`、`testIncrementalLegacyReducerCursorMatchesFullReducerForSequentialLocalRoster`、`testEachLegacySourceRecordAttemptsReducerApplyAtMostOnce`、`testInvalidLegacyCandidateDoesNotCommitCursorOrLastIdentity`、`testIncrementalCursorDuplicateIdentityAndMissingCauseFailWholeAuthority`、`testEveryUnsetCapableReducerKindIsExactNoOpBeforeDerivedParsing`与`testClassificationBatchSealsAuthorityExactlyOnce`。reader/rebuilder counters必须证明每个operation、每个authority只有一次decode/read与一次ordered builder pass；apply counter必须接在`IncrementalDomainReducerSession.apply`完成payload/order、branch binding、identity collision、base dependency与causation admission之后、调用共享`DomainReducerMutationPlanner.prepare(input:against:)`之前的唯一reducer-attempt边界，以`sourceOrdinal == 0`区分每round唯一seed并断言每个source ordinal最多一次，不能只计外层rebuilder调用；seal counter必须接在`SealedLegacyAuthority.make`函数体内，断言classification batch为整份authority恰好seal一次，不能只计`classificationBatch`入口。parity test对同一noncanonical sequential roster逐步比较session最终projection与full `DomainRoundReducer.reduce` exact equality；invalid-row regression同时比较失败前后session revision/projection、branch binding、identity roster、source ordinal与last identity均不变，随后合法row使用未污染的base revision/causation；duplicate identity与missing cause必须在任何session commit前使整份authority失败。`testEveryUnsetCapableReducerKindIsExactNoOpBeforeDerivedParsing`必须逐一覆盖`hole_score_set`、`putts_set`、`penalties_set`、`fairway_set`与`actual_club_set`的合法unset sentinel，并证明unset guard发生在任何int/string/switch派生解析前，且每个case的完整projection、目标entity revision与conflicts在apply前后exact不变；其中`actual_club_set`必须指向prefix中尚不存在的shot，锁住guard早于`shotId`解析、shot lookup与conflict构造。empty-ID regression断言malformed source record的`eventId/roundId`均为nil且raw bytes不变。

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/ShotCapture/PlayerLiveFactProducer.swift
public enum PlayerLiveFactProducerError: Error, Equatable {
    case invalidShotTargetProvenance(String)
    case invalidCoordinates
    case invalidHole
    case emptyTargetRef
    case missingTargetRevision
    case roundContextMismatch
}

public enum ShotTargetProvenance: String, Codable, Equatable {
    case playerConfirmed = "player_confirmed"
    case explicitTouchTarget = "explicit_touch_target"

    public init(validating rawValue: String) throws {
        guard let value = ShotTargetProvenance(rawValue: rawValue) else {
            throw PlayerLiveFactProducerError.invalidShotTargetProvenance(rawValue)
        }
        self = value
    }
}

public enum ShotTargetRetractionReason: String, Codable, Equatable {
    case shotTargetOrphaned = "shot_target_orphaned"
    case playerCancelledTarget = "player_cancelled_target"
}

public struct PlayerLiveFactProducer {
    public init() {}

    public func setShotTarget(
        session: ShotCaptureSession,
        targetRef: String,
        latitude: Double,
        longitude: Double,
        provenance: ShotTargetProvenance,
        builder: DomainEventBuilder,
        projection: DomainRoundProjection,
        occurredAt: String
    ) throws -> DomainRoundEvent {
        guard session.roundId == builder.context.roundId,
              session.roundIncarnationId == builder.context.roundIncarnationId else {
            throw PlayerLiveFactProducerError.roundContextMismatch
        }
        guard !targetRef.isEmpty else { throw PlayerLiveFactProducerError.emptyTargetRef }
        guard (-90...90).contains(latitude), (-180...180).contains(longitude) else {
            throw PlayerLiveFactProducerError.invalidCoordinates
        }
        let entity = "round:\(builder.context.roundId):shot:\(session.shotId):target"
        return try builder.make(
            kind: .shotTargetSet,
            entityRef: entity,
            payload: [
                "shotId": .string(session.shotId), "targetRef": .string(targetRef),
                "latitude": .number(latitude), "longitude": .number(longitude),
                "provenance": .string(provenance.rawValue),
            ],
            baseRevision: projection.revision(for: entity) ?? .absent(scopeId: entity),
            occurredAt: occurredAt
        )
    }

    public func retractShotTarget(
        session: ShotCaptureSession,
        reason: ShotTargetRetractionReason,
        builder: DomainEventBuilder,
        projection: DomainRoundProjection,
        occurredAt: String
    ) throws -> DomainRoundEvent {
        guard session.roundId == builder.context.roundId,
              session.roundIncarnationId == builder.context.roundIncarnationId else {
            throw PlayerLiveFactProducerError.roundContextMismatch
        }
        let entity = "round:\(builder.context.roundId):shot:\(session.shotId):target"
        guard let base = projection.revision(for: entity) else {
            throw PlayerLiveFactProducerError.missingTargetRevision
        }
        return try builder.make(
            kind: .shotTargetRetracted,
            entityRef: entity,
            payload: [
                "shotId": .string(session.shotId),
                "reasonCode": .string(reason.rawValue),
            ],
            baseRevision: base,
            occurredAt: occurredAt
        )
    }

    public func setFlagPosition(
        hole: Int,
        latitude: Double,
        longitude: Double,
        builder: DomainEventBuilder,
        projection: DomainRoundProjection,
        occurredAt: String
    ) throws -> DomainRoundEvent {
        guard (1...18).contains(hole) else { throw PlayerLiveFactProducerError.invalidHole }
        guard (-90...90).contains(latitude), (-180...180).contains(longitude) else {
            throw PlayerLiveFactProducerError.invalidCoordinates
        }
        let entity = "round:\(builder.context.roundId):hole:\(hole):flagPosition"
        return try builder.make(
            kind: .flagPositionSet,
            entityRef: entity,
            payload: [
                "hole": .integer(Int64(hole)), "latitude": .number(latitude),
                "longitude": .number(longitude), "provenance": .string("player_set"),
            ],
            baseRevision: projection.revision(for: entity) ?? .absent(scopeId: entity),
            occurredAt: occurredAt
        )
    }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomainTests/PlayerLiveFactProducerTests.swift
import XCTest
@testable import AICaddieDomain

final class PlayerLiveFactProducerTests: XCTestCase {
    private let roundId = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"

    @discardableResult
    private func materializeRoundStart(
        ledger: DomainLedgerStore,
        builder: DomainEventBuilder,
        occurredAt: String = "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
    ) throws -> DomainRoundEvent {
        let event = try builder.make(
            kind: .roundStarted,
            entityRef: "round:\(builder.context.roundId)",
            payload: [
                "deviceRoundInstallBinding": builder.context
                    .deviceRoundInstallBinding,
            ],
            baseRevision: nil,
            occurredAt: occurredAt
        )
        try ledger.append(event)
        return event
    }

    func testPayloadValidatorCoversEveryRegisteredKind() {
        XCTAssertEqual(RoundPayloadValidator.handledKinds, RoundEventKind.knownValues)
    }

    func testInvalidOrInferredTargetProvenanceThrows() {
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try ShotTargetProvenance(validating: "guidance_inferred")) { error in
            XCTAssertEqual(
                error as? PlayerLiveFactProducerError,
                .invalidShotTargetProvenance("guidance_inferred")
            )
        }
    }

    func testTouchRestartAndShotCommitReuseThenRotateDurableShotId() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        let ledgerURL = root.appendingPathComponent("ledger")
        addTeardownBlock {
            DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: ledgerURL)
            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root)
        }
        let producer = PlayerLiveFactProducer()
        var reservedShotId = ""
        do {
            let ledger = try DomainLedgerTestHarness.open(directoryURL: ledgerURL)
            let builder = DomainEventBuilder.fixture(roundId: roundId, ledger: ledger)
            try materializeRoundStart(ledger: ledger, builder: builder)
            let projection = try DomainRoundReducer().reduce(
                try ledger.projectionInputs(roundId: roundId),
                replication: DomainReplicationContext(
                    pendingCount: 1, syncing: false, deadLetterCount: 0
                )
            )
            let session = try ShotCaptureSession(ledger: ledger, context: builder.context)
            reservedShotId = session.shotId
            let target = try producer.setShotTarget(
                session: session, targetRef: "touch:green-front",
                latitude: 22.3001, longitude: 114.2001,
                provenance: .explicitTouchTarget,
                builder: builder, projection: projection,
                occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
            )
            try session.appendTarget(target)
            let afterTarget = try DomainRoundReducer().reduce(
                try ledger.projectionInputs(roundId: roundId),
                replication: DomainReplicationContext(
                    pendingCount: 2, syncing: false, deadLetterCount: 0
                )
            )
            XCTAssertEqual(afterTarget.shotTargets[reservedShotId]?.orphaned, true)
        }

        DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: ledgerURL)
        let restartedLedger = try DomainLedgerTestHarness.open(directoryURL: ledgerURL)
        let restartedBuilder = DomainEventBuilder.fixture(
            roundId: roundId, ledger: restartedLedger
        )
        let restarted = try ShotCaptureSession(
            ledger: restartedLedger, context: restartedBuilder.context
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(restarted.shotId, reservedShotId)
        let shot = try ManualShotProducer().record(
            ManualShotDraft(
                hole: 1, latitude: 22.2999, longitude: 114.1999,
                horizontalAccuracyM: 4, lie: "fairway"
            ),
            session: restarted,
            builder: restartedBuilder,
            occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:01.000Z"
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(shot.payload["shotId"], .string(reservedShotId))
        try restarted.appendShotAndReserveNext(shot)
        XCTAssertNotEqual(restarted.shotId, reservedShotId)
        let projection = try DomainRoundReducer().reduce(
            try restartedLedger.projectionInputs(roundId: roundId),
            replication: DomainReplicationContext(pendingCount: 3, syncing: false, deadLetterCount: 0)
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(projection.shotTargets[reservedShotId]?.orphaned, false)
        try restarted.appendShotAndReserveNext(shot)
        XCTAssertEqual(try restartedLedger.allEvents().filter { $0.kind == .shotRecorded }, [shot])
    }

    func testTargetRetractionStaysOnCurrentReservedShot() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        let ledgerURL = root.appendingPathComponent("ledger")
        addTeardownBlock {
            DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: ledgerURL)
            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root)
        }
        let ledger = try DomainLedgerTestHarness.open(directoryURL: ledgerURL)
        let builder = DomainEventBuilder.fixture(roundId: roundId, ledger: ledger)
        try materializeRoundStart(ledger: ledger, builder: builder)
        let session = try ShotCaptureSession(ledger: ledger, context: builder.context)
        let producer = PlayerLiveFactProducer()
        var projection = try DomainRoundReducer().reduce(
            try ledger.projectionInputs(roundId: roundId),
            replication: DomainReplicationContext(
                pendingCount: 1, syncing: false, deadLetterCount: 0
            )
        )
        let target = try producer.setShotTarget(
            session: session, targetRef: "touch:green-front", latitude: 22.3001, longitude: 114.2001,
            provenance: .explicitTouchTarget, builder: builder, projection: projection,
            occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
        )
        try session.appendTarget(target)
        projection = try DomainRoundReducer().reduce(
            try ledger.projectionInputs(roundId: roundId),
            replication: DomainReplicationContext(pendingCount: 2, syncing: false, deadLetterCount: 0)
        )
        let retracted = try producer.retractShotTarget(
            session: session, reason: .playerCancelledTarget,
            builder: builder, projection: projection,
            occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:02.000Z"
        )
        try session.appendTarget(retracted)
        XCTAssertEqual(retracted.kind, .shotTargetRetracted)
        XCTAssertEqual(retracted.payload["reasonCode"], .string("player_cancelled_target"))
        XCTAssertNotNil(retracted.baseEntityRevision)
    }

    func testConsecutiveShotsUseDifferentIdsAndWrongRoundFailsClosed() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        let ledgerURL = root.appendingPathComponent("ledger")
        let crossLedgerURL = root.appendingPathComponent("cross-ledger")
        addTeardownBlock {
            DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: ledgerURL)
            DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: crossLedgerURL)
            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root)
        }
        let ledger = try DomainLedgerTestHarness.open(directoryURL: ledgerURL)
        let builder = DomainEventBuilder.fixture(roundId: roundId, ledger: ledger)
        try materializeRoundStart(ledger: ledger, builder: builder)
        let session = try ShotCaptureSession(ledger: ledger, context: builder.context)
        let firstId = session.shotId
        let first = try ManualShotProducer().record(
            ManualShotDraft(hole: 1, latitude: 22.3, longitude: 114.2, horizontalAccuracyM: 4, lie: "tee"),
            session: session, builder: builder, occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
        )
        try session.appendShotAndReserveNext(first)
        let secondId = session.shotId
        let second = try ManualShotProducer().record(
            ManualShotDraft(hole: 1, latitude: 22.301, longitude: 114.201, horizontalAccuracyM: 4, lie: "fairway"),
            session: session, builder: builder, occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:01:00.000Z"
        )
        try session.appendShotAndReserveNext(second)
        XCTAssertNotEqual(firstId, secondId)
        let shotIds = try ledger.allEvents().compactMap { event -> String? in
            if case .string(let value)? = event.payload["shotId"] { return value }
            return nil
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(Set(shotIds).count, 2)

        let other = DomainEventBuilder.fixture(
            roundId: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
            ledger: ledger
        )
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try ManualShotProducer().record(
            ManualShotDraft(hole: 1, latitude: 22.3, longitude: 114.2, horizontalAccuracyM: 4, lie: "tee"),
            session: session, builder: other, occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:02:00.000Z"
        )) { error in
            XCTAssertEqual(error as? PlayerLiveFactProducerError, .roundContextMismatch)
        }

        let crossContext = RoundEventContext(
            ownerAccountId: builder.context.ownerAccountId,
            subjectPlayerId: builder.context.subjectPlayerId,
            actorId: builder.context.actorId,
            roundId: roundId,
            roundIntentId: builder.context.roundIntentId,
            roundIncarnationId: "inc-cross",
            snapshotId: builder.context.snapshotId,
            semanticBindingHash: builder.context.semanticBindingHash,
            deviceRoundInstallBinding: builder.context.deviceRoundInstallBinding
        )
        let crossLedger = try DomainLedgerTestHarness.open(
            directoryURL: crossLedgerURL,
            originDeviceId: "ios-cross"
        )
        let crossBuilder = DomainEventBuilder(ledger: crossLedger, context: crossContext)
        let currentId = session.shotId
        let crafted = try crossBuilder.make(
            kind: .shotRecorded,
            entityRef: "round:\(roundId):shot:\(currentId)",
            payload: [
                "shotId": .string(currentId), "hole": .integer(1),
                "latitude": .number(22.3), "longitude": .number(114.2),
                "horizontalAccuracyM": .number(4), "lie": .string("tee"),
                "provenance": .string("manual"),
            ],
            baseRevision: nil,
            occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:03:00.000Z"
        )
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try session.appendShotAndReserveNext(crafted))
    }

    func testCurrentOriginShotWithTamperedFrozenBindingLeavesLedgerAndSlotUnchanged() throws {

    func testShotAppendAndReservationRotationAreOneAtomicReplace() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        let beforeURL = root.appendingPathComponent("before")
        let afterURL = root.appendingPathComponent("after")
        addTeardownBlock {
            DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: beforeURL)
            DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: afterURL)
            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root)
        }
        var failBefore = false
        var beforeId = ""
        var beforeStart: DomainRoundEvent?
        do {
            let beforeLedger = try DomainLedgerTestHarness.open(
                directoryURL: beforeURL,
                faultHook: { point in
                    if failBefore && point == .beforeAtomicReplace {
                        throw CocoaError(.fileWriteUnknown)
                    }
                }
            )
            let beforeBuilder = DomainEventBuilder.fixture(
                roundId: roundId, ledger: beforeLedger
            )
            beforeStart = try materializeRoundStart(
                ledger: beforeLedger,
                builder: beforeBuilder
            )
            let beforeSession = try ShotCaptureSession(
                ledger: beforeLedger, context: beforeBuilder.context
            )
            beforeId = beforeSession.shotId
            let beforeEvent = try ManualShotProducer().record(
                ManualShotDraft(
                    hole: 1, latitude: 22.3, longitude: 114.2,
                    horizontalAccuracyM: 4, lie: "tee"
                ),
                session: beforeSession, builder: beforeBuilder,
                occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
            )
            failBefore = true
            XCTAssertThrowsError(try beforeSession.appendShotAndReserveNext(beforeEvent))
        }
        DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: beforeURL)
        let beforeRestartLedger = try DomainLedgerTestHarness.open(directoryURL: beforeURL)
        let beforeRestartBuilder = DomainEventBuilder.fixture(
            roundId: roundId, ledger: beforeRestartLedger
        )
        let beforeRestart = try ShotCaptureSession(
            ledger: beforeRestartLedger, context: beforeRestartBuilder.context
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(beforeRestart.shotId, beforeId)
        XCTAssertEqual(
            try beforeRestartLedger.allEvents(),
            [try XCTUnwrap(beforeStart)]
        )

        var failAfter = false
        var afterId = ""
        var afterEvent: DomainRoundEvent?
        do {
            let afterLedger = try DomainLedgerTestHarness.open(
                directoryURL: afterURL,
                faultHook: { point in
                    if failAfter && point == .afterAtomicReplace {
                        throw CocoaError(.fileWriteUnknown)
                    }
                }
            )
            let afterBuilder = DomainEventBuilder.fixture(
                roundId: roundId, ledger: afterLedger
            )
            try materializeRoundStart(
                ledger: afterLedger,
                builder: afterBuilder
            )
            let afterSession = try ShotCaptureSession(
                ledger: afterLedger, context: afterBuilder.context
            )
            afterId = afterSession.shotId
            afterEvent = try ManualShotProducer().record(
                ManualShotDraft(
                    hole: 1, latitude: 22.3, longitude: 114.2,
                    horizontalAccuracyM: 4, lie: "tee"
                ),
                session: afterSession, builder: afterBuilder,
                occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:01:00.000Z"
            )
            failAfter = true
            XCTAssertThrowsError(
                try afterSession.appendShotAndReserveNext(try XCTUnwrap(afterEvent))
            )
        }
        DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: afterURL)
        let afterRestartLedger = try DomainLedgerTestHarness.open(directoryURL: afterURL)
        let afterRestartBuilder = DomainEventBuilder.fixture(
            roundId: roundId, ledger: afterRestartLedger
        )
        let afterRestart = try ShotCaptureSession(
            ledger: afterRestartLedger, context: afterRestartBuilder.context
        )
        let committedEvent = try XCTUnwrap(afterEvent)
        XCTAssertNotEqual(afterRestart.shotId, afterId)
        XCTAssertEqual(
            try afterRestartLedger.allEvents().filter { $0.kind == .shotRecorded },
            [committedEvent]
        )
        let nextId = afterRestart.shotId
        try afterRestart.appendShotAndReserveNext(committedEvent)
        XCTAssertEqual(afterRestart.shotId, nextId)
        XCTAssertEqual(try afterRestartLedger.allEvents().filter { $0.kind == .shotRecorded }.count, 1)
    }
```
