
Guidance candidate、green geometry、GPS/map default 与 next-shot state 都不持有 `PlayerLiveFactProducer`；dependency graph test 对这些 target 搜索 constructor reference，必须为 0。Plan 4 只能注入 typed `.playerConfirmed`/`.explicitTouchTarget`，不能传任意字符串。

`ManualShotProducerTests` 断言 payload 只有 canonical shot facts，不含 `guidanceId/recommendedClubRef/actualClubRef`；同一 event 经 Watch direct 和 phone relay 保持同 identity/hash。

`CanonicalJSON.swift` 把 `JSONValue` 递归转换为 Foundation object，先验证 NFC/negative-zero/safe integer，再调用 vendored `_serialize`；`TypedID.make` 使用 `CryptoKit.SHA256` 计算 `domainTag + NUL + canonicalBytes`。本 step 后面的 `DomainRoundReducer.swift` 是 normative 完整实现；禁止用“照 Python 移植”替代源码。

同时把 Phase 0 receipt 升级为 wire-complete 结构：

```swift
public enum ReceiptStatus: String, Codable, Equatable, Sendable {
    case accepted
    case acceptedOpaque = "accepted_opaque"
    case duplicateHashMatch = "duplicate_hash_match"
    case rejectedPermanent = "rejected_permanent"
    case deferred
}

public struct EventReceipt: Codable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public let eventId: String?
    public let eventIdentity: String?
    public let eventHash: String?
    public let inputIndex: Int
    public let status: ReceiptStatus
    public let ledgerPartitionId: String?
    public let ledgerEpoch: Int?
    public let streamId: String?
    public let ledgerPosition: CanonicalLedgerPosition?
    public let currentEntityRevision: EntityRevisionToken?
    public let reasonCode: ReasonCode?

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey, CaseIterable {
        case eventId, eventIdentity, eventHash, inputIndex, status
        case ledgerPartitionId, ledgerEpoch, streamId, ledgerPosition
        case currentEntityRevision, reasonCode
    }

    public init(
        eventId: String?,
        eventIdentity: String?,
        eventHash: String?,
        inputIndex: Int,
        status: ReceiptStatus,
        ledgerPartitionId: String?,
        ledgerEpoch: Int?,
        streamId: String?,
        ledgerPosition: CanonicalLedgerPosition?,
        currentEntityRevision: EntityRevisionToken?,
        reasonCode: ReasonCode?
    ) {
        self.eventId = eventId
        self.eventIdentity = eventIdentity
        self.eventHash = eventHash
        self.inputIndex = inputIndex
        self.status = status
        self.ledgerPartitionId = ledgerPartitionId
        self.ledgerEpoch = ledgerEpoch
        self.streamId = streamId
        self.ledgerPosition = ledgerPosition
        self.currentEntityRevision = currentEntityRevision
        self.reasonCode = reasonCode
    }

    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let values = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        let present = Set(values.allKeys.map(\.rawValue))
        let required = Set(CodingKeys.allCases.map(\.rawValue))
        guard present == required else {
            throw DecodingError.dataCorrupted(.init(
                codingPath: decoder.codingPath,
                debugDescription: "EventReceipt requires all eleven keys"
            ))
        }
        eventId = try values.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .eventId)
        eventIdentity = try values.decodeIfPresent(
            String.self,
            forKey: .eventIdentity
        )
        eventHash = try values.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .eventHash)
        inputIndex = try values.decode(Int.self, forKey: .inputIndex)
        status = try values.decode(ReceiptStatus.self, forKey: .status)
        ledgerPartitionId = try values.decodeIfPresent(
            String.self,
            forKey: .ledgerPartitionId
        )
        ledgerEpoch = try values.decodeIfPresent(Int.self, forKey: .ledgerEpoch)
        streamId = try values.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .streamId)
        ledgerPosition = try values.decodeIfPresent(
            CanonicalLedgerPosition.self,
            forKey: .ledgerPosition
        )
        currentEntityRevision = try values.decodeIfPresent(
            EntityRevisionToken.self,
            forKey: .currentEntityRevision
        )
        reasonCode = try values.decodeIfPresent(
            ReasonCode.self,
            forKey: .reasonCode
        )
    }

    public func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {
        var values = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        if let eventId {
            try values.encode(eventId, forKey: .eventId)
        } else {
            try values.encodeNil(forKey: .eventId)
        }
        if let eventIdentity {
            try values.encode(eventIdentity, forKey: .eventIdentity)
        } else { try values.encodeNil(forKey: .eventIdentity) }
        if let eventHash {
            try values.encode(eventHash, forKey: .eventHash)
        } else {
            try values.encodeNil(forKey: .eventHash)
        }
        try values.encode(inputIndex, forKey: .inputIndex)
        try values.encode(status, forKey: .status)
        if let ledgerPartitionId {
            try values.encode(ledgerPartitionId, forKey: .ledgerPartitionId)
        } else { try values.encodeNil(forKey: .ledgerPartitionId) }
        if let ledgerEpoch {
            try values.encode(ledgerEpoch, forKey: .ledgerEpoch)
        } else {
            try values.encodeNil(forKey: .ledgerEpoch)
        }
        if let streamId {
            try values.encode(streamId, forKey: .streamId)
        } else {
            try values.encodeNil(forKey: .streamId)
        }
        if let ledgerPosition {
            try values.encode(ledgerPosition, forKey: .ledgerPosition)
        } else { try values.encodeNil(forKey: .ledgerPosition) }
        if let currentEntityRevision {
            try values.encode(
                currentEntityRevision,
                forKey: .currentEntityRevision
            )
        } else { try values.encodeNil(forKey: .currentEntityRevision) }
        if let reasonCode {
            try values.encode(reasonCode, forKey: .reasonCode)
        } else {
            try values.encodeNil(forKey: .reasonCode)
        }
    }
}

public struct EventWriteResponseV2: Codable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public let schema: String
    public let requestHash: String
    public let requestBodySha256: String
    public let eventCount: Int
    public let receipts: [EventReceipt]

    public init(
        schema: String,
        requestHash: String,
        requestBodySha256: String,
        eventCount: Int,
        receipts: [EventReceipt]
    ) {
        self.schema = schema
        self.requestHash = requestHash
        self.requestBodySha256 = requestBodySha256
        self.eventCount = eventCount
        self.receipts = receipts
    }
}

public struct ValidatedEventWriteResponse: Sendable {
    let response: EventWriteResponseV2
    let request: PreparedEventWriteRequest

    init(response: EventWriteResponseV2, request: PreparedEventWriteRequest) {
        self.response = response
        self.request = request
    }
}

public struct OutboxRecord: Codable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public let event: DomainRoundEvent
    public let eventIdentity: String
    public let eventHash: String
    public let source: OutboxSourceReference
    public var receipt: EventReceipt?
    public var receiptStorageKey: String?
    public var deadLetterReason: String?

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case event, eventIdentity, eventHash, source, receipt, receiptStorageKey
        case deadLetterReason
    }

    // Mutation owners construct rows only after source validation. No public
    // initializer accepts a caller-selected trusted source reference.
    init(
        event: DomainRoundEvent,
        eventIdentity: String,
        eventHash: String,
        source: OutboxSourceReference,
        receipt: EventReceipt? = nil,
        receiptStorageKey: String? = nil,
        deadLetterReason: String? = nil
    ) {
        self.event = event
        self.eventIdentity = eventIdentity
        self.eventHash = eventHash
        self.source = source
        self.receipt = receipt
        self.receiptStorageKey = receiptStorageKey
        self.deadLetterReason = deadLetterReason
    }

    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let values = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        event = try values.decode(DomainRoundEvent.self, forKey: .event)
        eventIdentity = try values.decode(String.self, forKey: .eventIdentity)
        eventHash = try values.decode(String.self, forKey: .eventHash)
        source = try values.decode(
            OutboxSourceReference.self,
            forKey: .source
        )
        receipt = try values.decodeIfPresent(EventReceipt.self, forKey: .receipt)
        receiptStorageKey = try values.decodeIfPresent(
            String.self,
            forKey: .receiptStorageKey
        )
        deadLetterReason = try values.decodeIfPresent(
            String.self,
            forKey: .deadLetterReason
        )
    }

    public func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {
        var values = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        try values.encode(event, forKey: .event)
        try values.encode(eventIdentity, forKey: .eventIdentity)
        try values.encode(eventHash, forKey: .eventHash)
        try values.encode(source, forKey: .source)
        if let receipt {
            try values.encode(receipt, forKey: .receipt)
        } else {
            try values.encodeNil(forKey: .receipt)
        }
        if let receiptStorageKey {
            try values.encode(receiptStorageKey, forKey: .receiptStorageKey)
        } else {
            try values.encodeNil(forKey: .receiptStorageKey)
        }
        if let deadLetterReason {
            try values.encode(deadLetterReason, forKey: .deadLetterReason)
        } else {
            try values.encodeNil(forKey: .deadLetterReason)
        }
    }
}

public struct EventWriteRequestSlot: Equatable, Sendable {
    public let event: DomainRoundEvent
    public let eventIdentity: String
    public let eventHash: String
}

public struct PreparedEventWriteRequest: Equatable, Sendable {
    public let roundId: String
    public let body: Data
    public let requestHash: String
    public let requestBodySha256: String
    public let slots: [EventWriteRequestSlot]

    init(
        roundId: String,
        body: Data,
        requestHash: String,
        requestBodySha256: String,
        slots: [EventWriteRequestSlot]
    ) {
        self.roundId = roundId
        self.body = body
        self.requestHash = requestHash
        self.requestBodySha256 = requestBodySha256
        self.slots = slots
    }
}
```

`EventReceipt` 的 nullable 不是“字段可省略”。network response 与 durable
storage 都使用同一 11-key shape；generated schema/wire-shape validator先拒绝
unknown key，`EventReceipt.init(from:)`再独立拒绝missing key。以下四种状态必须
逐字节证明 null roster 与restart round-trip，不能只比较decode后的Swift值：

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomainTests/EventWriteResponseValidatorTests.swift
final class EventReceiptWireShapeTests: XCTestCase {
    private let exactKeys: Set<String> = [
        "eventId", "eventIdentity", "eventHash", "inputIndex", "status",
        "ledgerPartitionId", "ledgerEpoch", "streamId", "ledgerPosition",
        "currentEntityRevision", "reasonCode",
    ]

    private func assertExactShape(
        _ receipt: EventReceipt,
        nullKeys: Set<String>,
        file: StaticString = #filePath,
        line: UInt = #line
    ) throws {
        let bytes = try JSONEncoder().encode(receipt)
        let object = try XCTUnwrap(
            JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: bytes) as? [String: Any],
            file: file,
            line: line
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(Set(object.keys), exactKeys, file: file, line: line)
        for key in nullKeys {
            XCTAssertTrue(object[key] is NSNull, key, file: file, line: line)
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(
            try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(EventReceipt.self, from: bytes),
            receipt,
            file: file,
            line: line
        )
    }

    func testAcceptedDeferredAndBothRejectShapesKeepExplicitNulls() throws {
        let accepted = EventReceipt(
            eventId: "event-1", eventIdentity: String(repeating: "a", count: 64),
            eventHash: String(repeating: "b", count: 64), inputIndex: 0,
            status: .accepted,
            ledgerPartitionId: String(repeating: "c", count: 64), ledgerEpoch: 1,
            streamId: "stream-1", ledgerPosition: try CanonicalLedgerPosition("1"),
            currentEntityRevision: nil, reasonCode: nil
        )
        try assertExactShape(
            accepted,
            nullKeys: ["currentEntityRevision", "reasonCode"]
        )

        let deferred = EventReceipt(
            eventId: "event-1", eventIdentity: String(repeating: "a", count: 64),
            eventHash: String(repeating: "b", count: 64), inputIndex: 0,
            status: .deferred, ledgerPartitionId: nil, ledgerEpoch: nil,
            streamId: nil, ledgerPosition: nil,
            currentEntityRevision: nil, reasonCode: nil
        )
        try assertExactShape(
            deferred,
            nullKeys: [
                "ledgerPartitionId", "ledgerEpoch", "streamId", "ledgerPosition",
                "currentEntityRevision", "reasonCode",
            ]
        )

        let identifiedReject = EventReceipt(
            eventId: "event-1", eventIdentity: String(repeating: "a", count: 64),
            eventHash: String(repeating: "b", count: 64), inputIndex: 0,
            status: .rejectedPermanent, ledgerPartitionId: nil, ledgerEpoch: nil,
            streamId: nil, ledgerPosition: nil, currentEntityRevision: nil,
            reasonCode: ReasonCode(rawValue: "invalid_event")
        )
        try assertExactShape(
            identifiedReject,
            nullKeys: [
                "ledgerPartitionId", "ledgerEpoch", "streamId", "ledgerPosition",
                "currentEntityRevision",
            ]
        )

        let rawReject = EventReceipt(
            eventId: "event-1", eventIdentity: nil, eventHash: nil, inputIndex: 0,
            status: .rejectedPermanent, ledgerPartitionId: nil, ledgerEpoch: nil,
            streamId: nil, ledgerPosition: nil, currentEntityRevision: nil,
            reasonCode: ReasonCode(rawValue: "invalid_event")
        )
        try assertExactShape(
            rawReject,
            nullKeys: [
                "eventIdentity", "eventHash", "ledgerPartitionId", "ledgerEpoch",
                "streamId", "ledgerPosition", "currentEntityRevision",
            ]
        )
    }

    func testMissingNullableKeyFailsBeforeReceiptCanEnterStorage() throws {
        let receipt = EventReceipt(
            eventId: "event-1", eventIdentity: nil, eventHash: nil, inputIndex: 0,
            status: .rejectedPermanent, ledgerPartitionId: nil, ledgerEpoch: nil,
            streamId: nil, ledgerPosition: nil, currentEntityRevision: nil,
            reasonCode: ReasonCode(rawValue: "invalid_event")
        )
        var object = try XCTUnwrap(
            JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: JSONEncoder().encode(receipt))
                as? [String: Any]
        )
        object.removeValue(forKey: "eventIdentity")
        let missing = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: object)
        XCTAssertThrowsError(
            try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(EventReceipt.self, from: missing)
        )
    }
}
```

`DomainLedgerStore.prepareEventWriteRequest(roundId:limit:)` 与 `prepareRoundStartedEventWriteRequest(roundId:)` 都通过同一个`validateOutboxSourceForPreparation`，且`PreparedEventWriteRequest`只有前者共享的private initializer owner：在ledger lock内按outbox durable顺序defensive-copy，每个row先重算identity/hash并要求matching durable fact，再按`.localOrdinary/.sealedLegacyMigration/.verifiedPeerBundle`查exact evidence、调用对应validator。local validator重跑ordinary submission/payload/frozen binding并只信append-time reservation evidence，不绑定当前epoch；legacy validator从fixed authority SHA/raw line/sourceLine/binding重建candidate；peer validator重验durable bundle/credential verification receipt。local opaque、commit-owned、forged legacy、forged peer或source/evidence mismatch都在构造body前fail closed。随后逐项选择同时满足generated `maxEventsPerBatch=64` 与exact canonical body `maxHttpBodyBytes=1_048_576` 的最大前缀，把`{"events":[...]}`编成唯一canonical body，`requestHash = TypedID("RoundEventBatch/v1", {roundId,events})`，`requestBodySha256 = SHA256(exact body)`；若首项自身仍超限，说明append-time 65,536-byte event guard或storage已损坏，builder fail closed并由`flushOutbox`记录visible `local_transport_invariant_violation`，原outbox保持不变等待repair；caller limit越界立即拒绝。重试复用同一个value的exact body/hash/slot roster，不能重新读取已变化的outbox或重编码。tests覆盖恰好64、65分页、63/64项跨过byte limit、旧epoch local pending可发送、local opaque/commit-owned evidence伪造、legacy authority/raw-line伪造、peer bundle/credential evidence伪造、单项损坏时anomaly+outbox不变，以及重试时outbox改变但prepared bytes/roster不变。`EventWriteResponseValidator`先对raw response bytes运行generated exact schema/duplicate-key validator，再验证`schema/requestHash/requestBodySha256/eventCount`、receipt索引恰好按顺序覆盖`0..<eventCount`、每槽`eventId`与immutable request snapshot一致。identity非null时必须与该槽event identity/hash精确相等；identity null只允许`rejected_permanent`，`identity_envelope_mismatch`可保留incoming event hash，其他raw reject的hash必须null。success receipt必须携带完整canonical coordinate；non-appended receipt四个coordinate fields都必须null。验证完成才产生不可公开构造的`ValidatedEventWriteResponse`。

Task 5 的 `DomainLedgerState.receipts` 改为 string storage key：identity 非 null 用 `eventIdentity`，raw reject 用 `requestBodySha256 + "#" + inputIndex`；每个V2 permanent dead-letter row同时在nullable `receiptStorageKey`保存这个exact key，restart validator以它反向证明`deadLetters ↔ receipts`是一一对应，不能靠nullable identity或eventId猜request slot。`append()` 先计算 identity/hash，以完整 identity 去重，同 identity/different hash 抛 mismatch。不同 origin 即使碰巧复用同一个 `eventId` 仍是两条合法 event。删除 network-facing 单条 `apply(receipt:)`；`apply(validatedResponse:)` 在一个 local transaction 内按 immutable request slot 处理整包，null identity 永远只作用于该 input index，不能按 identity 删除任意 outbox。任何顶层 hash/count、额外/缺失/重排 receipt 或槽 identity/hash mismatch 都在 state mutation 前记录 visible transport anomaly，原 outbox 全部 retryable。`accepted/duplicate_hash_match/accepted_opaque` 通常持久化 receipt、写 `acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay` 并删除 transport item；但若response丢失后canonical replay已经以exact identity/hash/partition/epoch/stream/position落盘，retry得到的success receipt必须先与该inbound coordinate逐字段匹配，再直接terminalize outbox并保持canonical projection，不得重建awaiting或local projection。coordinate mismatch整包回滚。`deferred` 留 queue；`rejected_permanent` 原子移入 visible dead letter并保存exact `receiptStorageKey`。

```swift
public extension DomainLedgerStore {
    func append(_ event: DomainRoundEvent) throws {
        try RoundPayloadValidator.validateLocallyAuthored(event)
        try transaction { state in
            try appendValidated(
                event,
                to: &state,
                validationMode: .locallyAuthored
            )
        }
    }

    func appendIfIdentityHashMatches(_ event: DomainRoundEvent) throws { try append(event) }

    private func legacyClassificationBatchesForPreparation(
        rows: [OutboxRecord],
        state: DomainLedgerStateV2
    ) throws -> [String: LegacyAuthorityClassificationBatch] {
        var batches: [String: LegacyAuthorityClassificationBatch] = [:]
        for row in rows
        where row.source.sourceClass == .sealedLegacyMigration {
            guard let evidence = state.sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence[
                    row.source.evidenceKey
                  ], let authority = state.sealedLegacyAuthorities[
                    evidence.authorityId
                  ], let completed =
                    state.completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations[
                        evidence.authorityId
                    ], let authorityData = Data(
                        base64Encoded: authority.authorityFileBase64
                    ) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            if let existing = batches[evidence.authorityId] {
                guard existing.authority == authority,
                      existing.sourceRecords == completed.sourceRecords else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                continue
            }
            let batch = try LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator
                .classificationBatch(
                    authority: authority,
                    authorityData: authorityData,
                    durableEvents: state.events,
                    legacyWireBindings: state.legacyWireBindings
                )
            guard batch.sourceRecords == completed.sourceRecords,
                  batches.updateValue(
                    batch,
                    forKey: evidence.authorityId
                  ) == nil else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        }
        return batches
    }

    private func validateOutboxSourceForPreparation(
        _ row: OutboxRecord,
        state: DomainLedgerStateV2,
        legacyBatches: [String: LegacyAuthorityClassificationBatch]
    ) throws {
        guard try row.event.eventIdentity() == row.eventIdentity,
              try row.event.eventHash() == row.eventHash,
              state.events.contains(where: {
                  (try? $0.eventIdentity()) == row.eventIdentity
                      && (try? $0.eventHash()) == row.eventHash
              }) else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        switch row.source.sourceClass {
        case .localOrdinary:
            guard let evidence = state.localOrdinaryOutboxEvidence[
                row.source.evidenceKey
            ] else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            try Self.validateStoredLocalOrdinaryEvidence(
                row: row,
                evidence: evidence,
                state: state
            )
        case .sealedLegacyMigration:
            guard let evidence = state.sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence[
                row.source.evidenceKey
            ], let batch = legacyBatches[
                evidence.authorityId
            ] else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            try LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator.validateStoredEvidence(
                row: row,
                evidence: evidence,
                batch: batch,
                legacyWireBindings: state.legacyWireBindings
            )
        case .verifiedPeerBundle:
            guard let evidence = state.verifiedPeerBundleEvidence[
                row.source.evidenceKey
            ] else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            try VerifiedPeerBundleEvidenceValidator.validateStored(
                row: row,
                evidence: evidence,
                state: state,
                trustedServerKeys: trustedPeerServerKeys
            )
        }
    }

    private func makePreparedRequest(
        roundId: String,
        rows: [OutboxRecord],
        state: DomainLedgerStateV2,
        legacyBatches: [String: LegacyAuthorityClassificationBatch]
    ) throws -> PreparedEventWriteRequest {
        for row in rows {
            try validateOutboxSourceForPreparation(
                row,
                state: state,
                legacyBatches: legacyBatches
            )
        }
        let slots = rows.map {
            EventWriteRequestSlot(
                event: $0.event,
                eventIdentity: $0.eventIdentity,
                eventHash: $0.eventHash
            )
        }
        let eventsValue = try slots.map {
            try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(JSONValue.self, from: JSONEncoder().encode($0.event))
        }
        let body = try CanonicalJSON.data(JSONValue.object(["events": .array(eventsValue)]))
        let requestHash = try TypedID.make(
            domain: "RoundEventBatch/v1",
            value: .object([
                "roundId": .string(roundId),
                "events": .array(eventsValue),
            ])
        )
        let bodySha = SHA256.hash(data: body).map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
        return PreparedEventWriteRequest(
            roundId: roundId,
            body: body,
            requestHash: requestHash,
            requestBodySha256: bodySha,
            slots: slots
        )
    }

    func prepareEventWriteRequest(
        roundId: String,
        limit: Int = RoundTransportLimits.maxEventsPerBatch
    ) throws -> PreparedEventWriteRequest? {
        guard (1...RoundTransportLimits.maxEventsPerBatch).contains(limit) else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.transportLimitExceeded
        }
        return try locked {
            let state = try loadV2()
            let candidates = state.outbox.filter {
                $0.event.roundId == roundId && $0.deadLetterReason == nil
            }
            let eligible = Array(candidates.prefix(limit))
            let legacyBatches = try
                legacyClassificationBatchesForPreparation(
                    rows: eligible,
                    state: state
                )
            var selected: [OutboxRecord] = []
            for row in eligible {
                let candidate = selected + [row]
                let request = try makePreparedRequest(
                    roundId: roundId,
                    rows: candidate,
                    state: state,
                    legacyBatches: legacyBatches
                )
                if request.body.count > RoundTransportLimits.maxHttpBodyBytes {
                    if selected.isEmpty { throw DomainLedgerError.transportLimitExceeded }
                    break
                }
                selected = candidate
            }
            guard !selected.isEmpty else { return nil }
            return try makePreparedRequest(
                roundId: roundId,
                rows: selected,
                state: state,
                legacyBatches: legacyBatches
            )
        }
    }

    func prepareRoundStartedEventWriteRequest(
        roundId: String
    ) throws -> PreparedEventWriteRequest? {
        try locked {
            let state = try loadV2()
            guard state.activeInboundPartitionsByRound[roundId, default: []].isEmpty else {
                return nil
            }
            let rows = state.outbox.filter {
                $0.event.roundId == roundId
                    && $0.event.kind.rawValue == "round_started"
                    && $0.deadLetterReason == nil
            }
            guard !rows.isEmpty else { return nil }
            guard rows.count == 1 else { throw DomainLedgerError.roundStartConflict }
            let legacyBatches = try
                legacyClassificationBatchesForPreparation(
                    rows: rows,
                    state: state
                )
            return try makePreparedRequest(
                roundId: roundId,
                rows: rows,
                state: state,
                legacyBatches: legacyBatches
            )
        }
    }

    func syncProgressFingerprint(roundId: String) throws -> String {
        try locked {
            let state = try loadV2()
            let cursors = state.inboundCursors.values
                .filter { $0.syncRoundId == roundId }
                .sorted { $0.ledgerPartitionId < $1.ledgerPartitionId }
                .map { cursor in
                    JSONValue.object([
                        "partition": .string(cursor.ledgerPartitionId),
                        "generation": .integer(Int64(cursor.mergeControlGeneration)),
                        "persisted": .string(cursor.persistedThrough.rawValue),
                        "acked": .string(cursor.ackedThrough.rawValue),
                    ])
                }
            let awaitingIdentities = Set(state.acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay.keys)
                .union(state.legacyV1AcceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay.keys)
                .sorted()
            return try TypedID.make(
                domain: "RoundSyncProgress/v1",
                value: .object([
                    "roundId": .string(roundId),
                    "cursors": .array(cursors),
                    "outbox": .array(state.outbox.filter { $0.event.roundId == roundId }
                        .map(\.eventIdentity).sorted().map(JSONValue.string)),
                    "awaiting": .array(awaitingIdentities.map(JSONValue.string)),
                    "deadLetters": .array(state.deadLetters.filter { $0.event.roundId == roundId }
                        .map(\.eventIdentity).sorted().map(JSONValue.string)),
                ])
            )
        }
    }

    private static func canonicalOrigin(
        matching receipt: EventReceipt,
        slot: EventWriteRequestSlot,
        state: DomainLedgerStateV2
    ) throws -> CanonicalOriginEvidence? {
        guard let origin = state.canonicalOriginEvidence[
            slot.eventIdentity
        ] else {
            return nil
        }
        guard origin.eventIdentity == slot.eventIdentity,
              origin.eventHash == slot.eventHash,
              origin.eventHash == receipt.eventHash,
              origin.ledgerPartitionId == receipt.ledgerPartitionId,
              origin.ledgerEpoch == receipt.ledgerEpoch,
              origin.streamId == receipt.streamId,
              origin.ledgerPosition == receipt.ledgerPosition else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.transportCanonicalContradiction
        }
        return origin
    }

    private static func terminalEquivalent(
        stored: EventReceipt,
        incoming: EventReceipt,
        currentSlot: EventWriteRequestSlot
    ) -> Bool {
        let success: Set<ReceiptStatus> = [
            .accepted, .duplicateHashMatch, .acceptedOpaque,
        ]
        let statusEquivalent =
            success.contains(stored.status)
                && success.contains(incoming.status)
            || stored.status == .rejectedPermanent
                && incoming.status == .rejectedPermanent
        let requestLocalIndexEquivalent =
            stored.eventIdentity != nil
                ? true
                : stored.inputIndex == incoming.inputIndex
        return statusEquivalent
            && requestLocalIndexEquivalent
            && stored.eventId == currentSlot.event.eventId
            && incoming.eventId == currentSlot.event.eventId
            && stored.eventIdentity == incoming.eventIdentity
            && stored.eventHash == incoming.eventHash
            && stored.ledgerPartitionId == incoming.ledgerPartitionId
            && stored.ledgerEpoch == incoming.ledgerEpoch
            && stored.streamId == incoming.streamId
            && stored.ledgerPosition == incoming.ledgerPosition
            && stored.currentEntityRevision
                == incoming.currentEntityRevision
            && stored.reasonCode == incoming.reasonCode
    }

    static func setLocalProjectionAuthority(
        eventIdentity: String,
        authority: ProjectionAuthority,
        state: inout DomainLedgerStateV2
    ) throws {
        var matched = 0
        state.localProjectionInputs = try state.localProjectionInputs.map {
            input in
            guard try input.event.eventIdentity() == eventIdentity else {
                return input
            }
            matched += 1
            return DomainProjectionInput(
                event: input.event,
                projectionOrder: try DomainProjectionOrder(
                    authority: authority,
                    ledgerPartitionId: nil,
                    ledgerPosition: nil,
                    sourceOrdinal: input.projectionOrder.sourceOrdinal
                )
            )
        }
        guard matched == 1 else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
    }

    private static func removeSourceEvidence(
        for row: OutboxRecord,
        state: inout DomainLedgerStateV2
    ) throws {
        switch row.source.sourceClass {
        case .localOrdinary:
            guard let removed = state.localOrdinaryOutboxEvidence
                .removeValue(forKey: row.source.evidenceKey),
                  removed.eventIdentity == row.eventIdentity,
                  removed.eventHash == row.eventHash else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        case .sealedLegacyMigration:
            guard let removed = state.sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence
                .removeValue(forKey: row.source.evidenceKey),
                  removed.eventIdentity == row.eventIdentity,
                  removed.eventHash == row.eventHash else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            let authorityId = removed.authorityId
            if !state.sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence.values.contains(
                where: { $0.authorityId == authorityId }
            ) {
                guard (state.outbox + state.deadLetters).allSatisfy({ row in
                    row.source.sourceClass != .sealedLegacyMigration
                        || row.source.evidenceKey != removed.evidenceKey
                }) else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                guard state.sealedLegacyAuthorities.removeValue(
                    forKey: authorityId
                ) != nil else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
        case .verifiedPeerBundle:
            // A terminal response consumes only the row-local evidence edge.
            // The signed bundle, credential verification, verification receipt,
            // peer receipt and takeover watermark are immutable audit roots.
            guard let evidence = state.verifiedPeerBundleEvidence[
                    row.source.evidenceKey
                  ],
                  let bundle = state.verifiedPeerBundleAuthorities[
                    evidence.bundleId
                  ],
                  let credential = state
                    .verifiedPeerCredentialVerificationRecords[
                        evidence.credentialVerificationRecordId
                    ],
                  let verification = state
                    .verifiedPeerBundleVerificationReceipts[
                        evidence.verificationReceiptId
                    ],
                  let peerReceipt = state.peerBundleReceipts[
                    evidence.bundleId
                  ],
                  let watermark = state.peerTakeoverWatermarks[
                    "\(evidence.sourceDeviceId)|\(evidence.roundId)"
                  ] else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            guard let removed = state.verifiedPeerBundleEvidence
                .removeValue(forKey: row.source.evidenceKey),
                  removed.eventIdentity == row.eventIdentity,
                  removed.eventHash == row.eventHash,
                  state.verifiedPeerBundleAuthorities[
                    evidence.bundleId
                  ] == bundle,
                  state.verifiedPeerCredentialVerificationRecords[
                    evidence.credentialVerificationRecordId
                  ] == credential,
                  state.verifiedPeerBundleVerificationReceipts[
                    evidence.verificationReceiptId
                  ] == verification,
                  state.peerBundleReceipts[evidence.bundleId]
                    == peerReceipt,
                  state.peerTakeoverWatermarks[
                    "\(evidence.sourceDeviceId)|\(evidence.roundId)"
                  ] == watermark else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        }
    }

    private static func validateLateTerminalReapply(
        slot: EventWriteRequestSlot,
        receipt incoming: EventReceipt,
        storageKey incomingStorageKey: String,
        state: DomainLedgerStateV2
    ) throws {
        let storedKey: String
        let stored: EventReceipt
        if incoming.eventIdentity != nil {
            storedKey = slot.eventIdentity
            guard let value = state.receipts[storedKey] else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.transportCanonicalContradiction
            }
            stored = value
        } else {
            storedKey = incomingStorageKey
            guard let value = state.receipts[storedKey] else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.transportCanonicalContradiction
            }
            stored = value
        }
        guard terminalEquivalent(
            stored: stored,
            incoming: incoming,
            currentSlot: slot
        ) else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.transportCanonicalContradiction
        }

        switch stored.status {
        case .accepted, .duplicateHashMatch, .acceptedOpaque:
            let origin = try Self.canonicalOrigin(
                matching: stored,
                slot: slot,
                state: state
            )
            let awaiting = state.acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay[
                slot.eventIdentity
            ] == stored
            guard awaiting == (origin == nil),
                  state.localProjectionInputs.contains(where: {
                    (try? $0.event.eventIdentity()) == slot.eventIdentity
                        && $0.projectionOrder.authority
                            == (origin == nil
                                ? .acceptedAwaitingReplay
                                : .localTerminalFallback)
                  }),
                  !state.deadLetters.contains(where: {
                    $0.eventIdentity == slot.eventIdentity
                  }) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.transportCanonicalContradiction
            }
        case .rejectedPermanent:
            guard state.canonicalOriginEvidence[slot.eventIdentity] == nil,
                  !state.stagedInboundProjectionRecords.contains(where: {
                    (try? $0.input.event.eventIdentity())
                        == slot.eventIdentity
                  }),
                  state.deadLetters.contains(where: {
                    $0.eventIdentity == slot.eventIdentity
                        && $0.eventHash == slot.eventHash
                        && $0.receiptStorageKey == storedKey
                        && $0.receipt == stored
                  }),
                  !state.localProjectionInputs.contains(where: {
                    (try? $0.event.eventIdentity())
                        == slot.eventIdentity
                  }) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.transportCanonicalContradiction
            }
        case .deferred:
            throw DomainLedgerError.transportCanonicalContradiction
        }
    }

    func apply(validatedResponse value: ValidatedEventWriteResponse) throws {
        try transaction { state in
            for (slot, receipt) in zip(
                value.request.slots, value.response.receipts
            ) {
                let storageKey = receipt.eventIdentity
                    ?? "\(value.request.requestBodySha256)#\(receipt.inputIndex)"
                guard let index = state.outbox.firstIndex(where: {
                    $0.eventIdentity == slot.eventIdentity
                        && $0.eventHash == slot.eventHash
                }) else {
                    try Self.validateLateTerminalReapply(
                        slot: slot,
                        receipt: receipt,
                        storageKey: storageKey,
                        state: state
                    )
                    continue
                }
                let row = state.outbox[index]
                switch receipt.status {
                case .accepted, .duplicateHashMatch, .acceptedOpaque:
                    guard state.receipts[storageKey] == nil,
                          receipt.eventIdentity == slot.eventIdentity,
                          receipt.eventHash == slot.eventHash else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError
                            .transportCanonicalContradiction
                    }
                    let origin = try Self.canonicalOrigin(
                        matching: receipt,
                        slot: slot,
                        state: state
                    )
                    // This is the first durable terminal receipt and is never
                    // overwritten by later duplicate/status/index variants.
                    state.receipts[storageKey] = receipt
                    if origin == nil {
                        state.acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay[
                            slot.eventIdentity
                        ] = receipt
                        try Self.setLocalProjectionAuthority(
                            eventIdentity: slot.eventIdentity,
                            authority: .acceptedAwaitingReplay,
                            state: &state
                        )
                    } else {
                        state.acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay.removeValue(
                            forKey: slot.eventIdentity
                        )
                        try Self.setLocalProjectionAuthority(
                            eventIdentity: slot.eventIdentity,
                            authority: .localTerminalFallback,
                            state: &state
                        )
                    }
                    state.outbox.remove(at: index)
                    try Self.removeSourceEvidence(for: row, state: &state)
                case .deferred:
                    guard state.receipts[slot.eventIdentity] == nil,
                          !state.deadLetters.contains(where: {
                            $0.eventIdentity == slot.eventIdentity
                          }) else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError
                            .transportReceiptSlotMismatch
                    }
                    state.outbox[index].receipt = receipt
                case .rejectedPermanent:
                    guard state.canonicalOriginEvidence[
                            slot.eventIdentity
                          ] == nil,
                          !state.stagedInboundProjectionRecords.contains(
                            where: {
                                (try? $0.input.event.eventIdentity())
                                    == slot.eventIdentity
                            }
                          ),
                          state.receipts[storageKey] == nil else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError
                            .transportCanonicalContradiction
                    }
                    var dead = state.outbox.remove(at: index)
                    dead.receipt = receipt
                    dead.receiptStorageKey = storageKey
                    dead.deadLetterReason = receipt.reasonCode?.rawValue
                        ?? "rejected_permanent"
                    state.receipts[storageKey] = receipt
                    state.deadLetters.append(dead)
                    // Permanent rejection retains source provenance, but no
                    // rejected fact may remain a projection fallback.
                    state.localProjectionInputs.removeAll {
                        (try? $0.event.eventIdentity())
                            == slot.eventIdentity
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`EventWriteResponseValidator.validate(rawResponse:request:)` 是 `ValidatedEventWriteResponse` 的唯一 initializer owner。它重新计算 request body SHA-256、验证 generated `EventWriteResponseV2` schema、运行上述 exact roster rules，并把 immutable prepared request 放进 capability。`DomainLedgerStore.apply` 不公开接受裸 `EventWriteResponseV2` 或 `[EventReceipt]` 的 overload；tests 通过 symbol scan 保住这一边界。Task 5 的 `EventReceiptStore.swift` 与旧单条 `apply(receipt:)` tests 在本 task 删除，完整替换为：exact success roster、nullable raw-reject slot、missing/extra/reordered receipt、wrong top-level hash/count、identity/hash mismatch、success coordinate 缺失、non-success 伪造 coordinate，以及“任一 validation failure 后 outbox byte-for-byte 未变且记录 transport anomaly”的 batch tests。

`generate_contracts.py` 同时生成 `GeneratedContractValidators.validateEventWriteResponse(_:)`；该入口先做 duplicate-key/unknown-key/type/enum/pattern 检查，再允许 decode。production validator 的完整 gate 为：

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/EventWriteResponseValidator.swift
import CryptoKit
import Foundation

public enum EventWriteResponseValidationError: Error, Equatable {
    case requestEvidenceMismatch
    case responseRosterMismatch
    case responseSlotMismatch(Int)
    case illegalReceiptShape(Int)
}

public enum EventWriteResponseValidator {
    public static func validate(
        rawResponse: Data,
        request: PreparedEventWriteRequest
    ) throws -> ValidatedEventWriteResponse {
        let requestBodySha256 = SHA256.hash(data: request.body)
            .map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
        guard requestBodySha256 == request.requestBodySha256 else {
            throw EventWriteResponseValidationError.requestEvidenceMismatch
        }
        try GeneratedContractValidators.validateEventWriteResponse(rawResponse)
        let response = try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(
            EventWriteResponseV2.self,
            from: rawResponse
        )
        guard response.schema == "ai-caddie-event-write-response-v2",
              response.requestHash == request.requestHash,
              response.requestBodySha256 == request.requestBodySha256,
              response.eventCount == request.slots.count,
              response.receipts.count == request.slots.count,
              response.receipts.map(\.inputIndex) == Array(0..<request.slots.count) else {
            throw EventWriteResponseValidationError.responseRosterMismatch
        }
        for (index, pair) in zip(request.slots, response.receipts).enumerated() {
            let (slot, receipt) = pair
            guard receipt.eventId == slot.event.eventId else {
                throw EventWriteResponseValidationError.responseSlotMismatch(index)
            }
            if let identity = receipt.eventIdentity {
                guard identity == slot.eventIdentity,
                      receipt.eventHash == slot.eventHash else {
                    throw EventWriteResponseValidationError.responseSlotMismatch(index)
                }
            } else {
                guard receipt.status == .rejectedPermanent else {
                    throw EventWriteResponseValidationError.illegalReceiptShape(index)
                }
                if receipt.reasonCode?.rawValue == "identity_envelope_mismatch" {
                    guard receipt.eventHash == slot.eventHash else {
                        throw EventWriteResponseValidationError.responseSlotMismatch(index)
                    }
                } else if receipt.eventHash != nil {
                    throw EventWriteResponseValidationError.illegalReceiptShape(index)
                }
            }
            let appended = [.accepted, .acceptedOpaque, .duplicateHashMatch]
                .contains(receipt.status)
            let coordinateComplete = receipt.ledgerPartitionId != nil
                && receipt.ledgerEpoch != nil
                && receipt.streamId != nil
                && receipt.ledgerPosition != nil
            let coordinateAbsent = receipt.ledgerPartitionId == nil
                && receipt.ledgerEpoch == nil
                && receipt.streamId == nil
                && receipt.ledgerPosition == nil
            guard appended ? coordinateComplete : coordinateAbsent else {
                throw EventWriteResponseValidationError.illegalReceiptShape(index)
            }
        }
        return ValidatedEventWriteResponse(response: response, request: request)
    }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/StrictJSONDecoder.swift
import Foundation

public enum StrictJSONError: Error, Equatable { case duplicateKey(String) }

public enum StrictJSONDecoder {
    private struct Frame {
        let object: Bool
        var keys: Set<String> = []
        var expectsKey: Bool
    }

    public static func decode<T: Decodable>(_ type: T.Type, from data: Data) throws -> T {
        try validateNoDuplicateKeys(in: data)
        return try JSONDecoder().decode(type, from: data)
    }

    static func validateNoDuplicateKeys(in data: Data) throws {
        let bytes = Array(data)
        var stack: [Frame] = []
        var index = 0
        while index < bytes.count {
            switch bytes[index] {
            case 0x7b:
                stack.append(Frame(object: true, expectsKey: true)); index += 1
            case 0x5b:
                stack.append(Frame(object: false, expectsKey: false)); index += 1
            case 0x7d, 0x5d:
                if !stack.isEmpty { stack.removeLast() }; index += 1
            case 0x2c:
                if !stack.isEmpty && stack[stack.count - 1].object {
                    stack[stack.count - 1].expectsKey = true
                }
                index += 1
            case 0x22:
                let start = index
                index += 1
                var escaped = false
                while index < bytes.count {
                    let byte = bytes[index]
                    if escaped { escaped = false }
                    else if byte == 0x5c { escaped = true }
                    else if byte == 0x22 { break }
                    index += 1
                }
                let end = index
                if !stack.isEmpty && stack[stack.count - 1].object && stack[stack.count - 1].expectsKey {
                    let keyData = Data(bytes[start...end])
                    let key = try JSONDecoder().decode(String.self, from: keyData)
                    if stack[stack.count - 1].keys.contains(key) { throw StrictJSONError.duplicateKey(key) }
                    stack[stack.count - 1].keys.insert(key)
                    stack[stack.count - 1].expectsKey = false
                }
                index += 1
            default:
                index += 1
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/CanonicalJSON.swift
import CryptoKit
import Foundation

public enum CanonicalJSONError: Error { case nonNFC, negativeZero, unsafeInteger, unsupported }

public enum CanonicalJSON {
    private static let safeInteger: Int64 = 9_007_199_254_740_991

    private static func foundation(_ value: JSONValue) throws -> Any {
        switch value {
        case .null: return NSNull()
        case .bool(let value): return NSNumber(value: value)
        case .integer(let value):
            guard value >= -safeInteger && value <= safeInteger else { throw CanonicalJSONError.unsafeInteger }
            return NSNumber(value: value)
        case .number(let value):
            guard value.isFinite else { throw CanonicalJSONError.unsupported }
            guard !(value == 0 && value.sign == .minus) else { throw CanonicalJSONError.negativeZero }
            guard value.rounded(.towardZero) != value || abs(value) <= Double(safeInteger) else { throw CanonicalJSONError.unsafeInteger }
            return NSNumber(value: value)
        case .string(let value):
            guard value.precomposedStringWithCanonicalMapping == value else { throw CanonicalJSONError.nonNFC }
            return value
        case .array(let values): return try values.map(foundation)
        case .object(let values):
            var result: [String: Any] = [:]
            for (key, child) in values {
                guard key.precomposedStringWithCanonicalMapping == key else { throw CanonicalJSONError.nonNFC }
                result[key] = try foundation(child)
            }
            return result
        }
    }

    public static func data(_ value: JSONValue) throws -> Data {
        try JSONCanonicalization.data(withJSONObject: foundation(value))
    }

    public static func data<T: Encodable>(_ value: T) throws -> Data {
        let encoded = try JSONEncoder().encode(value)
        return try data(JSONDecoder().decode(JSONValue.self, from: encoded))
    }

    public static func number(_ value: Double) throws -> String {
        if value == 0 && value.sign == .minus { throw CanonicalJSONError.negativeZero }
        return try _serializeNumber(value)
    }
}

public enum TypedID {
    public static func make(domain: String, value: JSONValue) throws -> String {
        try make(domain: domain, canonicalBytes: CanonicalJSON.data(value))
    }

    public static func make<T: Encodable>(domain: String, value: T) throws -> String {
        try make(domain: domain, canonicalBytes: CanonicalJSON.data(value))
    }

    private static func make(domain: String, canonicalBytes: Data) throws -> String {
        var bytes = Data(domain.utf8); bytes.append(0); bytes.append(canonicalBytes)
        return SHA256.hash(data: bytes).map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
    }
}
```

```swift
    public let hole: Int
    public let latitude: Double
    public let longitude: Double
    public let horizontalAccuracyM: Double?
    public let lie: String
    public let provenance: String
    public let actualClubId: String?
    public let retracted: Bool
}

public struct DomainShotTargetProjection: Codable, Equatable {
    public let shotId: String
    public let targetRef: String
    public let latitude: Double
    public let longitude: Double
    public let provenance: String
    public let orphaned: Bool
    public let retracted: Bool
}

public struct DomainFlagPositionProjection: Codable, Equatable {
    public let hole: Int
    public let latitude: Double
    public let longitude: Double
    public let provenance: String
}

public struct DomainRoundProjection: Codable, Equatable {
    public let lifecycle: String
    public let replication: String
    public let holes: [String: DomainHoleProjection]

    public let entityRef: String
    public let eventId: String
    public let eventIdentity: String
    public let currentRevision: EntityRevisionToken
    public let providedBase: EntityRevisionToken?

}
```
