```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/DomainRoundReducer.swift
import Foundation

public enum DomainReducerError: Error, Equatable {
    case invalidPayload(String)
    case invalidProjectionOrder
    case identityEnvelopeMismatch
    case duplicateIdentity
    case duplicateCoordinate
    case missingCause
    case canonicalDependsOnProvisional
    case unresolvedBaseDependency
    case projectionDependencyCycle
}

private struct ReducerEntityState {
    var value: JSONValue
    var revision: EntityRevisionToken
    var contributors: Set<String>
}

private struct ReducerNode {
    let key: String
    let identity: String
    let eventHash: String
    let input: DomainProjectionInput
}

private struct PreparedKeyedUpdate<Value> {
    let key: String
    let value: Value
}

private struct ResolutionScopeReducerIndex {
    let nonterminalCount: Int
    let activeResolutionId: String?
}

private struct PreparedDomainReducerMutation {
    let lifecycle: String?
    let entity: PreparedKeyedUpdate<ReducerEntityState>?
    let hole: PreparedKeyedUpdate<DomainHoleProjection>?
    let flagPosition: PreparedKeyedUpdate<DomainFlagPositionProjection>?
    let shots: [PreparedKeyedUpdate<DomainShotProjection>]
    let shotTargets: [PreparedKeyedUpdate<DomainShotTargetProjection>]
    let resolutions: [PreparedKeyedUpdate<String>]
    let resolutionScopes: [PreparedKeyedUpdate<String>]
    let resolutionScopeIndex:
        PreparedKeyedUpdate<ResolutionScopeReducerIndex>?
    let mergeControl: [String: JSONValue]?
    let conflicts: [DomainConflict]

    static let noOp = PreparedDomainReducerMutation()

    init(
        lifecycle: String? = nil,
        entity: PreparedKeyedUpdate<ReducerEntityState>? = nil,
        hole: PreparedKeyedUpdate<DomainHoleProjection>? = nil,
        flagPosition: PreparedKeyedUpdate<DomainFlagPositionProjection>? = nil,
        shots: [PreparedKeyedUpdate<DomainShotProjection>] = [],
        shotTargets:
            [PreparedKeyedUpdate<DomainShotTargetProjection>] = [],
        resolutions: [PreparedKeyedUpdate<String>] = [],
        resolutionScopes: [PreparedKeyedUpdate<String>] = [],
        resolutionScopeIndex:
            PreparedKeyedUpdate<ResolutionScopeReducerIndex>? = nil,
        mergeControl: [String: JSONValue]? = nil,
        conflicts: [DomainConflict] = []
    ) {
        self.lifecycle = lifecycle
        self.entity = entity
        self.hole = hole
        self.flagPosition = flagPosition
        self.shots = shots
        self.shotTargets = shotTargets
        self.resolutions = resolutions
        self.resolutionScopes = resolutionScopes
        self.resolutionScopeIndex = resolutionScopeIndex
        self.mergeControl = mergeControl
        self.conflicts = conflicts
    }
}

private enum PreparedEntityMutation {
    case noOp
    case conflict(DomainConflict)
    case applied(ReducerEntityState)
}

private extension Dictionary where Key == String, Value == JSONValue {
    func required(_ key: String) throws -> JSONValue {
        guard let value = self[key] else { throw DomainReducerError.invalidPayload(key) }
        return value
    }

    func string(_ key: String) throws -> String {
        guard case .string(let value) = try required(key), !value.isEmpty else {
            throw DomainReducerError.invalidPayload(key)
        }
        return value
    }

    func int(_ key: String) throws -> Int {
        switch try required(key) {
        case .integer(let value): return Int(value)
        case .number(let value) where value.rounded(.towardZero) == value: return Int(value)
        default: throw DomainReducerError.invalidPayload(key)
        }
    }

    func double(_ key: String) throws -> Double {
        switch try required(key) {
        case .integer(let value): return Double(value)
        case .number(let value): return value
        default: throw DomainReducerError.invalidPayload(key)
        }
    }

    func nullableDouble(_ key: String) throws -> Double? {
        guard let value = self[key] else { return nil }
        switch value {
        case .null: return nil
        case .integer(let number): return Double(number)
        case .number(let number): return number
        default: throw DomainReducerError.invalidPayload(key)
        }
    }

    func object(_ key: String) throws -> [String: JSONValue] {
        guard case .object(let value) = try required(key) else {
            throw DomainReducerError.invalidPayload(key)
        }
        return value
    }
}

private extension JSONValue {
    var isUnset: Bool { self == .object(["state": .string("unset")]) }
}

private final class MutableDomainProjection {
    var lifecycle = "draft"
    var holes: [String: DomainHoleProjection] = [:]
    var shots: [String: DomainShotProjection] = [:]
    var shotTargets: [String: DomainShotTargetProjection] = [:]
    var flagPositions: [String: DomainFlagPositionProjection] = [:]
    var resolutions: [String: String] = [:]
    var resolutionScopes: [String: String] = [:]
    var resolutionScopeIndexByScopeId:
        [String: ResolutionScopeReducerIndex] = [:]
    var mergeControl: [String: JSONValue]?
    var conflicts: [DomainConflict] = []
    var entities: [String: ReducerEntityState] = [:]

    func revision(for entityRef: String) -> EntityRevisionToken? {
        entities[entityRef]?.revision
    }

    func commit(_ mutation: PreparedDomainReducerMutation) {
        if let lifecycle = mutation.lifecycle {
            self.lifecycle = lifecycle
        }
        if let update = mutation.entity {
            entities[update.key] = update.value
        }
        if let update = mutation.hole {
            holes[update.key] = update.value
        }
        if let update = mutation.flagPosition {
            flagPositions[update.key] = update.value
        }
        for update in mutation.shots {
            shots[update.key] = update.value
        }
        for update in mutation.shotTargets {
            shotTargets[update.key] = update.value
        }
        for update in mutation.resolutions {
            resolutions[update.key] = update.value
        }
        for update in mutation.resolutionScopes {
            resolutionScopes[update.key] = update.value
        }
        if let update = mutation.resolutionScopeIndex {
            resolutionScopeIndexByScopeId[update.key] = update.value
        }
        if let mergeControl = mutation.mergeControl {
            self.mergeControl = mergeControl
        }
        conflicts.append(contentsOf: mutation.conflicts)
    }

    func freeze(replication: DomainReplicationContext) -> DomainRoundProjection {
        let replicationState = !conflicts.isEmpty ? "conflict"
            : replication.deadLetterCount > 0 ? "deadLetter"
            : replication.syncing ? "syncing"
            : (replication.pendingCount > 0
               || replication.awaitingCanonicalReplayCount > 0) ? "dirty" : "clean"
        return DomainRoundProjection(
            lifecycle: lifecycle,
            replication: replicationState,
            holes: holes,
            shots: shots,
            shotTargets: shotTargets,
            flagPositions: flagPositions,
            resolutions: resolutions,
            mergeControl: mergeControl,
            conflicts: conflicts,
            entityRevisions: entities.mapValues(\.revision)
        )
    }
}

private enum DomainReducerMutationPlanner {
    private static func projectionHash(
        _ value: JSONValue
    ) throws -> String {
        try TypedID.make(
            domain: "EntityProjection/v1",
            value: .object(["value": value])
        )
    }

    private static func eventSetHash(
        _ identities: Set<String>
    ) throws -> String {
        try TypedID.make(
            domain: "ContributingEventSet/v1",
            value: .object([
                "eventIds": .array(
                    identities.sorted().map { .string($0) }
                ),
            ])
        )
    }

    private static func absent(
        _ scopeId: String
    ) throws -> ReducerEntityState {
        ReducerEntityState(
            value: .null,
            revision: EntityRevisionToken(
                scopeId: scopeId,
                reducerVersion: "round-reducer-v2",
                canonicalOrdinal: 0,
                entityProjectionHash: try projectionHash(.null),
                contributingEventSetHash: try eventSetHash([]),
                provisionalFlag: true
            ),
            contributors: []
        )
    }

    private static func equivalent(
        _ provided: EntityRevisionToken,
        _ current: EntityRevisionToken
    ) -> Bool {
        provided.scopeId == current.scopeId
            && provided.reducerVersion == current.reducerVersion
            && provided.entityProjectionHash
                == current.entityProjectionHash
            && provided.contributingEventSetHash
                == current.contributingEventSetHash
    }

    fileprivate static func conflict(
        _ event: DomainRoundEvent,
        reasonCode: String,
        current override: ReducerEntityState? = nil,
        against state: MutableDomainProjection
    ) throws -> DomainConflict {
        let current = override
            ?? state.entities[event.entityRef]
            ?? (try absent(event.entityRef))
        return DomainConflict(
            entityRef: event.entityRef,
            eventId: event.eventId,
            eventIdentity: try event.eventIdentity(),
            currentRevision: current.revision,
            providedBase: event.baseEntityRevision,
            reasonCode: reasonCode
        )
    }

    fileprivate static func prepareEntityMutation(
        _ event: DomainRoundEvent,
        value: JSONValue,
        authority: ProjectionAuthority,
        against state: MutableDomainProjection
    ) throws -> PreparedEntityMutation {
        if value.isUnset { return .noOp }
        let current = state.entities[event.entityRef]
            ?? (try absent(event.entityRef))
        guard let provided = event.baseEntityRevision,
              equivalent(provided, current.revision) else {
            return .conflict(try conflict(
                event,
                reasonCode: "entity_base_revision_conflict",
                current: current,
                against: state
            ))
        }
        var contributors = current.contributors
        contributors.insert(try event.eventIdentity())
        return .applied(ReducerEntityState(
            value: value,
            revision: EntityRevisionToken(
                scopeId: event.entityRef,
                reducerVersion: "round-reducer-v2",
                canonicalOrdinal: current.revision.canonicalOrdinal
                    + (authority == .canonicalReplay ? 1 : 0),
                entityProjectionHash: try projectionHash(value),
                contributingEventSetHash:
                    try eventSetHash(contributors),
                provisionalFlag: authority != .canonicalReplay
            ),
            contributors: contributors
        ))
    }

    fileprivate static func prepareCreateEntity(
        _ event: DomainRoundEvent,
        value: JSONValue,
        authority: ProjectionAuthority,
        against state: MutableDomainProjection
    ) throws -> PreparedEntityMutation {
        if let current = state.entities[event.entityRef] {
            return .conflict(try conflict(
                event,
                reasonCode: "shot_identity_conflict",
                current: current,
                against: state
            ))
        }
        let contributors: Set<String> = [try event.eventIdentity()]
        return .applied(ReducerEntityState(
            value: value,
            revision: EntityRevisionToken(
                scopeId: event.entityRef,
                reducerVersion: "round-reducer-v2",
                canonicalOrdinal:
                    authority == .canonicalReplay ? 1 : 0,
                entityProjectionHash: try projectionHash(value),
                contributingEventSetHash:
                    try eventSetHash(contributors),
                provisionalFlag: authority != .canonicalReplay
            ),
            contributors: contributors
        ))
    }

    private static func prepared(
        event: DomainRoundEvent,
        entityMutation: PreparedEntityMutation,
        lifecycle: String? = nil,
        hole: PreparedKeyedUpdate<DomainHoleProjection>? = nil,
        flagPosition:
            PreparedKeyedUpdate<DomainFlagPositionProjection>? = nil,
        shots: [PreparedKeyedUpdate<DomainShotProjection>] = [],
        shotTargets:
            [PreparedKeyedUpdate<DomainShotTargetProjection>] = [],
        resolutions: [PreparedKeyedUpdate<String>] = [],
        resolutionScopes: [PreparedKeyedUpdate<String>] = [],
        resolutionScopeIndex:
            PreparedKeyedUpdate<ResolutionScopeReducerIndex>? = nil,
        mergeControl: [String: JSONValue]? = nil,
        conflictsOnApply: [DomainConflict] = []
    ) -> PreparedDomainReducerMutation {
        switch entityMutation {
        case .noOp:
            return .noOp
        case .conflict(let conflict):
            return PreparedDomainReducerMutation(conflicts: [conflict])
        case .applied(let entity):
            return PreparedDomainReducerMutation(
                lifecycle: lifecycle,
                entity: PreparedKeyedUpdate(
                    key: event.entityRef,
                    value: entity
                ),
                hole: hole,
                flagPosition: flagPosition,
                shots: shots,
                shotTargets: shotTargets,
                resolutions: resolutions,
                resolutionScopes: resolutionScopes,
                resolutionScopeIndex: resolutionScopeIndex,
                mergeControl: mergeControl,
                conflicts: conflictsOnApply
            )
        }
    }

    private static func prepareLifecycle(
        input: DomainProjectionInput,
        against state: MutableDomainProjection
    ) throws -> PreparedDomainReducerMutation {
        let event = input.event
        let targets = [
            "round_started": "active",
            "round_suspended": "suspended",
            "round_resumed": "active",
            "round_finished": "finished",
            "round_discarded": "discarded",
        ]
        let legal: [String: Set<String>] = [
            "draft": ["round_started"],
            "active": [
                "round_suspended", "round_finished", "round_discarded",
            ],
            "suspended": [
                "round_resumed", "round_finished", "round_discarded",
            ],
            "finished": [],
            "discarded": [],
        ]
        guard let target = targets[event.kind.rawValue],
              legal[state.lifecycle, default: []]
                .contains(event.kind.rawValue) else {
            return PreparedDomainReducerMutation(conflicts: [
                try conflict(
                    event,
                    reasonCode: "illegal_lifecycle_transition",
                    against: state
                ),
            ])
        }
        if event.kind.rawValue == "round_started" {
            return PreparedDomainReducerMutation(lifecycle: target)
        }
        return prepared(
            event: event,
            entityMutation: try prepareEntityMutation(
                event,
                value: .string(target),
                authority: input.projectionOrder.authority,
                against: state
            ),
            lifecycle: target
        )
    }

    private static func prepareHoleFact(
        input: DomainProjectionInput,
        payloadKey: String,
        field: String,
        against state: MutableDomainProjection
    ) throws -> PreparedDomainReducerMutation {
        let event = input.event
        let value = try event.payload.required(payloadKey)
        if value.isUnset { return .noOp }
        let hole = try event.payload.int("hole")
        let key = String(hole)
        let old = state.holes[key] ?? DomainHoleProjection(
            score: nil,
            putts: nil,
            penalties: nil,
            fairway: nil
        )
        let next: DomainHoleProjection
        switch field {
        case "score":
            next = DomainHoleProjection(
                score: try event.payload.int(payloadKey),
                putts: old.putts,
                penalties: old.penalties,
                fairway: old.fairway
            )
        case "putts":
            next = DomainHoleProjection(
                score: old.score,
                putts: try event.payload.int(payloadKey),
                penalties: old.penalties,
                fairway: old.fairway
            )
        case "penalties":
            next = DomainHoleProjection(
                score: old.score,
                putts: old.putts,
                penalties: try event.payload.int(payloadKey),
                fairway: old.fairway
            )
        case "fairway":
            next = DomainHoleProjection(
                score: old.score,
                putts: old.putts,
                penalties: old.penalties,
                fairway: try event.payload.string(payloadKey)
            )
        default:
            throw DomainReducerError.invalidPayload(field)
        }
        return prepared(
            event: event,
            entityMutation: try prepareEntityMutation(
                event,
                value: value,
                authority: input.projectionOrder.authority,
                against: state
            ),
            hole: PreparedKeyedUpdate(key: key, value: next)
        )
    }

    private static func prepareFlagPosition(
        input: DomainProjectionInput,
        against state: MutableDomainProjection
    ) throws -> PreparedDomainReducerMutation {
        let event = input.event
        let hole = try event.payload.int("hole")
        let latitude = try event.payload.double("latitude")
        let longitude = try event.payload.double("longitude")
        guard (1...18).contains(hole),
              (-90...90).contains(latitude),
              (-180...180).contains(longitude),
              try event.payload.string("provenance") == "player_set" else {
            throw DomainReducerError.invalidPayload(
                "flag_position_not_player_set"
            )
        }
        return prepared(
            event: event,
            entityMutation: try prepareEntityMutation(
                event,
                value: .object(event.payload),
                authority: input.projectionOrder.authority,
                against: state
            ),
            flagPosition: PreparedKeyedUpdate(
                key: String(hole),
                value: DomainFlagPositionProjection(
                    hole: hole,
                    latitude: latitude,
                    longitude: longitude,
                    provenance: "player_set"
                )
            )
        )
    }

    private static func prepareShotTarget(
        input: DomainProjectionInput,
        against state: MutableDomainProjection
    ) throws -> PreparedDomainReducerMutation {
        let event = input.event
        let shotId = try event.payload.string("shotId")
        let targetRef = try event.payload.string("targetRef")
        let provenance = try event.payload.string("provenance")
        let latitude = try event.payload.double("latitude")
        let longitude = try event.payload.double("longitude")
        guard ["player_confirmed", "explicit_touch_target"]
                .contains(provenance),
              (-90...90).contains(latitude),
              (-180...180).contains(longitude) else {
            throw DomainReducerError.invalidPayload(
                "shot_target_not_player_confirmed"
            )
        }
        let value: JSONValue = .object([
            "shotId": .string(shotId),
            "targetRef": .string(targetRef),
            "latitude": .number(latitude),
            "longitude": .number(longitude),
            "provenance": .string(provenance),
            "retracted": .bool(false),
        ])
        return prepared(
            event: event,
            entityMutation: try prepareEntityMutation(
                event,
                value: value,
                authority: input.projectionOrder.authority,
                against: state
            ),
            shotTargets: [PreparedKeyedUpdate(
                key: shotId,
                value: DomainShotTargetProjection(
                    shotId: shotId,
                    targetRef: targetRef,
                    latitude: latitude,
                    longitude: longitude,
                    provenance: provenance,
                    orphaned: state.shots[shotId] == nil,
                    retracted: false
                )
            )]
        )
    }

    private static func prepareShotTargetRetraction(
        input: DomainProjectionInput,
        against state: MutableDomainProjection
    ) throws -> PreparedDomainReducerMutation {
        let event = input.event
        let shotId = try event.payload.string("shotId")
        guard let target = state.shotTargets[shotId],
              let entity = state.entities[event.entityRef],
              case .object(var value) = entity.value else {
            return PreparedDomainReducerMutation(conflicts: [
                try conflict(
                    event,
                    reasonCode: "shot_target_orphaned",
                    against: state
                ),
            ])
        }
        value["retracted"] = .bool(true)
        return prepared(
            event: event,
            entityMutation: try prepareEntityMutation(
                event,
                value: .object(value),
                authority: input.projectionOrder.authority,
                against: state
            ),
            shotTargets: [PreparedKeyedUpdate(
                key: shotId,
                value: DomainShotTargetProjection(
                    shotId: target.shotId,
                    targetRef: target.targetRef,
                    latitude: target.latitude,
                    longitude: target.longitude,
                    provenance: target.provenance,
                    orphaned: target.orphaned,
                    retracted: true
                )
            )]
        )
    }

    private static func prepareRecordedShot(
        input: DomainProjectionInput,
        against state: MutableDomainProjection
    ) throws -> PreparedDomainReducerMutation {
        let event = input.event
        let shotId = try event.payload.string("shotId")
        if state.shots[shotId] != nil {
            return PreparedDomainReducerMutation(conflicts: [
                try conflict(
                    event,
                    reasonCode: "shot_identity_conflict",
                    against: state
                ),
            ])
        }
        let hole = try event.payload.int("hole")
        let latitude = try event.payload.double("latitude")
        let longitude = try event.payload.double("longitude")
        let horizontal = try event.payload.nullableDouble(
            "horizontalAccuracyM"
        )
        let lie = try event.payload.string("lie")
        let provenance = try event.payload.string("provenance")
        let value: JSONValue = .object([
            "shotId": .string(shotId),
            "hole": .integer(Int64(hole)),
            "latitude": .number(latitude),
            "longitude": .number(longitude),
            "horizontalAccuracyM":
                horizontal.map { .number($0) } ?? .null,
            "lie": .string(lie),
            "provenance": .string(provenance),
            "retracted": .bool(false),
        ])
        var targetUpdates:
            [PreparedKeyedUpdate<DomainShotTargetProjection>] = []
        if let target = state.shotTargets[shotId] {
            targetUpdates.append(PreparedKeyedUpdate(
                key: shotId,
                value: DomainShotTargetProjection(
                    shotId: target.shotId,
                    targetRef: target.targetRef,
                    latitude: target.latitude,
                    longitude: target.longitude,
                    provenance: target.provenance,
                    orphaned: false,
                    retracted: target.retracted
                )
            ))
        }
        return prepared(
            event: event,
            entityMutation: try prepareCreateEntity(
                event,
                value: value,
                authority: input.projectionOrder.authority,
                against: state
            ),
            shots: [PreparedKeyedUpdate(
                key: shotId,
                value: DomainShotProjection(
                    shotId: shotId,
                    hole: hole,
                    latitude: latitude,
                    longitude: longitude,
                    horizontalAccuracyM: horizontal,
                    lie: lie,
                    provenance: provenance,
                    actualClubId: nil,
                    retracted: false
                )
            )],
            shotTargets: targetUpdates
        )
    }

    private static func prepareCorrectedShot(
        input: DomainProjectionInput,
        against state: MutableDomainProjection
    ) throws -> PreparedDomainReducerMutation {
        let event = input.event
        let shotId = try event.payload.string("shotId")
        guard let shot = state.shots[shotId],
              let current = state.entities[event.entityRef],
              case .object(var value) = current.value else {
            return PreparedDomainReducerMutation(conflicts: [
                try conflict(
                    event,
                    reasonCode: "shot_identity_conflict",
                    against: state
                ),
            ])
        }
        let patch = try event.payload.object("patch")
        for (key, child) in patch { value[key] = child }
        let horizontal = patch["horizontalAccuracyM"] == nil
            ? shot.horizontalAccuracyM
            : try patch.nullableDouble("horizontalAccuracyM")
        let latitude = patch["latitude"] == nil
            ? shot.latitude : try patch.double("latitude")
        let longitude = patch["longitude"] == nil
            ? shot.longitude : try patch.double("longitude")
        let lie = patch["lie"] == nil
            ? shot.lie : try patch.string("lie")
        let provenance = patch["provenance"] == nil
            ? shot.provenance : try patch.string("provenance")
        return prepared(
            event: event,
            entityMutation: try prepareEntityMutation(
                event,
                value: .object(value),
                authority: input.projectionOrder.authority,
                against: state
            ),
            shots: [PreparedKeyedUpdate(
                key: shotId,
                value: DomainShotProjection(
                    shotId: shot.shotId,
                    hole: shot.hole,
                    latitude: latitude,
                    longitude: longitude,
                    horizontalAccuracyM: horizontal,
                    lie: lie,
                    provenance: provenance,
                    actualClubId: shot.actualClubId,
                    retracted: shot.retracted
                )
            )]
        )
    }

    private static func prepareRetractedShot(
        input: DomainProjectionInput,
        against state: MutableDomainProjection
    ) throws -> PreparedDomainReducerMutation {
        let event = input.event
        let shotId = try event.payload.string("shotId")
        guard let shot = state.shots[shotId],
              let current = state.entities[event.entityRef],
              case .object(var value) = current.value else {
            return PreparedDomainReducerMutation(conflicts: [
                try conflict(
                    event,
                    reasonCode: "shot_identity_conflict",
                    against: state
                ),
            ])
        }
        value["retracted"] = .bool(true)
        return prepared(
            event: event,
            entityMutation: try prepareEntityMutation(
                event,
                value: .object(value),
                authority: input.projectionOrder.authority,
                against: state
            ),
            shots: [PreparedKeyedUpdate(
                key: shotId,
                value: DomainShotProjection(
                    shotId: shot.shotId,
                    hole: shot.hole,
                    latitude: shot.latitude,
                    longitude: shot.longitude,
                    horizontalAccuracyM: shot.horizontalAccuracyM,
                    lie: shot.lie,
                    provenance: shot.provenance,
                    actualClubId: shot.actualClubId,
                    retracted: true
                )
            )]
        )
    }

    private static func prepareActualClub(
        input: DomainProjectionInput,
        against state: MutableDomainProjection
    ) throws -> PreparedDomainReducerMutation {
        let event = input.event
        let value = try event.payload.required("clubId")
        if value.isUnset { return .noOp }
        let shotId = try event.payload.string("shotId")
        guard let shot = state.shots[shotId] else {
            return PreparedDomainReducerMutation(conflicts: [
                try conflict(
                    event,
                    reasonCode: "shot_identity_conflict",
                    against: state
                ),
            ])
        }
        let clubId: String?
        switch value {
        case .null:
            clubId = nil
        case .string(let value):
            clubId = value
        default:
            throw DomainReducerError.invalidPayload("clubId")
        }
        return prepared(
            event: event,
            entityMutation: try prepareEntityMutation(
                event,
                value: value,
                authority: input.projectionOrder.authority,
                against: state
            ),
            shots: [PreparedKeyedUpdate(
                key: shotId,
                value: DomainShotProjection(
                    shotId: shot.shotId,
                    hole: shot.hole,
                    latitude: shot.latitude,
                    longitude: shot.longitude,
                    horizontalAccuracyM: shot.horizontalAccuracyM,
                    lie: shot.lie,
                    provenance: shot.provenance,
                    actualClubId: clubId,
                    retracted: shot.retracted
                )
            )]
        )
    }

    private static func prepareResolutionOpened(
        input: DomainProjectionInput,
        against state: MutableDomainProjection
    ) throws -> PreparedDomainReducerMutation {
        let event = input.event
        let resolutionId = try event.payload.string("resolutionId")
        let scopeId = try event.payload.string("scopeId")
        guard state.resolutions[resolutionId] == nil,
              state.resolutionScopes[resolutionId] == nil else {
            return PreparedDomainReducerMutation(conflicts: [
                try conflict(
                    event,
                    reasonCode: "resolution_episode_conflict",
                    against: state
                ),
            ])
        }
        let currentIndex = state.resolutionScopeIndexByScopeId[scopeId]
            ?? ResolutionScopeReducerIndex(
                nonterminalCount: 0,
                activeResolutionId: nil
            )
        guard currentIndex.nonterminalCount >= 0,
              currentIndex.nonterminalCount != 0
                || currentIndex.activeResolutionId == nil else {
            throw DomainReducerError.invalidProjectionOrder
        }
        var resolutionUpdates = [PreparedKeyedUpdate(
            key: resolutionId,
            value: currentIndex.nonterminalCount == 0
                ? "active" : "conflicted"
        )]
        if let activeResolutionId = currentIndex.activeResolutionId {
            guard currentIndex.nonterminalCount == 1,
                  state.resolutions[activeResolutionId] == "active",
                  state.resolutionScopes[activeResolutionId] == scopeId else {
                throw DomainReducerError.invalidProjectionOrder
            }
            resolutionUpdates.append(PreparedKeyedUpdate(
                key: activeResolutionId,
                value: "conflicted"
            ))
        } else if currentIndex.nonterminalCount == 1 {
            throw DomainReducerError.invalidProjectionOrder
        }
        let nextIndex = ResolutionScopeReducerIndex(
            nonterminalCount: currentIndex.nonterminalCount + 1,
            activeResolutionId: currentIndex.nonterminalCount == 0
                ? resolutionId : nil
        )
        let entityMutation = try prepareEntityMutation(
            event,
            value: .object([
                "state": .string("active"),
                "scopeId": .string(scopeId),
            ]),
            authority: input.projectionOrder.authority,
            against: state
        )
        switch entityMutation {
        case .noOp:
            return .noOp
        case .conflict(let conflict):
            return PreparedDomainReducerMutation(conflicts: [conflict])
        case .applied(let entity):
            let episodeConflict = currentIndex.nonterminalCount > 0
                ? try conflict(
                    event,
                    reasonCode: "resolution_episode_conflict",
                    current: entity,
                    against: state
                  ) : nil
            return PreparedDomainReducerMutation(
                entity: PreparedKeyedUpdate(
                    key: event.entityRef,
                    value: entity
                ),
                resolutions: resolutionUpdates,
                resolutionScopes: [PreparedKeyedUpdate(
                    key: resolutionId,
                    value: scopeId
                )],
                resolutionScopeIndex: PreparedKeyedUpdate(
                    key: scopeId,
                    value: nextIndex
                ),
                conflicts: episodeConflict.map { [$0] } ?? []
            )
        }
    }

    private static func prepareResolutionClosed(
        input: DomainProjectionInput,
        against state: MutableDomainProjection
    ) throws -> PreparedDomainReducerMutation {
        let event = input.event
        let resolutionId = try event.payload.string("resolutionId")
        guard state.resolutions[resolutionId] == "active",
              let scopeId = state.resolutionScopes[resolutionId] else {
            return PreparedDomainReducerMutation(conflicts: [
                try conflict(
                    event,
                    reasonCode: "resolution_episode_conflict",
                    against: state
                ),
            ])
        }
        guard let currentIndex =
                state.resolutionScopeIndexByScopeId[scopeId],
              currentIndex.nonterminalCount == 1,
              currentIndex.activeResolutionId == resolutionId else {
            throw DomainReducerError.invalidProjectionOrder
        }
        let disposition = try event.payload.string("disposition")
        return prepared(
            event: event,
            entityMutation: try prepareEntityMutation(
                event,
                value: .object([
                    "state": .string(disposition),
                    "scopeId": .string(scopeId),
                ]),
                authority: input.projectionOrder.authority,
                against: state
            ),
            resolutions: [PreparedKeyedUpdate(
                key: resolutionId,
                value: disposition
            )],
            resolutionScopeIndex: PreparedKeyedUpdate(
                key: scopeId,
                value: ResolutionScopeReducerIndex(
                    nonterminalCount: 0,
                    activeResolutionId: nil
                )
            )
        )
    }

    private static func prepareMergeControl(
        input: DomainProjectionInput,
        against state: MutableDomainProjection
    ) throws -> PreparedDomainReducerMutation {
        let event = input.event
        let revision = try event.payload.int("revision")
        if let current = state.mergeControl,
           try current.int("revision") >= revision {
            return PreparedDomainReducerMutation(conflicts: [
                try conflict(
                    event,
                    reasonCode: "entity_base_revision_conflict",
                    against: state
                ),
            ])
        }
        return prepared(
            event: event,
            entityMutation: try prepareEntityMutation(
                event,
                value: .object(event.payload),
                authority: input.projectionOrder.authority,
                against: state
            ),
            mergeControl: event.payload
        )
    }

    static func prepare(
        input: DomainProjectionInput,
        against state: MutableDomainProjection
    ) throws -> PreparedDomainReducerMutation {
        switch input.event.kind.rawValue {
        case "round_started", "round_suspended", "round_resumed",
             "round_finished", "round_discarded":
            return try prepareLifecycle(input: input, against: state)
        case "hole_score_set":
            return try prepareHoleFact(
                input: input,
                payloadKey: "strokes",
                field: "score",
                against: state
            )
        case "putts_set":
            return try prepareHoleFact(
                input: input,
                payloadKey: "putts",
                field: "putts",
                against: state
            )
        case "penalties_set":
            return try prepareHoleFact(
                input: input,
                payloadKey: "penalties",
                field: "penalties",
                against: state
            )
        case "fairway_set":
            return try prepareHoleFact(
                input: input,
                payloadKey: "fairway",
                field: "fairway",
                against: state
            )
        case "flag_position_set":
            return try prepareFlagPosition(input: input, against: state)
        case "shot_target_set":
            return try prepareShotTarget(input: input, against: state)
        case "shot_target_retracted":
            return try prepareShotTargetRetraction(
                input: input,
                against: state
            )
        case "shot_recorded":
            return try prepareRecordedShot(input: input, against: state)
        case "shot_fact_corrected":
            return try prepareCorrectedShot(input: input, against: state)
        case "shot_retracted":
            return try prepareRetractedShot(input: input, against: state)
        case "actual_club_set":
            return try prepareActualClub(input: input, against: state)
        case "resolution_opened":
            return try prepareResolutionOpened(input: input, against: state)
        case "resolution_closed":
            return try prepareResolutionClosed(input: input, against: state)
        case "round_merge_resolution":
            return try prepareMergeControl(input: input, against: state)
        default:
            return .noOp
        }
    }
}

private enum DomainReducerInputValidation {
    static func node(
        for input: DomainProjectionInput
    ) throws -> ReducerNode {
        _ = try RoundPayloadValidator.validatePersistedOrInbound(
            input.event
        )
        let order = input.projectionOrder
        guard order.sourceOrdinal >= 0 else {
            throw DomainReducerError.invalidProjectionOrder
        }
        switch order.authority {
        case .canonicalReplay:
            guard order.ledgerPartitionId != nil,
                  order.ledgerPosition != nil else {
                throw DomainReducerError.invalidProjectionOrder
            }
        default:
            guard order.ledgerPartitionId == nil,
                  order.ledgerPosition == nil else {
                throw DomainReducerError.invalidProjectionOrder
            }
        }
        let identity = try input.event.eventIdentity()
        return ReducerNode(
            key: identity,
            identity: identity,
            eventHash: try input.event.eventHash(),
            input: input
        )
    }

    static func validateIdentityCollision(
        prior: ReducerNode,
        incoming: ReducerNode
    ) throws {
        guard prior.eventHash == incoming.eventHash else {
            throw DomainReducerError.identityEnvelopeMismatch
        }
        let priorAuthority = prior.input.projectionOrder.authority
        let incomingAuthority = incoming.input.projectionOrder.authority
        if priorAuthority == .canonicalReplay
            && incomingAuthority == .canonicalReplay {
            throw DomainReducerError.duplicateIdentity
        }
        if priorAuthority != .canonicalReplay,
           incomingAuthority != .canonicalReplay,
           priorAuthority == incomingAuthority {
            throw DomainReducerError.duplicateIdentity
        }
    }

    static func validateBaseDependency(
        _ event: DomainRoundEvent
    ) throws {
        let emptyEventSetHash = try TypedID.make(
            domain: "ContributingEventSet/v1",
            value: .object(["eventIds": .array([])])
        )
        if let base = event.baseEntityRevision,
           (base.canonicalOrdinal > 0
            || base.contributingEventSetHash != emptyEventSetHash),
           event.causationId == nil {
            throw DomainReducerError.unresolvedBaseDependency
        }
    }

    static func validateCausationPresence(
        _ event: DomainRoundEvent,
        isIdentityAvailable: (String) -> Bool,
        knownCauseIdentities: Set<String>
    ) throws {
        guard let causationId = event.causationId else { return }
        guard isIdentityAvailable(causationId)
                || knownCauseIdentities.contains(causationId) else {
            throw DomainReducerError.missingCause
        }
    }
}

final class IncrementalDomainReducerSession {
    private let state = MutableDomainProjection()
    private var branchBinding = RoundEventBranchBindingValidator.Cursor()
    private var nodesByIdentity: [String: ReducerNode] = [:]
    private var lastSourceOrdinal: Int?
    private let authority: ProjectionAuthority
    private let replication: DomainReplicationContext
    private let legacyProcessingKey: LegacyAuthorityProcessingKey?
    private let onApplyAttempt:
        @Sendable (
            LegacyAuthorityProcessingKey,
            String,
            Int
        ) -> Void

    init(
        seed: DomainRoundEvent,
        authority: ProjectionAuthority,
        replication: DomainReplicationContext,
        legacyProcessingKey: LegacyAuthorityProcessingKey? = nil,
        onApplyAttempt:
            @escaping @Sendable (
                LegacyAuthorityProcessingKey,
                String,
                Int
            ) -> Void = { _, _, _ in }
    ) throws {
        self.authority = authority
        self.replication = replication
        self.legacyProcessingKey = legacyProcessingKey
        self.onApplyAttempt = onApplyAttempt
        guard authority != .canonicalReplay else {
            throw DomainReducerError.invalidProjectionOrder
        }
        try apply(seed, sourceOrdinal: 0)
    }

    var projection: DomainRoundProjection {
        state.freeze(replication: replication)
    }

    func revision(for entityRef: String) -> EntityRevisionToken? {
        state.revision(for: entityRef)
    }

    func apply(
        _ event: DomainRoundEvent,
        sourceOrdinal: Int
    ) throws {
        guard lastSourceOrdinal.map({ sourceOrdinal > $0 }) ?? true else {
            throw DomainReducerError.invalidProjectionOrder
        }
        let input = DomainProjectionInput(
            event: event,
            projectionOrder: try DomainProjectionOrder(
                authority: authority,
                ledgerPartitionId: nil,
                ledgerPosition: nil,
                sourceOrdinal: sourceOrdinal
            )
        )
        let node = try DomainReducerInputValidation.node(for: input)
        var tentativeBranchBinding = branchBinding
        try tentativeBranchBinding.validateAndCommit(event)
        if let prior = nodesByIdentity[node.identity] {
            try DomainReducerInputValidation.validateIdentityCollision(
                prior: prior,
                incoming: node
            )
        }
        try DomainReducerInputValidation.validateBaseDependency(event)
        try DomainReducerInputValidation.validateCausationPresence(
            event,
            isIdentityAvailable: { nodesByIdentity[$0] != nil },
            knownCauseIdentities:
                replication.canonicalPrefixEventIdentities
        )
        if let legacyProcessingKey {
            onApplyAttempt(
                legacyProcessingKey,
                node.identity,
                sourceOrdinal
            )
        }
        let prepared = try DomainReducerMutationPlanner.prepare(
            input: input,
            against: state
        )
        state.commit(prepared)
        branchBinding = tentativeBranchBinding
        nodesByIdentity[node.identity] = node
        lastSourceOrdinal = sourceOrdinal
    }
}

public struct DomainRoundReducer {
    public init() {}

    private func ordered(
        _ inputs: [DomainProjectionInput],
        knownCauseIdentities: Set<String>
    ) throws -> [DomainProjectionInput] {
        let authorityRank: [ProjectionAuthority: Int] = [
            .peerProvisional: 0,
            .localPreparedResolutionCommit: 1,
            .localProvisional: 2,
            .acceptedAwaitingReplay: 3,
            .localTerminalFallback: 4,
            .canonicalReplay: 5,
        ]
        var selected: [String: ReducerNode] = [:]
        var canonicalCoordinates: Set<String> = []
        var canonicalIdentities: Set<String> = []
        try RoundEventBranchBindingValidator.validatePersistedOrReduced(
            inputs.map(\.event)
        )
        for input in inputs {
            let node = try DomainReducerInputValidation.node(for: input)
            let identity = node.identity
            if input.projectionOrder.authority == .canonicalReplay {
                guard let partition = input.projectionOrder.ledgerPartitionId,
                      let position = input.projectionOrder.ledgerPosition else {
                    throw DomainReducerError.invalidProjectionOrder
                }
                guard canonicalCoordinates.insert("\(partition):\(position.rawValue)").inserted else {
                    throw DomainReducerError.duplicateCoordinate
                }
                guard canonicalIdentities.insert(identity).inserted else {
                    throw DomainReducerError.duplicateIdentity
                }
            }
            if let prior = selected[identity] {
                try DomainReducerInputValidation.validateIdentityCollision(
                    prior: prior,
                    incoming: node
                )
                let priorAuthority = prior.input.projectionOrder.authority
                let authority = input.projectionOrder.authority
                if authorityRank[authority, default: -1]
                    > authorityRank[priorAuthority, default: -1] {
                    selected[identity] = node
                }
            } else {
                selected[identity] = node
            }
        }
        let nodes = selected
        let nodeIdentities = Set(nodes.keys)
        var incoming = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: nodes.keys.map { ($0, 0) })
        var outgoing = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: nodes.keys.map { ($0, Set<String>()) })
        func addEdge(_ before: String, _ after: String) {
            guard before != after, outgoing[before]?.contains(after) == false else { return }
            outgoing[before, default: []].insert(after)
            incoming[after, default: 0] += 1
        }
        for node in nodes.values {
            let event = node.input.event
            try DomainReducerInputValidation.validateBaseDependency(event)
            try DomainReducerInputValidation.validateCausationPresence(
                event,
                isIdentityAvailable: { nodeIdentities.contains($0) },
                knownCauseIdentities: knownCauseIdentities
            )
            if let causationId = event.causationId {
                if let cause = nodes[causationId] {
                    if node.input.projectionOrder.authority == .canonicalReplay,
                       cause.input.projectionOrder.authority != .canonicalReplay {
                        throw DomainReducerError.canonicalDependsOnProvisional
                    }
                    addEdge(cause.key, node.key)
                }
            }
        }
        let canonicalNodes = nodes.values.filter {
            $0.input.projectionOrder.authority == .canonicalReplay
        }
        for rows in Dictionary(grouping: canonicalNodes, by: {
            $0.input.projectionOrder.ledgerPartitionId!
        }).values {
            let sorted = rows.sorted {
                let left = $0.input.projectionOrder.ledgerPosition!
                let right = $1.input.projectionOrder.ledgerPosition!
                return left == right ? $0.key < $1.key : left < right
            }
            for pair in zip(sorted, sorted.dropFirst()) { addEdge(pair.0.key, pair.1.key) }
        }
        func comesBefore(_ lhs: ReducerNode, _ rhs: ReducerNode) -> Bool {
            let lhsCanonical = lhs.input.projectionOrder.authority == .canonicalReplay ? 0 : 1
            let rhsCanonical = rhs.input.projectionOrder.authority == .canonicalReplay ? 0 : 1
            if lhsCanonical != rhsCanonical { return lhsCanonical < rhsCanonical }
            if lhs.input.projectionOrder.sourceOrdinal != rhs.input.projectionOrder.sourceOrdinal {
                return lhs.input.projectionOrder.sourceOrdinal < rhs.input.projectionOrder.sourceOrdinal
            }
            if lhs.identity != rhs.identity { return lhs.identity < rhs.identity }
            return lhs.eventHash < rhs.eventHash
        }
        var ready = incoming.compactMap { $0.value == 0 ? $0.key : nil }
        var result: [DomainProjectionInput] = []
        while !ready.isEmpty {
            ready.sort { comesBefore(nodes[$0]!, nodes[$1]!) }
            let key = ready.removeFirst()
            result.append(nodes[key]!.input)
            for target in outgoing[key, default: []].sorted() {
                incoming[target, default: 0] -= 1
                if incoming[target] == 0 { ready.append(target) }
            }
        }
        guard result.count == nodes.count else { throw DomainReducerError.projectionDependencyCycle }
        return result
    }

    public func reduce(
        _ inputs: [DomainProjectionInput],
        replication: DomainReplicationContext
    ) throws -> DomainRoundProjection {
        let state = MutableDomainProjection()
        for input in try ordered(
            inputs,
            knownCauseIdentities: replication.canonicalPrefixEventIdentities
        ) {
            let prepared = try DomainReducerMutationPlanner.prepare(
                input: input,
                against: state
            )
            state.commit(prepared)
        }
        return state.freeze(replication: replication)
    }
}
```

```swift
    private func canonicalOrigin(
        for event: DomainRoundEvent,
        position: String = "1"
    ) throws -> CanonicalOriginEvidence {
        let ledgerEpoch = 1
        let streamId = "storage-v1-canonical-origin"
        let partitionId = try TypedID.make(
            domain: "LedgerPartitionId/v1",
            value: .object([
                "ownerAccountId": .string(event.ownerAccountId),
                "streamSubject": try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(
                    JSONValue.self,
                    from: CanonicalJSON.data(event.streamSubject)
                ),
                "ledgerEpoch": .string(String(ledgerEpoch)),
                "streamId": .string(streamId),
            ])
        )
        return try CanonicalOriginEvidence.make(
            event: event,
            eventIdentity: event.eventIdentity(),
            eventHash: event.eventHash(),
            ledgerPartitionId: partitionId,
            ledgerEpoch: ledgerEpoch,
            streamId: streamId,
            ledgerPosition: CanonicalLedgerPosition(position)
        )
    }

    private func mutatedCanonicalJSON(
        _ data: Data,
        mutate: (inout [String: JSONValue]) throws -> Void
    ) throws -> Data {
        let decoded = try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(
            JSONValue.self,
            from: data
        )
        guard case .object(var root) = decoded else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        try mutate(&root)
        return try CanonicalJSON.data(JSONValue.object(root))
    }

    private func lowercaseSHA256(_ data: Data) -> String {
        SHA256.hash(data: data).map {
            String(format: "%02x", $0)
        }.joined()
    }

    private func peerServerPrivateKey()
        throws -> Curve25519.Signing.PrivateKey {
        try Curve25519.Signing.PrivateKey(
            rawRepresentation: Data(repeating: 0x31, count: 32)
        )
    }

    private func peerDevicePrivateKey()
        throws -> Curve25519.Signing.PrivateKey {
        try Curve25519.Signing.PrivateKey(
            rawRepresentation: Data(repeating: 0x52, count: 32)
        )
    }

    private func peerServerTrustKeys() throws -> [String: Data] {
        [
            "peer-manifest-signer-1":
                try peerServerPrivateKey().publicKey.rawRepresentation,
        ]
    }

    private func base64URL(_ data: Data) -> String {
        data.base64EncodedString()
            .replacingOccurrences(of: "+", with: "-")
            .replacingOccurrences(of: "/", with: "_")
            .replacingOccurrences(of: "=", with: "")
    }

    private func literalBase64URL(_ value: String) throws -> String {
        guard !value.isEmpty else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        return Data(value.utf8).base64EncodedString()
            .replacingOccurrences(of: "+", with: "-")
            .replacingOccurrences(of: "/", with: "_")
            .replacingOccurrences(of: "=", with: "")
    }

    private func literalBindingKey(
        roundId: String,
        wireClientId: String,
        wireEventId: String
    ) throws -> String {
        "binding.v1.\(try literalBase64URL(roundId))."
            + "\(try literalBase64URL(wireClientId))."
            + "\(try literalBase64URL(wireEventId))"
    }

    private func literalHistoricalFixedOriginEpoch(
        roundId: String,
        wireClientId: String,
        wireEventId: String,
        normalizedWireEnvelopeHash: String
    ) throws -> String {
        let value: JSONValue = .object([
            "normalizedWireEnvelopeHash":
                .string(normalizedWireEnvelopeHash),
            "roundId": .string(roundId),
            "wireClientId": .string(wireClientId),
            "wireEventId": .string(wireEventId),
        ])
        var preimage = Data(
            "ai-caddie/legacy-fixed-synthetic/v1".utf8
        )
        preimage.append(0)
        preimage.append(try CanonicalJSON.data(value))
        return "sha256-\(lowercaseSHA256(preimage))"
    }

        fixture: StorageV1Fixture,

    private func seedAcceptedLegacyReceiptGraph(
        storageKey: String,
        event: DomainRoundEvent,
        sourceOrdinal: Int,
        state: inout DomainLedgerStateV2
    ) throws {
        let identity = try event.eventIdentity()
        let hash = try event.eventHash()
        state.legacyV1TerminalReceipts[storageKey] =
            LegacyV1EventReceipt(
                eventIdentity: identity,
                eventHash: hash,
                status: .accepted,
                serverSequence: 1
            )
        state.legacyV1AcceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay[identity] =
            LegacyV1AcceptedReplayEvidence(
                receiptStorageKey: storageKey,
                eventIdentity: identity,
                eventHash: hash
            )
        state.localProjectionInputs.append(DomainProjectionInput(
            event: event,
            projectionOrder: try DomainProjectionOrder(
                authority: .acceptedAwaitingReplay,
                ledgerPartitionId: nil,
                ledgerPosition: nil,
                sourceOrdinal: sourceOrdinal
            )
        ))
    }

    @discardableResult
    private func seedLocalOrdinaryProvenanceGraph(
        event: DomainRoundEvent,
        sourceOrdinal: Int,
        state: inout DomainLedgerStateV2
    ) throws -> (
        evidence: LocalOrdinaryOutboxEvidence,
        row: OutboxRecord,
        input: DomainProjectionInput
    ) {
        let identity = try event.eventIdentity()
        let hash = try event.eventHash()
        let evidence = try LocalOrdinaryOutboxEvidence.make(
            eventIdentity: identity,
            eventHash: hash,
            event: event,
            reservedThroughAtAppend: event.clientSequence
        )
        let row = OutboxRecord(
            event: event,
            eventIdentity: identity,
            eventHash: hash,
            source: OutboxSourceReference(
                sourceClass: .localOrdinary,
                evidenceKey: evidence.evidenceKey
            )
        )
        let input = DomainProjectionInput(
            event: event,
            projectionOrder: try DomainProjectionOrder(
                authority: .localProvisional,
                ledgerPartitionId: nil,
                ledgerPosition: nil,
                sourceOrdinal: sourceOrdinal
            )
        )
        guard state.localOrdinaryOutboxEvidence.updateValue(
                evidence,
                forKey: evidence.evidenceKey
              ) == nil else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        state.outbox.append(row)
        state.localProjectionInputs.append(input)
        return (evidence, row, input)
    }

    @discardableResult
    private func seedVerifiedPeerProvenanceGraph(
        event: DomainRoundEvent,
        sourceOrdinal: Int,
        projectionAuthority: ProjectionAuthority,
        state: inout DomainLedgerStateV2
    ) throws -> (
        evidence: VerifiedPeerBundleEvidence,
        row: OutboxRecord,
        input: DomainProjectionInput
    ) {
        guard projectionAuthority == .peerProvisional
                || projectionAuthority == .localTerminalFallback else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        let identity = try event.eventIdentity()
        let hash = try event.eventHash()
        let sourceCredentialId = "peer-credential-1"
        let credentialGeneration = 1
        let takeoverGeneration = 1
        let verifiedAt = "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
        let signerKeyId = "peer-manifest-signer-1"
        let deviceKey = try peerDevicePrivateKey()
        let signingPublicKeyRawB64u = base64URL(
            deviceKey.publicKey.rawRepresentation
        )
        let manifestIdentity: JSONValue = .object([
            "schema": .string(
                "ai-caddie-paired-device-credential-manifest-v1"
            ),
            "ownerAccountId": .string(event.ownerAccountId),
            "deviceId": .string(event.originDeviceId),
            "credentialId": .string(sourceCredentialId),
            "credentialGeneration": .integer(
                Int64(credentialGeneration)
            ),
            "deviceClass": .string("watch"),
            "state": .string("active"),
            "algorithm": .string("Ed25519"),
            "signingPublicKeyRawB64u": .string(
                signingPublicKeyRawB64u
            ),
            "issuedAt": .string(verifiedAt),
            "notBefore": .string(verifiedAt),
            "expiresAt": .string("2027-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"),
            "refreshAfter": .string("2027-01-18T00:00:00.000Z"),
            "manifestSequence": .integer(1),
            "previousManifestHash": .null,
            "signerKeyId": .string(signerKeyId),
        ])
        let manifestId = try TypedID.make(
            domain: "PairedDeviceCredentialManifest/v1",
            value: manifestIdentity
        )
        let manifestIdentityBytes = try CanonicalJSON.data(
            manifestIdentity
        )
        var manifestSignatureInput = Data(
            "paired-device-credential-manifest/v1\0".utf8
        )
        manifestSignatureInput.append(manifestIdentityBytes)
        let manifestSignature = try peerServerPrivateKey().signature(
            for: manifestSignatureInput
        )
        guard case .object(var manifestObject) = manifestIdentity else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        manifestObject["manifestId"] = .string(manifestId)
        manifestObject["signatureB64u"] = .string(
            base64URL(manifestSignature)
        )
        let rawManifest = try CanonicalJSON.data(
            JSONValue.object(manifestObject)
        )
        let rawManifestSha256 = lowercaseSHA256(rawManifest)
        let credentialRecordId = try TypedID.make(
            domain: "VerifiedPeerCredentialVerificationRecord/v1",
            value: .object([
                "ownerAccountId": .string(event.ownerAccountId),
                "sourceDeviceId": .string(event.originDeviceId),
                "sourceCredentialId": .string(sourceCredentialId),
                "credentialGeneration": .integer(
                    Int64(credentialGeneration)
                ),
                "rawManifestSha256": .string(rawManifestSha256),
                "manifestId": .string(manifestId),
                "manifestSignerKeyId": .string(signerKeyId),
                "signingPublicKeyRawB64u": .string(
                    signingPublicKeyRawB64u
                ),
                "verifiedAt": .string(verifiedAt),
            ])
        )
        let credential = VerifiedPeerCredentialVerificationRecord(
            recordId: credentialRecordId,
            ownerAccountId: event.ownerAccountId,
            sourceDeviceId: event.originDeviceId,
            sourceCredentialId: sourceCredentialId,
            credentialGeneration: credentialGeneration,
            rawManifestBase64: rawManifest.base64EncodedString(),
            rawManifestSha256: rawManifestSha256,
            manifestId: manifestId,
            manifestSignerKeyId: signerKeyId,
            signingPublicKeyRawB64u: signingPublicKeyRawB64u,
            verifiedAt: verifiedAt
        )

        let eventBytes = try CanonicalJSON.data(event)
        let bundleIdentity: JSONValue = .object([
            "schema": .string("ai-caddie-peer-ledger-bundle-v1"),
            "ownerAccountId": .string(event.ownerAccountId),
            "sourceDeviceId": .string(event.originDeviceId),
            "sourceCredentialId": .string(sourceCredentialId),
            "roundId": .string(event.roundId),
            "takeoverGeneration": .integer(Int64(takeoverGeneration)),
            "operationalEvents": .array([
                .object([
                    "canonicalEventB64u": .string(base64URL(eventBytes)),
                    "eventIdentity": .string(identity),
                    "eventHash": .string(hash),
                    "transportClass": .string("ordinary_event"),
                ]),
            ]),
            "preparedResolutionCommits": .array([]),
            "createdAt": .string(verifiedAt),
        ])
        let bundleId = try TypedID.make(
            domain: "PeerLedgerBundle/v1",
            value: bundleIdentity
        )
        let bundleIdentityBytes = try CanonicalJSON.data(bundleIdentity)
        var bundleSignatureInput = Data(
            "peer-ledger-bundle-signature/v1\0".utf8
        )
        bundleSignatureInput.append(bundleIdentityBytes)
        let bundleSignature = try deviceKey.signature(
            for: bundleSignatureInput
        )
        guard case .object(var bundleObject) = bundleIdentity else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        bundleObject["bundleId"] = .string(bundleId)
        bundleObject["signatureB64u"] = .string(
            base64URL(bundleSignature)
        )
        let rawBundle = try CanonicalJSON.data(
            JSONValue.object(bundleObject)
        )
        let bundleHash = lowercaseSHA256(rawBundle)
        let bundle = VerifiedPeerBundleAuthority(
            bundleId: bundleId,
            bundleHash: bundleHash,
            canonicalBundleBase64: rawBundle.base64EncodedString(),
            canonicalIdentityBase64:
                bundleIdentityBytes.base64EncodedString(),
            signatureB64u: base64URL(bundleSignature),
            ownerAccountId: event.ownerAccountId,
            sourceDeviceId: event.originDeviceId,
            sourceCredentialId: sourceCredentialId,
            roundId: event.roundId,
            takeoverGeneration: takeoverGeneration,
            orderedImportedEventIdentities: [identity],
            orderedImportedEventHashes: [hash],
            orderedImportedResolutionCommitIds: []
        )
        let verificationReceiptId = try TypedID.make(
            domain: "VerifiedPeerBundleVerificationReceipt/v1",
            value: .object([
                "bundleId": .string(bundleId),
                "bundleHash": .string(bundleHash),
                "credentialVerificationRecordId": .string(
                    credentialRecordId
                ),
                "verifierVersion": .string("peer-verifier-v1"),
                "verifiedAt": .string(verifiedAt),
            ])
        )
        let verification = VerifiedPeerBundleVerificationReceipt(
            receiptId: verificationReceiptId,
            bundleId: bundleId,
            bundleHash: bundleHash,
            credentialVerificationRecordId: credentialRecordId,
            verifierVersion: "peer-verifier-v1",
            verifiedAt: verifiedAt
        )
        let peerReceipt = PeerBundleReceipt(
            bundleId: bundleId,
            bundleHash: bundleHash,
            sourceDeviceId: event.originDeviceId,
            roundId: event.roundId,
            takeoverGeneration: takeoverGeneration,
            importedEventIdentities: [identity],
            importedResolutionCommitIds: [],
            credentialVerificationRecordId: credentialRecordId,
            verificationReceiptId: verificationReceiptId
        )
        let watermark = PeerTakeoverWatermark(
            sourceDeviceId: event.originDeviceId,
            roundId: event.roundId,
            takeoverGeneration: takeoverGeneration,
            bundleId: bundleId,
            bundleHash: bundleHash
        )
        let eventIndex = 0
        let evidenceKey = try TypedID.make(
            domain: "VerifiedPeerBundleOutboxEvidence/v1",
            value: .object([
                "bundleId": .string(bundleId),
                "bundleHash": .string(bundleHash),
                "ownerAccountId": .string(event.ownerAccountId),
                "sourceDeviceId": .string(event.originDeviceId),
                "sourceCredentialId": .string(sourceCredentialId),
                "roundId": .string(event.roundId),
                "takeoverGeneration": .integer(
                    Int64(takeoverGeneration)
                ),
                "eventIndex": .integer(Int64(eventIndex)),
                "eventIdentity": .string(identity),
                "eventHash": .string(hash),
                "credentialVerificationRecordId": .string(
                    credentialRecordId
                ),
                "verificationReceiptId": .string(
                    verificationReceiptId
                ),
            ])
        )
        let evidence = VerifiedPeerBundleEvidence(
            evidenceKey: evidenceKey,
            bundleId: bundleId,
            bundleHash: bundleHash,
            ownerAccountId: event.ownerAccountId,
            sourceDeviceId: event.originDeviceId,
            sourceCredentialId: sourceCredentialId,
            roundId: event.roundId,
            takeoverGeneration: takeoverGeneration,
            eventIndex: eventIndex,
            eventIdentity: identity,
            eventHash: hash,
            credentialVerificationRecordId: credentialRecordId,
            verificationReceiptId: verificationReceiptId
        )
        let row = OutboxRecord(
            event: event,
            eventIdentity: identity,
            eventHash: hash,
            source: OutboxSourceReference(
                sourceClass: .verifiedPeerBundle,
                evidenceKey: evidence.evidenceKey
            )
        )
        let input = DomainProjectionInput(
            event: event,
            projectionOrder: try DomainProjectionOrder(
                authority: projectionAuthority,
                ledgerPartitionId: nil,
                ledgerPosition: nil,
                sourceOrdinal: sourceOrdinal
            )
        )
        guard state.verifiedPeerBundleAuthorities.updateValue(
                bundle,
                forKey: bundleId
              ) == nil,
              state.verifiedPeerCredentialVerificationRecords.updateValue(
                credential,
                forKey: credentialRecordId
              ) == nil,
              state.verifiedPeerBundleVerificationReceipts.updateValue(
                verification,
                forKey: verificationReceiptId
              ) == nil,
              state.peerBundleReceipts.updateValue(
                peerReceipt,
                forKey: bundleId
              ) == nil,
              state.peerTakeoverWatermarks.updateValue(
                watermark,
                forKey: "\(event.originDeviceId)|\(event.roundId)"
              ) == nil,
              state.verifiedPeerBundleEvidence.updateValue(
                evidence,
                forKey: evidence.evidenceKey
              ) == nil else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        state.outbox.append(row)
        state.localProjectionInputs.append(input)
        return (evidence, row, input)
    }

    private func assertValidStorageV1DestinationCollisionRollsBack(
        fixture: StorageV1Fixture,
        store: inout DomainLedgerStore?,
        mutation: String
    ) throws {
        let pending = try onlyPendingStorageV1(state(fixture))
        let authorityId = pending.authorityId
        try XCTUnwrap(store).validateStorageV2()
        let before = try stateBytes(fixture)
        store = nil
        let recorder = LegacyAuthorityProcessingRecorder()

        XCTAssertThrowsError(
            try LegacyAuthorityProcessingObserverScope.$current
                .withValue(recorder.observers) {
                    try restartStorageV1(fixture)
                },
            mutation
        ) { error in
            XCTAssertEqual(
                error as? DomainLedgerError,
                .storageInvariantViolation,
                mutation
            )
        }

        let observation = recorder.observation()
        XCTAssertEqual(
            observation.classificationBuiltTotal,
            1,
            mutation
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(observation.applyAttemptTotal, 4, mutation)
        XCTAssertEqual(observation.applyAttempts.count, 4, mutation)
        XCTAssertTrue(
            observation.applyAttempts.values.allSatisfy { $0 == 1 },
            mutation
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(try stateBytes(fixture), before, mutation)
        let after = try state(fixture)
        XCTAssertEqual(
            after.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations[authorityId],
            pending,
            mutation
        )
        XCTAssertNil(
            after.completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations[authorityId],
            mutation
        )
        XCTAssertTrue(
            after.completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations.isEmpty,
            mutation
        )
    }

    private func copiedRoundStart(
        _ source: DomainRoundEvent,
        eventId: String? = nil,
        clientSequence: Int? = nil,
        profileId: String? = nil
    ) throws -> DomainRoundEvent {
        guard case .object(var install)? =
                source.payload["deviceRoundInstallBinding"] else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        if let profileId {
            install["profileId"] = .string(profileId)
        }
        return DomainRoundEvent(
            eventId: eventId ?? source.eventId,
            originDeviceId: source.originDeviceId,
            originEpoch: source.originEpoch,
            clientSequence:
                clientSequence ?? source.clientSequence,
            ownerAccountId: source.ownerAccountId,
            subjectPlayerId: source.subjectPlayerId,
            actorId: source.actorId,
            roundId: source.roundId,
            streamSubject: source.streamSubject,
            roundIntentId: source.roundIntentId,
            snapshotId: source.snapshotId,
            roundSemanticBindingHash:
                source.roundSemanticBindingHash,
            kind: source.kind,
            entityRef: source.entityRef,
            payload: [
                "deviceRoundInstallBinding": .object(install),
            ],
            causationId: source.causationId,
            baseEntityRevision: source.baseEntityRevision,
            occurredAt: source.occurredAt,
            transactionRef: source.transactionRef,
            schemaVersion: source.schemaVersion
        )
    }

    private func installPendingIOSFixture(
        _ fixture: Fixture
    ) throws -> String {
        let snapshot = try validatedSnapshot(
            authorityData: fixture.authorityData,
            authorityKind:
                LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator.iosEventsAuthorityKind
        )
        try installPendingSnapshots([snapshot], fixture: fixture)
        return snapshot.authority.authorityId
    }

    private func onlyAuthorityId(
        _ current: DomainLedgerStateV2
    ) throws -> String {
        XCTAssertEqual(current.sealedLegacyAuthorities.count, 1)
        return try XCTUnwrap(
            current.sealedLegacyAuthorities.keys.first
        )
    }

    func testIOSFixedRootCaptureStaysPendingWithoutDurableRoundStart()
        throws {
        let fixture = try fixture(roundIds: [roundA])
        let sourceURL = fixture.applicationSupportRoot
            .appendingPathComponent("events.jsonl")
        try FileManager.default.removeItem(at: sourceURL)
        _ = try openFixedRoot(fixture)

        let absent = try state(fixture)
        XCTAssertTrue(absent.sealedLegacyAuthorities.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(
            absent.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations.isEmpty
        )
        XCTAssertTrue(
            absent.completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations.isEmpty
        )
        XCTAssertTrue(absent.legacyTransportEvidence.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(absent.sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(absent.migrationMarkers.isEmpty)

        try fixture.authorityData.write(
            to: sourceURL,
            options: [.atomic]
        )
        _ = try openFixedRoot(fixture)
        let captured = try state(fixture)
        let authorityId = try onlyAuthorityId(captured)
        XCTAssertNotNil(
            captured.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations[authorityId]
        )
        XCTAssertNil(
            captured.completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations[authorityId]
        )
        XCTAssertTrue(captured.events.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(captured.outbox.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(captured.localProjectionInputs.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(captured.legacyTransportEvidence.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(captured.sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(captured.migrationDeadLetters.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(captured.migrationMarkers.isEmpty)
        let pendingBytes = try stateBytes(fixture)
        let recorder = LegacyAuthorityProcessingRecorder()

        _ = try LegacyAuthorityProcessingObserverScope.$current.withValue(
            recorder.observers
        ) {
            try openFixedRoot(fixture)
        }

        XCTAssertEqual(try stateBytes(fixture), pendingBytes)
        let retried = try state(fixture)
        XCTAssertEqual(retried.sealedLegacyAuthorities.count, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(
            retried.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations.count,
            1
        )
        XCTAssertNotNil(
            retried.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations[authorityId]
        )
        XCTAssertTrue(
            retried.completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations.isEmpty
        )
        XCTAssertTrue(retried.legacyTransportEvidence.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(retried.sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(retried.migrationMarkers.isEmpty)
        let observation = recorder.observation()
        XCTAssertEqual(observation.classificationBuiltTotal, 0)
        XCTAssertEqual(observation.applyAttemptTotal, 0)
    }

    func testIOSFixedRootCompletesWholeAuthorityAfterEveryRequiredRoundStartExists()
        throws {
        let fixture = try fixture(roundIds: [roundA, roundB])
        let ledger = try openLedger(fixture)
        try appendRoundStart(roundId: roundA, to: ledger, second: 1)
        try appendRoundStart(roundId: roundB, to: ledger, second: 2)

        _ = try openFixedRoot(fixture)

        let current = try state(fixture)
        let authorityId = try onlyAuthorityId(current)
        XCTAssertNil(
            current.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations[authorityId]
        )
        let completed = try XCTUnwrap(
            current.completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations[authorityId]
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(
            completed.sourceRecords.map(\.sourceRecordId),
            completed.terminalDispositions.map(\.sourceRecordId)
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(
            Set(current.events.map(\.eventId)),
            Set([
                "legacy-1", "legacy-2",
                current.events.first {
                    $0.kind == .roundStarted && $0.roundId == roundA
                }!.eventId,
                current.events.first {
                    $0.kind == .roundStarted && $0.roundId == roundB
                }!.eventId,
            ])
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(
            completed.terminalDispositions.map(\.disposition),
            [.importedEvent, .importedEvent]
        )
    }

    func testCachedCompositionRootOpenResumesEligiblePendingAuthority()
        throws {
        let fixture = try fixture(roundIds: [roundA])
        let cached = try openLedger(fixture)
        try appendRoundStart(roundId: roundA, to: cached, second: 1)
        let authorityId = try installPendingIOSFixture(fixture)
        XCTAssertNotNil(

        )

        )

            current.completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations[authorityId]
        )

        )
    }

            roundId: roundA,

        )

        )

        )

        throws {
        let firstData = Data(#"{"eventId":"ios-overlap-a","roundId":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","timestamp":"2026-07-18T00:00:00Z","hole":1,"kind":"future_kind","payload":{"opaque":"first"}}"#.utf8)
```
