```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieTests/SyncClientTests.swift
// Append to the file's existing `final class SyncClientTests: XCTestCase`.
import XCTest
@testable import AICaddie
@testable import AICaddieDomain

extension SyncClientTests {
private struct MockRoundSyncTransport: RoundSyncTransport {
    let makeReceipts: @Sendable (PreparedEventWriteRequest) throws -> [EventReceipt]

    func post(_ request: PreparedEventWriteRequest) async throws -> ValidatedEventWriteResponse {
        let response = EventWriteResponseV2(
            schema: "ai-caddie-event-write-response-v2",
            requestHash: request.requestHash,
            requestBodySha256: request.requestBodySha256,
            eventCount: request.slots.count,
            receipts: try makeReceipts(request)
        )
        return try EventWriteResponseValidator.validate(
            rawResponse: CanonicalJSON.data(response),
            request: request
        )
    }
    func bootstrap(roundId: String, consumerEpoch: String) async throws -> DeviceSyncBootstrap {
        DeviceSyncBootstrap(
            roundId: roundId, consumerDeviceId: "ios-1", consumerEpoch: consumerEpoch,
            mergeControlGeneration: 0, mergeResolutionId: nil, streams: [],
            mergedCheckpointHash: "empty"
        )
    }
    func replay(roundId: String, stream: DeviceSyncStream, vectorGeneration: Int, after: CanonicalLedgerPosition, limit: Int) async throws -> DeviceReplayPage {
        DeviceReplayPage(
            ledgerPartitionId: stream.ledgerPartitionId, ledgerEpoch: stream.ledgerEpoch,
            streamId: stream.streamId, fromExclusive: after, throughInclusive: after,
            events: [], nextCursor: nil, hasMore: false,
            checkpointHash: stream.checkpointHash, ackCheckpointHash: "prefix-empty",
            mergeControlGeneration: vectorGeneration, mergeResolutionId: nil
        )
    }
    func ack(roundId: String, stream: DeviceSyncStream, vectorGeneration: Int, through position: CanonicalLedgerPosition, ackCheckpointHash: String, consumerEpoch: String) async throws {}
}

func testStartedBranchDeferredReceiptStaysPendingAndAcceptedReceiptsAreRemoved() async throws {
    let directory = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
    addTeardownBlock {
        DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: directory)
        try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: directory)
    }
    let store = try DomainLedgerTestHarness.open(directoryURL: directory)
    let roundId = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
    let builder = DomainEventBuilder.fixture(roundId: roundId, ledger: store)
    let start = try builder.make(
        kind: .roundStarted,
        entityRef: "round:\(roundId)",
        payload: [
            "deviceRoundInstallBinding": builder.context
                .deviceRoundInstallBinding,
        ],
        baseRevision: nil,
        occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
    )
    try store.append(start)
    let puttsEntity = "round:\(roundId):hole:1:putts"
    let deferred = try builder.make(
        kind: .puttsSet,
        entityRef: puttsEntity,
        payload: ["hole": .integer(1), "putts": .integer(2)],
        baseRevision: .absent(scopeId: puttsEntity),
        occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:01.000Z"
    )
    let scoreEntity = "round:\(roundId):hole:1:score"
    let accepted = try builder.make(
        kind: .holeScoreSet,
        entityRef: scoreEntity,
        payload: ["hole": .integer(1), "strokes": .integer(4)],
        baseRevision: .absent(scopeId: scoreEntity),
        occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:02.000Z"
    )
    try store.append(deferred)
    try store.append(accepted)
    let transport = MockRoundSyncTransport { request in
        try request.slots.enumerated().map { index, slot in
            let isDeferred = slot.event.eventId == deferred.eventId
            let acceptedPosition = slot.event.kind == .roundStarted ? "1" : "2"
            let ledgerPosition: CanonicalLedgerPosition?
            if isDeferred {
                ledgerPosition = nil
            } else {
                ledgerPosition = try CanonicalLedgerPosition(acceptedPosition)
            }
            return EventReceipt(
                eventId: slot.event.eventId,
                eventIdentity: slot.eventIdentity,
                eventHash: slot.eventHash,
                inputIndex: index,
                status: isDeferred ? .deferred : .accepted,
                ledgerPartitionId: isDeferred
                    ? nil : String(repeating: "a", count: 64),
                ledgerEpoch: isDeferred ? nil : 1,
                streamId: isDeferred ? nil : "s1",
                ledgerPosition: ledgerPosition,
                currentEntityRevision: nil,
                reasonCode: nil
            )
        }
    }
    let epochStore = try ConsumerEpochStore(url: directory.appendingPathComponent("consumer-epoch"))
    let client = try RoundLedgerSyncClient(
        baseURL: URL(string: "https://example.invalid")!, ledger: store,
        transport: transport, consumerEpochStore: epochStore,
        principal: RoundSyncPrincipal(
            ownerAccountId: "acct-1",
            subjectPlayerId: "player-1",
            actorId: "player-1"
        )
    )
    try await client.flushOutbox(roundId: roundId)
    XCTAssertEqual(try store.pendingEventIds(), [deferred.eventId])
    let replication = try store.replicationContext(
        roundId: roundId
    )
    XCTAssertEqual(replication.awaitingCanonicalReplayCount, 2)
}

func testResponseLostThenReplayThenDuplicateReceiptTerminalizesWithoutAwaiting() throws {
    let directory = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory
        .appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
    addTeardownBlock {
        DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: directory)
        try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: directory)
    }
    let ledger = try DomainLedgerTestHarness.open(directoryURL: directory)
    let roundId = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
    let builder = DomainEventBuilder.fixture(roundId: roundId, ledger: ledger)
    let start = try builder.make(
        kind: .roundStarted,
        entityRef: "round:\(roundId)",
        payload: [
            "deviceRoundInstallBinding": builder.context
                .deviceRoundInstallBinding,
        ],
        baseRevision: nil,
        occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
    )
    try ledger.append(start)
    let scoreEntity = "round:\(roundId):hole:1:score"
    let score = try builder.make(
        kind: .holeScoreSet,
        entityRef: scoreEntity,
        payload: ["hole": .integer(1), "strokes": .integer(4)],
        baseRevision: .absent(scopeId: scoreEntity),
        occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:01.000Z"
    )
    try ledger.append(score)
    let request = try XCTUnwrap(
        ledger.prepareEventWriteRequest(roundId: roundId)
    )
    XCTAssertEqual(request.slots.count, 2)

    let partition = String(repeating: "a", count: 64)
    let stream = DeviceSyncStream(
        streamSubject: .roundIncarnation(builder.context.roundIncarnationId),
        ledgerPartitionId: partition,
        ledgerEpoch: 1,
        streamId: "stream-a",
        lastAckedPosition: try CanonicalLedgerPosition("0"),
        replayCursor: try CanonicalLedgerPosition("0"),
        checkpointHash: "head-0",
        sourceOrdinal: 0
    )
    try ledger.adoptBootstrap(DeviceSyncBootstrap(
        roundId: roundId,
        consumerDeviceId: "ios-1",
        consumerEpoch: "consumer-1",
        mergeControlGeneration: 1,
        mergeResolutionId: "r1",
        streams: [stream],
        mergedCheckpointHash: "merged-1"
    ))
    func replayPage(
        event: DomainRoundEvent,
        from: Int,
        position: Int
    ) throws -> DeviceReplayPage {
        DeviceReplayPage(
            ledgerPartitionId: partition,
            ledgerEpoch: 1,
            streamId: "stream-a",
            fromExclusive: try CanonicalLedgerPosition(String(from)),
            throughInclusive: try CanonicalLedgerPosition(String(position)),
            events: [DomainProjectionInput(
                event: event,
                projectionOrder: try DomainProjectionOrder(
                    authority: .canonicalReplay,
                    ledgerPartitionId: partition,
                    ledgerPosition: try CanonicalLedgerPosition(
                        String(position)
                    ),
                    sourceOrdinal: 0
                )
            )],
            nextCursor: nil,
            hasMore: false,
            checkpointHash: "head-\(position)",
            ackCheckpointHash: "prefix-\(position)",
            mergeControlGeneration: 1,
            mergeResolutionId: "r1"
        )
    }
    let principal = RoundSyncPrincipal(
        ownerAccountId: builder.context.ownerAccountId,
        subjectPlayerId: builder.context.subjectPlayerId,
        actorId: builder.context.actorId
    )
    try ledger.persistInbound(
        replayPage(event: start, from: 0, position: 1),
        stream: stream,
        roundId: roundId,
        principal: principal
    )
    try ledger.persistInbound(
        replayPage(event: score, from: 1, position: 2),
        stream: stream,
        roundId: roundId,
        principal: principal
    )
    XCTAssertEqual(Set(try ledger.pendingEventIds()), Set([
        start.eventId, score.eventId,
    ]))

    let receipts = try request.slots.enumerated().map { index, slot in
        EventReceipt(
            eventId: slot.event.eventId,
            eventIdentity: slot.eventIdentity,
            eventHash: slot.eventHash,
            inputIndex: index,
            status: .duplicateHashMatch,
            ledgerPartitionId: partition,
            ledgerEpoch: 1,
            streamId: "stream-a",
            ledgerPosition: try CanonicalLedgerPosition(String(index + 1)),
            currentEntityRevision: nil,
            reasonCode: nil
        )
    }
    let validated = try EventWriteResponseValidator.validate(
        rawResponse: CanonicalJSON.data(EventWriteResponseV2(
            schema: "ai-caddie-event-write-response-v2",
            requestHash: request.requestHash,
            requestBodySha256: request.requestBodySha256,
            eventCount: request.slots.count,
            receipts: receipts
        )),
        request: request
    )
    try ledger.apply(validatedResponse: validated)
    XCTAssertTrue(try ledger.pendingEventIds().isEmpty)
    XCTAssertEqual(
        try ledger.replicationContext(roundId: roundId)
            .awaitingCanonicalReplayCount,
        0
    )
    XCTAssertEqual(
        try ledger.projectionInputs(roundId: roundId)
            .map(\.projectionOrder.authority),
        [.canonicalReplay, .canonicalReplay]
    )

    DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: directory)
    let restarted = try DomainLedgerTestHarness.open(directoryURL: directory)
    XCTAssertTrue(try restarted.pendingEventIds().isEmpty)
    XCTAssertEqual(
        try restarted.replicationContext(roundId: roundId)
            .awaitingCanonicalReplayCount,
        0
    )
}
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieTests/DomainLedgerInboundVectorTests.swift
@testable import AICaddieDomain
import XCTest
@testable import AICaddie

final class DomainLedgerInboundVectorTests: XCTestCase {
    private let roundId = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
    private let principal = RoundSyncPrincipal(
        ownerAccountId: "acct-1",
        subjectPlayerId: "player-1",
        actorId: "player-1"
    )

    private func partitionId(_ label: String) -> String {
        String(repeating: label == "a" ? "a" : label == "b" ? "b" : "c", count: 64)
    }

    private func stream(_ partition: String, ordinal: Int) -> DeviceSyncStream {
        DeviceSyncStream(
            streamSubject: .roundIncarnation("inc-\(partition)"),
            ledgerPartitionId: partitionId(partition), ledgerEpoch: 1, streamId: "stream-\(partition)",
            lastAckedPosition: try! CanonicalLedgerPosition("0"),
            replayCursor: try! CanonicalLedgerPosition("0"),
            checkpointHash: "head-\(partition)", sourceOrdinal: ordinal
        )
    }

    private func bootstrap(
        generation: Int,
        resolution: String,
        streams: [DeviceSyncStream],
        syncRoundId: String? = nil
    ) -> DeviceSyncBootstrap {
        DeviceSyncBootstrap(
            roundId: syncRoundId ?? roundId,
            consumerDeviceId: "ios-1", consumerEpoch: "epoch-1",
            mergeControlGeneration: generation, mergeResolutionId: resolution,
            streams: streams, mergedCheckpointHash: "merged-\(generation)"
        )
    }

    private func originDeviceId(partition: String) -> String {
        "server-\(partition)"
    }

    private func originEpoch(partition: String) -> String {
        "epoch-\(partition)"
    }

    private func event(
        _ id: String,
        partition: String,
        ordinal: Int,
        eventRoundId: String? = nil
    ) -> DomainRoundEvent {
        let boundRoundId = eventRoundId ?? roundId
        return DomainRoundEvent(
            eventId: id,
            originDeviceId: originDeviceId(partition: partition),
            originEpoch: originEpoch(partition: partition),
            clientSequence: 2,
            ownerAccountId: "acct-1", subjectPlayerId: "player-1", actorId: "player-1",
            roundId: boundRoundId, streamSubject: .roundIncarnation("inc-\(partition)"),
            roundIntentId: "intent-1",
            snapshotId: "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111",
            roundSemanticBindingHash: "485bf215ad28efe7b626e1083702e0c7250230c17f5bb879e69ede3d433a6d58",
            kind: .holeScoreSet,
            entityRef: "round:\(boundRoundId):hole:\(ordinal + 1):score",
            payload: ["hole": .integer(Int64(ordinal + 1)), "strokes": .integer(4)],
            causationId: nil,
            baseEntityRevision: .absent(scopeId: "round:\(boundRoundId):hole:\(ordinal + 1):score"),
            occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
        )
    }

    private func started(
        partition: String,
        eventRoundId: String? = nil,
        eventId: String? = nil,
        clientSequence: Int = 1
    ) -> DomainRoundEvent {
        let boundRoundId = eventRoundId ?? roundId
        return DomainRoundEvent(
            eventId: eventId ?? "start-\(partition)",
            originDeviceId: originDeviceId(partition: partition),
            originEpoch: originEpoch(partition: partition),
            clientSequence: clientSequence,
            ownerAccountId: "acct-1", subjectPlayerId: "player-1", actorId: "player-1",
            roundId: boundRoundId, streamSubject: .roundIncarnation("inc-\(partition)"),
            roundIntentId: "intent-1",
            snapshotId: "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111",
            roundSemanticBindingHash: "485bf215ad28efe7b626e1083702e0c7250230c17f5bb879e69ede3d433a6d58",
            kind: .roundStarted,
            entityRef: "round:\(boundRoundId)",
            payload: ["deviceRoundInstallBinding": .object([
                "deviceId": .string(originDeviceId(partition: partition)),
                "installAckId": .string("6666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666"),
                "installInstanceId": .string("9a3d4f6b-2c71-4e85-9b06-1f2a3c4d5e6f"),
                "installManifestId": .string("7777777777777777777777777777777777777777777777777777777777777777"),
                "snapshotId": .string("1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111"),
                "profileId": .string("watch-18"),
                "courseLayoutIdentityId": .string("layout-1"),
                "layoutRevisionId": .string("layout-r1"),
                "teeSelectionId": .string("tee-1"),
                "liveRoundPackageId": .string("5555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555"),
                "verifiedAt": .string("2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"),
            ])],
            causationId: nil, baseEntityRevision: nil,
            occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
        )
    }

    private func future(partition: String) -> DomainRoundEvent {
        DomainRoundEvent(
            eventId: "future-\(partition)",
            originDeviceId: originDeviceId(partition: partition),
            originEpoch: originEpoch(partition: partition),
            clientSequence: 2,
            ownerAccountId: "acct-1",
            subjectPlayerId: "player-1",
            actorId: "player-1",
            roundId: roundId,
            streamSubject: .roundIncarnation("inc-\(partition)"),
            roundIntentId: "intent-1",
            snapshotId: "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111",
            roundSemanticBindingHash: "485bf215ad28efe7b626e1083702e0c7250230c17f5bb879e69ede3d433a6d58",
            kind: RoundEventKind(rawValue: "future_kind"),
            entityRef: "opaque:\(roundId):future-\(partition)",
            payload: ["futureField": .string("kept")],
            causationId: nil,
            baseEntityRevision: nil,
            occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:01.000Z"
        )
    }

    private func page(
        stream: DeviceSyncStream,
        generation: Int,
        resolution: String,
        event: DomainRoundEvent?,
        from: Int = 0,
        eventPosition: Int? = nil
    ) -> DeviceReplayPage {
        let position = eventPosition ?? (from + 1)
        let events = event.map { value in
            [DomainProjectionInput(
                event: value,
                projectionOrder: try! DomainProjectionOrder(
                    authority: .canonicalReplay,
                    ledgerPartitionId: stream.ledgerPartitionId,
                    ledgerPosition: try! CanonicalLedgerPosition(String(position)),
                    sourceOrdinal: stream.sourceOrdinal
                )
            )]
        } ?? []
        let through = event == nil ? from : max(from, position)
        return DeviceReplayPage(
            ledgerPartitionId: stream.ledgerPartitionId, ledgerEpoch: stream.ledgerEpoch,
            streamId: stream.streamId,
            fromExclusive: try! CanonicalLedgerPosition(String(from)),
            throughInclusive: try! CanonicalLedgerPosition(String(through)),
            events: events, nextCursor: nil, hasMore: false,
            checkpointHash: "head-\(stream.ledgerPartitionId)-\(through)",
            ackCheckpointHash: "prefix-\(generation)-\(stream.ledgerPartitionId)-\(through)",
            mergeControlGeneration: generation, mergeResolutionId: resolution
        )
    }

    func testCanonicalFutureKindInboundPersistsAndReducerTreatsItAsOpaqueNoOp() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory
            .appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        addTeardownBlock {
            DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: root)
            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root)
        }
        let ledger = try DomainLedgerTestHarness.open(directoryURL: root)
        let source = stream("a", ordinal: 0)
        try ledger.adoptBootstrap(bootstrap(
            generation: 1,
            resolution: "r1",
            streams: [source]
        ))
        try ledger.persistInbound(
            page(
                stream: source,
                generation: 1,
                resolution: "r1",
                event: started(partition: "a")
            ),
            stream: source,
            roundId: roundId,
            principal: principal
        )
        let before = try DomainRoundReducer().reduce(
            ledger.projectionInputs(roundId: roundId),
            replication: ledger.replicationContext(roundId: roundId)
        )

        try ledger.persistInbound(
            page(
                stream: source,
                generation: 1,
                resolution: "r1",
                event: future(partition: "a"),
                from: 1
            ),
            stream: source,
            roundId: roundId,
            principal: principal
        )
        let after = try DomainRoundReducer().reduce(
            ledger.projectionInputs(roundId: roundId),
            replication: ledger.replicationContext(roundId: roundId)
        )

        XCTAssertEqual(after, before)
        XCTAssertEqual(
            try ledger.allEvents().filter {
                $0.kind.rawValue == "future_kind"
            }.map(\.eventId),
            ["future-a"]
        )
    }

    func testHigherPositionSecondStartIsRejectedButExactCoordinateReplayIsIdempotent() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory
            .appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        addTeardownBlock {
            DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: root)
            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root)
        }
        let ledger = try DomainLedgerTestHarness.open(directoryURL: root)
        let source = stream("a", ordinal: 0)
        try ledger.adoptBootstrap(bootstrap(
            generation: 1,
            resolution: "r1",
            streams: [source]
        ))
        let firstStart = started(partition: "a")
        try ledger.persistInbound(
            page(
                stream: source,
                generation: 1,
                resolution: "r1",
                event: firstStart
            ),
            stream: source,
            roundId: roundId,
            principal: principal
        )

        try ledger.persistInbound(
            page(
                stream: source,
                generation: 1,
                resolution: "r1",
                event: firstStart,
                from: 1,
                eventPosition: 1
            ),
            stream: source,
            roundId: roundId,
            principal: principal
        )
        let eventsBefore = try ledger.allEvents()
        let inputsBefore = try ledger.projectionInputs(roundId: roundId)
        let replacement = started(
            partition: "a",
            eventId: "start-a-replacement",
            clientSequence: 3
        )
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try ledger.persistInbound(
            page(
                stream: source,
                generation: 1,
                resolution: "r1",
                event: replacement,
                from: 1
            ),
            stream: source,
            roundId: roundId,
            principal: principal
        )) { error in
            XCTAssertEqual(error as? DomainLedgerError, .roundStartConflict)
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(try ledger.allEvents(), eventsBefore)
        XCTAssertEqual(
            try ledger.projectionInputs(roundId: roundId),
            inputsBefore
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(
            try ledger.inboundPersistedThrough(
                roundId: roundId,
                partitionId: source.ledgerPartitionId
            ),
            try CanonicalLedgerPosition("1")
        )
    }

    func testUnmergeRemovesAAndRewritesRetainedBOrdinalAtomically() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        addTeardownBlock {
            DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: root)
            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root)
        }
        let ledger = try DomainLedgerTestHarness.open(directoryURL: root)
        let a = stream("a", ordinal: 0)
        let b = stream("b", ordinal: 1)
        try ledger.adoptBootstrap(bootstrap(generation: 1, resolution: "r1", streams: [a, b]))
        try ledger.persistInbound(page(stream: a, generation: 1, resolution: "r1", event: started(partition: "a")), stream: a, roundId: roundId, principal: principal)
        try ledger.persistInbound(page(stream: a, generation: 1, resolution: "r1", event: event("a1", partition: "a", ordinal: 0), from: 1), stream: a, roundId: roundId, principal: principal)
        try ledger.persistInbound(page(stream: b, generation: 1, resolution: "r1", event: started(partition: "b")), stream: b, roundId: roundId, principal: principal)
        try ledger.persistInbound(page(stream: b, generation: 1, resolution: "r1", event: event("b1", partition: "b", ordinal: 1), from: 1), stream: b, roundId: roundId, principal: principal)

        let retainedB = stream("b", ordinal: 0)
        try ledger.adoptBootstrap(bootstrap(generation: 2, resolution: "r2", streams: [retainedB]))
        let inputs = try ledger.projectionInputs(roundId: roundId).filter {
            $0.event.kind == .holeScoreSet
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(inputs.map { $0.event.eventId }, ["b1"])
        XCTAssertEqual(inputs.map { $0.projectionOrder.sourceOrdinal }, [0])
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try ledger.inboundAckCheckpointHash(
            roundId: roundId, partitionId: retainedB.ledgerPartitionId, mergeControlGeneration: 1
        ))
    }

    func testReorderRewritesBothOrdinalsAndRejectsStaleGenerationPage() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        addTeardownBlock {
            DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: root)
            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root)
        }
        let ledger = try DomainLedgerTestHarness.open(directoryURL: root)
        let a = stream("a", ordinal: 0)
        let b = stream("b", ordinal: 1)
        try ledger.adoptBootstrap(bootstrap(generation: 7, resolution: "r7", streams: [a, b]))
        try ledger.persistInbound(page(stream: a, generation: 7, resolution: "r7", event: started(partition: "a")), stream: a, roundId: roundId, principal: principal)
        try ledger.persistInbound(page(stream: a, generation: 7, resolution: "r7", event: event("a1", partition: "a", ordinal: 0), from: 1), stream: a, roundId: roundId, principal: principal)
        try ledger.persistInbound(page(stream: b, generation: 7, resolution: "r7", event: started(partition: "b")), stream: b, roundId: roundId, principal: principal)
        try ledger.persistInbound(page(stream: b, generation: 7, resolution: "r7", event: event("b1", partition: "b", ordinal: 1), from: 1), stream: b, roundId: roundId, principal: principal)

        let reorderedB = stream("b", ordinal: 0)
        let reorderedA = stream("a", ordinal: 1)
        try ledger.adoptBootstrap(bootstrap(generation: 8, resolution: "r8", streams: [reorderedB, reorderedA]))
        let byId = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: try ledger.projectionInputs(roundId: roundId).filter {
            $0.event.kind == .holeScoreSet
        }.map {
            ($0.event.eventId, $0.projectionOrder.sourceOrdinal)
        })
        XCTAssertEqual(byId, ["a1": 1, "b1": 0])
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try ledger.persistInbound(
            page(stream: a, generation: 7, resolution: "r7", event: nil, from: 2),
            stream: a, roundId: roundId, principal: principal
        ))

        // Replaying an empty page under generation 8 creates a fresh immutable
        // prefix token; the generation-7 token was cleared during adoption.
        try ledger.persistInbound(
            page(stream: reorderedA, generation: 8, resolution: "r8", event: nil, from: 2),
            stream: reorderedA, roundId: roundId, principal: principal
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(
            try ledger.inboundAckCheckpointHash(
                roundId: roundId, partitionId: reorderedA.ledgerPartitionId, mergeControlGeneration: 8
            ),
            "prefix-8-\(reorderedA.ledgerPartitionId)-2"
        )
    }

    func testSamePartitionHasIndependentStandaloneAndMergedMaterializationCursors() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        addTeardownBlock {
            DomainLedgerTestHarness.release(directoryURL: root)
            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root)
        }
        let ledger = try DomainLedgerTestHarness.open(directoryURL: root)
        let sourceRoundId = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
        let shared = stream("shared", ordinal: 0)
        let sharedStart = started(
            partition: "shared",
            eventRoundId: sourceRoundId
        )
        let sharedScore = event(
            "source-1",
            partition: "shared",
            ordinal: 0,
            eventRoundId: sourceRoundId
        )

        try ledger.adoptBootstrap(bootstrap(
            generation: 0, resolution: "standalone", streams: [shared],
            syncRoundId: sourceRoundId
        ))
        try ledger.persistInbound(
            page(
                stream: shared,
                generation: 0,
                resolution: "standalone",
                event: sharedStart
            ),
            stream: shared, roundId: sourceRoundId, principal: principal
        )
        try ledger.persistInbound(
            page(
                stream: shared,
                generation: 0,
                resolution: "standalone",
                event: sharedScore,
                from: 1
            ),
            stream: shared, roundId: sourceRoundId, principal: principal
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(
            try ledger.inboundPersistedThrough(roundId: sourceRoundId, partitionId: shared.ledgerPartitionId),
            try CanonicalLedgerPosition("2")
        )

        // The server ACK is partition-scoped, but the merged projection has not
        // materialized this prefix yet and therefore must replay from zero.
        try ledger.adoptBootstrap(bootstrap(
            generation: 1, resolution: "merged-r1", streams: [shared]
        ))
        XCTAssertEqual(
            try ledger.inboundPersistedThrough(roundId: roundId, partitionId: shared.ledgerPartitionId),
            try CanonicalLedgerPosition("0")
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(
            try ledger.inboundPersistedThrough(roundId: sourceRoundId, partitionId: shared.ledgerPartitionId),
            try CanonicalLedgerPosition("2")
        )
        try ledger.persistInbound(
            page(
                stream: shared,
                generation: 1,
                resolution: "merged-r1",
                event: sharedStart
            ),
            stream: shared,
            roundId: roundId,
            principal: principal
        )
        try ledger.persistInbound(
            page(
                stream: shared,
                generation: 1,
                resolution: "merged-r1",
                event: sharedScore,
                from: 1
            ),
            stream: shared,
            roundId: roundId,
            principal: principal
        )
        let standaloneIdentities = try ledger.projectionInputs(
            roundId: sourceRoundId
        ).map { try $0.event.eventIdentity() }
        let mergedIdentities = try ledger.projectionInputs(
            roundId: roundId
        ).map { try $0.event.eventIdentity() }
        XCTAssertEqual(mergedIdentities, standaloneIdentities)
        XCTAssertEqual(Set(try ledger.allEvents().map {
            try $0.eventIdentity()
        }), Set(standaloneIdentities))
    }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator.swift
import Foundation

public extension LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator {
    static func openMigratingApplicationSupportRoot(
        _ applicationSupportRootURL: URL,
        expectedOriginDeviceId: String,
        faultHook: @escaping (
            DomainLedgerFaultPoint
        ) throws -> Void = { _ in }
    ) throws -> DomainLedgerStore {
        try DomainLedgerCompositionRoot
            .openMigratingApplicationSupportRoot(
                applicationSupportRootURL,
                expectedOriginDeviceId: expectedOriginDeviceId,
                faultHook: faultHook
            )
    }
}

extension LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator {
    static func fixedIOSSnapshotIfPresent(
        applicationSupportRootURL: URL,
        observers: LegacyAuthorityProcessingObservers
    ) throws -> ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot? {
        let root = applicationSupportRootURL.standardizedFileURL
            .resolvingSymlinksInPath()
        let sourceURL = root.appendingPathComponent("events.jsonl")
        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(
            atPath: sourceURL.path
        ) else {
            return nil
        }
        let authorityData = try Data(contentsOf: sourceURL)
        let authority = try SealedLegacyAuthority.make(
            authorityKind: iosEventsAuthorityKind,
            authorityFile: authorityData,
            observers: observers
        )
        return try validatedIOSSnapshot(
            validatedAuthority: authority,
            authorityData: authorityData,
            observers: observers
        )
    }

    // This capability overload is in the same physical coordinator file as
    // LegacyIOSJSONLReader/iosSourceRecords. It consumes an already sealed
    // authority, so fixed-root capture performs one seal, one read and one scan.
    static func validatedIOSSnapshot(
        validatedAuthority authority: SealedLegacyAuthority,
        authorityData: Data,
        observers: LegacyAuthorityProcessingObservers
    ) throws -> ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot {
        guard authority.authorityKind == iosEventsAuthorityKind,
              Data(base64Encoded: authority.authorityFileBase64)
                == authorityData else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        let records = LegacyIOSJSONLReader.read(
            authorityData,
            processingKey: authority.processingKey,
            observers: observers
        )
        let sourceRecords = try iosSourceRecords(
            authority: authority,
            records: records,
            observers: observers
        )
        let snapshot = ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot(
            authority: authority,
            authorityData: authorityData,
            sourceRecords: sourceRecords,
            storageV1ParsedTransportEvidence: nil,
            contents: .iosJSONL(records)
        )
        for sourceRecord in sourceRecords {
            try validateSourceRecord(
                sourceRecord,
                authority: authority
            )
        }
        return snapshot
    }

    static func captureFixedIOSAuthority(
        snapshot: ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot,
        state: inout DomainLedgerStateV2,
        snapshotsByAuthorityId: inout
            [String: ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot]
    ) throws -> Bool {
        let authority = snapshot.authority
        guard authority.authorityKind == iosEventsAuthorityKind else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        let sameKind = state.sealedLegacyAuthorities.values
            .filter { $0.authorityKind == iosEventsAuthorityKind }
        guard sameKind.count <= 1 else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        if let existing = sameKind.first {
            // A fixed source whose bytes changed is a different authority ID and
            // must fail closed; it is never imported as a second journal.
            let isPending =
                state.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations[
                    authority.authorityId
                ] != nil
            let isCompleted =
                state.completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations[
                    authority.authorityId
                ] != nil
            guard existing == authority,
                  isPending != isCompleted else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        } else {
            let pending = PendingLegacyAuthorityMigration(
                authorityId: authority.authorityId,
                authorityKind: authority.authorityKind,
                authorityFileSha256:
                    authority.authorityFileSha256,
                sourceRecords: snapshot.sourceRecords,
                sourceRoundIds: CanonicalStringSet(Set(
                    snapshot.sourceRecords.compactMap { record in
                        record.classification == .event
                            ? record.roundId : nil
                    }
                ))
            )
            guard state.completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations[
                    authority.authorityId
                  ] == nil,
                  state.sealedLegacyAuthorities.updateValue(
                    authority,
                    forKey: authority.authorityId
                  ) == nil,
                  state.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations.updateValue(
                    pending,
                    forKey: authority.authorityId
                  ) == nil else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        }
        guard snapshotsByAuthorityId.updateValue(
                snapshot,
                forKey: authority.authorityId
              ) == nil else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        return sameKind.isEmpty
    }

    static func pendingConnectedComponents(
        state: DomainLedgerStateV2
    ) throws -> [[String]] {
        let pendingIds =
            state.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations.keys.sorted()
        var authorityIdsByRound: [String: [String]] = [:]
        for authorityId in pendingIds {
            guard let pending =
                    state.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations[authorityId],
                  pending.authorityId == authorityId else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            for roundId in pending.sourceRoundIds {
                authorityIdsByRound[roundId, default: []]
                    .append(authorityId)
            }
        }
        for roundId in authorityIdsByRound.keys {
            authorityIdsByRound[roundId]?.sort()
        }

        var seen = Set<String>()
        var components: [[String]] = []
        for seed in pendingIds where !seen.contains(seed) {
            var queue = [seed]
            var cursor = 0
            var component: [String] = []
            seen.insert(seed)
            while cursor < queue.count {
                let authorityId = queue[cursor]
                cursor += 1
                component.append(authorityId)
                guard let pending =
                        state.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations[
                            authorityId
                        ] else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                for roundId in pending.sourceRoundIds.sorted() {
                    for neighbor in
                        authorityIdsByRound[roundId, default: []]
                    where seen.insert(neighbor).inserted {
                        queue.append(neighbor)
                    }
                }
            }
            components.append(component.sorted())
        }
        return components.sorted {
            $0.lexicographicallyPrecedes($1)
        }
    }

    static func readyContexts(
        component: [String],
        state: DomainLedgerStateV2
    ) throws -> [String: RoundEventContext]? {
        var allRoundIds = Set<String>()
        var iosRoundIds = Set<String>()
        for authorityId in component {
            guard let pending =
                    state.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations[
                        authorityId
                    ] else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            allRoundIds.formUnion(pending.sourceRoundIds)
            if pending.authorityKind == iosEventsAuthorityKind {
                iosRoundIds.formUnion(pending.sourceRoundIds)
            }
        }

        var contexts: [String: RoundEventContext] = [:]
        for roundId in allRoundIds.sorted() {
            guard let context = try LegacyRoundStartContextResolver
                    .context(
                        roundId: roundId,
                        events: state.events
                    ) else {
                return nil
            }
            if iosRoundIds.contains(roundId) {
                guard case .object(let install) =
                        context.deviceRoundInstallBinding,
                      install["profileId"] == .string("ios-v1") else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.roundContextMismatch
                }
            }
            contexts[roundId] = context
        }
        return contexts
    }

    static func snapshot(
        authorityId: String,
        state: DomainLedgerStateV2,
        snapshotsByAuthorityId: inout
            [String: ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot],
        observers: LegacyAuthorityProcessingObservers
    ) throws -> ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot {
        if let cached =
            snapshotsByAuthorityId[authorityId] {
            return cached
        }
        guard let authority =
                state.sealedLegacyAuthorities[authorityId],
              let authorityData = Data(
                base64Encoded: authority.authorityFileBase64
              ) else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        let validated = try validatedSnapshot(
            authority: authority,
            authorityData: authorityData,
            observers: observers
        )
        guard snapshotsByAuthorityId.updateValue(
                validated,
                forKey: authorityId
              ) == nil else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        return validated
    }

    static func validatePendingAuthority(
        authorityId: String,
        snapshot: ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot,
        state: DomainLedgerStateV2
    ) throws {
        let authority = snapshot.authority
        let expectedRoundIds = CanonicalStringSet(Set(
            snapshot.sourceRecords.compactMap { record in
                record.classification == .event
                    ? record.roundId : nil
            }
        ))
        guard state.completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations[authorityId] == nil,
              let pending =
                state.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations[authorityId],
              pending.authorityId == authorityId,
              authority.authorityId == authorityId,
              pending.authorityKind == authority.authorityKind,
              pending.authorityFileSha256
                == authority.authorityFileSha256,
              pending.sourceRecords == snapshot.sourceRecords,
              pending.sourceRoundIds == expectedRoundIds else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
    }

    // P1.2a2a1 operational merge candidate/index primitives. These helpers
    // validate copied destination state only; they do not commit primary state.
    private struct LegacyOperationalEventFact: Equatable {
        let event: DomainRoundEvent
        let eventHash: String
    }

    private struct LegacyOperationalMergeCandidate {
        var state: DomainLedgerStateV2
        var nextBaseOrdinalByRound: [String: Int]

        init(
            copying state: DomainLedgerStateV2,
            ordinals nextBaseOrdinalByRound: [String: Int]
        ) {
            self.state = state
            self.nextBaseOrdinalByRound = nextBaseOrdinalByRound
        }
    }

    @discardableResult
    private static func insertOrReuseExact<Value: Equatable>(
        _ value: Value,
        forKey key: String,
        in index: inout [String: Value]
    ) throws -> Bool {
        if let existing = index[key] {
            guard existing == value else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            return false
        }
        guard index.updateValue(value, forKey: key) == nil else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        return true
    }

    private static func insertUnique<Value>(
        _ value: Value,
        forKey key: String,
        in index: inout [String: Value]
    ) throws {
        guard index.updateValue(value, forKey: key) == nil else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
    }

    private static func checkedEventFactsByIdentity(
        _ events: [DomainRoundEvent]
    ) throws -> [String: LegacyOperationalEventFact] {
        var index: [String: LegacyOperationalEventFact] = [:]
        for event in events {
            let eventIdentity = try event.eventIdentity()
            let eventHash = try event.eventHash()
            try insertUnique(
                LegacyOperationalEventFact(
                    event: event,
                    eventHash: eventHash
                ),
                forKey: eventIdentity,
                in: &index
            )
        }
        return index
    }

    private static func checkedOrdinaryOutboxByIdentity(
        _ rows: [OutboxRecord]
    ) throws -> [String: OutboxRecord] {
        var index: [String: OutboxRecord] = [:]
        for row in rows {
            guard try row.event.eventIdentity() == row.eventIdentity,
                  try row.event.eventHash() == row.eventHash else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            try insertUnique(
                row,
                forKey: row.eventIdentity,
                in: &index
            )
        }
        return index
    }

    private static func checkedDeadLettersByIdentity(
        _ rows: [OutboxRecord]
    ) throws -> [String: OutboxRecord] {
        var index: [String: OutboxRecord] = [:]
        for row in rows {
            guard try row.event.eventIdentity() == row.eventIdentity,
                  try row.event.eventHash() == row.eventHash else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            try insertUnique(
                row,
                forKey: row.eventIdentity,
                in: &index
            )
        }
        return index
    }

    private static func checkedLocalProjectionInputsByEventIdentity(
        _ rows: [DomainProjectionInput]
    ) throws -> [String: DomainProjectionInput] {
        var index: [String: DomainProjectionInput] = [:]
        for row in rows {
            let eventIdentity = try row.event.eventIdentity()
            try insertUnique(
                row,
                forKey: eventIdentity,
                in: &index
            )
        }
        return index
    }

    private static func checkedMigrationDeadLettersByID(
        _ rows: [MigrationDeadLetter]
    ) throws -> [String: MigrationDeadLetter] {
        var index: [String: MigrationDeadLetter] = [:]
        for row in rows {
            guard row.sourceLine > 0,
                  let raw = Data(base64Encoded: row.rawBase64),
                  try MigrationDeadLetter.make(
                    sourceLine: row.sourceLine,
                    eventId: row.eventId,
                    roundId: row.roundId,
                    reasonCode: row.reasonCode,
                    raw: raw
                  ) == row else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            try insertUnique(row, forKey: row.id, in: &index)
        }
        return index
    }

    private static func checkedTransportAnomaliesByID(
        _ rows: [TransportAnomaly]
    ) throws -> [String: TransportAnomaly] {
        var index: [String: TransportAnomaly] = [:]
        for row in rows {
            guard row.id == try TypedID.make(
                    domain: "TransportAnomaly/v1",
                    value: .object([
                        "roundId": .string(row.roundId),
                        "code": .string(row.code),
                        "evidence": .string(row.evidence),
                    ])
                  ) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            try insertUnique(row, forKey: row.id, in: &index)
        }
        return index
    }

    static func validateTransportAnomalyRoot(
        _ anomalies: [TransportAnomaly]
    ) throws {
        _ = try checkedTransportAnomaliesByID(anomalies)
    }

    private static var legacyProjectionSafeIntegerMaximum: Int {
        9_007_199_254_740_991
    }

    private static func checkedLegacyProjectionOrdinal(
        base: Int,
        delta: Int
    ) throws -> Int {
        guard base >= 0,
              base <= legacyProjectionSafeIntegerMaximum,
              delta >= 0,
              delta <= legacyProjectionSafeIntegerMaximum - base else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        return base + delta
    }

    static func legacyProjectionBaseOrdinals(
        state: DomainLedgerStateV2
    ) throws -> [String: Int] {
        var baseOrdinalByRound: [String: Int] = [:]
        for input in state.localProjectionInputs {
            if input.projectionOrder.authority == .canonicalReplay {
                // Canonical replay belongs to serving/staged replay roots and
                // is skipped before local ordinal validation or base updates.
                continue
            }
            let sourceOrdinal = input.projectionOrder.sourceOrdinal
            guard sourceOrdinal >= 0,
                  sourceOrdinal
                    <= legacyProjectionSafeIntegerMaximum else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            let roundId = input.event.roundId
            baseOrdinalByRound[roundId] = max(
                baseOrdinalByRound[roundId, default: 0],
                sourceOrdinal
            )
        }
        return baseOrdinalByRound
    }

    // P1.2a2a2a is a pure iOS operational preflight.  These values contain
    // exact writes plus insert/reuse decisions; they never own primary state.
    private enum LegacyIOSOperationalMergeDecision: Equatable {
        case insert
        case reuse
    }

    private struct LegacyIOSImportedOperationalPlan: Equatable {
        let sourceRecord: LegacyAuthoritySourceRecord
        let event: DomainRoundEvent
        let eventIdentity: String
        let eventHash: String
        let eventDecision: LegacyIOSOperationalMergeDecision
        let legacyWireBindingKey: String
        let legacyWireBinding: LegacyWireBinding
        let bindingDecision: LegacyIOSOperationalMergeDecision
        let sourceEvidence: SealedLegacyMigrationEvidence
        let evidenceDecision: LegacyIOSOperationalMergeDecision
        let outboxRow: OutboxRecord
        let outboxDecision: LegacyIOSOperationalMergeDecision
        let projectionAuthority: ProjectionAuthority
        let projectionInput: DomainProjectionInput
        let projectionDecision: LegacyIOSOperationalMergeDecision
        let newProjectionOrdinal: Int?
        let terminalDisposition: LegacyAuthorityTerminalDisposition
    }

    private struct LegacyIOSMigrationDeadLetterOperationalPlan: Equatable {
        let sourceRecord: LegacyAuthoritySourceRecord
        let migrationDeadLetter: MigrationDeadLetter
        let decision: LegacyIOSOperationalMergeDecision
        let terminalDisposition: LegacyAuthorityTerminalDisposition
    }

    private struct LegacyIOSIgnoredSyncMarkerOperationalPlan: Equatable {
        let sourceRecord: LegacyAuthoritySourceRecord
        let terminalDisposition: LegacyAuthorityTerminalDisposition
    }

    private enum LegacyIOSOperationalRowPlan: Equatable {
        case importedEvent(LegacyIOSImportedOperationalPlan)
        case migrationDeadLetter(
            LegacyIOSMigrationDeadLetterOperationalPlan
        )
        case ignoredSyncMarker(
            LegacyIOSIgnoredSyncMarkerOperationalPlan
        )
    }

    private struct LegacyIOSOperationalMergePlan: Equatable {
        let authority: SealedLegacyAuthority
        let sourceRecords: [LegacyAuthoritySourceRecord]
        let rowPlans: [LegacyIOSOperationalRowPlan]
        let terminalDispositions:
            [LegacyAuthorityTerminalDisposition]
        let advancedBaseOrdinalByRound: [String: Int]
    }

    private static func prepareIOSOperationalMerge(
        batch: LegacyAuthorityClassificationBatch,
        snapshot: ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot,
        contextsByRound: [String: RoundEventContext],
        candidate: LegacyOperationalMergeCandidate
    ) throws -> LegacyIOSOperationalMergePlan {
        guard batch.authority == snapshot.authority,
              batch.authority.authorityKind == iosEventsAuthorityKind,
              batch.sourceRecords == snapshot.sourceRecords,
              batch.sourceRecords.count == snapshot.sourceRecords.count,
              case .iosJSONL(let iosRecords) = snapshot.contents,
              iosRecords.count == batch.sourceRecords.count else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }

        // Every array-backed destination is indexed and checked once before
        // the ordered row pass. Dictionary roots are copied as local indexes.
        var eventFactsByIdentity = try checkedEventFactsByIdentity(
            candidate.state.events
        )
        var outboxByIdentity = try checkedOrdinaryOutboxByIdentity(
            candidate.state.outbox
        )
        let deadLettersByIdentity = try checkedDeadLettersByIdentity(
            candidate.state.deadLetters
        )
        var projectionInputsByIdentity =
            try checkedLocalProjectionInputsByEventIdentity(
                candidate.state.localProjectionInputs
            )
        var migrationDeadLettersByID =
            try checkedMigrationDeadLettersByID(
                candidate.state.migrationDeadLetters
            )
        var evidenceByKey = candidate.state.sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence
        var bindingsByKey = candidate.state.legacyWireBindings
        let canonicalOriginsByIdentity =
            candidate.state.canonicalOriginEvidence

        // Affected rounds come only from event-classified source rows.  The
        // full roster count is checked before any row plan is constructed.
        var affectedRoundIds = Set<String>()
        for sourceRecord in batch.sourceRecords
        where sourceRecord.classification == .event {
            guard let roundId = sourceRecord.roundId,
                  !roundId.isEmpty else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            affectedRoundIds.insert(roundId)
        }
        var advancedBaseOrdinalByRound: [String: Int] = [:]
        for roundId in affectedRoundIds.sorted() {
            guard contextsByRound[roundId]?.roundId == roundId else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            let base = candidate.nextBaseOrdinalByRound[
                roundId,
                default: 0
            ]
            let advanced = try checkedLegacyProjectionOrdinal(
                base: base,
                delta: batch.sourceRecords.count
            )
            guard advancedBaseOrdinalByRound.updateValue(
                    advanced,
                    forKey: roundId
                  ) == nil else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        }

        var rowPlans: [LegacyIOSOperationalRowPlan] = []
        rowPlans.reserveCapacity(batch.sourceRecords.count)
        var terminalDispositions:
            [LegacyAuthorityTerminalDisposition] = []
        terminalDispositions.reserveCapacity(batch.sourceRecords.count)

        // This is the only ordered classification pass. It consumes the
        // already-read JSONL records and calls batch.result(for:) once per row.
        for pair in zip(iosRecords, batch.sourceRecords) {
            let (iosRecord, sourceRecord) = pair
            let expectedEventId = iosRecord.classification == .malformed
                ? nil : iosRecord.event?.eventId
            let expectedRoundId = iosRecord.classification == .malformed
                ? nil : iosRecord.event?.roundId
            guard sourceRecord.coordinateKind == .physicalLine,
                  sourceRecord.sourceLine == iosRecord.sourceLine,
                  sourceRecord.byteOffset == iosRecord.byteOffset,
                  sourceRecord.rawBase64
                    == iosRecord.raw.base64EncodedString(),
                  sourceRecord.classification == iosRecord.classification,
                  sourceRecord.eventId == expectedEventId,
                  sourceRecord.roundId == expectedRoundId else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }

            let result = try batch.result(for: sourceRecord)
            switch result {
            case .importedEvent(let imported):
                let event = imported.candidate.event
                let eventIdentity = try event.eventIdentity()
                let eventHash = try event.eventHash()
                let binding = imported.legacyWireBinding
                let bindingKey = imported.legacyWireBindingKey
                let evidence = imported.candidate.sourceEvidence
                guard sourceRecord.classification == .event,
                      let roundId = sourceRecord.roundId,
                      let context = contextsByRound[roundId],
                      context.roundId == roundId,
                      imported.candidate.authority == batch.authority,
                      event.eventId == sourceRecord.eventId,
                      event.roundId == roundId,
                      event.ownerAccountId == context.ownerAccountId,
                      event.subjectPlayerId == context.subjectPlayerId,
                      event.actorId == context.actorId,
                      event.streamSubject == .roundIncarnation(
                        context.roundIncarnationId
                      ),
                      event.roundIntentId == context.roundIntentId,
                      event.snapshotId == context.snapshotId,
                      event.roundSemanticBindingHash
                        == context.semanticBindingHash,
                      binding.roundId == roundId,
                      binding.canonicalDomainIdentity == eventIdentity,
                      binding.canonicalDomainEventHash == eventHash,
                      binding.legacyAliases.allSatisfy({
                        $0.eventIdentity == eventIdentity
                            && $0.eventHash == eventHash
                      }),
                      evidence.authorityId == batch.authority.authorityId,
                      evidence.authorityFileSha256
                        == batch.authority.authorityFileSha256,
                      evidence.sourceRecordId
                        == sourceRecord.sourceRecordId,
                      evidence.sourceLine == sourceRecord.sourceLine,
                      evidence.rawLineBase64 == sourceRecord.rawBase64,
                      evidence.legacyWireBindingKey == bindingKey,
                      evidence.eventIdentity == eventIdentity,
                      evidence.eventHash == eventHash else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }

                let eventDecision: LegacyIOSOperationalMergeDecision =
                    try insertOrReuseExact(
                        LegacyOperationalEventFact(
                            event: event,
                            eventHash: eventHash
                        ),
                        forKey: eventIdentity,
                        in: &eventFactsByIdentity
                    ) ? .insert : .reuse
                guard deadLettersByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }

                let projectionAuthority: ProjectionAuthority
                if let origin = canonicalOriginsByIdentity[eventIdentity] {
                    guard origin.eventIdentity == eventIdentity,
                          origin.eventHash == eventHash else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    projectionAuthority = .localTerminalFallback
                } else {
                    projectionAuthority = .localProvisional
                }

                let bindingDecision: LegacyIOSOperationalMergeDecision =
                    try insertOrReuseExact(
                        binding,
                        forKey: bindingKey,
                        in: &bindingsByKey
                    ) ? .insert : .reuse
                let evidenceDecision: LegacyIOSOperationalMergeDecision =
                    try insertOrReuseExact(
                        evidence,
                        forKey: evidence.evidenceKey,
                        in: &evidenceByKey
                    ) ? .insert : .reuse
                let outboxRow = OutboxRecord(
                    event: event,
                    eventIdentity: eventIdentity,
                    eventHash: eventHash,
                    source: OutboxSourceReference(
                        sourceClass: .sealedLegacyMigration,
                        evidenceKey: evidence.evidenceKey
                    ),
                    receipt: nil,
                    receiptStorageKey: nil,
                    deadLetterReason: nil
                )
                let outboxDecision: LegacyIOSOperationalMergeDecision =
                    try insertOrReuseExact(
                        outboxRow,
                        forKey: eventIdentity,
                        in: &outboxByIdentity
                    ) ? .insert : .reuse

                let projectionInput: DomainProjectionInput
                let projectionDecision: LegacyIOSOperationalMergeDecision
                let newProjectionOrdinal: Int?
                let base = candidate.nextBaseOrdinalByRound[
                    roundId,
                    default: 0
                ]
                let ordinal = try checkedLegacyProjectionOrdinal(
                    base: base,
                    delta: sourceRecord.sourceLine
                )
                let expectedProjectionInput = DomainProjectionInput(
                    event: event,
                    projectionOrder: try DomainProjectionOrder(
                        authority: projectionAuthority,
                        ledgerPartitionId: nil,
                        ledgerPosition: nil,
                        sourceOrdinal: ordinal
                    )
                )
                if let existing =
                    projectionInputsByIdentity[eventIdentity] {
                    guard existing == expectedProjectionInput else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    projectionInput = existing
                    projectionDecision = .reuse
                    newProjectionOrdinal = nil
                } else {
                    try insertUnique(
                        expectedProjectionInput,
                        forKey: eventIdentity,
                        in: &projectionInputsByIdentity
                    )
                    projectionInput = expectedProjectionInput
                    projectionDecision = .insert
                    newProjectionOrdinal = ordinal
                }

                let disposition = LegacyAuthorityTerminalDisposition(
                    sourceRecordId: sourceRecord.sourceRecordId,
                    disposition: .importedEvent,
                    eventIdentity: eventIdentity,
                    eventHash: eventHash,
                    sourceEvidenceKey: evidence.evidenceKey,
                    migrationDeadLetterId: nil
                )
                rowPlans.append(.importedEvent(
                    LegacyIOSImportedOperationalPlan(
                        sourceRecord: sourceRecord,
                        event: event,
                        eventIdentity: eventIdentity,
                        eventHash: eventHash,
                        eventDecision: eventDecision,
                        legacyWireBindingKey: bindingKey,
                        legacyWireBinding: binding,
                        bindingDecision: bindingDecision,
                        sourceEvidence: evidence,
                        evidenceDecision: evidenceDecision,
                        outboxRow: outboxRow,
                        outboxDecision: outboxDecision,
                        projectionAuthority: projectionAuthority,
                        projectionInput: projectionInput,
                        projectionDecision: projectionDecision,
                        newProjectionOrdinal: newProjectionOrdinal,
                        terminalDisposition: disposition
                    )
                ))
                terminalDispositions.append(disposition)

            case .migrationDeadLetter(let dead):
                guard sourceRecord.classification == .malformed
                        || sourceRecord.classification == .event,
                      dead.sourceLine == sourceRecord.sourceLine,
                      dead.eventId == sourceRecord.eventId,
                      dead.roundId == sourceRecord.roundId,
                      dead.rawBase64 == sourceRecord.rawBase64 else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                let decision: LegacyIOSOperationalMergeDecision =
                    try insertOrReuseExact(
                        dead,
                        forKey: dead.id,
                        in: &migrationDeadLettersByID
                    ) ? .insert : .reuse
                let disposition = LegacyAuthorityTerminalDisposition(
                    sourceRecordId: sourceRecord.sourceRecordId,
                    disposition: .migrationDeadLetter,
                    eventIdentity: nil,
                    eventHash: nil,
                    sourceEvidenceKey: nil,
                    migrationDeadLetterId: dead.id
                )
                rowPlans.append(.migrationDeadLetter(
                    LegacyIOSMigrationDeadLetterOperationalPlan(
                        sourceRecord: sourceRecord,
                        migrationDeadLetter: dead,
                        decision: decision,
                        terminalDisposition: disposition
                    )
                ))
                terminalDispositions.append(disposition)

            case .ignoredSyncMarker:
                guard sourceRecord.classification == .syncMarker else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                let disposition = LegacyAuthorityTerminalDisposition(
                    sourceRecordId: sourceRecord.sourceRecordId,
                    disposition: .ignoredSyncMarker,
                    eventIdentity: nil,
                    eventHash: nil,
                    sourceEvidenceKey: nil,
                    migrationDeadLetterId: nil
                )
                rowPlans.append(.ignoredSyncMarker(
                    LegacyIOSIgnoredSyncMarkerOperationalPlan(
                        sourceRecord: sourceRecord,
                        terminalDisposition: disposition
                    )
                ))
                terminalDispositions.append(disposition)
            }
        }

        guard rowPlans.count == batch.sourceRecords.count,
              terminalDispositions.count == batch.sourceRecords.count,
              zip(batch.sourceRecords, terminalDispositions).allSatisfy({
                $0.0.sourceRecordId == $0.1.sourceRecordId
              }) else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        return LegacyIOSOperationalMergePlan(
            authority: batch.authority,
            sourceRecords: batch.sourceRecords,
            rowPlans: rowPlans,
            terminalDispositions: terminalDispositions,
            advancedBaseOrdinalByRound: advancedBaseOrdinalByRound
        )
    }

    // P1.2a2a2b commits only the exact writes approved by iOS preflight.
    // It never validates or mutates primary state.
    private static func commitIOSOperationalMerge(
        plan: LegacyIOSOperationalMergePlan,
        candidate: inout LegacyOperationalMergeCandidate
    ) {
        for rowPlan in plan.rowPlans {
            switch rowPlan {
            case .importedEvent(let imported):
                switch imported.eventDecision {
                case .insert:
                    candidate.state.events.append(imported.event)
                case .reuse:
                    break
                }
                switch imported.bindingDecision {
                case .insert:
                    candidate.state.legacyWireBindings[
                        imported.legacyWireBindingKey
                    ] = imported.legacyWireBinding
                case .reuse:
                    break
                }
                switch imported.evidenceDecision {
                case .insert:
                    candidate.state.sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence[
                        imported.sourceEvidence.evidenceKey
                    ] = imported.sourceEvidence
                case .reuse:
                    break
                }
                switch imported.outboxDecision {
                case .insert:
                    candidate.state.outbox.append(imported.outboxRow)
                case .reuse:
                    break
                }
                switch imported.projectionDecision {
                case .insert:
                    candidate.state.localProjectionInputs.append(imported.projectionInput)
                case .reuse:
                    break
                }

            case .migrationDeadLetter(let dead):
                switch dead.decision {
                case .insert:
                    candidate.state.migrationDeadLetters.append(dead.migrationDeadLetter)
                case .reuse:
                    break
                }

            case .ignoredSyncMarker:
                break
            }
        }

        for (roundId, advancedBaseOrdinal) in
            plan.advancedBaseOrdinalByRound {
            candidate.nextBaseOrdinalByRound[roundId] = advancedBaseOrdinal
        }
    }

    // P1.2a2a2c-S1a1 normalizes only the already-validated storage-v1 source
    // graph. It carries exact source capabilities and makes no destination
    // insert/reuse, projection, ordinal, completion, or commit decision.
    private struct LegacyStorageV1ReceiptFactKey: Hashable {
        let eventIdentity: String
        let eventHash: String
        let statusRawValue: String
        let serverSequence: Int

        init(_ receipt: LegacyV1EventReceipt) {
            eventIdentity = receipt.eventIdentity
            eventHash = receipt.eventHash
            statusRawValue = receipt.status.rawValue
            serverSequence = receipt.serverSequence
        }
    }

    private struct LegacyStorageV1StoredReceipt: Equatable {
        let storageKey: String
        let receipt: LegacyV1EventReceipt
    }

    private struct LegacyStorageV1ImportedSourceFact: Equatable {
        let storedEvent: StoredEventV1
        let sourceRecord: LegacyAuthoritySourceRecord
        let imported: LegacyAuthorityImportedEvent
        let eventIdentity: String
        let eventHash: String
        let legacyWireBindingKey: String
        let legacyWireBinding: LegacyWireBinding
    }

    private struct LegacyStorageV1SuccessfulTransportSource: Equatable {
        let receiptStorageKey: String
        let receipt: LegacyV1EventReceipt
        let acceptedReplayEvidence: LegacyV1AcceptedReplayEvidence
    }

    private struct LegacyStorageV1PermanentDeadLetterSource: Equatable {
        let deadLetter: LegacyV1OutboxRecord
        let receiptStorageKey: String
    }

    private enum LegacyStorageV1ImportedTransportSource: Equatable {
        case retryable(LegacyV1OutboxRecord)
        case successful(LegacyStorageV1SuccessfulTransportSource)
        case permanentDeadLetter(
            LegacyStorageV1PermanentDeadLetterSource
        )
    }

    private struct LegacyStorageV1ImportedSourceRow: Equatable {
        let fact: LegacyStorageV1ImportedSourceFact
        let transport: LegacyStorageV1ImportedTransportSource
    }

    private struct LegacyStorageV1MigrationDeadLetterSourceRow: Equatable {
        let storedEvent: StoredEventV1
        let sourceRecord: LegacyAuthoritySourceRecord
        let migrationDeadLetter: MigrationDeadLetter
    }

    private enum LegacyStorageV1SourceRow: Equatable {
        case imported(LegacyStorageV1ImportedSourceRow)
        case migrationDeadLetter(
            LegacyStorageV1MigrationDeadLetterSourceRow
        )

        var sourceRecord: LegacyAuthoritySourceRecord {
            switch self {
            case .imported(let row):
                return row.fact.sourceRecord
            case .migrationDeadLetter(let row):
                return row.sourceRecord
            }
        }
    }

    private struct LegacyStorageV1CoreSourceGraph: Equatable {
        let authority: SealedLegacyAuthority
        let sourceRecords: [LegacyAuthoritySourceRecord]
        let origin: OriginSequenceState
        let parsedTransportEvidence: JSONValue
        let legacyWireBindingsByKey: [String: LegacyWireBinding]
        let terminalReceiptsByIdentity:
            [String: LegacyV1EventReceipt]
        let rows: [LegacyStorageV1SourceRow]
    }

    private static func prepareStorageV1CoreSourceGraph(
        batch: LegacyAuthorityClassificationBatch,
        snapshot: ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot
    ) throws -> LegacyStorageV1CoreSourceGraph {
        guard batch.authority == snapshot.authority,
              batch.sourceRecords == snapshot.sourceRecords,
              batch.sourceRecords.count == snapshot.sourceRecords.count,
              batch.authority.authorityKind == storageV1AuthorityKind,
              case .storageV1(let legacy) = snapshot.contents,
              legacy.storageVersion == 1,
              snapshot.storageV1ParsedTransportEvidence
                == legacy.transportEvidence,
              legacy.events.count == batch.sourceRecords.count else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }

        // Build every source-root index once before the ordered result pass.
        // Duplicate source identities, keys, or bodies fail closed.
        var bindingsByKey: [String: LegacyWireBinding] = [:]
        var bindingKeyByIdentityHash:
            [LegacyBindingIdentityKey: String] = [:]
        for binding in legacy.legacyWireBindings {
            let bindingKey = try LegacyV1CanonicalIdentityResolver
                .legacyWireBindingKey(
                    roundId: binding.roundId,
                    wireClientId: binding.wireClientId,
                    wireEventId: binding.wireEventId
                )
            guard !binding.canonicalDomainIdentity.isEmpty,
                  DomainStringValidation.isLowercaseHex64(
                    binding.canonicalDomainEventHash
                  ),
                  DomainStringValidation.isLowercaseHex64(
                    binding.normalizedWireEnvelopeHash
                  ),
                  binding.legacyAliases.allSatisfy({
                    $0.eventIdentity
                        == binding.canonicalDomainIdentity
                        && $0.eventHash
                            == binding.canonicalDomainEventHash
                  }) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            try insertUnique(
                binding,
                forKey: bindingKey,
                in: &bindingsByKey
            )
            guard bindingKeyByIdentityHash.updateValue(
                bindingKey,
                forKey: LegacyBindingIdentityKey(
                    roundId: binding.roundId,
                    eventIdentity: binding.canonicalDomainIdentity,
                    eventHash: binding.canonicalDomainEventHash
                )
            ) == nil else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        }

        var retryableOutboxByIdentity:
            [String: LegacyV1OutboxRecord] = [:]
        for row in legacy.outbox {
            guard !row.eventIdentity.isEmpty,
                  !row.eventHash.isEmpty,
                  row.receipt == nil,
                  row.deadLetterReason == nil else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            try insertUnique(
                row,
                forKey: row.eventIdentity,
                in: &retryableOutboxByIdentity
            )
        }

        var deadLettersByIdentity: [String: LegacyV1OutboxRecord] = [:]
        for row in legacy.deadLetters {
            guard !row.eventIdentity.isEmpty,
                  !row.eventHash.isEmpty,
                  let receipt = row.receipt,
                  receipt.status == .rejectedPermanent,
                  receipt.eventIdentity == row.eventIdentity,
                  receipt.eventHash == row.eventHash,
                  receipt.serverSequence >= 0,
                  receipt.serverSequence
                    <= legacyProjectionSafeIntegerMaximum,
                  let reason = row.deadLetterReason,
                  !reason.isEmpty else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            try insertUnique(
                row,
                forKey: row.eventIdentity,
                in: &deadLettersByIdentity
            )
        }

        var successfulReceiptsByIdentity:
            [String: LegacyStorageV1StoredReceipt] = [:]
        var rejectedReceiptStorageKeysByFact:
            [LegacyStorageV1ReceiptFactKey: [String]] = [:]
        var rejectedReceiptStorageKeyCount = 0
        for (storageKey, receipt) in legacy.receipts {
            guard !storageKey.isEmpty,
                  !receipt.eventIdentity.isEmpty,
                  !receipt.eventHash.isEmpty,
                  receipt.serverSequence >= 0,
                  receipt.serverSequence
                    <= legacyProjectionSafeIntegerMaximum else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            switch receipt.status {
            case .accepted, .duplicateHashMatch:
                try insertUnique(
                    LegacyStorageV1StoredReceipt(
                        storageKey: storageKey,
                        receipt: receipt
                    ),
                    forKey: receipt.eventIdentity,
                    in: &successfulReceiptsByIdentity
                )
            case .rejectedPermanent:
                rejectedReceiptStorageKeysByFact[
                    LegacyStorageV1ReceiptFactKey(receipt),
                    default: []
                ].append(storageKey)
                rejectedReceiptStorageKeyCount += 1
            }
        }

        var terminalReceiptsByIdentity:
            [String: LegacyV1EventReceipt] = [:]
        for stored in successfulReceiptsByIdentity.values {
            try insertUnique(
                stored.receipt,
                forKey: stored.receipt.eventIdentity,
                in: &terminalReceiptsByIdentity
            )
        }
        for deadLetter in deadLettersByIdentity.values {
            guard let receipt = deadLetter.receipt else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            try insertUnique(
                receipt,
                forKey: receipt.eventIdentity,
                in: &terminalReceiptsByIdentity
            )
        }
```
