```swift
        var consumedBindingKeys = Set<String>()
        var consumedRetryableIdentities = Set<String>()
        var consumedSuccessfulReceiptStorageKeys = Set<String>()
        var consumedRejectedReceiptStorageKeys = Set<String>()
        var consumedDeadLetterIdentities = Set<String>()
        var rows: [LegacyStorageV1SourceRow] = []
        rows.reserveCapacity(batch.sourceRecords.count)

        // The only ordered source/result pass pairs each StoredEventV1 with
        // its validated source record and performs exactly one batch lookup.
        for (offset, pair) in zip(
            legacy.events,
            batch.sourceRecords
        ).enumerated() {
            let (stored, sourceRecord) = pair
            guard sourceRecord.coordinateKind == .storageV1Event,
                  sourceRecord.sourceLine == offset + 1,
                  sourceRecord.byteOffset == nil,
                  sourceRecord.classification == .event,
                  sourceRecord.eventId == stored.eventId,
                  sourceRecord.roundId == stored.roundId else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }

            let result = try batch.result(for: sourceRecord)
            switch result {
            case .importedEvent(let imported):
                let event = imported.candidate.event
                let eventIdentity = try event.eventIdentity()
                let eventHash = try event.eventHash()
                let bindingIdentityHash =
                    LegacyBindingIdentityKey(
                        roundId: event.roundId,
                        eventIdentity: eventIdentity,
                        eventHash: eventHash
                    )
                let bindingKey = imported.legacyWireBindingKey
                let evidence = imported.candidate.sourceEvidence
                guard imported.candidate.authority == batch.authority,
                      event.eventId == stored.eventId,
                      event.eventId == sourceRecord.eventId,
                      event.roundId == stored.roundId,
                      event.roundId == sourceRecord.roundId,
                      event.originDeviceId == stored.originDeviceId,
                      event.originEpoch == stored.originEpoch,
                      event.clientSequence == stored.clientSequence,
                      event.occurredAt == stored.occurredAt,
                      let sourceBinding = bindingsByKey[bindingKey],
                      sourceBinding == imported.legacyWireBinding,
                      sourceBinding.roundId == event.roundId,
                      sourceBinding.canonicalDomainIdentity
                        == eventIdentity,
                      sourceBinding.canonicalDomainEventHash == eventHash,
                      bindingKeyByIdentityHash[bindingIdentityHash]
                        == bindingKey,
                      evidence.authorityId
                        == batch.authority.authorityId,
                      evidence.authorityFileSha256
                        == batch.authority.authorityFileSha256,
                      evidence.sourceRecordId
                        == sourceRecord.sourceRecordId,
                      evidence.sourceLine == sourceRecord.sourceLine,
                      evidence.rawLineBase64 == sourceRecord.rawBase64,
                      evidence.legacyWireBindingKey == bindingKey,
                      evidence.eventIdentity == eventIdentity,
                      evidence.eventHash == eventHash,
                      consumedBindingKeys.insert(bindingKey).inserted else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                // kind/payload are adapter-normalized; raw equality to the
                // StoredEventV1 kind/payload is intentionally not required.
                let retryable = retryableOutboxByIdentity[eventIdentity]
                let successful =
                    successfulReceiptsByIdentity[eventIdentity]
                let deadLetter = deadLettersByIdentity[eventIdentity]
                var categoryCount = 0
                if retryable != nil { categoryCount += 1 }
                if successful != nil { categoryCount += 1 }
                if deadLetter != nil { categoryCount += 1 }
                guard categoryCount == 1 else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }

                let transport: LegacyStorageV1ImportedTransportSource
                if let retryable {
                    guard retryable.eventHash == eventHash,
                          consumedRetryableIdentities.insert(
                            eventIdentity
                          ).inserted else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    transport = .retryable(retryable)
                } else if let successful {
                    let receipt = successful.receipt
                    guard receipt.eventIdentity == eventIdentity,
                          receipt.eventHash == eventHash,
                          receipt.status == .accepted
                            || receipt.status == .duplicateHashMatch,
                          consumedSuccessfulReceiptStorageKeys.insert(
                            successful.storageKey
                          ).inserted else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    transport = .successful(
                        LegacyStorageV1SuccessfulTransportSource(
                            receiptStorageKey: successful.storageKey,
                            receipt: receipt,
                            acceptedReplayEvidence:
                                LegacyV1AcceptedReplayEvidence(
                                    receiptStorageKey:
                                        successful.storageKey,
                                    eventIdentity: eventIdentity,
                                    eventHash: eventHash
                                )
                        )
                    )
                } else if let deadLetter {
                    guard let receipt = deadLetter.receipt,
                          receipt.eventIdentity == eventIdentity,
                          receipt.eventHash == eventHash,
                          receipt.status == .rejectedPermanent,
                          let reason = deadLetter.deadLetterReason,
                          !reason.isEmpty,
                          consumedDeadLetterIdentities.insert(
                            eventIdentity
                          ).inserted else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    let matchingStorageKeys =
                        rejectedReceiptStorageKeysByFact[
                            LegacyStorageV1ReceiptFactKey(receipt),
                            default: []
                        ]
                    let receiptStorageKey: String
                    switch matchingStorageKeys.count {
                    case 0:
                        guard legacy.receipts[
                                sourceRecord.sourceRecordId
                              ] == nil else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError
                                .storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                        receiptStorageKey = sourceRecord.sourceRecordId
                    case 1:
                        let matchingStorageKey = matchingStorageKeys[0]
                        guard consumedRejectedReceiptStorageKeys.insert(
                                matchingStorageKey
                              ).inserted else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                        receiptStorageKey = matchingStorageKey
                    default:
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    transport = .permanentDeadLetter(
                        LegacyStorageV1PermanentDeadLetterSource(
                            deadLetter: deadLetter,
                            receiptStorageKey: receiptStorageKey
                        )
                    )
                } else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }

                rows.append(.imported(
                    LegacyStorageV1ImportedSourceRow(
                        fact: LegacyStorageV1ImportedSourceFact(
                            storedEvent: stored,
                            sourceRecord: sourceRecord,
                            imported: imported,
                            eventIdentity: eventIdentity,
                            eventHash: eventHash,
                            legacyWireBindingKey: bindingKey,
                            legacyWireBinding:
                                imported.legacyWireBinding
                        ),
                        transport: transport
                    )
                ))

            case .migrationDeadLetter(let dead):
                guard dead.sourceLine == sourceRecord.sourceLine,
                      dead.eventId == sourceRecord.eventId,
                      dead.roundId == sourceRecord.roundId,
                      dead.rawBase64 == sourceRecord.rawBase64 else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                rows.append(.migrationDeadLetter(
                    LegacyStorageV1MigrationDeadLetterSourceRow(
                        storedEvent: stored,
                        sourceRecord: sourceRecord,
                        migrationDeadLetter: dead
                    )
                ))

            case .ignoredSyncMarker:
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        }

        guard rows.count == batch.sourceRecords.count,
              rows.enumerated().allSatisfy({
                $0.element.sourceRecord
                    == batch.sourceRecords[$0.offset]
              }),
              consumedBindingKeys.count == bindingsByKey.count,
              consumedRetryableIdentities.count
                == retryableOutboxByIdentity.count,
              consumedSuccessfulReceiptStorageKeys.count
                == successfulReceiptsByIdentity.count,
              consumedRejectedReceiptStorageKeys.count
                == rejectedReceiptStorageKeyCount,
              consumedDeadLetterIdentities.count
                == deadLettersByIdentity.count else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }

        return LegacyStorageV1CoreSourceGraph(
            authority: batch.authority,
            sourceRecords: batch.sourceRecords,
            origin: legacy.origin,
            parsedTransportEvidence: legacy.transportEvidence,
            legacyWireBindingsByKey: bindingsByKey,
            terminalReceiptsByIdentity: terminalReceiptsByIdentity,
            rows: rows
        )
    }

    // P1.2a2a2c-S1a1 END. Authority-wide source roots belong to S1a2.
    // P1.2a2a2c-S1a2 authority-wide source-root normalization START.
    private struct LegacyStorageV1AuthoritySourceGraph: Equatable {
        let core: LegacyStorageV1CoreSourceGraph
        let preparedBatchesInSourceOrder: [PreparedLegacyV1Batch]
        let watchObligationsInSourceOrder:
            [WatchTerminalReceiptRelayObligation]
        let watchConfirmationsInSourceOrder:
            [WatchTerminalReceiptRelayConfirmation]
        let exactMigrationMarkers: CanonicalStringSet
        let transportAnomaliesInFirstOccurrenceOrder: [TransportAnomaly]
    }

    private static func prepareStorageV1AuthoritySourceGraph(
        core: LegacyStorageV1CoreSourceGraph,
        snapshot: ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot
    ) throws -> LegacyStorageV1AuthoritySourceGraph {
        guard core.authority == snapshot.authority,
              core.authority.authorityKind == storageV1AuthorityKind,
              case .storageV1(let legacy) = snapshot.contents,
              legacy.storageVersion == 1,
              core.origin == legacy.origin,
              core.parsedTransportEvidence
                == legacy.transportEvidence else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }

        var preparedBatchesByIdempotencyKey:
            [String: PreparedLegacyV1Batch] = [:]
        var preparedBatchesInSourceOrder: [PreparedLegacyV1Batch] = []
        preparedBatchesInSourceOrder.reserveCapacity(
            legacy.preparedLegacyV1Batches.count
        )
        for preparedBatch in legacy.preparedLegacyV1Batches {
            guard !preparedBatch.idempotencyKey.isEmpty,
                  lowercaseSHA256(preparedBatch.exactRequestBody)
                    == preparedBatch.requestBodySha256,
                  case .object(let requestBody) =
                    try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(
                        JSONValue.self,
                        from: preparedBatch.exactRequestBody
                    ),
                  Set(requestBody.keys) == ["events"],
                  case .array(let bodyEvents)? = requestBody["events"],
                  bodyEvents == preparedBatch.orderedSlots.map(
                    \.exactNormalizedEnvelope
                  ) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            for slot in preparedBatch.orderedSlots {
                guard lowercaseSHA256(
                        try CanonicalJSON.data(
                            slot.exactNormalizedEnvelope
                        )
                      ) == slot.exactNormalizedEnvelopeHash,
                      let binding = core.legacyWireBindingsByKey[
                        slot.bindingKey
                      ],
                      binding.roundId == preparedBatch.roundId,
                      binding.normalizedWireEnvelopeHash
                        == slot.exactNormalizedEnvelopeHash else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
            try insertUnique(
                preparedBatch,
                forKey: preparedBatch.idempotencyKey,
                in: &preparedBatchesByIdempotencyKey
            )
            preparedBatchesInSourceOrder.append(preparedBatch)
        }

        var obligationsByID:
            [String: WatchTerminalReceiptRelayObligation] = [:]
        var watchObligationsInSourceOrder:
            [WatchTerminalReceiptRelayObligation] = []
        watchObligationsInSourceOrder.reserveCapacity(
            legacy.watchTerminalReceiptRelayObligations.count
        )
        for obligation in
            legacy.watchTerminalReceiptRelayObligations {
            guard let receipt = core.terminalReceiptsByIdentity[
                    obligation.eventIdentity
                  ],
                  receipt.eventIdentity == obligation.eventIdentity,
                  receipt.eventHash == obligation.eventHash,
                  receipt.status == obligation.status else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            try insertUnique(
                obligation,
                forKey: obligation.obligationId,
                in: &obligationsByID
            )
            watchObligationsInSourceOrder.append(obligation)
        }

        var confirmationsByID:
            [String: WatchTerminalReceiptRelayConfirmation] = [:]
        var watchConfirmationsInSourceOrder:
            [WatchTerminalReceiptRelayConfirmation] = []
        watchConfirmationsInSourceOrder.reserveCapacity(
            legacy.watchTerminalReceiptRelayConfirmations.count
        )
        for confirmation in
            legacy.watchTerminalReceiptRelayConfirmations {
            guard let sourceObligation = obligationsByID[
                    confirmation.obligationId
                  ],
                  sourceObligation.obligationId
                    == confirmation.obligationId,
                  sourceObligation.eventIdentity
                    == confirmation.eventIdentity,
                  sourceObligation.eventHash == confirmation.eventHash,
                  sourceObligation.status == confirmation.status else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            try insertUnique(
                confirmation,
                forKey: confirmation.confirmationId,
                in: &confirmationsByID
            )
            watchConfirmationsInSourceOrder.append(confirmation)
        }

        guard legacy.migrationMarkers.allSatisfy({ marker in
            !marker.trimmingCharacters(
                in: .whitespacesAndNewlines
            ).isEmpty
        }) else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }

        var transportAnomaliesByID: [String: TransportAnomaly] = [:]
        var transportAnomaliesInFirstOccurrenceOrder:
            [TransportAnomaly] = []
        transportAnomaliesInFirstOccurrenceOrder.reserveCapacity(
            legacy.transportAnomalies.count
        )
        for sourceAnomaly in legacy.transportAnomalies {
            let id = try TypedID.make(
                domain: "TransportAnomaly/v1",
                value: .object([
                    "roundId": .string(sourceAnomaly.roundId),
                    "code": .string(sourceAnomaly.code),
                    "evidence": .string(sourceAnomaly.evidence),
                ])
            )
            let typedAnomaly = TransportAnomaly(
                id: id,
                roundId: sourceAnomaly.roundId,
                code: sourceAnomaly.code,
                evidence: sourceAnomaly.evidence
            )
            if try insertOrReuseExact(
                typedAnomaly,
                forKey: id,
                in: &transportAnomaliesByID
            ) {
                transportAnomaliesInFirstOccurrenceOrder.append(
                    typedAnomaly
                )
            }
        }

        return LegacyStorageV1AuthoritySourceGraph(
            core: core,
            preparedBatchesInSourceOrder:
                preparedBatchesInSourceOrder,
            watchObligationsInSourceOrder:
                watchObligationsInSourceOrder,
            watchConfirmationsInSourceOrder:
                watchConfirmationsInSourceOrder,
            exactMigrationMarkers: legacy.migrationMarkers,
            transportAnomaliesInFirstOccurrenceOrder:
                transportAnomaliesInFirstOccurrenceOrder
        )
    }
    // P1.2a2a2c-S1a2 authority-wide source-root normalization END.

    static func resumeEligiblePendingComponents(
        state: inout DomainLedgerStateV2,
        snapshotsByAuthorityId: inout
            [String: ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot],
        classificationBatchesByAuthorityId: inout
            [String: LegacyAuthorityClassificationBatch],
        observers: LegacyAuthorityProcessingObservers
    ) throws -> Bool {
        // Invalid destination typed records are rejected before any pending
        // authority classification or reducer apply callback can fire.
        try validateTransportAnomalyRoot(state.transportAnomalies)
        let components = try pendingConnectedComponents(state: state)
        var readyComponents: [(
            authorityIds: [String],
            contextsByRound: [String: RoundEventContext]
        )] = []

        // Phase 1 is global metadata preflight. Its pending/completed XOR and
        // every ready authority's exact metadata in deterministic order must
        // validate before any classification or operational apply callback.
        for component in components {
            guard let contexts = try readyContexts(
                component: component,
                state: state
            ) else {
                // One missing strict start keeps the entire connected component
                // pending; no snapshot/classification builder is invoked here.
                continue
            }

            for authorityId in component {
                let validated = try snapshot(
                    authorityId: authorityId,
                    state: state,
                    snapshotsByAuthorityId:
                        &snapshotsByAuthorityId,
                    observers: observers
                )
                try validatePendingAuthority(
                    authorityId: authorityId,
                    snapshot: validated,
                    state: state
                )
            }
            readyComponents.append((
                authorityIds: component,
                contextsByRound: contexts
            ))
        }

        // Phase 2 preserves the sorted component/authority operational order
        // only after all ready metadata has passed the first phase.
        guard !readyComponents.isEmpty else {
            return false
        }
        var nextBaseOrdinalByRound =
            try legacyProjectionBaseOrdinals(state: state)
        var didComplete = false
        for readyComponent in readyComponents {
            var componentState = state
            var componentOrdinals = nextBaseOrdinalByRound
            var componentBatchesByAuthorityId =
                classificationBatchesByAuthorityId
            for authorityId in readyComponent.authorityIds {
                guard let validated =
                        snapshotsByAuthorityId[authorityId] else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                let batch = try classificationBatch(
                    snapshot: validated,
                    durableEvents: componentState.events,
                    legacyWireBindings:
                        componentState.legacyWireBindings,
                    observers: observers
                )
                guard componentBatchesByAuthorityId.updateValue(
                            batch,
                            forKey: authorityId
                        ) == nil else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }

                let completed = try applyOperationalMerge(
                    batch: batch,
                    snapshot: validated,
                    contextsByRound:
                        readyComponent.contextsByRound,
                    nextBaseOrdinalByRound:
                        &componentOrdinals,
                    state: &componentState
                )
                guard completed.authorityId == authorityId,
                      completed.sourceRecords
                        == batch.sourceRecords,
                      componentState
                        .completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations
                        .updateValue(
                            completed,
                            forKey: authorityId
                        ) == nil else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }

                // Frozen ordering: completed assignment is durable candidate state
                // before pending removal. Any later throw rolls back the component.
                guard componentState.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations
                        .removeValue(forKey: authorityId) != nil else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
            // Whole-connected-component copy-then-commit: no later authority
            // failure can leak state, ordinal advancement, or cached batches.
            state = componentState
            nextBaseOrdinalByRound = componentOrdinals
            classificationBatchesByAuthorityId =
                componentBatchesByAuthorityId
            didComplete = true
        }
        return didComplete
    }

    // P1.2a2a2c-D1 storage-v1 row-destination preflight START.
    // D1 is pure: it freezes exact row writes and reuse decisions without
    // changing the copied candidate, primary state, or ordinal authority.
    private enum LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision: Equatable {
        case insert
        case reuse
    }

    private struct LegacyStorageV1ProjectionPlan: Equatable {
        let authority: ProjectionAuthority
        let input: DomainProjectionInput
        let decision: LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision
        let newProjectionOrdinal: Int?
    }

    private struct LegacyStorageV1IndependentSupportPlan: Equatable {
        let canonicalOrigin: CanonicalOriginEvidence?
        let localOrdinaryEvidence: LocalOrdinaryOutboxEvidence?
        let verifiedPeerBundleEvidence: VerifiedPeerBundleEvidence?
        let transportRow: OutboxRecord?
        let localProjectionInput: DomainProjectionInput?
    }

    private enum LegacyStorageV1RetryableDestinationPlan: Equatable {
        case independentlySupported(
            LegacyStorageV1IndependentSupportPlan
        )
        case legacyRetryable(
            row: LegacyV1OutboxRecord,
            decision: LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision,
            projection: LegacyStorageV1ProjectionPlan
        )
    }

    private struct LegacyStorageV1RetryableTransportPlan: Equatable {
        let sourceRetryableRow: LegacyV1OutboxRecord
        let destination: LegacyStorageV1RetryableDestinationPlan
    }

    private struct LegacyStorageV1SuccessfulTransportPlan: Equatable {
        let source: LegacyStorageV1SuccessfulTransportSource
        let receiptStorageKey: String
        let receipt: LegacyV1EventReceipt
        let receiptDecision: LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision
        let acceptedReplayEvidence:
            LegacyV1AcceptedReplayEvidence?
        let acceptedReplayDecision:
            LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision?
        let projection: LegacyStorageV1ProjectionPlan
    }

    private struct LegacyStorageV1PermanentDeadLetterTransportPlan:
        Equatable {
        let source: LegacyStorageV1PermanentDeadLetterSource
        let receiptStorageKey: String
        let receipt: LegacyV1EventReceipt
        let receiptDecision: LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision
        let deadLetterRow: OutboxRecord
        let deadLetterDecision: LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision
    }

    private enum LegacyStorageV1ImportedTransportPlan: Equatable {
        case retryable(LegacyStorageV1RetryableTransportPlan)
        case successful(LegacyStorageV1SuccessfulTransportPlan)
        case permanentDeadLetter(
            LegacyStorageV1PermanentDeadLetterTransportPlan
        )
    }

    private struct LegacyStorageV1ImportedRowPlan: Equatable {
        let sourceRecord: LegacyAuthoritySourceRecord
        let event: DomainRoundEvent
        let eventIdentity: String
        let eventHash: String
        let eventDecision: LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision
        let legacyWireBindingKey: String
        let legacyWireBinding: LegacyWireBinding
        let bindingDecision: LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision
        let sourceEvidence: SealedLegacyMigrationEvidence
        let evidenceDecision: LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision
        let transport: LegacyStorageV1ImportedTransportPlan
        let terminalDisposition: LegacyAuthorityTerminalDisposition
    }

    private struct LegacyStorageV1MigrationDeadLetterRowPlan: Equatable {
        let sourceRecord: LegacyAuthoritySourceRecord
        let migrationDeadLetter: MigrationDeadLetter
        let decision: LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision
        let terminalDisposition: LegacyAuthorityTerminalDisposition
    }

    private enum LegacyStorageV1RowPlan: Equatable {
        case imported(LegacyStorageV1ImportedRowPlan)
        case migrationDeadLetter(
            LegacyStorageV1MigrationDeadLetterRowPlan
        )

        var sourceRecord: LegacyAuthoritySourceRecord {
            switch self {
            case .imported(let row):
                return row.sourceRecord
            case .migrationDeadLetter(let row):
                return row.sourceRecord
            }
        }
    }

    private struct LegacyStorageV1RowOperationalMergePlan: Equatable {
        let authority: SealedLegacyAuthority
        let sourceRecords: [LegacyAuthoritySourceRecord]
        let rowPlans: [LegacyStorageV1RowPlan]
        let terminalDispositions:
            [LegacyAuthorityTerminalDisposition]
        let advancedBaseOrdinalByRound: [String: Int]
    }

    private static func prepareStorageV1RowOperationalMerge(
        sourceGraph: LegacyStorageV1AuthoritySourceGraph,
        contextsByRound: [String: RoundEventContext],
        candidate: LegacyOperationalMergeCandidate
    ) throws -> LegacyStorageV1RowOperationalMergePlan {
        let core = sourceGraph.core
        guard core.authority.authorityKind == storageV1AuthorityKind,
              core.sourceRecords.count == core.rows.count else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }

        var affectedRoundIdsInSourceOrder: [String] = []
        var seenAffectedRoundIds = Set<String>()
        affectedRoundIdsInSourceOrder.reserveCapacity(
            core.sourceRecords.count
        )
        for pair in zip(core.sourceRecords, core.rows) {
            let (sourceRecord, sourceRow) = pair
            guard sourceRow.sourceRecord == sourceRecord,
                  sourceRecord.authorityId == core.authority.authorityId,
                  sourceRecord.classification == .event,
                  sourceRecord.coordinateKind == .storageV1Event,
                  sourceRecord.sourceLine > 0,
                  sourceRecord.eventId?.isEmpty == false,
                  let roundId = sourceRecord.roundId,
                  !roundId.isEmpty,
                  contextsByRound[roundId]?.roundId == roundId else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            if seenAffectedRoundIds.insert(roundId).inserted {
                affectedRoundIdsInSourceOrder.append(roundId)
            }
        }

        let baseOrdinalByRound = candidate.nextBaseOrdinalByRound
        var advancedBaseOrdinalByRound: [String: Int] = [:]
        for roundId in affectedRoundIdsInSourceOrder {
            let advanced = try checkedLegacyProjectionOrdinal(
                base: baseOrdinalByRound[roundId, default: 0],
                delta: core.sourceRecords.count
            )
            try insertUnique(
                advanced,
                forKey: roundId,
                in: &advancedBaseOrdinalByRound
            )
        }

        // All relevant destination roots are checked and indexed once before
        // the single ordered source-row planning pass.
        var eventFactsByIdentity = try checkedEventFactsByIdentity(
            candidate.state.events
        )
        var ordinaryOutboxByIdentity = try checkedOrdinaryOutboxByIdentity(
            candidate.state.outbox
        )
        var deadLettersByIdentity = try checkedDeadLettersByIdentity(
            candidate.state.deadLetters
        )
        var projectionInputsByIdentity =
            try checkedLocalProjectionInputsByEventIdentity(
                candidate.state.localProjectionInputs
            )
        var migrationDeadLettersByID =
            try checkedMigrationDeadLettersByID(
                candidate.state.migrationDeadLetters
            )

        var legacyRetryableByIdentity:
            [String: LegacyV1OutboxRecord] = [:]
        for row in candidate.state.legacyV1RetryableOutbox {
            guard !row.eventIdentity.isEmpty,
                  DomainStringValidation.isLowercaseHex64(
                    row.eventHash
                  ),
                  row.receipt == nil,
                  row.deadLetterReason == nil,
                  eventFactsByIdentity[row.eventIdentity]?.eventHash
                    == row.eventHash else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            try insertUnique(
                row,
                forKey: row.eventIdentity,
                in: &legacyRetryableByIdentity
            )
        }

        var sealedEvidenceByKey =
            candidate.state.sealedLegacyMigrationEvidence
        for (evidenceKey, evidence) in sealedEvidenceByKey {
            guard evidenceKey == evidence.evidenceKey,
                  !evidence.authorityId.isEmpty,
                  evidence.sourceLine > 0,
                  !evidence.sourceRecordId.isEmpty,
                  !evidence.legacyWireBindingKey.isEmpty,
                  eventFactsByIdentity[evidence.eventIdentity]?.eventHash
                    == evidence.eventHash else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        }

        var bindingsByKey = candidate.state.legacyWireBindings
        for (bindingKey, binding) in bindingsByKey {
            let expectedKey = try LegacyV1CanonicalIdentityResolver
                .legacyWireBindingKey(
                    roundId: binding.roundId,
                    wireClientId: binding.wireClientId,
                    wireEventId: binding.wireEventId
                )
            guard bindingKey == expectedKey,
                  eventFactsByIdentity[
                    binding.canonicalDomainIdentity
                  ]?.eventHash == binding.canonicalDomainEventHash,
                  binding.legacyAliases.allSatisfy({ alias in
                    alias.eventIdentity
                        == binding.canonicalDomainIdentity
                        && alias.eventHash
                            == binding.canonicalDomainEventHash
                  }) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        }

        var legacyReceiptsByStorageKey =
            candidate.state.legacyV1TerminalReceipts
        var legacyReceiptByIdentity:
            [String: LegacyStorageV1StoredReceipt] = [:]
        for (storageKey, receipt) in legacyReceiptsByStorageKey {
            guard !storageKey.isEmpty,
                  eventFactsByIdentity[receipt.eventIdentity]?.eventHash
                    == receipt.eventHash,
                  receipt.serverSequence >= 0,
                  receipt.serverSequence
                    <= legacyProjectionSafeIntegerMaximum,
                  receipt.status == .accepted
                    || receipt.status == .duplicateHashMatch
                    || receipt.status == .rejectedPermanent else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            try insertUnique(
                LegacyStorageV1StoredReceipt(
                    storageKey: storageKey,
                    receipt: receipt
                ),
                forKey: receipt.eventIdentity,
                in: &legacyReceiptByIdentity
            )
        }

        var legacyAcceptedAwaitingByIdentity =
            candidate.state.legacyV1AcceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay
        for (identity, awaiting) in legacyAcceptedAwaitingByIdentity {
            guard identity == awaiting.eventIdentity,
                  let receipt = legacyReceiptsByStorageKey[
                    awaiting.receiptStorageKey
                  ],
                  receipt.eventIdentity == identity,
                  receipt.eventHash == awaiting.eventHash,
                  receipt.status == .accepted
                    || receipt.status == .duplicateHashMatch else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        }

        var v2ReceiptsByStorageKey = candidate.state.receipts
        var v2ReceiptByIdentity: [String: EventReceipt] = [:]
        for (storageKey, receipt) in v2ReceiptsByStorageKey {
            if let identity = receipt.eventIdentity {
                guard storageKey == identity,
                      let eventHash = receipt.eventHash,
                      eventFactsByIdentity[identity]?.eventHash
                        == eventHash else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                try insertUnique(
                    receipt,
                    forKey: identity,
                    in: &v2ReceiptByIdentity
                )
            }
        }

        var v2AcceptedAwaitingByIdentity =
            candidate.state.acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay
        for (identity, awaiting) in v2AcceptedAwaitingByIdentity {
            guard awaiting.eventIdentity == identity,
                  v2ReceiptByIdentity[identity] == awaiting else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        }

        var independentlySupportedHashByIdentity: [String: String] = [:]
        var canonicalOriginsByIdentity =
            candidate.state.canonicalOriginEvidence
        for (identity, origin) in canonicalOriginsByIdentity {
            guard identity == origin.eventIdentity,
                  eventFactsByIdentity[identity]?.eventHash
                    == origin.eventHash else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            _ = try insertOrReuseExact(
                origin.eventHash,
                forKey: origin.eventIdentity,
                in: &independentlySupportedHashByIdentity
            )
        }

        var localEvidenceByKey =
            candidate.state.localOrdinaryOutboxEvidence
        var localEvidenceByIdentity:
            [String: LocalOrdinaryOutboxEvidence] = [:]
        for (evidenceKey, evidence) in localEvidenceByKey {
            guard evidenceKey == evidence.evidenceKey,
                  eventFactsByIdentity[evidence.eventIdentity]?.eventHash
                    == evidence.eventHash,
                  evidence.clientSequence > 0,
                  evidence.clientSequence
                    <= evidence.reservedThroughAtAppend else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            try insertOrReuseExact(
                evidence.eventHash,
                forKey: evidence.eventIdentity,
                in: &independentlySupportedHashByIdentity
            )
            try insertUnique(
                evidence,
                forKey: evidence.eventIdentity,
                in: &localEvidenceByIdentity
            )
        }

        var peerEvidenceByKey = candidate.state.verifiedPeerBundleEvidence
        var peerEvidenceByIdentity:
            [String: VerifiedPeerBundleEvidence] = [:]
        for (evidenceKey, evidence) in peerEvidenceByKey {
            guard evidenceKey == evidence.evidenceKey,
                  eventFactsByIdentity[evidence.eventIdentity]?.eventHash
                    == evidence.eventHash,
                  !evidence.sourceDeviceId.isEmpty,
                  !evidence.sourceCredentialId.isEmpty else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            try insertOrReuseExact(
                evidence.eventHash,
                forKey: evidence.eventIdentity,
                in: &independentlySupportedHashByIdentity
            )
            try insertUnique(
                evidence,
                forKey: evidence.eventIdentity,
                in: &peerEvidenceByIdentity
            )
        }

        var stagedCanonicalHashByIdentity: [String: String] = [:]
        for staged in candidate.state.stagedInboundProjectionRecords {
            let identity = try staged.input.event.eventIdentity()
            let eventHash = try staged.input.event.eventHash()
            guard eventFactsByIdentity[identity]?.eventHash == eventHash else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            _ = try insertOrReuseExact(
                eventHash,
                forKey: identity,
                in: &stagedCanonicalHashByIdentity
            )
        }

        var rowPlans: [LegacyStorageV1RowPlan] = []
        rowPlans.reserveCapacity(core.rows.count)
        var terminalDispositions:
            [LegacyAuthorityTerminalDisposition] = []
        terminalDispositions.reserveCapacity(core.rows.count)

        for sourceRow in core.rows {
            switch sourceRow {
            case .imported(let sourceRow):
                let sourceRecord = sourceRow.fact.sourceRecord
                let event = sourceRow.fact.imported.candidate.event
                let eventIdentity = sourceRow.fact.eventIdentity
                let eventHash = sourceRow.fact.eventHash
                let bindingKey = sourceRow.fact.legacyWireBindingKey
                let binding = sourceRow.fact.legacyWireBinding
                let sourceEvidence =
                    sourceRow.fact.imported.candidate.sourceEvidence
                guard let roundId = sourceRecord.roundId,
                      let context = contextsByRound[roundId],
                      context.roundId == roundId,
                      sourceRow.fact.imported.candidate.authority
                        == core.authority,
                      try event.eventIdentity() == eventIdentity,
                      try event.eventHash() == eventHash,
                      event.eventId == sourceRecord.eventId,
                      event.roundId == roundId,
                      event.ownerAccountId == context.ownerAccountId,
                      event.subjectPlayerId == context.subjectPlayerId,
                      event.actorId == context.actorId,
                      event.streamSubject == .roundIncarnation(
                        context.roundIncarnationId
                      ),
                      event.roundIntentId == context.roundIntentId,
                      event.snapshotId == context.snapshotId,
                      event.roundSemanticBindingHash == context.semanticBindingHash,
                      binding
                        == sourceRow.fact.imported.legacyWireBinding,
                      binding.roundId == roundId,
                      binding.canonicalDomainIdentity == eventIdentity,
                      binding.canonicalDomainEventHash == eventHash,
                      sourceEvidence.authorityId
                        == core.authority.authorityId,
                      sourceEvidence.authorityFileSha256
                        == core.authority.authorityFileSha256,
                      sourceEvidence.sourceRecordId
                        == sourceRecord.sourceRecordId,
                      sourceEvidence.sourceLine == sourceRecord.sourceLine,
                      sourceEvidence.rawLineBase64
                        == sourceRecord.rawBase64,
                      sourceEvidence.legacyWireBindingKey == bindingKey,
                      sourceEvidence.eventIdentity == eventIdentity,
                      sourceEvidence.eventHash == eventHash else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }

                let eventDecision: LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision =
                    try insertOrReuseExact(
                        LegacyOperationalEventFact(
                            event: event,
                            eventHash: eventHash
                        ),
                        forKey: eventIdentity,
                        in: &eventFactsByIdentity
                    ) ? .insert : .reuse
                let bindingDecision: LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision =
                    try insertOrReuseExact(
                        binding,
                        forKey: bindingKey,
                        in: &bindingsByKey
                    ) ? .insert : .reuse
                let evidenceDecision: LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision =
                    try insertOrReuseExact(
                        sourceEvidence,
                        forKey: sourceEvidence.evidenceKey,
                        in: &sealedEvidenceByKey
                    ) ? .insert : .reuse
                let disposition = LegacyAuthorityTerminalDisposition(
                    sourceRecordId: sourceRecord.sourceRecordId,
                    disposition: .importedEvent,
                    eventIdentity: eventIdentity,
                    eventHash: eventHash,
                    sourceEvidenceKey: sourceEvidence.evidenceKey,
                    migrationDeadLetterId: nil
                )

                let transportPlan: LegacyStorageV1ImportedTransportPlan
                switch sourceRow.transport {
                case .retryable(let sourceRetryable):
                    guard sourceRetryable.eventIdentity == eventIdentity,
                          sourceRetryable.eventHash == eventHash,
                          sourceRetryable.receipt == nil,
                          sourceRetryable.deadLetterReason == nil else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    let canonicalOrigin =
                        canonicalOriginsByIdentity[eventIdentity]
                    let localEvidence =
                        localEvidenceByIdentity[eventIdentity]
                    let peerEvidence = peerEvidenceByIdentity[eventIdentity]
                    let independentSupportHash =
                        independentlySupportedHashByIdentity[eventIdentity]
                    let ordinaryRow = ordinaryOutboxByIdentity[eventIdentity]
                    let deadRow = deadLettersByIdentity[eventIdentity]
                    guard ordinaryRow == nil || deadRow == nil else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    let independentTransportRow = ordinaryRow ?? deadRow
                    let independentProjectionInput =
                        projectionInputsByIdentity[eventIdentity]
                    let destination: LegacyStorageV1RetryableDestinationPlan
                    if let independentSupportHash {
                        guard independentSupportHash == eventHash,
                              legacyRetryableByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                              legacyReceiptByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                              legacyAcceptedAwaitingByIdentity[
                                eventIdentity
                              ] == nil,
                              !(localEvidence != nil
                                && peerEvidence != nil),
                              canonicalOrigin != nil
                                || localEvidence != nil
                                || peerEvidence != nil else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError
                                .storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                        if let canonicalOrigin {
                            guard canonicalOrigin.eventIdentity
                                    == eventIdentity,
                                  canonicalOrigin.eventHash == eventHash,
                                  stagedCanonicalHashByIdentity[
                                    eventIdentity
                                  ].map({ $0 == eventHash }) ?? true else {
                                throw DomainLedgerError
                                    .storageInvariantViolation
                            }
                        }
                        if let localEvidence {
                            guard localEvidence.eventIdentity
                                    == eventIdentity,
                                  localEvidence.eventHash == eventHash,
                                  independentTransportRow?.source
                                    .sourceClass == .localOrdinary,
                                  independentTransportRow?.source
                                    .evidenceKey
                                    == localEvidence.evidenceKey else {
                                throw DomainLedgerError
                                    .storageInvariantViolation
                            }
                        }
                        if let peerEvidence {
                            guard peerEvidence.eventIdentity
                                    == eventIdentity,
                                  peerEvidence.eventHash == eventHash,
                                  independentTransportRow?.source
                                    .sourceClass == .verifiedPeerBundle,
                                  independentTransportRow?.source
                                    .evidenceKey
                                    == peerEvidence.evidenceKey else {
                                throw DomainLedgerError
                                    .storageInvariantViolation
                            }
                        }
                        if let independentTransportRow {
                            guard (localEvidence != nil)
                                    != (peerEvidence != nil),
                                  independentTransportRow.event == event,
                                  independentTransportRow.eventIdentity
                                    == eventIdentity,
                                  independentTransportRow.eventHash
                                    == eventHash,
                                  independentTransportRow.source.sourceClass
                                    != .sealedLegacyMigration else {
                                throw DomainLedgerError
                                    .storageInvariantViolation
                            }
                        }
                        if ordinaryRow != nil {
                            let expectedAuthority: ProjectionAuthority =
                                canonicalOrigin != nil
                                    ? .localTerminalFallback
                                    : localEvidence != nil
                                        ? .localProvisional
                                        : .peerProvisional
                            guard deadRow == nil,
                                  v2ReceiptByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                                  v2AcceptedAwaitingByIdentity[
                                    eventIdentity
                                  ] == nil,
                                  let independentProjectionInput,
                                  independentProjectionInput.event == event,
                                  independentProjectionInput
                                    .projectionOrder.authority
                                    == expectedAuthority else {
                                throw DomainLedgerError
                                    .storageInvariantViolation
                            }
                        }
                        if deadRow != nil {
                            guard ordinaryRow == nil,
                                  independentProjectionInput == nil,
                                  v2AcceptedAwaitingByIdentity[
                                    eventIdentity
                                  ] == nil else {
                                throw DomainLedgerError
                                    .storageInvariantViolation
                            }
                        }
                        if independentTransportRow == nil {
                            guard localEvidence == nil,
                                  peerEvidence == nil,
                                  let canonicalOrigin else {
                                throw DomainLedgerError
                                    .storageInvariantViolation
                            }
                            if let v2Receipt = v2ReceiptByIdentity[
                                eventIdentity
                            ] {
                                guard v2Receipt.eventId == event.eventId,
                                      v2Receipt.eventIdentity
                                        == eventIdentity,
                                      v2Receipt.eventHash == eventHash,
                                      v2Receipt.status == .accepted
                                        || v2Receipt.status
                                            == .acceptedOpaque
                                        || v2Receipt.status
                                            == .duplicateHashMatch,
                                      v2Receipt.ledgerPartitionId
                                        == canonicalOrigin
                                            .ledgerPartitionId,
                                      v2Receipt.ledgerEpoch
                                        == canonicalOrigin.ledgerEpoch,
                                      v2Receipt.streamId
                                        == canonicalOrigin.streamId,
                                      v2Receipt.ledgerPosition
                                        == canonicalOrigin
                                            .ledgerPosition,
                                      v2Receipt.reasonCode == nil,
                                      v2AcceptedAwaitingByIdentity[
                                        eventIdentity
                                      ] == nil,
                                      let independentProjectionInput,
                                      independentProjectionInput.event
                                        == event,
                                      independentProjectionInput
                                        .projectionOrder.authority
                                        == .localTerminalFallback,
                                      independentProjectionInput
                                        .projectionOrder
                                        .ledgerPartitionId == nil,
                                      independentProjectionInput
                                        .projectionOrder
                                        .ledgerPosition == nil else {
                                    throw DomainLedgerError
                                        .storageInvariantViolation
                                }
                            } else {
                                guard v2AcceptedAwaitingByIdentity[
                                        eventIdentity
                                      ] == nil,
                                      independentProjectionInput == nil else {
                                    throw DomainLedgerError
                                        .storageInvariantViolation
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        destination = .independentlySupported(
                            LegacyStorageV1IndependentSupportPlan(
                                canonicalOrigin: canonicalOrigin,
                                localOrdinaryEvidence: localEvidence,
                                verifiedPeerBundleEvidence: peerEvidence,
                                transportRow: independentTransportRow,
                                localProjectionInput: independentProjectionInput
                            )
                        )
                    } else {
                        guard ordinaryRow == nil,
                              deadRow == nil,
                              legacyReceiptByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                              legacyAcceptedAwaitingByIdentity[
                                eventIdentity
                              ] == nil,
                              v2ReceiptByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                              v2AcceptedAwaitingByIdentity[
                                eventIdentity
                              ] == nil,
                              canonicalOriginsByIdentity[eventIdentity]
                                == nil,
                              localEvidenceByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                              peerEvidenceByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                              stagedCanonicalHashByIdentity[eventIdentity]
                                == nil else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError
                                .storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                        let expectedRetryable = sourceRetryable
                        let retryableDecision:
                            LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision =
                            try insertOrReuseExact(
                                expectedRetryable,
                                forKey: eventIdentity,
                                in: &legacyRetryableByIdentity
                            ) ? .insert : .reuse
                        let ordinal = try checkedLegacyProjectionOrdinal(
                            base: baseOrdinalByRound[
                                roundId,
                                default: 0
                            ],
                            delta: sourceRecord.sourceLine
                        )
                        let expectedProjection = DomainProjectionInput(
                            event: event,
                            projectionOrder: try DomainProjectionOrder(
                                authority: .localProvisional,
                                ledgerPartitionId: nil,
                                ledgerPosition: nil,
                                sourceOrdinal: ordinal
                            )
                        )
                        let projectionDecision:
                            LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision
                        let projectionInput: DomainProjectionInput
                        let newProjectionOrdinal: Int?
                        if let existing = projectionInputsByIdentity[
                            eventIdentity
                        ] {
                            guard existing == expectedProjection else {
                                throw DomainLedgerError
                                    .storageInvariantViolation
                            }
                            projectionInput = existing
                            projectionDecision = .reuse
                            newProjectionOrdinal = nil
                        } else {
                            try insertUnique(
                                expectedProjection,
                                forKey: eventIdentity,
                                in: &projectionInputsByIdentity
                            )
                            projectionInput = expectedProjection
                            projectionDecision = .insert
                            newProjectionOrdinal = ordinal
                        }
                        destination = .legacyRetryable(
                            row: expectedRetryable,
                            decision: retryableDecision,
                            projection: LegacyStorageV1ProjectionPlan(
                                authority: .localProvisional,
                                input: projectionInput,
                                decision: projectionDecision,
                                newProjectionOrdinal:
                                    newProjectionOrdinal
                            )
                        )
                    }
                    transportPlan = .retryable(
                        LegacyStorageV1RetryableTransportPlan(
                            sourceRetryableRow: sourceRetryable,
                            destination: destination
                        )
                    )

                case .successful(let sourceSuccessful):
                    let receiptStorageKey =
                        sourceSuccessful.receiptStorageKey
                    let receipt = sourceSuccessful.receipt
                    guard !receiptStorageKey.isEmpty,
                          receipt.eventIdentity == eventIdentity,
                          receipt.eventHash == eventHash,
                          receipt.status == .accepted
                            || receipt.status == .duplicateHashMatch,
                          ordinaryOutboxByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                          deadLettersByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                          legacyRetryableByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                          v2ReceiptByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                          v2AcceptedAwaitingByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                          localEvidenceByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                          peerEvidenceByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    let storedReceipt = LegacyStorageV1StoredReceipt(
                        storageKey: receiptStorageKey,
                        receipt: receipt
                    )
                    if let existing = legacyReceiptByIdentity[
                        eventIdentity
                    ] {
                        guard existing == storedReceipt else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError
                                .storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                    }
                    let receiptDecision:
                        LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision =
                        try insertOrReuseExact(
                            receipt,
                            forKey: receiptStorageKey,
                            in: &legacyReceiptsByStorageKey
                        ) ? .insert : .reuse
                    _ = try insertOrReuseExact(
                        storedReceipt,
                        forKey: eventIdentity,
                        in: &legacyReceiptByIdentity
                    )

                    let acceptedReplayEvidence:
                        LegacyV1AcceptedReplayEvidence?
                    let acceptedReplayDecision:
                        LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision?
                    let projectionAuthority: ProjectionAuthority
                    if let canonicalOrigin = canonicalOriginsByIdentity[eventIdentity] {
                        guard canonicalOrigin.eventIdentity == eventIdentity,
                              canonicalOrigin.eventHash == eventHash,
                              legacyAcceptedAwaitingByIdentity[
                                eventIdentity
                              ] == nil,
                              stagedCanonicalHashByIdentity[
                                eventIdentity
                              ].map({ $0 == eventHash }) ?? true else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError
                                .storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                        projectionAuthority = .localTerminalFallback
                        acceptedReplayEvidence = nil
                        acceptedReplayDecision = nil
                    } else {
                        guard stagedCanonicalHashByIdentity[eventIdentity]
                                == nil else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError
                                .storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                        let awaitingDecision:
                            LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision =
                            try insertOrReuseExact(
                                sourceSuccessful.acceptedReplayEvidence,
                                forKey: eventIdentity,
                                in: &legacyAcceptedAwaitingByIdentity
                            ) ? .insert : .reuse
                        projectionAuthority = .acceptedAwaitingReplay
                        acceptedReplayEvidence =
                            sourceSuccessful.acceptedReplayEvidence
                        acceptedReplayDecision = awaitingDecision
                    }

                    let ordinal = try checkedLegacyProjectionOrdinal(
                        base: baseOrdinalByRound[roundId, default: 0],
                        delta: sourceRecord.sourceLine
                    )
                    let expectedProjection = DomainProjectionInput(
                        event: event,
                        projectionOrder: try DomainProjectionOrder(
                            authority: projectionAuthority,
                            ledgerPartitionId: nil,
                            ledgerPosition: nil,
                            sourceOrdinal: ordinal
                        )
                    )
                    let projectionDecision:
                        LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision
                    let projectionInput: DomainProjectionInput
                    let newProjectionOrdinal: Int?
                    if let existing = projectionInputsByIdentity[
                        eventIdentity
                    ] {
                        guard existing == expectedProjection else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError
                                .storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                        projectionInput = existing
                        projectionDecision = .reuse
                        newProjectionOrdinal = nil
                    } else {
                        try insertUnique(
                            expectedProjection,
                            forKey: eventIdentity,
                            in: &projectionInputsByIdentity
                        )
                        projectionInput = expectedProjection
                        projectionDecision = .insert
                        newProjectionOrdinal = ordinal
                    }
                    transportPlan = .successful(
                        LegacyStorageV1SuccessfulTransportPlan(
                            source: sourceSuccessful,
                            receiptStorageKey: receiptStorageKey,
                            receipt: receipt,
                            receiptDecision: receiptDecision,
                            acceptedReplayEvidence:
                                acceptedReplayEvidence,
                            acceptedReplayDecision:
                                acceptedReplayDecision,
                            projection: LegacyStorageV1ProjectionPlan(
                                authority: projectionAuthority,
                                input: projectionInput,
                                decision: projectionDecision,
                                newProjectionOrdinal:
                                    newProjectionOrdinal
                            )
                        )
                    )

                case .permanentDeadLetter(let sourcePermanent):
                    let rejectedReceipt =
                        sourcePermanent.deadLetter.receipt
                    let legacyReason =
                        sourcePermanent.deadLetter.deadLetterReason
                    guard let rejectedReceipt,
                          let legacyReason,
                          sourcePermanent.deadLetter.eventIdentity
                            == eventIdentity,
                          sourcePermanent.deadLetter.eventHash == eventHash,
                          rejectedReceipt.eventIdentity == eventIdentity,
                          rejectedReceipt.eventHash == eventHash,
                          rejectedReceipt.status == .rejectedPermanent,
                          !legacyReason.trimmingCharacters(
                            in: .whitespacesAndNewlines
                          ).isEmpty,
                          ordinaryOutboxByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                          legacyRetryableByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                          v2ReceiptByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                          v2AcceptedAwaitingByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                          legacyAcceptedAwaitingByIdentity[
                            eventIdentity
                          ] == nil,
                          canonicalOriginsByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                          localEvidenceByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                          peerEvidenceByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                          stagedCanonicalHashByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil,
                          projectionInputsByIdentity[eventIdentity] == nil else {
                        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                    }
                    let storedReceipt = LegacyStorageV1StoredReceipt(
                        storageKey: sourcePermanent.receiptStorageKey,
                        receipt: rejectedReceipt
                    )
                    if let existing = legacyReceiptByIdentity[
                        eventIdentity
                    ] {
                        guard existing == storedReceipt else {
                            throw DomainLedgerError
                                .storageInvariantViolation
                        }
                    }
                    let receiptDecision:
                        LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision =
                        try insertOrReuseExact(
                            rejectedReceipt,
                            forKey: sourcePermanent.receiptStorageKey,
                            in: &legacyReceiptsByStorageKey
                        ) ? .insert : .reuse
                    _ = try insertOrReuseExact(
                        storedReceipt,
                        forKey: eventIdentity,
                        in: &legacyReceiptByIdentity
                    )
                    let deadLetterRow = OutboxRecord(
                        event: event,
                        eventIdentity: eventIdentity,
                        eventHash: eventHash,
                        source: OutboxSourceReference(
                            sourceClass: .sealedLegacyMigration,
                            evidenceKey: sourceEvidence.evidenceKey
                        ),
                        receipt: nil,
                        receiptStorageKey: nil,
                        deadLetterReason: legacyReason
                    )
                    let deadLetterDecision:
                        LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision =
                        try insertOrReuseExact(
                            deadLetterRow,
                            forKey: eventIdentity,
                            in: &deadLettersByIdentity
                        ) ? .insert : .reuse
                    transportPlan = .permanentDeadLetter(
                        LegacyStorageV1PermanentDeadLetterTransportPlan(
                            source: sourcePermanent,
                            receiptStorageKey:
                                sourcePermanent.receiptStorageKey,
                            receipt: rejectedReceipt,
                            receiptDecision: receiptDecision,
                            deadLetterRow: deadLetterRow,
                            deadLetterDecision: deadLetterDecision
                        )
                    )
                }

                rowPlans.append(.imported(
                    LegacyStorageV1ImportedRowPlan(
                        sourceRecord: sourceRecord,
                        event: event,
                        eventIdentity: eventIdentity,
                        eventHash: eventHash,
                        eventDecision: eventDecision,
                        legacyWireBindingKey: bindingKey,
                        legacyWireBinding: binding,
                        bindingDecision: bindingDecision,
                        sourceEvidence: sourceEvidence,
                        evidenceDecision: evidenceDecision,
                        transport: transportPlan,
                        terminalDisposition: disposition
                    )
                ))
                terminalDispositions.append(disposition)

            case .migrationDeadLetter(let sourceDead):
                let sourceRecord = sourceDead.sourceRecord
                let dead = sourceDead.migrationDeadLetter
                guard dead.sourceLine == sourceRecord.sourceLine,
                      dead.eventId == sourceRecord.eventId,
                      dead.roundId == sourceRecord.roundId,
                      dead.rawBase64 == sourceRecord.rawBase64 else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
                let decision: LegacyStorageV1DestinationDecision =
                    try insertOrReuseExact(
                        dead,
                        forKey: dead.id,
                        in: &migrationDeadLettersByID
                    ) ? .insert : .reuse
                let disposition = LegacyAuthorityTerminalDisposition(
                    sourceRecordId: sourceRecord.sourceRecordId,
                    disposition: .migrationDeadLetter,
                    eventIdentity: nil,
                    eventHash: nil,
                    sourceEvidenceKey: nil,
                    migrationDeadLetterId: dead.id
                )
                rowPlans.append(.migrationDeadLetter(
                    LegacyStorageV1MigrationDeadLetterRowPlan(
                        sourceRecord: sourceRecord,
                        migrationDeadLetter: dead,
                        decision: decision,
                        terminalDisposition: disposition
                    )
                ))
                terminalDispositions.append(disposition)
            }
        }

        guard rowPlans.count == core.sourceRecords.count,
              terminalDispositions.count == core.sourceRecords.count,
              zip(core.sourceRecords, rowPlans).allSatisfy({
                $0.0 == $0.1.sourceRecord
              }),
              zip(core.sourceRecords, terminalDispositions).allSatisfy({
                $0.0.sourceRecordId == $0.1.sourceRecordId
              }) else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        return LegacyStorageV1RowOperationalMergePlan(
            authority: core.authority,
            sourceRecords: core.sourceRecords,
            rowPlans: rowPlans,
            terminalDispositions: terminalDispositions,
            advancedBaseOrdinalByRound: advancedBaseOrdinalByRound
        )
    }
    // P1.2a2a2c-D1 storage-v1 row-destination preflight END.
}
```

`resumeEligiblePendingComponents`固定为两阶段：先按`pendingConnectedComponents`的deterministic component/authority顺序枚举全部component；missing-context component直接跳过且零snapshot/classification。对每个ready component只读取或复用snapshot并运行`validatePendingAuthority`，保存component与contexts；该全局metadata preflight显式包含pending/completed exact XOR，要求completed map中同一authority ID必须缺席。全局preflight后没有ready component时直接返回`false`，也不扫描legacy projection base ordinal。只有全部ready metadata都通过后才进入phase 2。

phase 2对每个ready connected component执行whole-component copy-then-commit：从当前primary candidate复制`componentState`、`componentOrdinals`与保留此前已提交batch cache的component-local batch map；component内后一个authority的classification必须读取前一个authority已经写入candidate的`componentState.events`与`componentState.legacyWireBindings`。每个authority仍按classification → missing `applyOperationalMerge` call → completed assignment → pending removal的确定顺序执行，completed必须先进入`componentState.completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations`，随后才能从同一candidate移除pending。只有component内所有authority都成功，才把三份component candidate一起赋回primary；任一后续authority抛错都不得泄漏前一个authority的state、ordinal advancement或batch cache，且不得catch-and-continue。`didComplete`只在整份component提交后置为`true`。

`legacyProjectionBaseOrdinals(state:)`是P1.2a2a1冻结的projection ordinal owner：它只扫描`state.localProjectionInputs`，按`input.event.roundId`取non-canonical local ordinal最大值，缺省base为0；遇到`.canonicalReplay`必须在读取/range-check其`sourceOrdinal`之前直接`continue`，因此serving/staged inbound canonical replay roots从不参与base。所有被计入的ordinal必须位于`0...9_007_199_254_740_991`，checked-add同时拒绝negative base/delta与`base + delta`溢出。

P1.2a2a1只冻结后续operational merge所需的private groundwork：generic exact dictionary insert/reuse、六个array-backed destination checked index builder，以及只持有copied `DomainLedgerStateV2`/ordinal map的candidate。所有index key都在builder中checked生成，duplicate row一律fail closed；candidate primitive本身不向primary `inout` state或ordinal map赋值。

P1.2a2a2a新增唯一pure `prepareIOSOperationalMerge(...)`：它只读by-value candidate，先证明batch/snapshot authority、ordered source roster与already-read `.iosJSONL` record的coordinate/raw/classification exact pairing；随后在ordered row loop之前各构造一次event/outbox/dead-letter/local-projection/migration-dead-letter checked index并复制dictionary indexes。row loop按scanner roster恰好一次调用`batch.result(for:)`，只生成exact values与`.insert/.reuse` decisions；不得重读、重解码、重seal authority，不得写candidate、primary state或ordinal map。

| iOS row/result | Planned roots | Preflight collision/reuse | Terminal disposition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.event / .importedEvent` | exact event identity/hash、完整binding（含aliases）、sealed evidence、`.sealedLegacyMigration` outbox、canonical-origin-selected local projection | same identity/different event hash或canonical-origin hash立即fail；每个destination只允许exact reuse，否则insert；projection先构造checked `base + sourceLine` full input，exact full-input reuse时`newProjectionOrdinal == nil` | `.importedEvent`携带exact identity/hash/evidence key |
| `.malformed` or `.event` / `.migrationDeadLetter` | only exact `MigrationDeadLetter` | same ID只允许exact reuse，否则new insertion | `.migrationDeadLetter`只携带exact dead-letter ID |
| `.syncMarker / .ignoredSyncMarker` | no operational root | no destination lookup/write | `.ignoredSyncMarker`且其余nullable fields全nil |

affected rounds只从event-classified source records（即`.event` rows）派生；任一event row缺少non-empty round ID立即fail closed。任何row plan之前，每个affected round都checked-preflight `base + batch.sourceRecords.count`，每个imported projection都checked `base + sourceRecord.sourceLine`。输出row/disposition roster与source roster exact同长、同序，并只携带affected-round advanced bases；completion roster SHA、marker与shared iOS/storage commit owner留给后续dispatcher slices。storage-v1 operational roots与completion/shared dispatcher commit仍不属于P1.2a2a2a，33项测试/filter保持不变。

P1.2a2a2b新增唯一private nonthrowing `commitIOSOperationalMerge(plan:candidate:)`，作为prepare-then-commit的第二半，只接收already-validated `LegacyIOSOperationalMergePlan`与`inout LegacyOperationalMergeCandidate`。它按`plan.rowPlans`原序恰好循环一次；`.importedEvent`分别switch五个既定decision，仅在`.insert`把plan中exact event、binding key/value、evidence key/value、outbox row与projection input写入candidate，`.reuse`一律no-op；`.migrationDeadLetter`只在`.insert` append exact planned row；`.ignoredSyncMarker`零写入。row loop完整结束后，才把`plan.advancedBaseOrdinalByRound`每个entry exact赋给candidate ordinal map，不做算术且不改其他round。

该commit helper不得throw、try、guard、validate、catch、`try?`、trap/force-unwrap；不得读取、扫描或重建candidate index，不得IO、decode、hash或seal；不得生成completion record/SHA/marker，不得触碰storage-v1 roots、primary state或outer ordinal。它只消费preflight已经冻结的values/decisions并只变更传入candidate；33项legacy-authority测试与33条filter的顺序和数量保持不变。

P1.2a2a2c-S1a1只接收already-validated `batch`与`snapshot`，在O(source+roots)内把exact storage-v1 event/binding/transport XOR与receipt-key graph规范化为source graph；它按source roster对每条record恰好调用一次`batch.result(for:)`，并直接信任validated raw capability，不重读、不重解码或重seal authority。

S1a1所有source-root traversal必须保持线性，禁止任何`.sorted`变体；source dictionary iteration顺序不承载输出确定性。
