S1a1显式不包含prepared/Watch/marker/anomaly source roots（归P1.2a2a2c-S1a2），也不包含candidate/destination/ordinal/disposition/commit/completion/shared dispatcher；33项测试与33条filter保持不变，`applyOperationalMerge(...)` production definitions=0、call=1。

P1.2a2a2c-S1a2的唯一入口只接收S1a1产出的`core`与同一already-decoded storage-v1 `snapshot`。initial guard必须先证明`core.authority == snapshot.authority`、authority kind exact为`storageV1AuthorityKind`、snapshot contents exact为storage-v1且`legacy.storageVersion == 1`、`core.origin == legacy.origin`、`core.parsedTransportEvidence == legacy.transportEvidence`；任一不符都fail closed。

`preparedLegacyV1Batches`必须按source array原序保留exact batch/request bytes。每个batch的`idempotencyKey`必须nonempty并在唯一index中只出现一次，`lowercaseSHA256(exactRequestBody)`必须exact等于literal `requestBodySha256`；`StrictJSONDecoder`必须把exact body解为只含`events`的object，且body events exact等于`orderedSlots`的normalized envelope原序。每个slot必须以`CanonicalJSON`重算exact envelope hash，按`bindingKey`命中`core.legacyWireBindingsByKey`，并要求binding round exact等于batch round、binding normalized wire hash exact等于slot literal hash；duplicate key（包括exact duplicate）必须fail closed。

`watchTerminalReceiptRelayObligations`必须按source array原序保留并以`obligationId`唯一索引；每项必须按identity命中`core.terminalReceiptsByIdentity`且receipt identity/hash/status逐字段exact matching。`watchTerminalReceiptRelayConfirmations`同样按source array原序保留并以`confirmationId`唯一索引，每项必须按`obligationId`命中source obligation且obligation ID/identity/hash/status全部exact matching；duplicate ID与orphan confirmation必须fail closed，但source obligation可以合法保持unconfirmed，S1a2不得要求confirmation覆盖全部obligation。`migrationMarkers`必须原样保留exact unchanged `CanonicalStringSet`且每项trim后nonblank；不得在这里添加`storageV1AuthorityKind`或completion marker。

每个`LegacyV1TransportAnomaly`必须由exact `{roundId,code,evidence}`构造`TransportAnomaly/v1` typed ID，再用exact insert/reuse仅折叠source中的exact duplicate；输出保持first-occurrence order，不排序，同ID/different body collision必须fail closed。`LegacyStorageV1AuthoritySourceGraph`的输出roster exact只有六项：`core`、`preparedBatchesInSourceOrder`、`watchObligationsInSourceOrder`、`watchConfirmationsInSourceOrder`、`exactMigrationMarkers`、`transportAnomaliesInFirstOccurrenceOrder`；不得调用`batch.result(for:)`、重扫source records或S1a1 events/bindings/outbox/deadLetters/receipts，不得重读/重解码/重seal authority，也不得读取或修改任何destination/candidate/projection/ordinal/disposition/completion/commit/shared-dispatcher state。

后续`applyOperationalMerge`实现必须保留以下ordinal规则：新写入的imported projection ordinal exact为`baseForRound + sourceRecord.sourceLine`；authority成功后只推进这些affected rounds，而且推进量必须是完整source-record roster count，绝不能用inserted projection count或event count；malformed、sync marker与other-round lines因此留下不可复用的hole。未受该authority影响的round不得推进。

P1.2a1故意保留`applyOperationalMerge(batch:snapshot:contextsByRound:nextBaseOrdinalByRound:state:)`调用且production definition为零、call site恰好一个；P1.2a2a1只增加可复用candidate/index/collision primitives，P1.2a2a2a只增加上述pure iOS plan，P1.2a2a2b只增加对应candidate-local iOS commit half。storage-v1 operational matrix与completion/shared dispatcher commit仍归后续GREEN slices；该checkpoint不得用placeholder body、catch-and-continue或第二套raw import API提前填充它。

P1.2a2a2c-D1是pure storage-v1 row-destination preflight：唯一入口`prepareStorageV1RowOperationalMerge(sourceGraph:contextsByRound:candidate:)`只消费S1a2 graph、exact round contexts与by-value candidate，并返回immutable row plan。它先锁定authority kind、`core.sourceRecords`/`core.rows` exact同长同序且每个`row.sourceRecord`对应、每条storage-v1 source record均为nonempty event-classified round及其exact context；imported event的owner/subject/actor/round-incarnation stream、round intent、snapshot与semantic binding必须逐字段match context。旧pending在显式origin rotation后仍须继续，因此D1不得把`core.origin`与当前`candidate.state.originSequenceAuthority`作device、epoch、high-water或whole-value比较，也不得修改任一origin authority。

affected round按source roster首次出现顺序派生；在任何row plan前，每个affected round都checked advance `base + core.sourceRecords.count`（full source roster），而每个由D1新建的projection使用checked `base + sourceRecord.sourceLine`。malformed conversion、migration-dead row及其他round source line都留下不可复用hole；exact independent support复用既有local projection时保留其原ordinal，绝不强迫改成storage-v1 sourceLine。row plan与terminal disposition均按`core.rows`原序append并与source roster exact同长同序，不排序、不reverse。

所有array destination只在ordered row loop前各调用一次既有checked event、ordinary-outbox、dead-letter、local-projection与migration-dead-letter index owner；legacy V1 retryable另建event-identity唯一index并验证`receipt == nil && deadLetterReason == nil`。sealed evidence、binding、legacy terminal receipt storage-key map与identity唯一owner、legacy awaiting、V2 receipt/awaiting、canonical origin以及pending-authority frozen的local-ordinary/verified-peer support roots都预先copy/check；staged canonical identity/hash也预先建O(1) index。canonical/local/peer同identity+exact hash可幂等合并成exact independent canonical/local-ordinary/verified-peer support，same identity/different hash、partial link或多个transport owner立即fail closed；每个nonnil independent transport row必须由local或peer evidence恰好一个（XOR）完整back且`sourceClass`/`evidenceKey` exact matching，canonical-only support强制transport row与两类evidence均nil，而canonical可以与一份complete local或peer graph共存；不得把bare V2 receipt/dead-letter graph提升为第四类independent support。整个retryable independent prefix从source row guard到independent plan construction都禁止构造`OutboxRecord`、`DomainProjectionInput`或`LegacyStorageV1ProjectionPlan`。整个D1复杂度固定为O(source + relevant destination roots)，ordered row loop内只能做keyed lookup，不能扫描任何destination collection。

ordinary independent projection authority不得折叠来源：local-only且无canonical origin时existing projection必须exact为`.localProvisional`；peer-only且无canonical origin时必须exact为`.peerProvisional`；canonical与一份complete local或peer ordinary graph共存时必须exact为`.localTerminalFallback`。dead transport始终要求projection nil。pure canonical-only且无V2 receipt时要求V2 awaiting与local projection均nil；若同identity已有V2 successful terminal receipt，则status只允许`.accepted`/`.acceptedOpaque`/`.duplicateHashMatch`，receipt event/identity/hash以及`ledgerPartitionId`/`ledgerEpoch`/`streamId`/`ledgerPosition`必须与event和canonical origin逐字段exact，V2 awaiting必须nil，retained projection event必须exact且authority为`.localTerminalFallback`，原`sourceOrdinal`原样保留。orphan/wrong event/hash/authority/awaiting/rejected receipt一律fail closed。

| storage-v1 source row | Destination root plan | Exact collision/XOR | Projection | Terminal disposition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| retryable | every import仍plan exact event、binding、sealed historical evidence；若已有exact independent support则只保留该canonical/local/peer graph，否则plan exact `LegacyV1OutboxRecord` insert/reuse | independent support必须identity+hash exact且其transport/evidence link完整；它抑制duplicate legacy retryable。无support时ordinary/V2 receipt/awaiting/dead/legacy-terminal/canonical/staged owner均须absent；canonical-only只接受empty transport或exact V2 successful terminal graph | independent support零新projection并按下表保留existing projection/ordinal；legacy-owned path为`.localProvisional` exact insert/reuse | `.importedEvent`携带exact identity/hash/evidence key |
| successful without canonical origin | exact legacy receipt按original `receiptStorageKey` insert/reuse；exact `LegacyV1AcceptedReplayEvidence`按identity insert/reuse | reject retryable、dead、ordinary/V2 receipt/awaiting及local/peer owner；receipt storage key与identity owner都只能full-value exact reuse | `.acceptedAwaitingReplay` full `DomainProjectionInput` insert/reuse | `.importedEvent`携带exact identity/hash/evidence key |
| successful with exact canonical origin | exact legacy receipt按original key insert/reuse；不得plan legacy awaiting | canonical identity/hash必须exact；same identity/different hash及任何cross-protocol transport owner失败 | `.localTerminalFallback` full `DomainProjectionInput` insert/reuse | `.importedEvent`携带exact identity/hash/evidence key |
| permanent dead letter | exact rejected receipt只plan到`legacyV1TerminalReceipts`；V2 dead row使用exact event/identity/hash、`.sealedLegacyMigration` evidence reference、exact nonblank legacy reason，且`receipt == nil`、`receiptStorageKey == nil` | reject retryable、successful、ordinary/V2 receipt/awaiting、canonical/staged/local/peer owner；existing dead row仅full-value exact reuse | none；任何existing local projection都失败 | `.importedEvent`携带exact identity/hash/evidence key |
| migration dead letter | only exact `MigrationDeadLetter` insert/reuse | 不plan event、binding、sealed evidence或transport | none | `.migrationDeadLetter`只携带exact dead-letter ID |

| retryable independent graph | Exact retained projection |
|---|---|
| local-only ordinary, no canonical | exact event + `.localProvisional` + original ordinal |
| peer-only ordinary, no canonical | exact event + `.peerProvisional` + original ordinal |
| canonical + complete local/peer ordinary | exact event + `.localTerminalFallback` + original ordinal |
| pure canonical-only, no V2 receipt | none |
| canonical + exact V2 successful terminal | exact event + `.localTerminalFallback` + original ordinal |
| independent dead transport | none |

`LegacyStorageV1RowOperationalMergePlan`只含authority、exact source records、ordered row plans、ordered terminal dispositions与affected-round advanced base ordinals；不含completion record、disposition SHA或authority marker。每个imported row无论transport分支都在共同owner中plan exact event/binding/sealed evidence/disposition，permanent也不得遗漏source evidence；storage-v1绝不创建ordinary V2 outbox、V2 receipt或V2 accepted-awaiting row。每个destination key/identity只允许`.insert`或full-value `.reuse`，不得overwrite后伪称reuse。

D1全程zero-write：不得修改candidate、primary state或outer ordinal map，不得commit root、构造completion/SHA/marker、调用I/O、读取/解码/reseal snapshot/authority、调用`batch.result(for:)`、定义或调用`applyOperationalMerge`，也不得catch/continue。D1显式不读取`preparedBatchesInSourceOrder`、`watchObligationsInSourceOrder`、`watchConfirmationsInSourceOrder`、`exactMigrationMarkers`或`transportAnomaliesInFirstOccurrenceOrder`；这些authority-wide destination plans、Watch/source marker/anomaly merge以及shared commit/dispatcher全部留给D2。

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/DomainLedgerStorageMigration.swift
// Replace Task 11's existing capture method only; the mutation body stays
// single-owner here, while the store constructs the file-private operation.
extension DomainLedgerStore {
    fileprivate func capturePendingLegacyAuthority(
        _ capture: ValidatedPendingLegacyAuthorityCapture,
        observers: LegacyAuthorityProcessingObservers
    ) throws {
        let snapshot = capture.snapshot
        try transactionForValidatedPendingLegacyAuthorityCapture(
            snapshot,
            observers: observers
        ) { state in
            let stagingOrigin = state.originSequenceAuthority
            let authority = snapshot.authority
            let pending = capture.pending
            let legacyStorageEvidence = capture.legacyStorageEvidence
            guard stagingOrigin == capture.originSequenceAuthority,
                  pending.authorityId == authority.authorityId,
                  pending.authorityKind == authority.authorityKind,
                  pending.authorityFileSha256
                    == authority.authorityFileSha256,
                  state.completedLegacyAuthorityMigrations[
                    authority.authorityId
                  ] == nil,
                  legacyStorageEvidence.storageVersion == 1,
                  legacyStorageEvidence.rawStorageBase64
                    == authority.authorityFileBase64,
                  legacyStorageEvidence.rawStorageSha256
                    == authority.authorityFileSha256 else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            if let existing = state.sealedLegacyAuthorities[
                authority.authorityId
            ] {
                guard existing == authority else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            } else {
                state.sealedLegacyAuthorities[authority.authorityId] =
                    authority
            }
            if let existing = state.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations[
                authority.authorityId
            ] {
                guard existing == pending else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            } else {
                state.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations[
                    authority.authorityId
                ] = pending
            }
            if state.legacyTransportEvidence.isEmpty {
                state.legacyTransportEvidence.append(
                    legacyStorageEvidence
                )
            } else {
                guard state.legacyTransportEvidence
                        == [legacyStorageEvidence] else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
                }
            }
            guard state.originSequenceAuthority == stagingOrigin else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/DomainLedgerStore.swift
// Replace Task 11's productionStore and both transaction overloads with these
// final Task 12 definitions; do not append duplicate declarations.
fileprivate struct PrevalidatedLegacyAuthorityOperation {
    var snapshotsByAuthorityId:
        [String: ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot] = [:]
    var classificationBatchesByAuthorityId:
        [String: LegacyAuthorityClassificationBatch] = [:]
}

extension DomainLedgerStore {
    static func productionStore(
        directoryURL: URL,
        expectedOriginDeviceId: String,
        trustedPeerServerKeys: [String: Data],
        fixedIOSSnapshotProvider:
            (() throws -> ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot?)?,
        observers: LegacyAuthorityProcessingObservers,
        faultHook: @escaping (
            DomainLedgerFaultPoint
        ) throws -> Void = { _ in }
    ) throws -> DomainLedgerStore {
        guard !expectedOriginDeviceId.trimmingCharacters(
                in: .whitespacesAndNewlines
              ).isEmpty else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        let root = directoryURL.standardizedFileURL
            .resolvingSymlinksInPath()
        productionOwnerLock.lock()
        defer { productionOwnerLock.unlock() }
        guard claimedProductionRoots.insert(root).inserted else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.productionOwnerAlreadyOpen
        }
        do {
            let stateURL = Self.stateURL(in: root)
            let seed = FileManager.default.fileExists(
                atPath: stateURL.path
            ) ? nil : DomainLedgerStateV2(
                originSequenceAuthority: try .fresh(
                    originDeviceId: expectedOriginDeviceId
                )
            )
            let store = try DomainLedgerStore(
                directoryURL: root,
                seedState: seed,
                claimedProductionRoot: root,
                trustedPeerServerKeys: trustedPeerServerKeys,
                faultHook: faultHook
            )
            // Cold open always executes the required full operational gate,
            // even when there is no fixed snapshot and no pending authority.
            try store.resumeLegacyAuthoritiesAndValidate(
                expectedOriginDeviceId: expectedOriginDeviceId,
                fixedIOSSnapshotProvider:
                    fixedIOSSnapshotProvider,
                observers: observers
            )
            return store
        } catch {
            claimedProductionRoots.remove(root)
            throw error
        }
    }

    func cachedLegacyOpenInspection() throws -> (
        originDeviceId: String,
        hasPendingLegacyAuthority: Bool
    ) {
        try locked {
            let state = try loadV2()
            return (
                state.originSequenceAuthority.originDeviceId,
                !state.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations.isEmpty
            )
        }
    }

    func resumeLegacyAuthoritiesAndValidate(
        expectedOriginDeviceId: String,
        fixedIOSSnapshotProvider:
            (() throws -> ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot?)?,
        observers: LegacyAuthorityProcessingObservers
    ) throws {
        try locked {
            var state = try loadV2()
            guard state.originSequenceAuthority.originDeviceId
                    == expectedOriginDeviceId else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            let fixedIOSSnapshot:
                ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot?
            if let fixedIOSSnapshotProvider {
                fixedIOSSnapshot = try fixedIOSSnapshotProvider()
            } else {
                fixedIOSSnapshot = nil
            }
            var operation =
                PrevalidatedLegacyAuthorityOperation()
            var didMutate = false
            if let fixedIOSSnapshot {
                if try LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator
                    .captureFixedIOSAuthority(
                        snapshot: fixedIOSSnapshot,
                        state: &state,
                        snapshotsByAuthorityId:
                            &operation.snapshotsByAuthorityId
                    ) {
                    didMutate = true
                }
            }
            if try LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator
                .resumeEligiblePendingComponents(
                    state: &state,
                    snapshotsByAuthorityId:
                        &operation.snapshotsByAuthorityId,
                    classificationBatchesByAuthorityId:
                        &operation.classificationBatchesByAuthorityId,
                    observers: observers
                ) {
                didMutate = true
            }
            try Self.validateOperationalInvariants(
                state,
                prevalidatedLegacyAuthorityOperation: operation,
                observers: observers
            )
            if didMutate {
                try writeStateDurably(
                    state,
                    invokeFaultHooks: true
                )
            }
        }
    }

    // The storage-v1 staging owner is the sole caller. It can supply one
    // already-validated snapshot, but no caller can inject a classification
    // batch or the file-private operation capability.
    func transactionForValidatedPendingLegacyAuthorityCapture(
        _ snapshot: ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot,
        observers: LegacyAuthorityProcessingObservers,
        _ update: (inout DomainLedgerStateV2) throws -> Void
    ) throws {
        try locked {
            var state = try loadV2()
            var operation =
                PrevalidatedLegacyAuthorityOperation()
            guard operation.snapshotsByAuthorityId.updateValue(
                    snapshot,
                    forKey: snapshot.authority.authorityId
                  ) == nil else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            try update(&state)
            _ = try LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator
                .resumeEligiblePendingComponents(
                    state: &state,
                    snapshotsByAuthorityId:
                        &operation.snapshotsByAuthorityId,
                    classificationBatchesByAuthorityId:
                        &operation.classificationBatchesByAuthorityId,
                    observers: observers
                )
            try Self.validateOperationalInvariants(
                state,
                prevalidatedLegacyAuthorityOperation: operation,
                observers: observers
            )
            try writeStateDurably(
                state,
                invokeFaultHooks: true
            )
        }
    }

    func transaction(
        _ update: (inout DomainLedgerStateV2) throws -> Void
    ) throws {
        let observers =
            LegacyAuthorityProcessingObserverScope.current
        try locked {
            var state = try loadV2()
            var operation =
                PrevalidatedLegacyAuthorityOperation()
            try update(&state)
            _ = try LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator
                .resumeEligiblePendingComponents(
                    state: &state,
                    snapshotsByAuthorityId:
                        &operation.snapshotsByAuthorityId,
                    classificationBatchesByAuthorityId:
                        &operation.classificationBatchesByAuthorityId,
                    observers: observers
                )
            try Self.validateOperationalInvariants(
                state,
                prevalidatedLegacyAuthorityOperation: operation,
                observers: observers
            )
            try writeStateDurably(
                state,
                invokeFaultHooks: true
            )
        }
    }
}
```

同一retained validator的pending-authority round gate必须把Task 11旧的round-wide `durableRoundEvents.allSatisfy { $0.kind == .roundStarted }` / transport / projection三组限制exact替换为下列定义。在既有pending-authority loop之前，validator invocation必须恰好一次以O(n)扫描canonical、local ordinary与verified-peer三份独立support root，构造identity→hash index；不得按authority、round、durable/transport/projection fact重复线性扫描evidence collection。canonical dictionary key必须等于record event identity，其他两份dictionary key必须等于各自record evidence key；同identity+hash跨root重复是合法幂等，same identity/different hash立即fail closed。full validator随后仍逐项验证这些support roots，不能把裸event误当成independent authority：

```swift
var independentlySupportedPendingFactHashesByIdentity =
    [String: String]()

func insertIndependentPendingSupport(
    eventIdentity: String,
    eventHash: String
) throws {
    if let existingHash =
        independentlySupportedPendingFactHashesByIdentity[
            eventIdentity
        ] {
        guard existingHash == eventHash else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        return
    }
    independentlySupportedPendingFactHashesByIdentity[
        eventIdentity
    ] = eventHash
}

for (identity, evidence) in state.canonicalOriginEvidence {
    guard identity == evidence.eventIdentity else {
        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
    }
    try insertIndependentPendingSupport(
        eventIdentity: evidence.eventIdentity,
        eventHash: evidence.eventHash
    )
}
for (evidenceKey, evidence) in
    state.localOrdinaryOutboxEvidence {
    guard evidenceKey == evidence.evidenceKey else {
        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
    }
    try insertIndependentPendingSupport(
        eventIdentity: evidence.eventIdentity,
        eventHash: evidence.eventHash
    )
}
for (evidenceKey, evidence) in
    state.verifiedPeerBundleEvidence {
    guard evidenceKey == evidence.evidenceKey else {
        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
    }
    try insertIndependentPendingSupport(
        eventIdentity: evidence.eventIdentity,
        eventHash: evidence.eventHash
    )
}

func independentlySupportedPendingFact(
    _ event: DomainRoundEvent
) throws -> Bool {
    let identity = try event.eventIdentity()
    let hash = try event.eventHash()
    return independentlySupportedPendingFactHashesByIdentity[
        identity
    ] == hash
}
```

只有完成上述single index construction后，才进入既有的`for (authorityId, pending) in state.pendingLegacyAuthorityMigrations` loop；不能把index或insert helper下沉到该loop。外层既有`referencedLegacyAuthorities.contains(authorityId) == false`与`!legacyEvidenceAuthorityIds.contains(authorityId)` guard继续禁止该pending authority自己的sealed evidence/import roots。loop内每个round已经取得`durableRoundEvents`、`transportRows`与`roundProjectionEvents`后，只执行下列O(1) keyed support lookup：

```swift
for event in durableRoundEvents where event.kind != .roundStarted {
    guard try independentlySupportedPendingFact(event) else {
        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
    }
}
for row in transportRows where row.event.kind != .roundStarted {
    guard row.source.sourceClass != .sealedLegacyMigration,
          try independentlySupportedPendingFact(row.event) else {
        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
    }
}
for event in roundProjectionEvents where event.kind != .roundStarted {
    guard try independentlySupportedPendingFact(event) else {
        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
    }
}
guard durableRoundEvents.filter({
        $0.kind == .roundStarted
      }).count <= 1,
      try LegacyRoundStartContextResolver.context(
        roundId: roundId,
        events: state.events
      ) != nil || durableRoundEvents.isEmpty else {
    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
}
```

Task 11 validator中原有的inline `var anomalyIds = Set<String>()` loop同时exact替换为`try LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator.validateTransportAnomalyRoot(state.transportAnomalies)`，与`resumeEligiblePendingComponents`入口共享唯一typed-ID/body owner；因此same ID/different body destination corruption在classification builder之前fail closed，而exact pre-existing anomaly可通过preflight并在operational merge中exact reuse。

在保留的validator body中，把从旧`prevalidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshots` guard开始、到`completedLegacyClassificationBatches`构造结束的整段exact替换为下列代码：

```swift
let prevalidatedSnapshots =
    prevalidatedLegacyAuthorityOperation.snapshotsByAuthorityId
let prevalidatedBatches =
    prevalidatedLegacyAuthorityOperation
        .classificationBatchesByAuthorityId
guard Set(prevalidatedSnapshots.keys).isSubset(
        of: sealedAuthorityIds
      ), Set(prevalidatedBatches.keys).isSubset(
        of: completedAuthorityIds
      ), Set(prevalidatedBatches.keys).isSubset(
        of: Set(prevalidatedSnapshots.keys)
      ) else {
    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
}
var validatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshotsById:
    [String: ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot] = [:]
for (authorityId, snapshot) in prevalidatedSnapshots {
    guard authorityId == snapshot.authority.authorityId,
          state.sealedLegacyAuthorities[authorityId]
            == snapshot.authority,
          validatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshotsById.updateValue(
            snapshot,
            forKey: authorityId
          ) == nil else {
        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
    }
}
for (authorityId, authority) in state.sealedLegacyAuthorities
where validatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshotsById[authorityId] == nil {
    guard authorityId == authority.authorityId,
          let authorityData = Data(
            base64Encoded: authority.authorityFileBase64
          ) else {
        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
    }
    let snapshot = try LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator
        .validatedSnapshot(
            authority: authority,
            authorityData: authorityData,
            observers: observers
        )
    guard validatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshotsById.updateValue(
            snapshot,
            forKey: authorityId
          ) == nil else {
        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
    }
}
guard Set(validatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshotsById.keys)
        == sealedAuthorityIds else {
    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
}

var expectedLegacyTransportEvidenceByRawSha256:
    [String: LegacyStorageEvidence] = [:]
for snapshot in validatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshotsById.values {
    if snapshot.authority.authorityKind
        == LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator.storageV1AuthorityKind {
        guard let parsed =
                snapshot.storageV1ParsedTransportEvidence else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        let expected = LegacyStorageEvidence(
            storageVersion: 1,
            rawStorageBase64:
                snapshot.authority.authorityFileBase64,
            rawStorageSha256:
                snapshot.authority.authorityFileSha256,
            parsedTransportEvidence: parsed
        )
        guard expectedLegacyTransportEvidenceByRawSha256
                .updateValue(
                    expected,
                    forKey: expected.rawStorageSha256
                ) == nil else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
    } else {
        guard snapshot.storageV1ParsedTransportEvidence == nil else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
    }
}
guard state.legacyTransportEvidence.count
        == expectedLegacyTransportEvidenceByRawSha256.count else {
    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
}
var seenLegacyTransportEvidenceSha256 = Set<String>()
for evidence in state.legacyTransportEvidence {
    guard seenLegacyTransportEvidenceSha256.insert(
            evidence.rawStorageSha256
          ).inserted,
          let expected =
            expectedLegacyTransportEvidenceByRawSha256[
                evidence.rawStorageSha256
            ], expected == evidence else {
        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
    }
}
guard seenLegacyTransportEvidenceSha256
        == Set(expectedLegacyTransportEvidenceByRawSha256.keys) else {
    throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
}

var completedLegacyClassificationBatches:
    [String: LegacyAuthorityClassificationBatch] = [:]
for authorityId in completedAuthorityIds {
    guard let snapshot =
            validatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshotsById[authorityId] else {
        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
    }
    let batch: LegacyAuthorityClassificationBatch
    if let prevalidated = prevalidatedBatches[authorityId] {
        guard prevalidated.authority == snapshot.authority,
              prevalidated.sourceRecords
                == snapshot.sourceRecords else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
        }
        batch = prevalidated
    } else {
        // Includes an exact same-bytes fixed reopen: its snapshot is already
        // cached in the operation, but no completion batch was produced by
        // this operation, so build exactly one classification batch here.
        batch = try LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator
            .classificationBatch(
                snapshot: snapshot,
                durableEvents: state.events,
                legacyWireBindings: state.legacyWireBindings,
                observers: observers
            )
    }
    guard completedLegacyClassificationBatches.updateValue(
            batch,
            forKey: authorityId
          ) == nil else {
        throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
    }
}
```

newly-completed authority只有在operation batch存在时才复用；operation只带same-bytes fixed snapshot但没有batch时，必须从同一snapshot cache构造一次batch。public validation、staging validation与所有不带capture的callsite显式传`.init()`；不得保留带默认值的旧snapshot-map签名。

Task 11的`productionStore`与两个transaction overload由上面代码整体替换：删除`try store.validateStorageV2()` cold path、删除`transaction(prevalidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshots:observers:_:)`，且全module只保留一个`transaction(_:)`。Task 11的storage-v1 capture callsite改为调用唯一internal `transactionForValidatedPendingLegacyAuthorityCapture`；该入口只接收一个validated snapshot，不能接收classification batch，且由store内部构造file-private operation。

Task 11的validator入口同步改为接收`prevalidatedLegacyAuthorityOperation`。由于该operation保持`fileprivate`，replacement必须是`fileprivate static func validateOperationalInvariants`，不得为解决编译可见性而放宽operation或validator。对operation内带classification batch的新完成authority，validator逐项要求map key等于authority ID、snapshot authority等于sealed record、batch authority/source roster等于completed record、batch results等于terminal disposition/evidence/fact；通过后直接复用batch，不再调用classifier。对operation外既有completed authority，以及same-bytes fixed retry中“operation有snapshot但没有completion batch”的既有completed authority，都从唯一snapshot cache恰好构造一次batch。prevalidated capability不得成为store property、public/test参数或durable state。

ordinary transaction在caller update之后、post-validation之前执行resume，因此最后一条合法`round_started`与整component completion处于同一个locked atomic replace。fixed source必须通过lazy optional provider进入canonical-root owner，`openMigratingApplicationSupportRoot`本身不得提前seal/read/scan。cold startup只能是storage migration → construct store → single load → expected-origin guard → provider → optional fixed capture → resume → validate；禁止先`validateStorageV2()`再开第二个transaction。cached composition-root先读取inspection并校验expected origin，之后恰好求值provider一次；provider返回nil且无pending时直接返回，不进入validator且observer零callback，有pending或snapshot时才把已求值结果用`{ fixedIOSSnapshot }`交给required-validation入口，禁止重复读取fixed source。这个fast path绝不能被放进cold productionStore。

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/DomainLedgerCompositionRoot.swift
extension DomainLedgerCompositionRoot {
    // Replace both Task 11 open overloads with these final Task 12 owners.
    public static func open(
        directoryURL: URL,
        expectedOriginDeviceId: String,
        faultHook: @escaping (
            DomainLedgerFaultPoint
        ) throws -> Void = { _ in }
    ) throws -> DomainLedgerStore {
        try open(
            directoryURL: directoryURL,
            expectedOriginDeviceId: expectedOriginDeviceId,
            trustedPeerServerKeys: [:],
            faultHook: faultHook
        )
    }

    static func open(
        directoryURL: URL,
        expectedOriginDeviceId: String,
        trustedPeerServerKeys: [String: Data],
        faultHook: @escaping (
            DomainLedgerFaultPoint
        ) throws -> Void = { _ in }
    ) throws -> DomainLedgerStore {
        let observers =
            LegacyAuthorityProcessingObserverScope.current
        return try openCanonicalRoot(
            directoryURL: directoryURL,
            expectedOriginDeviceId: expectedOriginDeviceId,
            trustedPeerServerKeys: trustedPeerServerKeys,
            fixedIOSSnapshotProvider: nil,
            observers: observers,
            faultHook: faultHook
        )
    }

    static func openMigratingApplicationSupportRoot(
        _ applicationSupportRootURL: URL,
        expectedOriginDeviceId: String,
        trustedPeerServerKeys: [String: Data] = [:],
        faultHook: @escaping (
            DomainLedgerFaultPoint
        ) throws -> Void
    ) throws -> DomainLedgerStore {
        let observers =
            LegacyAuthorityProcessingObserverScope.current
        let applicationRoot = applicationSupportRootURL
            .standardizedFileURL.resolvingSymlinksInPath()
        let ledgerRoot = applicationRoot.appendingPathComponent(
            "round-ledger-v2",
            isDirectory: true
        )
        let fixedIOSSnapshotProvider:
            () throws -> ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot? = {
            try LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator
                .fixedIOSSnapshotIfPresent(
                    applicationSupportRootURL: applicationRoot,
                    observers: observers
                )
        }
        return try openCanonicalRoot(
            directoryURL: ledgerRoot,
            expectedOriginDeviceId: expectedOriginDeviceId,
            trustedPeerServerKeys: trustedPeerServerKeys,
            fixedIOSSnapshotProvider:
                fixedIOSSnapshotProvider,
            observers: observers,
            faultHook: faultHook
        )
    }

    private static func openCanonicalRoot(
        directoryURL: URL,
        expectedOriginDeviceId: String,
        trustedPeerServerKeys: [String: Data],
        fixedIOSSnapshotProvider:
            (() throws -> ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot?)?,
        observers: LegacyAuthorityProcessingObservers,
        faultHook: @escaping (
            DomainLedgerFaultPoint
        ) throws -> Void
    ) throws -> DomainLedgerStore {
        let root = directoryURL.standardizedFileURL
            .resolvingSymlinksInPath()
        lock.lock()
        defer { lock.unlock() }
        if let existing = storesByCanonicalRoot[root] {
            let inspection =
                try existing.cachedLegacyOpenInspection()
            guard inspection.originDeviceId
                    == expectedOriginDeviceId,
                  existing.hasExactTrustedPeerServerKeys(
                    trustedPeerServerKeys
                  ) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.storageInvariantViolation
            }
            let fixedIOSSnapshot:
                ValidatedLegacyAuthoritySnapshot?
            if let fixedIOSSnapshotProvider {
                fixedIOSSnapshot = try fixedIOSSnapshotProvider()
            } else {
                fixedIOSSnapshot = nil
            }
            if fixedIOSSnapshot != nil
                || inspection.hasPendingLegacyAuthority {
                try existing.resumeLegacyAuthoritiesAndValidate(
                    expectedOriginDeviceId:
                        expectedOriginDeviceId,
                    fixedIOSSnapshotProvider: {
                        fixedIOSSnapshot
                    },
                    observers: observers
                )
            }
            return existing
        }
        try DomainLedgerStorageMigration.migrateIfNeeded(
            stateURL: DomainLedgerStore.stateURL(in: root),
            expectedOriginDeviceId: expectedOriginDeviceId,
            faultHook: faultHook
        )
        let store = try DomainLedgerStore.productionStore(
            directoryURL: root,
            expectedOriginDeviceId: expectedOriginDeviceId,
            trustedPeerServerKeys: trustedPeerServerKeys,
            fixedIOSSnapshotProvider:
                fixedIOSSnapshotProvider,
            observers: observers,
            faultHook: faultHook
        )
        storesByCanonicalRoot[root] = store
        return store
    }
}
```

Task 12同时把既有public `DomainLedgerCompositionRoot.open(directoryURL:expectedOriginDeviceId:faultHook:)`改为调用`openCanonicalRoot(... fixedIOSSnapshotProvider:nil ...)`；fixed application-support entry只构造lazy provider。`DomainLedgerStore.productionStore`构造store后只调用一次`resumeLegacyAuthoritiesAndValidate`，由store在同一次load的expected-origin guard之后求值原provider，并删除旧的先行`validateStorageV2()`。这样regular iOS/Watch cold open也会恢复Task 11捕获的storage-v1 pending authority，而fixed entry额外提供exact iOS snapshot；两个入口仍共享single-root owner。

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddie/Services/RoundLedgerMigration.swift

enum RoundLedgerMigration {

        applicationSupportRootURL: URL,
        expectedOriginDeviceId: String,

            DomainLedgerFaultPoint
        ) throws -> Void = { _ in }
    ) throws -> DomainLedgerStore {
        try LegacyRoundMigrationCoordinator
            .openMigratingApplicationSupportRoot(
                applicationSupportRootURL,

```

fixed source file不存在时不创建marker或空authority；存在时whole bytes只能对应一个`ios-events-jsonl-v1` authority。相同bytes retry复用typed authority/pending/completed，bytes变化产生不同authority ID并因同kind冲突fail closed。App层只能传application-support root、expected device ID和fault hook，不能选择authority kind、source line、candidate、dead letter、context或completion marker。

`MigrationDeadLetter/v1`继续使用Task 11冻结的`sourceLine/eventId/roundId/reasonCode/rawBase64` canonical shape。`LiveRoundEvent`变为v1 adapter；所有新写入由`LiveRoundEventBuilder`直接创建`DomainRoundEvent`，生成并持久化originEpoch、clientSequence与RoundSemanticBindingHash。

`RoundLedgerSyncClient` 增加可测试 transport boundary：

```swift
    func flushOutbox(roundId: String) async throws {
        do {
            guard let request = try ledger.prepareEventWriteRequest(roundId: roundId) else { return }
            try ledger.apply(validatedResponse: try await transport.post(request))
        } catch let error as EventWriteResponseValidationError {
            try ledger.recordTransportAnomaly(
                roundId: roundId,
                code: "transport_receipt_hash_mismatch",
                evidence: String(describing: error)

        } catch DomainLedgerError.transportLimitExceeded {
            try ledger.recordTransportAnomaly(
                roundId: roundId,
                code: "local_transport_invariant_violation",
                evidence: "first ordinary outbox record exceeds exact batch body limit"
            )
            throw DomainLedgerError.transportLimitExceeded
        }
    }
```

Protocol/mock 不是生产实现。`SyncClient.swift` 的 final stored-property shape、durable consumer epoch 与 URLSession transport 固定如下：

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddie/Services/ConsumerEpochStore.swift
import Foundation

final class ConsumerEpochStore {
    private let url: URL

    init(url: URL) throws {
        self.url = url
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: url.deletingLastPathComponent(), withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        if !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path) {
            try Data(UUID().uuidString.lowercased().utf8).write(to: url, options: .atomic)
        }
    }

    func current() throws -> String {
        let value = try String(contentsOf: url, encoding: .utf8)
        guard UUID(uuidString: value) != nil, value == value.lowercased() else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.bootstrapRequired
        }
        return value
    }

    func rotateAfterLocalReplicaReset() throws -> String {
        let value = UUID().uuidString.lowercased()
        try Data(value.utf8).write(to: url, options: .atomic)
        return value
    }
}
```
